details.body: FABACEOUS , a. mOdgInaH -nA -naM, mAzIRaH -RA -RaM, SimbAsaguRaH -RA -RaM
FABIAN (adj.): *PAbIyaH (yA, yaM); dIrGasUtraH (trA, traM).

Fable, s. kaTA, AKyAyikA, upAKyAnaM, kalpitakaTA, purAvfttAKyAnaM, prabaMDakalpanA. v. t. manasA kxp c. or rac 10 or sfj 6 P. Fabulous, a. EtihAsika (kI f.), kaTAnibadDa, AKyAnakIrtita. 2 alIka manaH-kalpita, manasA sfzwa, kAlpanika (kI f.), kftrima. Fabulist, s. kaTAracakaH, EtihAsikaH.
FABLE: II Lit.: kaTA: v. Story.II False- -hood: q.v.

FABLE , s. (Feigned story) purAvfttakaTA, purAvfttopAKyAnaM, kUwATI pAKyAnaM. upAKyAnaM, AKyAnaM, AKyAyikA, kaTA, parikaTA, itihAsaH — (Fiction) kalpanAsfzwiH f., pravanDakalpanA, manaHkalpitaM, vyapadeSaH.
To FABLE , v. a. and n. purAvfttakaTAM rac (c. 10. racayati -yituM), virac manasA kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM) or sfj (c. 6. sfjati, srazwuM) miTyAkaTA rac.
FABLED , p. p. manaHkalpitaH -tA -taM, kAlpanikaH -kI -kaM, kUwArTaH -rTA -rTaM.

Fabric, s. BavanaM, gfhaM, harmyaM, mAMdiraM, prAsAdaH, DAman n., SAlA. 2 nirmARaM, racanaM. 3 Uti f., pawAkAraH. 4 Cloth, q. v. Fabricate, v. t. nirmA 3 A or 2 P or c. (mApayati), virac 10, kf 8 U, kxp c., vi-DA 3 U, sfj 6 P. 2 manasA sfj or kxp c., kapawena-miTyA kxp c.; ‘to f(abricate) evidence’ kUwapramARaM nirmA, kapawasAkzyaM kf; See Counterfeit. [Fabricat]ion, s. kapawaracanA, alIkaM, kftrimanirmARaM manaHkalpanA, kUwaM. 2 nirmARaM, kalpanA-naM, racanA. [Fabricat]or, s. nirmAtf m., racakaH. 2 kUwakft m.
FABRIC: I Texture: q.v.II Edifice: q.v.: Bavanam.III Cloth: q.v.: pawwaH.
FABRIC , s. (Structure) nirmmARaM, nirmmitiH f., kalyanA. — (Edifice) harmyaM, SAlA, BavanaM, mandiraM, prAsAdaH, DAma n. (n), awwAlikA. — (Form, texture) AkAraH, AkftiH f., UtiH f.
FABRICATE: I To build, produce: q.v.: racayati (rac, c. 10.).II To invent: sfjati (sfj, c. 6.): v. Counterfeit; false.

To FABRICATE , v. a. (Construct) nirmA (c. 2. -mAti -tuM, c. 3. -mimIte, c. 4. -mIyate caus. -mApayati -yituM), kf (c. 8. karoti, karttuM caus. kArayati -yituM), kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM), virac (c. 10. -racayati -yituM), sfj (c. 6. sfjati, srazwuM), Gaw (c. 1. Gawate -wituM). — (Invent) manasA kxp, miTyA kxp or kf.
To FABRICATE , v. a. for -mIyate, read -mAyate.
FABRICATED , p. p. (Constructed) nirmmitaH -tA -taM, racitaH -tA -taM, viracitaH -tA -taM, GawitaH -tA -taM, kalpitaH -tA -taM. — (Invented) manaHkalpitaH -tA -taM, kftrimaH -mA -maM.
FABRICATION: I Construction, manufacture: q.v.: racanA, vi-.II Falsehood: this is a f.: alIkametat: v. False, counterfeit.
FABRICATION , s. (Construction) nirmmARaM, nirmmitiH f., racanA, viracanA, kalpanaM -nA, GawanaM. — (Falsehood, forgery) manaHkalyitaM, miTyAkaTA.
FABRICATOR: racayitf (m.): v. Maker.
FABRICATOR , s. nirmmAtA m. (tf), nirmmARakArI m. (n), racakaH, viracakaH.
FABULIST: (1) kaTAkAraH (?);(2) AKyAnakAnAM kartA, K.;(3) AKyAyikAkAraH, C.
FABULIST , s. purAvfttakaTAviracakaH, itihAsaracakaH, EtihAsikaH.
FABULOUS: I Fictitious: q.v.II Related in fable: kaTAnibadDaH (dDA, dDaM); AKyAnakIrtitaH (tA, taM).

FABULOUS , a. (Fictitious) kftrimaH -mA -maM, manaHkalpitaH -tA -taM, kAlpa- -nikaH -kI -kaM, aprasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, kUwArTaH -rTA -rTaM. — (Relating to fable) purAvfttakaTAsambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), EtihAsikaH -kI -kaM, kATikaH -kI -kaM.
FABULOUSLY , adv. kftrimaprakAreRa, kalpanApUrvvaM, itihAsAnusAreRa.
FAC-SIMILE: pratirUpam (?).
FAC-SIMILE , s. pratilipiH f., hastAkzarapratirUpaM.
Facade, s. harmyamuKaM.
FACADE: muKam.
FACADE , s. (Of a building) harmyamuKaM, prAsAdamUrdDA m. (n).

Face, s. muKaM, vadanaM, AnanaM, vaktraM, AsyaM, tuMqaM. 2 talaM, pIWaM, pfzWaM. 3 avasTA, sTiti f., daSA; ‘before oneʼs f(ace)’ agre, agrataH, pu-rataH, samakzaM, pratyakzaM, saMmuKaM-Ke; ‘long f(ace)’ vi-zaRRavadanaM; ‘f(ace) to f(ace)’ muKAmuKi, saMmuKaM; ‘in the f(ace) of’ anAdftya, avigaRayya; See ‘in spite of’; ‘in the f(ace) of so many difficulties’ evaMviDAnyapi kfcCrARyaviga-Rayya; ‘turn away the f(ace)’ vimuKIBU; ‘stand f(ace) to f(ace)’ saMmuKI-aBimuKI-BU. v. t. saMmuKayati-aBimuKayati (D.); pratimuKI-saMmuKI-aBimuKI-BU 1 P, (with gen.), saMmuKaM sTA 1 P, aBimuKaM gam 1 P; paryavasTA 1 A. 2 saMmuKa-aBimuKa-pratimuKa a. BU 1 P, or by muKa-aBimuKa in comp.; ‘a house f(ac)ing the east’ pUrvABimuKaM gfhaM; ‘stand f(ac)ing the east’ prANmuKastizWa; ‘one who boldly f(ace)s the enemy’ aByamitryaH; aByamitrIRaH-yaH. [Fac]ed, a. (s.) in comp.; ‘moon-f(aced)’ caMdrAnanA, iMdumuKI. 2 pawAcCanna, aDivastrAnvita. [Face]less, a. nirmuKa, AnanahIna.

FACE (subs.): I In gen.:(1) muKam, struck Yudhisṭhira on the f.: yuDizWiraM muKe'hanam, Mah.: with a f. beautiful as the moon: indusundaramuKI, Ma.; how (we) will shew our f. to men: kaTaM lokasya muKaM drakzyAmaH, Ana.; makes thousands of f. s: muKaBaNgisahasrARi kurute, K.; is it proper for a king to turn his f. from duty: kiM DarmaM prati vimuKa- tocitA rAJaH, Sa.; you have come before my f. (= eyes: v. Eye): matsammuKaBAgato'si, Ve.; the f.s of the quarters: diSAM muKAni, N.;(2) Ananam;(3) vadanam;(4) vaktram;(5) Asyam. Ph.: in the f. of the Vedāntas: vedAntozu jAgarukezu, D.s.II In Geo.: pASrvaH, K. d.: *muKam, hav- ing six f. s: zaRmuKaH (KI, KaM).

FACE (v.): I To confront:(1) sammuKayati (nomi.);(2) aBimuKayati (nomi.);(3) sammuKI- or aBimuKIBavati (with gen.), made it f. me with difficulty: kaTamapi madaBimuKamakarot, D.: v. To meet. II To front upon: expr. by muKa- or aBimuKa- in comp., f. ing the east: pUrvamuKa (f. KI); f. the north: uttaramuKa (f. KI); f. ing Lakṣmaṇa: lakzaRABimuKaH, Ram.III To cover the f. of: v. To cover.

FACE , s. (Visage) muKaM, vadanaM, AnanaM, vaktaM, AsyaM, vandanaM, cubraM, Sman indec.; ‘face like the moon,’ vadanacandraH, vadanenduH m. — (Air, look) vadanaM, dfzwiH f., AkAraH, ABA. — (Surface) talaM, muKaM, pfzWaM, pIWaM; ‘face of the earth,’ BUtalaM, pfTivItalaM, kzitipIWaM. — (State) avasTA, sTitiH f., daSA, BAvaH, rUpaM; ‘before the face,’ pratimuKaM, sammuKaM -Ke, aBimuKaM, sAkzAt, samakzaM, pratyakzaM -kzeRa -kzatas, agre, agratas; ‘face to face,’ sammuKaM, muKAmuKi; ‘in face of,’ sammuKaH -KA -KI -KaM, sammuKInaH -nA -naM, aBimuKaH -KA -KI -KaM; ‘having the face averted,’ vimuKaH -KI -KaM, parANmuKaH -KI -KaM; ‘to turn away the face,’ vimuKIBU; ‘to stand face to face,’ sammuKIBU; ‘to fall with one's face on the ground,’ BUmO nyaNmuKaH or aDomuKaH [Page255-a+ 51] pat (c. 1. patati -tituM); ‘a wry face,’ vikftAnanaM.

To FACE , v. a. sammuKIBU, aBimuKIBU, pratimuKIBU. — (Meet, oppose) aBimuKaM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), aBivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), paryya- -vasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM); ‘one who faces the foe,’ aByami- -trIRaH, aByamitrIyaH, aByamitryaH. — (Be opposite to) expressed by muKa or aBimuKa in comp.; ‘to face the south,’ dakziRAmuKaH -KI -KaM BU; ‘the north,’ udaNmuKaH -KI -kaM BU, uttarABimuKaH -KI -KaM BU; ‘the east,’ prANmuKaH -KI -KaM BU. — (Covered with ad- -ditional cloth) aDivastreRa or aDikapawena Cad (c. 10. CAdayati -yituM).

FACED , a. aDivastropetaH -tA -taM, uttaravastrAnvitaH -tA -taM. — (Having a face) used in comp.; as, ‘lovely faced,’ sumuKaH -KI -KaM, mugDAnanaH -nI -naM; ‘lotus-faced,’ AnanAbjaH -bjA -bjaM; ‘moon faced,’ candramuKaH -KI -KaM.
FACELESS , s. nirmuKaH -KA -KI -KaM, nirvadanaH -nA -naM, muKahInaH -nA -naM.
Facet, s. kaRaH, muKaM.
FACET.: as of a diamond: muKam.
FACET , s. (Small surface of a gem) kaRaH.
Facetious, a. vinodin, parihAsaSIla, narma-prAya, sarasa, rasavat, hAsotpAdaka, narma in comp. [Facetious]ly, adv. sarasaM, vinodArTaM, parihAsa-pUrvaM. [Facetious]ness, s. parihAsaSIlatA.
FACETIOUS: I Merry, jocular: parihAsaSIlaH (lA, laM).II Exciting laughter: f. conver- sation: narmaBAzitam, K.

FACETIOUS , a. rAsakaH -kA -kaM, rasI -sinI -si (n), rasavAn -vatI -vat (t), sarasaH -sA -saM, parihAsaSIlaH -lA -laM, parihAsavedI -dinI -di (n), prahAsI -sinI -si (n), vinodI -dinI -di (n), vidUpakaH -kA -kaM; ‘facetious conversation,’ sarasAlApaH, citraM.
FACETIOUSLY: parihAsapUrvakam: v. Merrily, gaily.
FACETIOUSLY , adv. sarasaM, hAsakaraRArTaM, vinodArTaM, rasikaprakAreRa.
FACETIOUSNESS , s. rasikatvaM, rasavattvaM, sarasatA, parihAsaSIlatA, vinodakatvaM, hAsyatA, hAsotpAdakatvaM, ullasatA.

Facile, a. sukara, susADya, anAyAsa; See Easy. 2 anukUla, anuvartin. [Facil]ity, s. Ease, q. v. 2 lAGavaM; ‘f(acility) of hand’ hasta-lAGavaM, kzipratA, sahajatA. Facilitate, v. t. sukara a. kf 8 U, viGnAn apanI 1 P, or naS c., nirviGnIkf; better ex. by words for ‘Easy’ q. v.; ‘this will f(acilitate) their communication’ anena tezAmanyonyavyava-hAro'yatnasADyo Bavet-sukaro Bavet. [Facilitat]ed, a. nirviGna, hftapratyUha, sukarIkfta.
FACILE: I Easy:(1) sukaraH (rA, raM);(2) ayatna- sADyaH (DyA, DyaM);(3) anAyAsanizpAdyaH (dyA, dyaM). II Easy to pass: sugamaH (mA, maM).III Mild, affable: q.v.: mfdu (f. dvI).

FACILE , a. suKaH -KA -KaM, sukaraH -rA -raM, nirAyAsaH -sA -saM, anAyAsI -sinI -si (n), susADyaH -DyA -DyaM, sugamaH -mA -maM, suKena kAryyaH -ryyA ryyaM, akaWinaH -nA -naM. — (Complying) abukUlaH -lA -laM. — (Easy of access) aBigamyaH -myA -myaM.
FACILITATE: expr. by adj., it will f. their union: anena samAgamastayorayatnasADyaH.

To FACILITATE , v. a. sukaraM -rAM -raM kf, nirAyAsIkf, suKIkf, duHKAni or durgARi or viGnAn or SalyAni vinI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM) or apanI or hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM) or naS (c. 10. nASayati -yituM), nirviGnIkf, nizpratpUhIkf.
FACILITATED , p. p. sukarIkftaH -tA -taM, hftaviGnaH -GnA -GnaM, hftapratyUhaH -hA -haM,
FACILITY: I Ease: q.v.: sOkaryam.II Dexteri- -ty: q.v.: lAGavam, shewing the f. of his hand: darSayan pARilAGavam, Ram.III Mildness, affa- -bility: mArdavam.
FACILITY , s. sOkaryyaM, sukaratvaM, sOKyaM, sOgamyaM, sugamatvaM, susADyatA, anAyAsaH, nirAyAsatvaM, akAWinyaM, akazwatvaM, avEzamyaM.
FACING (subs.): *muKacCadaH.

FACING , part. (Opposite to) aBimuKaH -KA -KI -KaM, sammuKaH -KA -KaM, sammuKInaH -nA -naM, aBimuKagataH -tA -taM, pratimuKaH -KA -KaM, ‘facing the north,’ uttarABimuKaH -KA -KaM, or expressed by muKa; as, ‘facing the east,’ prANmuKaH -KA -KaM; ‘the west,’ pratyaNmuKaH; ‘the south,’ dakziRAmuKaH; ‘the north,’ udaNmuKaH; ‘with the head facing the east,’ prAkSirasaH -sA -saM.
FACING , s. (Additional covering in from of a garment) vastrA- -graBAge syUtam aDikAMSukaM or aDivasanaM. — (End of a sleeve) pippa- -lAntaM. — (Of a fortification) durgamuKaM.
Facsimile, s. pratilipi f., pratirUpaM.

Fact, s. taTyaM, yaTArTatA, satyaM, tattvaM, BUtArTaH; ‘it was a statement of f(act)s’ BUtArTavyA-hftiH sA (R. x. 33). 2 vfttaM, vastu n., arTaH, karman n.; ‘in fact’ vastutaH, tattvataH, ‘as a matter of f(act)’ vastuvfttena, paramArTataH, tattvataH.

FACT (subs.): I Reality, truth: q.v.: BUtArTaH, it was speaking the f.: BUtArTavyAhftiH sA hi, R.; why don't you represent the f.: kimarTaM BUtArTo na nivedyate, Mr. ix.II An act, event: q.v.: vfttam.
FACT, IN: (1) vastutaH, but in f.: vastutastu, Da. com.; (2) pratyuta, it is in f. (your) abuse: pratyuta sA tiraskriyA, Si.

FACT , s. vastu n. BUtaM, arTaH, vfttaM, karmma n. (n), kftaM, kftavastu n. — (Reality) tattvaM, sattvaM, sattA, satyatA, yaTArTatA, yATArTyaM, prakftatvaM; ‘in fact,’ vastutas, arTatas, tattvatas, paramArTatas.

Faction, s. dalaM, pakzaH, SAKA. 2 BedaH, vi-roDaH, vipratipatti f., dvaMdvaM, dvEDaM, pakzaBedaH. Factious, a. kalahapriya, BedakArin, upa-jApin, upajApaka, Bedin. 2 pAkza (kzI f.). [Factious]ly, adv. sopajApaM. [Factious]ness, s. upajApaH, BedakAritA.
FACTION: I A body of combatants: dalam.II A party: q.v.: dalam.III Discord: q.v.: BedaH.

FACTION , s. (A party) pakzaH, SAKA, gaRaH, dalaM; ‘one of the oppo- site faction,’ vipakzaH; ‘one's own faction,’ AtmapakzaH; ‘fol- lowing a faction,’ pakzapAtaH -titA, pakzapAtakftasnehaH, gaRatA. — (Political dissension) BedaH, dvEDaM, dvandvaM, viroDaH, rAjadrohaH.
FACTIOUS: I Given to faction:(1) kalahapriyaH (yA, yaM) (= quarrelsome),(2) upajApin (f. nI) (=intriguing).II Belonging to a f.: expr. by comp. or gen.

FACTIOUS , a. (Relating to faction) pAkzaH -kzI -kzaM. — (Promoting [Page255-b+ 51] faction, seditious) rAjyaBedakaraH -rI -raM rAjadrohI -hiRI -hi (n), kalahakArI -riRI -ri (n), BettA -ttrI -ttf (ttf), upajApakaH -kA -kaM, upadravI -viRI -vi (n).
FACTIOUSLY , adv. BedakaraRArTaM, kalahakaraRArTaM, sopajApaM, upajApakavata.
FACTIOUSNESS: (1) kalahapriyatA;(2) upajApitA.
FACTIOUSNESS , s. BedakaraRaSIlatA, rAjadrohaH, kalahakAritvaM, upajApaH.
Factitious, a. kftrima, kftaka, kalpita, racita, Silpanirmita.
FACTITIOUS: kftrimaH (mA, maM): v. Artificial, unnatural.
FACTITIOUS , a. kftrimaH -mA -maM, kftakaH -kA -kaM, kalpitaH -tA -taM, kAlpa- nikaH -kI -kaM, racitaH -tA -taM, GawitaH -tA -taM, SilpikaH -kA -kaM, SilpanirmmitaH -tA -taM, yOktikaH -kI -kaM.
FACTITIOUSLY , adv. kftrimaprakAreRa, Silpena, kalpanApUrvvaM.
FACTITIVE: Ph.: f. object: gORaM karman (n.).
Factor, s. niyogin m., pratiniDiH; ‘three is a f(actor) of six’ zaw triBirBAjyAH.
FACTOR: I A manager, agent: q.v.II In arith: expr. by circumlo: two is a f. of ten: daSa dvAByAM BAjyaH.
FACTOR , s. baRikpratiniDiH m., deSAntare bARijyakarmmanirvAhaRe niyukto janaH, niyogI m. (n), niyuktaH, pratipuruzaH.
FACTORAGE: pAritozikam (= reward): v. Also commission.
FACTORAGE , s. baRikpratiniDigfhItaH SulkaH, baRikkarmmanirvAhaRArTaM niyo- -giRe deyaM pAritozikaM.
Factory, s. Silpa-karma-SAlA-gfhaM, paRyanirmARasTAnaM.
FACTORY: *karmasTAnam.
FACTORY , s. (Manufactory) SilpagfhaM, SilpaSAlA, yantragfhaM, AveSanaM, prAveSanaM, anvAsanaM, paRyanirmmARaSAlA, bARijyadravyanirmmARagfhaM.
Factotum, s. sarvakarmakaraH.
FACTOTUM , s. marvvakarmmA m. f. (n), sarvvakarmmakaraH -rI, sarvvakarmmIRaH -RA.
Faculty, s. Sakti f., kzamatA, praBAvaH, sAmarTyaM. 2 aDikAraH. 3 gaRaH, samAjaH.
FACULTY: I Power: q.v.: SaktiH.II Autho- -rity: kzamatA.III A body of men: samAjaH, f. of medicine: *cikitsAsamAjaH.

FACULTY , s. (Power) SaktiH f., balaM, kzamatA, sAmarTyaM, praBAvaH, ASaktiH. — (Faculty of the mind) DISaktiH f., manaHSaktiH f., nizkramaH, saMskAraH, cittasaMskAraH. — (Facility of performance) yogyatA, yuktiH f., suprayogatA, kOSalyaM, pAwavaM. — (Privilege) aDikAraH. — (The body of doctors) vEdyagaRaH, cikitsakavargaH.
FACUND , a. vAkpawuH -wuH -wu, vAgmI -gminI -gmi (n). See ELOQUENT.
FACUNDITY , s. vAkpawutA, vAkpAwavaM, pawutvaM, vAgvidagDatA.
Fad, s. laharI, CaMdaH.
To FADDLE , v. n. ram (c. 1. ramate, rantuM), Kel (c. 1. Kelati -lituM), KelAM kf.

Fade, v. i. mlE-glE 1 P, vi-SF pass., nirgal 1 P, vicCAyatAM gam 1 P, vivarRIBU 1 P. 2 avasad 1 P, jF 4 P, naS 4 P, kzi pass., DvaMs 1 A, pra-lI 4 A, apa-ci pass. v. t. Causal of roots above. 2 tejo hf 1 P, varRaM naS c. or vilup c., vivarRIkf 8 U. [Fad]ed, a. nazwa, kzIRa, apacita. 2 mlAna, vi-varRa, vicCAya, gatavarRa, vItarAga. [Fad]ing, s. mlAni f., kzayaH, DvaMsaH, avasAdaH, hAni f.; ‘f(ading) of colours’ varRocCozaH, varRahAniH, varRikocCvAsaH.

FADE (v.i.): I To decay, droop: q.v.: ava- sIdati (sad, c. 1.).II To lose freshness: (1) mlAyati, pari-, (mlE, c. 1.), with f. d beauty of faces: parimlAnamuKaSriyAm, Ku.;(2) malinIBavati, the f. ing garland: mAlAM malinIBavantIm, N.
FADE (v. t.): (1) mlApayati, pari- (c. of mlE), fad- ing the chaplet: vanamAlAM mlApayan, Si.;(2) malinayati (nomi.) or malinIkaroti, Ki.

To FADE , v. n. (Decay, wither) mlE (c. 1. mlAyati, mlAtuM), parimlE, viSa in pass. (-SIryyate), kzi in pass. (kzIyate), sad (c. 1. sIdati, sattuM) avasad, vyavasad, jF (c. 4. jIryyati, jarituM -rItuM), naS (c. 4. naSyati naSituM), praRaS, vinaS DvaMs (c. 1. -DvaMsate -situM), viDvaMs, Sad (c. 1. SIyate, SattuM), glE (c. 1. glAyati, glAtuM), pralI (c. 4. -lIyate -letuM), gal (c. 1. galati -lituM). — (Lose colour) vivarRIBU, nIraktIBU.

To FADE , v. a. (Cause to wither) kzi in caus. (kzapayati, kzayayati -yituM), avasad in caus. (-sAdayati -yituM), DvaMs in caus. (DvaMsayati -yituM), glE in caus. (glapayati -yituM), mlAnIkf, viSIrRIkf, tejo hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM). — (Deprive of colour) vivarRIkf, varRaM duz in caus. (dUzayati -yituM) or naS in caus. (nASayati -yituM).

FADED , p. p. mlAnaH -nA -naM, parimlAnaH -nA -naM, SIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, viSIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, kzIRaH -RA -RaM, DvastaH -stA -staM, avasannaH -nnA -nnaM, jIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, tAntaH -ntA -ntaM. — (In colour) vivarRaH -rRA -rRaM, dInavarRaH -rRA -rRaM, vItarAgaH -gA -gaM, gatavarRaH -rRA -rRaM, nIraktaH -ktA -ktaM.

FAITH (subs.): SradDA, being full of f. saluted the gods: SradDAmayIBUya suparvaRastAn nanAma, N.: v. Belief. To have f. in: SraddaDAti or Datte (DA, c. 3.) (with loc.), having f. in gods: surezu SraddaDat (f. tI), N.; he had f. in Rāma's prowess: sa pOruzaM rAGave SraddaDe, R.
FAITH (interj.): satyam: v. Verily.

FAITH , s. SradDA, BaktiH f., pratyayaH, viSvAsaH, viSramBaH, AsTA, nizWA, AstikyavudDiH f., AstikatA, BaktatA; ‘of one faith,’ ekaBaktiH -ktiH -kti; ‘to have faith in,’ SradDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), viSvas (c. 2. -Svasiti -tuM). — (Veracity, honesty) satyatA, satyavAditvaM, viSvAsyatA, sAralyaM; ‘done with faith,’ SradDAkftaH -tA -taM.
FAITH , exclam. satyaM, nUnaM, Kalu, evaM, AScaryyaM, citraM.

FAITHFUL: I Full of faith:(1) SradDAlu (mfn.); (2) SradDAmayaH (yI, yaM).II Loyal: BaktaH (ktA, ktaM). Ph.: a f. wife: pativratA nArI; a f. husband: patnIrataH pumAn (?).III Not breaking promises: satyasanDaH (nDA, nDaM); satyapratiJaH (JA, JaM), etc. IV Worthy of belief: viSvasanIyaH (yA, yaM) or viSvAsya (f. syA).V True: yaTArTaH (rTA, rTaM).

FAITHFUL , a. (Firm in adherence) BaktaH -ktA -ktaM, BaktimAn -matI -mat (t), dfQaBaktiH -ktiH -kti, BaktiyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, AptaH -ptA -ptaM, avya- -BicArI -riRI -ri (n); ‘faithful to one's master,’ praBuBaktaH -ktA -ktaM; ‘a faithful friend,’ sTitapremA m. (n), dfQapremA m., dfQasOhfdaH. — (True to obligations) satyapratijYaH -jYA -jYaM, satyasanDaH -nDA -nDaM, saMSitavrataH -tA -taM, askanditavrataH -tA -taM, alaNGitavrataH -tA -taM, anuvrataH, -tA -taM, pratijYApAlakaH -kA -kaM. — (Full of faith, having faith) SradDAluH -luH -lu, SradDAvAn -vatI -vat (t), SraddaDAnaH -nA -naM, SraddaDat -DatI -Dat (t), SradDAmayaH -yI -yaM, viSvAsI -sinI -si (n), pratyayI -yinI -yi (n). — (To be trusted, confided in) viSvAsyaH -syA -syaM, viSvasanIyaH -yA -yaM, viSvastaH -stA -staM, viSrabDaH -bDA -bDaM; ‘faith- -ful wife,’ pativratA, sADvI, satI, sucaritrA, svIyA, ekapatnI; ‘faith- -ful lover,’ anukUlaH.
FAITHFULLY , adv. BaktyA, dfQaBaktyA, Baktavat, satyaM, sAralyena, kapawaM, vinA.
FAITHFULNESS: I Lit.: SradDAlutA.II Loyalty: BaktiH.III Constancy: avyaBicAritA.IV Truth: yaTArTatA.

FAITHFULNESS , s. (Firm adherence) BaktiH f., dfQA BaktiH, BaktatvaM, BaktimattvaM, dfQaBaktitvaM, AsaktiH f., anuraktiH f., dfQaM sOhfdyaM. — (Veracity) satyatA, satyavAditvaM. — (Performance of promises) pratijYApAlanaM -lakatvaM. — (In a wife) pAtivratyaM, satItvaM, sADvItvaM; ‘in a lover,’ anukUlatA.

FAITHLESS: I Lit.: aSraddaDAnaH (nA, naM);(2) SradDAhInaH (nA, naM).II Treacherous: viSvAsa- GAtin (f. nI).III Disloyal: BaktihInaH (nA, naM). IV Inconstant: vyamicArin (f. RI). v. Delusive: ayaTArTaH (rTA, rTaM).VI In promises: asatyasanDa (f. nDA); and sim. comp.s.

FAITHLESS , a. (Unbelieving) aSraddaDAnaH -nA -naM, SradDArahitaH -tA -taM, aviSvAsI -sinI -si (n), apratyayI -yinI -yi (n). — (Disloyal, perfidious) aBaktaH -ktA -ktaM, aBaktimAn -matI -mat (t), BaktihInaH -nA -naM, viSvAsaGAtI -tinI -ti (n), viSramBaGAtI &c., dviwsevI -vinI -vi (n), kuwilAcAraH -rA -raM. — (Not to be trusted) avi- SvAsyaH -syA -syaM. — (Not true to engagements) BagnapratijYaH -jYA -jYaM, asatyasanDaH -nDA -nDaM, miTyApratijYaH -jYA -jYaM, visaMvAdI -dinI -di (n). — (Not true to marriage) vyaBicArI m. -riRI f. (n), asADvI f., asatI f.
FAITHLESSLY , adv. aBaktyA, aBaktavat, BaktiBaNgAt, pratijYABaNgAt, miTyA.
FAITHLESSNESS: I Lit.: aSradDA.II Treachery: viSvAsaGAtaH.III Disloyalty: aBaktiH.IV In- -constancy: vyaBicAritA.V Delusiveness: ayaTArTatA.VI In promises:(1) asatyasanDatA; (2) pratiJABaNgaH, etc.

FAITHLESSNESS , s. (Unbelief) aSradDA, aviSvAsaH, apratyayaH, aviSramBaH. — (Disloyalty) aBaktiH f., BaktihInatA, BaktiBaNgaH, viSvAsaBaNgaH, viSvA- saGAtaH, SatrusevA. — (Violation of promises, &c.) pratijYABaNgaH, pratijYAtikramaH, vratalopanaM, saMvidvyatikramaH.
FALCATE, FALCATED: anuvakraH (krA, kraM), D.
Falcated, a. vakra, dAtrAkfti.
FALCATED , a. dAtrAkftiH -tiH -ti, lavitrAkAraH -rA -raM, vakraH -krA -kraM.
Falchion, s. vakraKaqgaH, nistriMSaH, caMdrahAsaH, kfpARaH.
FALCHION: KaNgaviSezaH v. Sword, scimitar.
FALCHION , s. vakraKaNgaH, candrahAsaH, nistriMSaH, KaNgaH, maRqalAgraH, kfpARaH -RakaH.
Falcon, s. SyenaH, SaSAdanaH, patrin m., KagAM-takaH. [Falcon]er, s. SyenapAlakaH-pozakaH, SyenAjIvaH. [Falcon]ry, s. SyenapAlanaM-SikzA-pozaRaM.
FALCON: SyenaH.

FALCONER: SyenajIvin (f. nI), M. iii. 169.
FALCONER , s. SyenajIvI m. (n), SyenapozakaH, SyenapAlakaH, SyenaSikzakaH.
FALCONRY , s. SyEnampAtA, SyenaSikzA, SyenapozaH, SyenapAlanaM.
FALD-STOOL , a. itastato vahanayogyo laGupIWaH, DarmmADyakzapIWaH -WaM.

Fall, v. i. cyu 1 A, gal 1 P, sraMs 1 A, pat 1 P, ni-ava°, BraMS 1 A, 4 P; ‘fell under his displeasure’ tasyAkfpApAtraM-kopAspadaM-baBUva. 2 mf 6 A, naS 4 P, vi-pra-DvaMs 1 A, pra-lI 4 A, prAREH viyuj pass. 3 avasad 1 P, kzi-apaci pass., nyUnIBU 1 P, hras 1 P; ‘a cow f(all)s beneath his paw’ gOstasya naKapaMjare patati, naKarAkrAMtA Bavati; ‘when the wind fell’ SAMte pavane. 4 dru 1 P, praviS 6 P, avatF 1 P, (gaMgA sAgaraM praviSati-avatarati); ‘f(all) foul of’ saMGaww 1 A, Akram 1 U, 4 P; vi-vad 1 A; ‘f(all) to the ground’ DvaMs, (DvaMsitaste utsAha-vfttAMtaH S. 2), vinaS. s. pAtaH, patanaM, cyuti f.; DvaMsaH, BraMSaH, sraMsanaM, aDaH-ni-patanaM, ava-ni-pAtaH; ‘in rapid f(all) descend’ javena nipataMti. 2 sTAnaBraMSaH-cyutiH, apakarzaH, padanASaH-BraMSaH-cyutiH. 3 pra-vi-DvaMsaH, saM-upa-pari-kzayaH, avasAdaH; ‘rise and f(all)’ pAto-tpAtAH. 4 hrAsaH, apacayaH, nyUnIBAvaH. 5 nirJaraH, prasravaRaM; prapAtaH, vAripravAhaH. 6 pAtuka-pravaRa-BUmi f.; ‘f(all) of snow’ tuzAravarzaH, himasruti f.; ‘f(all) of rain’ DArAsaMpAtaH, DArAsAraH, AsAraH. [Fall] away, mlE-glE 1 P, nirgal, pra-lI, naS. 2 svaDarmAd BraMS or cyu. [Fall] back, parAvft 1 A, apa-sf-sfp 1 P, avasTA 1 A. [Fall] in with, saMman 4 A, aByupa-gam 1 P; See Agree. 2 Asad c., sa-hasA dfS 1 P. [Fall] into, ni-aMtaH-pat; ‘f(all) into vice’ durmArgagAmino BavaMti; ‘f(all) into misfortune’ vipadgrastA BavaMti [Fall] off, cyu BraMS. 2 apasf 1 P, palAy 1 A, viyuj pass. 3 svaDarmaM tyaj 1 P, pat. 4 hrAsaM gam 1 P, kzi-apaci-saMhf- pass., hras. [Fall] on, [Fall] upon, Akram, aBidraaBidru, Apat, avaskaMd 1 P. [Fall] out, vivad 1 A, viprati-pad 4 A, kalahaM kf 8 U. [Fall] short, nyUnIBU, hras, kzi-saMhf pass.; ‘his arrow fell short of its aim’ sa lakzyacyutasAyakoBUt; ‘words f(all) short in describing your greatness’ tava mahimAnamutkIrtya vacaH saMhriyate (R. x. 32). [Fall] to, pra-upa-kram 1 A, prAraB 1 A; ‘they fell to blows’ parasparaprahAramAreBire. [Fall] under, (power) vaSaM i 2 P, a-DIna a. BU. 2 aMtarBU, aMtargaR pass.

FALL (v.i.): I In gen.:(1) patati, ni-, (rarely pra-, pari-, vini-, A-, saM-,) (pat, c. l.,) Putanā fell on the ground: papAta pUtanA BUmO, v. p.; with the dress fell into the water: savAsAH prApatajjale, Mah.; to fall on the knees: jAnuByAM (ins.) patati, Mah.; the glittering scimitar fell from his hand: jvalannasistasya papAta pAReH; Ki. xvii. 58.; rivers f. ing into the ocean: aBburASiM patantIrnadIH, Si. iii. 75. (This use of pat is rare. Gen. expr. by praviSati, M. n. or upEti, Mah. or prayAti, Ri., etc.); flower-rain fell from the sky: viyataH puzpavarzaM papAta, Vi.: v. Rain; we suddenly fell on Vindhyaketu: atarkitA eva vinDyaketorupari nipatitAH sma, Pri.: v. To assail, some rise and [Page265] f.: ko'pyutTitaH patati, Mr.: v. To decline, the refuge of the f. en: patitaSaraRyA, J.; something else has f. en there: anyat kimapyarTAntaraM tatra patitam, Ana. iv. v.: To happen; this kingdom had f. en into the hands of Vasantabhānu: vasantaBAnorhaste rAjyamidaM patitam, D.;(2) BraSyati, -te or BraMSate, pari-, (BraMS, c. 4. and 1.) (gen. in fig. senses), f. en on the ground: urvyAM BrazwaH (zwA, zwaM), R.; did not f. from truth: satyAnnABraSyata, R.;(3) cyavate, vi-, pra-, pari-, (cyu, c. 1.) (gen. fig.), has f. en from the top of the tree: taruSiKarAdasmAtpari- cyutaH, K.; f. en from the path: paTaScyutaH (tA, taM), Ki.II To cease: q.v.: SAmyati (Sam, c. 4.), when the wind fell: vAte SamatAM gate, Mah. III To decrease: q.v.: hnAsamupEti (i, c. 2.). Ph.: to f. asleep: v. Asleep; to fall calm, i.e. to become calm.: v. Calm; to f. foul: v. To attack; to f. short: nyUnIBavatiH v. Deficient.

FALL (subs.): I The act of f. ing:(1) pAtaH, ni-, f. of a mountain: giripAtaH, V. p.;(2) patanam, ni-, pra-, f. from a mountain: gireH patanam, H. i.;(3) avapatanaM or avapAtaH (= f. ing down); (4) BraMSaH, pra-, (rare);(5) cyutiH, pari-, vi-, (rare). Ph.: coming out had a f. in front: nizkramyAgre papAta ha, Mah.: v. To fall.II Death, destruction: q.v.: pAtaH or patanam, ni-, vini-, how will Rāvaṇa brook the repeated f. of his men: kaTamiva daSamuKaH BUyoBUyaH svajanavini- pAtaM saheta, Vi.III Downfall, degradation: pAtaH or patanam, ava-, ni-, vini-, rise and f. of men: pAtotpAtA manuzyARAm, H.; even f.....is equivalent to rise: vinipAto'pi samaM samunnateH, Ki. IV Decrease: q.v.: hrAsaH, rise and f. of prices: arGasya vfdDihrAsaH, Vy. V. Cadence: q.v.: pAtaH.VI Declivity, slope: q.v. pAtaH.VII Waterfall: prapAtaH, the f. s of the great Koshi: mahAkoSIprapAtaH, Ku.VIII A falling: pAtaH, heavy f. of hail: tumulakarakAvfzwipAtaH, Me.IX Felling: pAtaH, -nam.

To FALL , v. n. pat (c. 1. patati -tituM), nipat, paripat, BraMS (c. 4. BraSyati, (c. 1. BraMSate -SituM), pariBraMS, cyu (c. 1. cyavate, cyotuM), DvaMs (c. 1. DvaMsate -situM), viDvaMs, sraMs (c. 1. sraMsate -situM), AsraMs, visraMs, gal (c. 1. galati -lituM), avagal, vigal, samAgal, lamb (c. 1. lambate [Page257-b+ 51] mbituM), sKal (c. 1. sKalati -lituM). — (Die) mf (c. 6. mriyate, marttuM). — (Sink) sad (c. 6. sIdati, sattuM), avasad. — (Fall away) ‘become lean,’ kzi in pass. (kzIyate), kfSIBU; ‘apostatize,’ svaDarmmAd BraS or cyu or vicyu; ‘decline, fade,’ mlE (c. 1. mlAyati, mlAtuM), pralI (c. 4. -lIyate -letuM). — (Fall back) avasTA (c. 1. -tizWate -sTAtuM), avasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM). — (Fall calm) nirvAtIBU. — (Fall down) avapat, nipat, prapat; ‘prostrate one's self in worship,’ praRipat, avaniM gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM), azwANgapAtaM kf; ‘fall down with one's face on the ground,’ BUmO nyaNmuKaH or aDomuKaH pat; ‘fall down at one's feet,’ pAdayoH or caraRayoH pat. — (Fall foul) Akram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM). — (Fall from) BraMS, praBraMS or cyu with abl. c. — (Fall into) nipat; ‘fall into the hands of the enemy,’ Satruhaste pat. — (Fall in with) samman (c. 4. -manyate -mantuM), upagam. — (Fall off) ‘withdraw,’ palAy (c. 1. palAyati -yituM, rt. i), cal (c. 1. calati -lituM), avasTA, apasf; ‘abandon one's duty,’ svaDarmmaM tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tyaktuM). — (Fall on) Apat, Akram, Asad (c. 10. -sAdayati -yituM), aBidra, (c. 1. -dravati -drotuM). — (Fall out) ‘quarrel,’ vivad (c. 1. -vadate -dituM), kalahaM kf; ‘befall,’ nipat, Apat, upasTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), samBU. — (Fall short) nyUnIBU, hras (c. 1. hrasate -situM), kzi in pass., hA in pass. (hIyate). (Fall sick) rogagrastaH -stA -staM BU, pIqitaH -tA -taM BU. — (Fall to) upakram, prakram. — (Fall under) antargaR in pass. (-gaRyate). — (Fall upon). See To FALL ON. (Fall into misfortune) ApadgrastaH -stA -staM BU, Apad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM).
To FALL , v. a. (Drop, let fall) pat in caus. (pAtayati -yituM), BraMS in caus. (BraMSayati -yituM), sraMs in caus. (sraMsayati -yituM). — (Diminish) nyUnIkf.

FALL , s. (Act of falling and dropping) pAtaH, patanaM, avapAtaH, nipAtaH, nipatanaM, sampAtaH, prapatanaM, BraMSaH, praBraMSaH, cyutiH f., DvaMsaH -sanaM, viDvaMsaH, praDvaMsaH, aDogatiH f., aDaHpatanaM, visraMsA. — (Death, ruin) kzayaH, parikzayaH, DvaMsaH, pariDvaMsaH, nASaH. — (Degradation) padaBraMSaH, padacyutiH f., sTAnapraBraMSaH, apakarzaH, apaDvaMsaH, aDogamaH -manaM, maryyAdAkzayaH. — (De- -clension, sinking) cyutiH f., kzayaH, avakzayaH, sAdaH, avasAdaH. — (Diminution) nyUnatA, hrAsaH, apacayaH, kzayaH. — (Declivity) pAtukaH, pAtukaBUmiH f., pravaRaBUmiH f., nimnaBUmiH. — (Cascade) prapAtaH, praSravaRaM, vAripravAhaH, nirJaraH. — (Fall of the leaf) parRaDvaMsaH, patrApagamaH, Sarad f. — (Fall of snow) himavarzaH. — (Fall of rain) DArAsampAtaH, DArAsAraH, DArA, AsAraH, aBrAvakASaH. — (Fall from a vehicle) vAhanaBraMSaH, vAhaBraMSaH.
FALL AWAY: I To pine: aNgezu parihIyate (pass. of hA), Sa.II To sink into wickedness: patatiH v. To fall.
FALL BACK: I To recede: q.v.II Not to fulfil: q.v.:(1) BraSyati;(2) cyavate.
FALL DOWN: I Lit.: patati, ni-, ava-, as if the hot-rayed (sun) had f. en d. on the earth: nipatanta- mivozRaraSimamurvyAm, Ki.II To prostrate: q.v.
FALL IN WITH: AsAdayati, sam-, (c. of sad): v. To meet.

FALL OUT: I To quarrel: q.v.II To happen: patati, A-, ni-, saM-.

FALLACIOUS: (1) BramajananaH (nI, naM);(2) miTyA in comp. (= false: q.v.).

FALLACY: I Deception: q.v.: vaYcanA.II Mistake: q.v.: BramaH.III Logical:(1) hetvABAsaH, N. d.;(2) BrAntatarkaH.

FALLIBILITY: (1) patanaSIlatA;(2) BrAntiH (?).

Fallible, a. patana-sKalana-SIla, BramaSIla, BramA-DIna, mohaSIla, Brama-sKalana-pAtraM. 2 Brama-kArin, mohin, mohajanaka. Fallibility, s. BramapAtratA, mohaSIlatA, sKalanaSIlaM.
FALLIBLE: (1) patanaSIlaH (lA, laM);(2) BrAntaH (ntA, ntaM) (= erring).
FALLIBLE , a. BrAntijanakaH -kA -kaM, BramajanakaH -kA -kaM, BrAntimAn -matI -mat (t), mohI -hinI -hi (n), BramaRaSIlaH -lA -laM, vaYcanIyaH -yA -yaM, BramayogyaH -gyA -gyaM.
FALLIBLE , a. BramapAtraM, samBAvitaBramaH -mA -maM, BramArhaH &c.
FALLING , part. pAtukaH -kA -kaM, pAtI -tinI -ti (n), patayAluH -luH -lu, sraMsI -sinI -si (n), DvaMsI -sinI -si (n), pitsan -tsantI -tsat (t), pipatizuH -zuH -zu.
FALLING , s. (Indenture) BaNgaH, nimnatA. — (Falling away) DarmmaBraMSaH, DarmmacyutiH f., DarmmatyAgaH. — (Falling off) BraMSaH, BrezaH, kzayaH, utkramaH.
FALLING-SICKNESS: apasmAraH: v. Epilepsy.
FALLING-SICKNESS , s. BrAmaraM, grahAmayaH, aparamAraH, BUtavikriyA, pratAnaH.
Fallow, a. akfzwa, ahalya, aprahata, Kila. 2 vaMDya, nizPala, viPala, anuptaSasya. 3 Izadrakta, Arakta, Svetarakta.
FALLOW (adj.): I Lit.: patitaH (tA, taM) (land which lies) f. for three years is waste (land): trivarzapatitaM Kilam, Viv.: v. Untilled.II Pale red: pAwalaH (lA, laM).
FALLOW (subs.): patitaBUmiH.
FALLOW (v.): (1) pAtayati (c. of pat), f. ing land: kzetraM pAtayitvA, Viv.;(2) vAhayati (c. of vah), to f. low land: nimnAM BUmiM vAhayati, Pa.

FALLOW , a. (Unsowed) anuptaH -ptA -ptaM, anuptaSasyaH -syA -syaM, anuptrimaH -mA -maM, avApitaH -tA -taM. — (Untilled) aprahataH -tA -taM, akfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, aPAlakfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, akftaH -tA -taM, ahalaH -lA -laM, ahalyaH -lyA -lyaM, KilaH -lA -laM; ‘fallow land,’ anuptaBUmiH f., aprahataBUmiH f. — (Pale red) IzadraktaH -ktA -ktaM, SvetaraktaH -ktA -ktaM.
To FALLOW , v. a. vIjAropaRavyatirekeRa or vIjAni anuptvA BUmiM halena kfz (c. 1. karzati, krazwuM) or BUmilozwAn Bid (c. 7. Binatti, BettuM).
FALLOW-DEER: hariRaviSezaH: v. Deer.

FALLOWNESS , s. anuptatvaM, akfzwatA, ahalyatA, banDyatA, nizPalatA, vEPalyaM.

False, a. asatya, anfta, vitaTa, ataTya, ayaTArTa, alIka, mfzA-miTyA- in comp.; ‘f(alse) speech’ mfzodyaM. 2 kftrima, kftaka, kalpita, kUwa-kapawa-Cadma. in comp.; ‘f(alse) balance’ kUwatulAmAnaM; ‘f(alse) ascetic’ CadmatApasaH, vakavrataH; ‘f(alse) witness’ kUwa-miTyA-sAkzin m. ‘f(alse) accusation’ miTyABiyogaH, aBiSApaH, aByAKyAnaM, miTyABiSaMsanaM. 3 kApawika (kI f.), viSvAsaGAtin, maMtra-rahasya-Bedin; ‘f(alse) to oneʼs promise’ luptapratijYa, asatyasaMDa, BagnapratijYa-vrata. 4 mAyin, daMBin, dAMBika-CAdmika (kI f.). 5 moGa, vyarTa, nirarTaka, vfTA-miTyA- in comp. [False]hood, s. anftaM, asatyaM, vitaTaM, alIkaM, mfzodyaM, kEtavaM. 2 asatyaBAzaRaM, miTyA-mfzA-vAdaH, kEtavokti f., miTyABiDAnaM, anftavAdaH. 3 asatyatA, alIkatA, ayaTArTatA, anftatA. [False]ly, adv. mfzA, miTyA, anyaTA, asatyaM, anftaM; ‘speaking f(alsely)’ anftavAdin. [False]ness, s. asatyatA, &c. 2 kUwatA, kApawyaM, vyAjaH, Cadman n., kEtavaM. 3 viSvAsaBaMgaH-GAtaH. Falsify, v. t. miTyA kf 8 U, kUwaM-kapaqaM-kf ‘a f(alsifi)ed document’ kUwa-kftrima-leKaH. 2 KaMq 10, nirA-apA-kf, aDarIkf, vitaTIkf, pratyAKyA 2 P, niras 4 U. 3 atikram 1 U, 4 P, aticar 1 P, Bid 7 P, ullaMG 1 A, 10, vi-, lup 6 P or c. v. i. asatyaM-anftaM-vad 1 P. FALSE (subs.): I Not true, not real:(1) miTyA. in comp., f. reply: miTyottaram; to speak f.: [Page266] miTyA vadati, M.;(2) alIkaH (kA, kaM), f. pro- wess alIkavikramaH, Pr. i.; f. Nala: alIkanalaH, N.;(3) vitaTaH (TA, TaM), this proverb is f.: ayaM lokavAdo vitaTaH, Ve.;(4) mfzA in comp., f. assertion: mfzAvAdaH, K. b.;(5) anftaH (tA, taM), f. accusation: anftABiyogaH, Si.;(6) asatyaH (tyA, tyaM).II Uttering falsehood: miTyAvAdin (f. nI);(2) anftagir (mfn.); and sim. comp.s. III Fictitious, counterfeit: q.v.: kUwa in comp., f. measures of weight: kUwatulAmAnam, P.; f. evidence: kUwasAkzyam, M.IV. Treacherous, unfaithful: q.v.: asatyasanDaH (nDA, nDaM), Sa.
FALSE (adv.): v. Falsely. F. -hearted: kapawa- hfdayaH (yA, yaM).

FALSE , a. (Not true) asatyaH -tyA -tyaM, niHsatyaH -tyA -tyaM, anftaH -tA -taM, ataTyaH -TyA -TyaM, vitaTaH -TA -TaM, ayaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, asan -satI -sat (t), aprakftaH -tA -taM, alIkaH -kA -kaM, miTyA or mfzA or anyaTA in comp.; as, ‘a false accusation,’ miTyABiyogaH, miTyApavAdaH; ‘a false opinion,’ miTyAmatiH f.; ‘a false reply,’ miTyottaraM; ‘false speaking,’ mfzAvAdaH, miTyAvAdaH, asatyaBAzaRaM; ‘false accuser,’ mfzApavAdI m. (n). — (Fictitious) kftrimaH -mA -maM, kalpitaH -tA -taM, kAlpanikaH -kI -kaM, viqambitaH -tA -taM, kapawI -winI -wi (n), kUwa or kapawa or Cadma in comp.; as, ‘false coin,’ kUwasvarRaM; ‘false dice,’ kUwAkzaH; ‘false document,’ kapawaleKyaM; ‘false balances,’ kUwatulA; ‘false measure,’ kUwamAnaM; ‘a false ascetic,’ CadmatApasaH, vakavratI m. (n); ‘in a false dress,’ CadmaveSI m. (n). — (Un- -faithful, treacherous) viSvAsaGAtI -tinI -ti (n), rahasyaBedI -dinI -di (n), mantraBedI &c., kzIRaBaktiH -ktiH -kti, vyaBicArI -riRI -ri (n); ‘to vows, engagements,’ skanditavrataH -tA -taM, ullaNGitavrataH -tA -taM, asatyasanDaH -nDA -nDaM, luptavrataH -tA -taM; ‘a false wife,’ apativratA. — (Hypocritical) kuhakaH -kA -kaM, damBI -mBinI -mBi (n); ‘false worship,’ arccAviqambanaM. — (Vain, groundless) vfTA or miTyA in comp. moGaH -GA -GaM; ‘a false alarm,’ vfTAkroSaH; ‘false hope,’ moGASA. — (Dishonest) kApawikaH -kI -kaM.
FALSE-HEARTED , a. viSramBaGAtI -tinI -ti (n), asTirapremA -mA -ma (n).
FALSE-PROPHET , s. BavizyadvAdino veSaDArI m. (n), miTyABavizyadvAdI m.
FALSE-WITNESS , s. kUwasAkzI m. (n), miTyAsAkzI m., kUwakArakaH, kOwa- -sAkzyaM, miTyAsAkzyaM, ataTyasAkzyaM.

FALSEHOOD: I Want of truth:(1) asatyatA; (2) alIkatA;(3) vEtaTyam, how could f. take a footing in their speech: kaTaM tAdfSAnAM giri vEtaTyamAspadaM kuryAt, K.II A lie: q.v.: anftam. III Deceit: q.v.: kEtavam, unaquainted with f.: anaBiJaH kEtavasya, Sa.

FALSEHOOD , s. (Want of truth) asatyatA, niHsatyatA, ataTyatA, anftatA, vitaTatA, alIkatA, ayATArTyaM. — (A lie) anftaM, asatyaM, vitaTaM, ataTyaM, alIkaM, aSlIlaM, mfzodyaM. — (Speaking falsehood) miTyAvAdaH, mfzAvAdaH, miTyAkaTanaM, mfzABAzitA, asatyaBAzaRaM, mfzABiDAnaM, kEtavavAdaH; ‘one who tells a falsehood,’ anftavAdI m. (n), miTyAvAdI, mfzA- -vAdI; ‘devoted to falsehood,’ anftavrataH -tA -taM.
FALSELY: I Not truly:(1) miTyA;(2) mfzA, deposing f.: sAkzyaM mfzA bruvanH, Mit.;(3) by adj. v. False.II Deceitfully: q.v.

FALSELY , adv. miTyA, mfzA, anyaTA, asatyaM, niHsatyaM, anftaM; ‘acting falsely,’ miTyAcAraH -rA -raM; ‘speaking falsely,’ anftavAdI -dinI -di (n), anftavAk m. f. n. (c); ‘falsely modest,’ miTyAvinItaH -tA -taM, kapawavinayavAn -vatI -vat (t).
FALSENESS: I Lit.: alIkatA: v. Falsehood (I). II Fictitiousness: kftrimatA.III Perfidy, deceitfulness: q.v.

FALSENESS , s. (Want of truth) asatyatA, niHsatyatA. — (Fictitious- -ness) kUwatA, kftrimatA, kApawyaM. — (Duplicity) kapawatA, vyAjaH, kEtavaM, SaWatA. — (Perfidy) viSvAsaBaNgaH, viSvAsaGAtaH, mantraBedaH.
FALSIFICATION: I Lit.:(1) miTyAkaraRam;(2) vitaTIkaraRam, etc.II Counterfeiting, f. of coins: kftrimamudrAkaraRam.
FALSIFICATION , s. kUwakaraRaM, kapawakaraRaM, CadmakaraRaM, kftrimakaraRaM, miTyA- karaRaM, anyaTAkaraRaM.
FALSIFIER , s. kUwakaH, kUwakft, kapawakArI m. (n), miTyAkArI m. — (Disprover) KaRqanakft, pratyAKyAtA m. (tf), aDarIkArI m.

FALSIFY (v.t.): I To couterfeitcounterfeit; forge.II To prooveprove to be false:(1) miTyAkaroti, vitaTIkaroti, etc., if you f. your own saying: miTyAkarozi cet svIyaM BAzitam, A. r.;(2) anftaM (f. tAM) karoti; you should not f. it: tattvayA nAnftaM kAryam, V. p.
FALSIFY (v.i.): (1) miTyA vadati;(2) mfzA bravIti, etc.

To FALSIFY , v. a. (Counterfeit) kUwaM kf, kapawaM kf, Cal (c. 10. Cala- yati -yituM), anyaTA kf, miTyA kf, — (Disprove) KaRq (c. 10. KaRqa- yati -yituM), aDarIkf, asatyam iti sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM). — (Violate, break) atikram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), Bida (c. 7. Binatti, BettuM), lup (c. 6. lumpati, loptuM).
To FALSIFY , v. n. asatyaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), miTyA or mfzA vad.
FALSITY , s. asatyatA, niHsatyatA, anftatA, ayATArTyaM, vitaTatvaM, alIkatA.

Falter, v. i. (svareRa) sKal 1 P, svaraBaMgena or sagadgadaM-vad 1 P; ‘makes thy words f(alter)’ sKalayati vacanaM te (Mal. 3); ‘f(alter)ing with tears’ bAzpagadgadaM; ‘a f(alter)ing step’ sKalitA gatiH; prasTAnaviklavagateH (S. 5); ‘whose step f(alter)s &c.’. 2 pracal 1 P, kaMp 1 A, vep 1 A, prasKal. FALTER: I Of speech: making them f. at every step: vacanAni sKalayan pade pade, Ku.; f. ing with tears: sASrudgadam, D. ii.II To tremble: Ph.: with steps f. ing: sKalitABirgatiBiH, Si. ix. 78.III To fail: q.v.

To FALTER , v. n. (Speak with broken utterance) svaraBaNgena or BagnasvareRa or sKaladvAkyena vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), sKalitaM vad, svareRa sKal (c. 1. sKalati -lituM, c. 10. sKalayati -yituM), gadgadayA vAcA vad, aspazwavAcA vad, gadgada (nom. gadgadyati). — (Tremble, totter) sKal, prasKal, sKalanaM kf, kamp (c. 1. kampate -mpituM), vep (c. 1. vepate -pituM).
FALTERING, FALTERINGLY: (1) sKaladgirA;(2) gadgadavAcA;(3) gadgadagalodgacCadvilInAkzaraH, J.
FALTERING , part. or a. sKalitavAkyaH -kyA -kyaM, BagnasvaraH -rA -raM, BinnasvaraH -rA -raM.
FALTERING , s. sKalanaM, vAkyasKalanaM, sKaladvAkyaM, svaraBaNgaH, svaraBedaH, gadgadavAk f. (c), aspazwavacanaM.
FALTERINGLY , adv. sKalatsvareRa, sKaladvAkyena, svaraBaNgena, gadgadavAcA.

Fame, s. yaSas n., kIrti f., KyAti f., viSruti f., prasidDi f., pratizWA, pra-vi-KyAtiH, saM-praTA. [Fam]ed, [Fam]ous, a. KyAta, praTita, viSruta, pra-vi-KyAta, prasidDa, yaSasvin, yaSasvat, kIrtimat, kIrtita, lokaviSruta, mahAyaSaska, labDapratizWa-varRa.
FAME: I Rumour: q.v.: kiMvadantI.II Glory, renown:(1) yaSas (n.), to acquire f.: yaSo'Di- gantum, Ki;(2) kIrti, of endless f.: anantakIrti (mfn.), R.: v. Renown.

FAME , s. kIrttiH f., yaSaH n. (s), KyAtiH f., suKyAtiH f., pariKyAtiH f., viSrutiH f., pratizWA, viSrAvaH, prasidDiH f., prakIrttiH f., kIrttanA -naM, praTA, praTitiH f., sampraTA, samAKyA, samAjYA, pratipattiH f., viKyAtiH f., praviKyAtiH f., pratiKyAtiH f., rUQiH. — (Rumour) janaSrutiH f., janapra- -vAdaH, janodAharaRaM.

FAMILIAR (subs.): ciraparicitaH, D.: Friend.

(Domestic) gfhajaH -jA -jaM -jAtaH -tA -taM, AntarveSimakaH -kI -kaM, kOlikaH -kI -kaM, kula in comp. — (Well acquainted with, intimate) paricitaH -tA -taM, suvid m. f. n., susaMsargI -rgiRI -rgi (n), saMstutaH -tA -taM; ‘with the scriptures,’ SAstrajYaH, svaDI- -taSAstraH; ‘with law,’ smftikuSalaH. — (Accustomed to) aByastaH -stA -staM. — (Well-known) suviditaH -tA -taM, sujYAtaH -tA -taM, prasidDaH -dDA -dDaM. — (Unceremonious) AdarahInaH -nA -naM, nirgOravaH -vA -vaM, nirAdaraH -rA -raM. — (Ordinary) prAkftaH -tI -taM, lOkikaH -kI -kaM, lokasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, prasidDaH -dDA -dDaM; ‘familiar conversation,’ viSramBAlApaH.

FAMILIARITY: I Acquaintance: paricayaH.II Intimacy: GanizWatA.

FAMILIARIZE: (1) paricayaM karoti;(2) aByasyati (as, c. 4.): v. To accustom.

FAMILIARLY: (1) visrabDam;(2) by circumlo.

Family, s. kulaM, vaMSaH, jAti f., gotraM. 2 ku-wuMbaM, putrakalatrAdi, gfhajanaH. 3 anvayaH, saM-tAnaH-naM, saMtati f.; ‘members of a f(amily)’ kuwuMbinaH; ‘head of a f(amily)’ kuwuMbin m., kulapatiH; ‘of a good f(amily)’ kulIna, mahAkula, aBijAta, kula in comp.; ‘his wife is in the f(amily) way’ ApannasattvA-garBavatI-jAtA; ‘of royal f(amily)’ rAjavaMSya, rAjakulaprasUta; ‘family dispute’ gfhacCidraM, aMtarBedaH; ‘a f(amily) man (diligently caring for the f(amily))’ aByA-gArikaH, upADiH, kuwuMbavyApftaH.
FAMILY: kulam, this girl is the life of the f.: kanyeyaM kulajIvitam, Ku.; of good f.: kulajaH (jA, jaM), N.: v. Race, lineage, descent.

FAMILY , s. (Race) kulaM, vaMSaH, kuwumbaH, jAtiH f., gotraM, santAnaH, pravaraM. — (Lineage) anvayaH, santatiH f., jananaM, AvaliH f., anvavAyaH. — (Household) gfhajanaH, aBijanaH, svajanaH, parijanaH, kuwumbakaM, strIpu- trakanyAdi; ‘head of a family,’ kuwumbI, kOwumbikaH, kulapatiH m., kulodvahaH; ‘of the same family,’ sakulaH -lA -laM, sakulyaH -lyA -lyaM; ‘relating to a family,’ kOlaH -lI -laM -likaH -kI -kaM, kula in comp.; ‘of good or noble family,’ mahAkulaH -lA -laM -lInaH -nA -naM, kulInaH -nA -naM, kOleyaH -yI -yaM, kulikaH -kA -kaM, kulodgataH -tA -taM; ‘of low family,’ duzkulInaH -nA -naM, akulInaH -nA -naM; ‘a woman of good family,’ kulanArI, kulakanyA; ‘of royal family,’ rAjavaMSyaH -SyA -SyaM; ‘family honour,’ kulamaryyAdA; ‘family pride,’ kulABimAnaM, kulonnatiH f.; ‘family disgrace,’ kulanindA; ‘family respectability,’ kulotkarzaH; ‘family duty,’ kulaDarmmaH, kulAcAraH; ‘family priest,’ kulAcAryyaH; ‘family party,’ gfhotsavaH; ‘family feuds,’ gfhacCidraM; ‘family con- nexions,’ gozWI, kulasanniDiH f.; ‘of ancient family,’ dIrGavaMSaH -SA -SaM; ‘attentive in supporting one's family,’ kuwumbavyApftaH, kulAlambI m. (n), aByAgArikaH, upADiH m.; ‘cruelty to one's family,’ anAtmyaM.
Famine, s. durBikzaM, anaSanaM, duzkAlaH, prayAmaH, nIvAkaH, AhArABAvaH, anAhArasamayaH, ‘f(amine)-stricken’ dUrBikzapIqita.
FAMINE: durBikzam, in a f. stricken country: durBikza- pIqite deSe, P. iv. 4.: f. would enter a country: durBikzamAviSedrAzwram, Mah.: v. To starve, kill.
FAMINE , s. durBikzaM, duzkAlaH, durBakzyaM, anAkAlaH, prayAmaH, nIvAkaH, anAhArakAlaH, AhAravirahaH, AhArABAvaH, annABAvaH, AhArAsamBavaH, durmUlyaM.

To FAMISH , v. a. kzuDayA pIq (c. 10. pIqayati -yituM) or vyApad (c. 10. -pAdayati -yituM) or avasad in caus. (-sAdayati -yituM) or kfSIkf, kzuDArttaM -rttAM -rttaM kf.
To FAMISH , v. n. AhAravirahAd avasad (c. 6. -sIdati -sattuM) or kzi in pass. (kzIyate) or kzIRaSarIraH -rA -raM BU or kfSANgIBU or vyApad (c. 4. -padyate).

FAMISHED , p. p. or a. kzutpIqitaH -tA -taM, kzuDArttaH -rttA -rttaM, kzuDApIqitaH -tA -taM, kzutkzAmaH -mA -maM, kzutparikfSaH -SA -SaM, kzuDArdditaH -tA -taM, buBukzitaH -tA -taM, nirannaH -nnA -nnaM.
FAMISHMENT , s. kzutpIqA, kzutkzAmatA, anAhAraH, annABAvaH, buBukzA.
FAMOUS: (1) KyAtaH (tA, taM), vi-, pra-;(2) viSrutaH (tA, taM);(3) praTitaH (tA, taM): v. Renowned, illustrious.

FAMOUS , a. KyAtaH -tA -taM, suKyAtaH -tA -taM, yaSasvI -svinI -svi (n), mahAyaSAH -SAH -SaH (s) -yaSaskaH -skA -skaM, kIrttimAn -matI -mat (t), viSrutaH -tA -taM, praTitaH -tA -taM, prasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, viKyAtaH -tA -taM, pariKyAtaH -tA -taM, kIrttitaH -tA -taM, pratizWaH -zWA -zWaM, pratipattimAn -matI -mat (t), pfTupraTaH -TA -TaM, lokaviSrutaH -tA -taM, ‘rendering famous,’ yaSaskaraH -rI -raM, yaSasyaH -syA -syaM, kIrttikaraH -rI -raM.
FAMOUSLY , adv. mahAyaSasA, mahAkIrttipUrvvaM, paramaM, uttamaprakAreRa.
FAMOUSNESS , s. kIrttimattvaM, yaSasvitA, KyAtimattvaM, viSrutiH f.
Fan, s. tAlavfMtaH-vfMtakaM, vyajanaM, vIjanaM, vyajaH. v. t. vIj 10, upa-anu-saM°; vyajanena viDU 5, 9 U; (fig.) ud-dIp c., saMDukz 10.
FAN (subs.): (1) vyajanam;(2) tAlavfntaH (of palm leaves). Winnowing.
FAN (v.t.): I vIjayati, upa-, ut-, (vIj, c. 10.), are my friends. f. ing me: kiM vIjayato mAM saKyO, Sa.II To kindle: q.v.: sanDukzayati.III To winnow: q.v.
FAN , s. vyajanaM, tAlavfntaH -ntakaM, vIjanaM, prakIrRakaM, cAmaraM, marudAndolaH, [Page259-b+ 51] utkzepaRaM, vyajaH. — (For winnowing) sUryyaH -ryyaM, SUryyaH -ryyaM.
To FAN , v. a. vIj c. 10. vIjayati -yituM), upavIj, anuvIj, udvIj, vyajanavAyunA viDU (c. 5. -DUnoti, c. 6. -Duvati -DavituM), vyajanavAtena SItala (nom. SItalayati -yituM).
FAN-LIGHT , s. vyajanAkAro gavAkzaH or gfhAkzaH.

Fanatic, [Fanatic]al, a., s. Darmonmatta, atiSradDAvyagra; unmatta, BrAMtabudDi. [Fanatic]ally, adv. unmattavat, atiSradDayA. [Fanatic]ism, s. DarmonmAdaH, Baktyu-tkarzaH, atiBaktivyagratA. 2 unmAdaH, u-nmattatA.
FANATIC (subs.): DarmonmattaH (ttA, ttaM) (?).
FANATIC, FANATICAL: (1) ugraH (grA, graM);(2) unmattaH (ttA, ttaM) (= mad).
FANATIC , FANATICAL, a. devaBaktivyagraH -grA -graM or atiSradDAvyagraH, ekA- -ntadevaBaktitvAd unmattaH -ttA -taM or uttaptabudDiH -dDiH -dDi or uccaRqabudDiH -dDiH -dDi or BrAntabudDiH -dDiH -dDi.
FANATIC , s. atiSayadevaBaktitvAd unmattajanaH or unmAdI m. (n), miTyA- BaktimAn m. (t), kzapaRakaH.
FANATICALLY: (1) unmattavat (= madly);(2) ugram (= sharply).
FANATICALLY , adv. devaBaktivyagravat, ekAntadevaBaktyA, unmattavat.
FANATICISM: DarmonmAdaH (?).
FANATICISM , s. ekAntadevaBaktijanyo mAdaviSezaH or unmAdaH or unmadaH or uttaptabudDitvaM, atiSradDAprayuktA unmattatA, atiBaktivyagratA, atiSradDAvyagratA, BaktisucaRqatA, miTyABaktiH f.
FANCIED , p. p. BAvitaH -tA -taM, viBAvitaH -tA -taM, mataH -tA -taM.
FANCIER: I Lit.: BAvakaH.II A breeder: pozakaH.
FANCIFUL: I Dictated by fancy:(1) BAvitaH (tA, taM);(2) kalpitaH (tA, taM).II Whim- -sical: q.v.: BAvanAparAyaRa (f. nA) (?).

FANCIFUL , a. (Formed in the imagination) mAnasikaH -kI -kaM, manojaH -jA -jaM, manasijaH -jA -jaM, manogataH -tA -taM, mAyAmayaH -yI -yaM, vAsanAkalpitaH -tA -taM, kAlpanikaH -kI -kaM, manaHkalpitaH -tA -taM, manoraTasfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, saNkalyajaH -jA -jaM, amUlakaH -kA -kaM. — (Fan- ciful man) vfTAvAsanAkArI m. (n), durvAsanAkft m., anarTakaci- ntAkaraH, asamBavakalpakaH, capalabudDiH m., manolOlyavAn m. (t), lolamatiH m.
FANCIFULLY: BAvanayA: v. Wildly, whimsically.
FANCIFULLY , adv. vfTAvAsanApUrvvaM, anarTakacintApUrvvaM, kAlpanikaprakAreRa, manolOlyAt, budDicApalyAt.
FANCIFULNESS , s. manolOlyaM, budDicApalyaM, lolabudDitvaM, mAyAvattvaM, budDivi- -lAsitA, miTyAsaNkalpavattvaM.

Fancy, s. vAsanA, BAvanA, kalpanA, BAvanA-kalpanA-Sakti f. 2 budDi f., mati f., saMkalpaH. 3 manolOlyaM, kAmacAraH, budDicApalyaM, cA-palaM, laharI, taraMgaH, CaMdaH. 4 ruci f.; aBi-ruciH, kAmaH; ‘to have or take a f(ancy) for’ spfh 10 (with dat.) or ex. by kAma-manaH with inf.; spfhayAmi Kalu durlalitAyAsmE (S. 7); ‘took a f(ancy) to hunt’ mfgayAM kartumanA baBUva. v. t. man 1 A, tark 10, saM-vi-BU c.; ciMt 10, manasA kxp c.; citte-manasi-kf, Aloc 10. 2 ruc 1 A, aBi-naMd 1 P; ‘f(ancy)ing oneself to be learned’ paMqitaMmanya, paMqitamAnin; ‘doing what one f(anci)es’ kAmacArin. Fanciful, a. mAnasa (sI f.), kAlpanika-mAnasika (kI f.), manaHkalpita, BAvita, manoraTasfzwa-kalpita, BAvanotpAdita, vAsanAkalpita, saMkalpaja, mAyAmaya (yI f.) 2 (Of persons) calacitta, lolamati, kAmacArin, capalabudDi, manolO-lyavat, svErin, svEravftta. 3 anarTakavAsanA-kft, asaMBavakalpaka. [Fanciful]ly, adv. kAmacAreRa, manolOlyAt, svEraM; cApalyena. [Fanciful]ness, s. cala-cittatA, lolamati f., kAmacAritA, mano-lOlyaM, budDicApalyaM, svEritA.

FANCY (subs.): I Imagination: q.v.: BAvaH, -nA, my f. -got likeness: BAvagamyaM matsAdfSyam, Me. II Conception, idea: q.v.: BAvaH, -nA.III Inclination: BAvaH, my mind rests on him with entire f.: mamAtra BAvEkarasaM manaH sTitam, Ku.; “f-free” BAvamuktaH (ktA, ktaM).
FANCY (v.i.): manyate (man, c. 4.), one who f. s. himself to be a learned man: paRqitammanyaH, B.: v. To think, believe.

FANCY (v. t.): I To imagine, guess: q. v.: tarkayati (tark, c. 10.); which do you f. (to be Śakuntalā): tvaM tAvat katamAM tarkayasi, Sa.II To have a f. for: rocate (ruc, c. 1.). (with dat. of the person): v. To like.
FANCY (adj.): F. goads: ruciradravyARi; f. ball: *ruciranftyam; f. price *kalpitamUlyam.

FANCY , s. (The faculty of imagination) kalpanASaktiH f., BAvanA -naM, viBAvanA -naM, vAsanA, kalpanA. — (Idea) budDiH f., matiH f., saNkalpaH, manogataM, cintA, manoraTasfzwiH f. — (Caprice, whim) manolOlpaM, budDi- -vilAsaH, budDicApalyaM, cApalaM, BAsaH, ABAsaH, nirbbanDaH, laharI, taraNgaH, aKawwiH m., CandaH n. (s). — (Strange fancy) vfTAvAsanA, asamBavakalpanA, anarTakavAsanA, miTyAvAsanA, durvAsanA, anarTakacintA, manomAyA, mfzArTakaM. — (Liking) ruciH f., aBiruciH f.

To FANCY , v. n. (Imagine, think) man (c. 4. manyate, mantuM), BU (c. 10. BAvayati -yituM), viBU, samBU, cint (c. 10. cintayati -yituM). ‘To fancy one's self,’ is sometimes expressed by the adj. manyaH -nyA -nyaM; as, ‘one who fancies himself learned,’ paRqitammanyaH; ‘one who fancies himself good,’ sADummanyaH; ‘one who fancies herself beautiful,’ sundarImmanyA.

To FANCY , v. a. (Form in the mind) manasA kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM) or BU in caus. (BAvayati -yituM) or kf. — (Like) aBinand (c. 1. -nandati -ndituM), ruc (c. 1. rocate -cituM) with dat. of the person; as, ‘he fancies that,’ tat tasmE rocate; ‘doing what one fancies,’ kAmakArI m. (n); ‘eating what one fancies,’ kAmaBakzaH.
FANCY-FRAMED , a. manaHkalpitaH -tA -taM, vAsanAkalpitaH -tA -taM, manojaH -jA -jaM, manasijaH -jA -jaM, manoraTasfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, mAnasikaH -kI -kaM.
FANCY-SICK: duzwabudDi (mfn.) and sim. comp. s.
FANCY-SICK , a. vikftabudDiH -dDiH -dDi; ‘one who fancies himself sick,’ rogiRammanyaH.
FANE: sidDAyatanam: v. Temple.
FANE , s. devatAgAraH, devAgAraH, devAlayaH, devatAyatanaM, devaBavanaM, devaprAsAdaH, devagfhaM, devaveSma n. (n), devatAmandiraM, devatAvAsaH.
Fang, s. daMzwrA, daSanaH-naM, radaH, radanaH, daMtaH; ‘f(ang) of a serpent’ vizadaMtaH, ASI. [Fang]ed, a. daMzwrin, daMtin. [Fang]less, a. BagnadaMzwra, nirdaSana, nirdaMta.
FANG: daMzwrA, with the rays of the f. s.: daMzwrAmayUKEH, R. Ph.: having poison in the f. (i. e. a serpent): ASIvizaH, Ve.

FANG , s. daMzwrA, daSanaH -naM, radaH -danaH, dantaH, udagradantaH, dIrGadantaH, vizARaH [Page260-a+ 51] -RaM, dAQA, dAqakaH, rAkzasI; ‘of a serpent,’ vipadantaHvizadantaH, ASIH f. (s). — (Claw) naKaH.
FANGED: daMzwrin (f. RI), Ki. xiii. 50
FANGED , a. daMzwrI -zwriRI -zwri (n), dantI -ntinI -nti (n), dIrGadantavAn -vatI -vat (t).
FANGLESS: daMzwrAhInaH (nA, naM) and sim. comp.s.
FANGLESS , a. nirdaSanaH -nA -naM, BagnadaMzwraH -zwrA -zwraM, galitadantaH -ntA -ntaM, nirdantaH -ntA -ntaM, daSanocCizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
FANNED , p. p. vIjitaH -tA -taM, upavIjitaH -tA -taM, vIjyamAnaH -nA -naM, udvIjyamAnaH -nA -naM, vyajanena viDUyamAnaH -nA -naM or viDutaH -tA -taM.
FANNER, FANNING-MACHINE: vyajanayantram.
FANNER , s. vIjayitA m. (tf), vIjanakarttA m. (rttf), viDavitA m. (tf).
Fantasm, s. ABAsaH, mAyA, manoraTasfzwi f. Fantastic, a. Fanciful, q. v. 2 vizama, asaMgata, aparUpa, vilakzaRa.
FANTASM , s. miTyAvAsanA, manoraTasfzwiH f., ABAsaH, apacCAyA.
FANTASTIC, -AL: I Not real: kalpitaH (tA, taM) II Capricious: capalaH (lA, laM).III Irregular, wild: q.v.

FANTASTIC , FANTASTICAL, a. (Existing in the imagination) manaHka- -lpitaH -tA -taM, manasijaH -jA -jaM, vAsanAkalpitaH -tA -taM, mAnasikaH -kI -kaM. — (Capricious, whimsical) capalaH -lA -laM, lolaH -lA -laM. — (Odd) vizamaH -mA -maM, asaNgataH -tA -taM, aparUpaH -pA -pI -paM, vilakzaRaH -RA -RaM.
FANTASTICALLY , adv. capalaM, cApalyena, manolOlyAt, vizamaM, asaNgataM.
FANTASTICALNESS , s. cApalyaM, manolOlyaM, vEzamyaM, aparUpatA, asaNgatatvaM.

Far, a. dUra (with abl. or gen.), viprakfzwa; See Distant; ‘f(ar) from comfort’ suKAdapeta. adv. dUraM-re ArAt (with abl.), vidUrataH, atyaMtaM, BfSaM, atIva, su-ati pr.; ‘f(ar) away’ dUre, sudUraM; ‘from f(ar)’ dUrAt, dUrataH (eva); ‘how f(ar)’ kiyaddUraM, kiyatyaDvani; kiyat-pramARaM, kiMparyaMtaM, kiyatAMSena; ‘f(ar) off’ dUra, dUrasTa, dUravartin, dUrasTAyin; ‘as f(ar) as’ ex. by A with abl. or in comp.; ‘as f(ar) as the sea’ AsamudrAt or AsamudraM; oft. by yAvat (with acc.) or paryaMta in comp.; ‘so far as’, ‘as f(ar) as’ iti; See under As ‘not f(ar) from the tree’ tasya vfkzyasya nAtidUre; ‘by f(ar)’ BUyasA; ‘your statement is not f(ar) from the truth’ BUtArTakalpaM tava vacaH; ‘f(ar) gone in love’ dUragatamanmaTA (S. 3). In comp. ex. by ati, bahu, dUra; ‘f(ar)-extended’ bahuvistIrRa; ‘f(ar)-famed’ praTitayaSas, urukIrti; ‘f(ar)-fetched’ klizwa, yatnakfta, asugama, asukara; ‘f(ar)-reaching’ dUrADirUQa, ‘f(ar)-seeing’, ‘f(ar)-sighted’ dUradarSin, dIrGadfzwi, dUradfzwi.

FAR (adj.): I Not near:(1) draH (rA, raM), (with abl. or gen.), f. from the village: dUraM grAmasya grAmAdvA, S. k.; not very f. from here: ito nAtidUre, K.;(2) viprakfzwaH (zwA, zwaM) (rare), even now (his) time of awaking is very f.: adyApi viprakfzwaH praboDakAlaH, Vi.II. Remote from pur- -pose: f. be it from me to justify cruelty: *dUratastAvat krOryaSoDanaprastAvaH.

FAR (Adv.) I To a great distance: dUram, with f. different results: dUraBinnaPalayoH, Si.; f. -risen hope: dUrArohiRI ASA, Sa.II At a great d.: dUre, Mu. Ph.: from f.:(1) dUrAt;(2) dUrAdeva, K.;(3) dUrataH, P.;(4) dUrata eva, K. How f.: (a)=to what distance: kiyaddUraM, h. f. are you coming: kiyadyAvadupEzi dUram, N.;(2) kiyat, h. f. did he come following us: kiyadanusarannasmAnasAvAgataH, K. (b)=at what distance:(1) kiyaddUre;(2) kiyatyaDvani, what sort of a place is Ujjayanī and how f. is it (from here): kIdfSyujjayinI kiyatyaDvani sA ca, K. Far off:(1) dUraM or dUreH v. Far.(2) dUrasTaH (sTA, sTaM) (= situated f.), nearing what was f. o.: nedayan dUrasaMsTam, B. So far (i. e. such a distance): etAvatIM BUmim, K. So far as: v. So. As far as: (a)=up to: paryantaM in comp., as f. as the park: vanAntaparyantam, N.; (b)=so far as: v. So.

FAR , a. dUraH -rA -raM, vidUraH -rA -raM, dUrasTaH -sTA -sTaM -sTAyI -yinI -yi (n), dUravarttI -rttinI -rtti (n), dUrIBUtaH -tA -taM, anupasTAyI -yinI -yi (n), anupasTaH -sTA -sTaM, asannikfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, viprakfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, asannihitaH -tA -taM; ‘very far,’ sudUraH -rA -raM, davizWaH -zWA -zWaM, davIyAn -yasI -yaH (s).

FAR , adv. (At a distance) dUraM, dUre, dUratas, vidUratas, ArAt. — (To a distance) dUraM, dUraparyyantaM. — (By a distance) dUreRa. — (From far) dUrAt, dUratas. — (To a great extent) atyantaM, BfSaM, bahu, su or ati or atiSaya prefixed. — (As far as) expressed by A prefixed governing the abl. c., or by paryyantaM or anta affixed; as, ‘the earth as far as the ocean,’ AsamudrAt or samudraparyyantaM or sAgarAntA pfTivI. — (By far) dUreRa; ‘action is by far inferior to devotion,’ karmma dUreRa avaraM yogAt. — (How far?) kiM paryyantaM, kiyat paryyantaM, kiyat pramARaM. — (So far) tadantaM, tatparyyantaM. — (Far off) darasTaH -sTA -sTaM, dUrasaMsTaH -sTA -sTaM, dUrIBUtaH -tA -taM; ‘the day being far spent,’ atikrAnte divase; ‘a woman far gone in love,’ dUragatamanmaTA.
FAR-EXTENDED , a. bahuvistIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, sarvvatravyApI -pinI -pi (n).
FAR-FAMED , a. pfTupaTaH -TA -TaM, pfTuyaSAH -SAH -SaH (s), mahAyaSAH &c.
FAR-FETCHED , a. klizwaH -zwA -zwaM, yatnakftaH -tA -taM; ‘far-fetched idea,’ klizwakalpanA.
FAR-GONE , (In love) dUrArUQapraRayaH -yA -yaM.
FAR-SEEING , a. dUradarSI -rSinI -rSi (n), dIrGadarSI -rSinI -rSi (n).
FAR-SIGHTED , a. dUradfzwiH -zwiH -zwi, dIrGadfzwiH -zwiH -zwi, pAradfSvA -SvA -Sva (n).
Farce, s. prahasanaM, durmallikA. Farcical, a. upahAsya, hAsakara (rI f.), hAsyotpAdaka; asaMgata, aparUpa, hAsajanaka.
FARCE: I A comedy: prahasanam:II Empty show: perh. darSanam.
FARCE , s. prahasanaM, vilAsikA, durmmallikA, hAsyotyAdako nAwakaH, pari- -hAsajanakam uparUpakaM.

FARCICAL , a. prahasanasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n). — (Droll) hAsakaraH -rI -raM, hAsyaH -syA -syaM, upahAsyaH -syA -syaM, rasikaH -kA -kaM, vinodI -dinI -di (n), hAsyotpAdakaH -kA -kaM, asaNgataH -tA -taM, aparUpaH -pA -paM.
FARCIN, FARCY: jantUnAM carmarogaviSezaH.
FARCY , s. aSvAnAM carmmarogaviSezaH or duScarmmatvaM or carmmadUzikA.
Fardel, s. kUrcaH, gucCaH-cCakaH, powalikA, BAraH.
FARDEL , s. kUrccaH, gucCaH -cCakaH, powalikA, powwalI, BAraH.

Fare, s. annaM, AhAraH, BakzyaM, BojanaM. 2 tAryaM, AtA(ta)raH, tArikaM, tarapaRyaM-mUlyaM. v. i. BU 1 P, vft 1 A, as 2 P, sTA 1 P; ko vfttAMtastatraBavatyAH (M. 4) ‘how f(are) sit with her ladyship’; ‘f(ar)ing well’ susTa, susTita; ‘f(ar)ing ill’ dusTita, durgata. Farewell, interj. svasti, BadraM (BUyAt) with dat.; ‘bid f(arewell)’ AmaMtr 10 A, ApracC 6 A.
FARE (subs.): I Food: q. v.: annam.II Passage money: (f.) tArikaM or tAryam (for crossing);(2) vAhikam (?) (for conveying).III News; vArttA.

FARE (v.i.): I To go, pass: q.v.: vrajati (vraj, c. 1.).II To be in any state: how does Sāgarikā f.: sAgarikAyAH kiM vartate, Ra,; he f. s. well, ill: tasya priyaM, apriyaM vartate: v. To happen. III To feed: q.v.: BojanaM karoti.

To FARE , v. n. (Be in any state) vft (c. 1. varttate -rttituM), as (c. 2. asti), BU (c. 1. Bavati -vituM), sTA (c. 1. tizWati, sTAtuM); ‘to [Page260-b+ 51] fare well,’ susTaH -sTA -sTaM or susTitaH -tA -taM BU or as; ‘to fare badly,’ duHsTaH -sTA -sTaM BU or as; ‘faring well,’ BavizRuH -zRuH -zRu, BUzRuH -zRuH -zRu, BavitA -trI -tf (tf). — (Feed) BojanaM kf, Buj (c. 7. BuMkte, BoktuM), AhAraM kf; ‘to fare well,’ svAdvannAni or uttamA- -nnAni or paramAnnAni Buj.

FARE , s. (Passage-money) AtAraH, AtaraH, tarapaRyaM, taramUlyaM, tArikaM, tAryyaM, anutaraM. — (Food) BojanaM, AhAraH, annaM, BakzyaM; ‘good fare,’ uttamAhAraH, paramAnnaM, uttamAnnaM; ‘bad fare,’ kadannaM.
FAREWELL: v. Adieu. Bid your companion f.: Amantrayasva sahacaram, Sa.; I have done, f. to you: sADayAmyahamaviGnamastu te, R.; “f.:” Sivamastu.

FAREWELL , adv. (To bid farewell) Amantr (c. 10. -mantrayate -yituM), anumantr, ApracC (c. 6. -pfcCate -ti -prazwuM). — (Bidding farewell) AmantraRaM, ApracCanaM, prasTAnakAle kuSalavAdaH or praRAmaH or namaskAraH; ‘farewell!’ kuSalaM BUyAt, suKaM BUyAt, kalyARaM BUyAt, suKam AstAM.
FARF-FAMED: (1) dUrayaSas (mfn.) (?);(2) praTita- yaSas (mfn.);(3) urukIrti. (mfn.), R.; and sim. comp s.
Farina, s. parAgaH, rajas n., puzpareRuH.
FARINA: I Flour: q.v.:II Pollen:(1) parAgaH;(2) puzpareRuH.
FARINA , s. parAgaH, sumanorajaH n. (s), puzpareRuH m., sumanaHpAMSuH m., puruH m.
Farinaceous, a. DAnyamaya, goDUmacUrRamaya (yI f.).
FARINACEOUS: I Made of flour: cUrRamayaH (yI, yaM) (?).II Yielding f.: cUrRadaH (dA, daM) (?).III Mealy: cUrRa- in comp.
FARINACEOUS , a. SasyamayaH -yI -yaM, DAnyamayaH -yI -yaM, goDUmacUrRamayaH -yI -yaM.
