sanskrit.iast: śate śate niyamitabhāgo mayā dātavya iti sandhiṃ kṛtvā amukajanaṃ

details.body: Farm, s. kzetraM, kfzikzetraM, kzetraBUmi f.; ‘f(arm) house’ kzetrikagfhaM, kzetrapatigfhaM; ‘f(arm) yard’ kzetravAwaH-wikA [Farm]er, s. kzetrapatiH, kzetrapAlaH, kzetrikaH, kzetrAjIvaH, kzetrin m., karzakaH, kfzIvalaH, kfzikaH. [Farm]ing, s. kfzi f., kfzi-karman n.
FARM (subs.): I Lit. kzetram, owner of a f.: kzetra- patiH, H.II Lease: q.v.
FARM (v.): I To let: q.v.: BAwena or BAwakena dadAti (dA, c. 8.).II To hire: BAwayati (c. of Baw) or BAwakena gfhRAti (grah, c. 9.), Viv.III To cultivate: q.v.: kzetraM karoti.
FARM , s. kzetraM, BUmiH f., kzetraBUmiH, BUH f., kfzikzetraM, karzaRaBUmiH f., sItyaM.

To FARM , v. a. (Let out the collection of the revenue or any other work at a certain rate per cent.) Sate Sate nirUpitamUlyaM pratijYAya or Sate Sate niyamitaBAgo mayA dAtavya iti sanDiM kftvA amukajanaM SulkakarAdigrahaRe or kiYcitkarmmanirvahaRe niyuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yoktuM, c. 10. -yojayati -yituM). — (Undertake any work for another at a certain rate per cent.) Sate Sate niyamitaBAgo madvetanArTam udDaraRIyaM or Sate Sate nirUpitamUlyaM mayA grahaRIyam iti sanDiM kftvA amukajanasTAne kiYcit karmma nirvah in caus. (-vAhayati -yituM) or niyamitamUlpam apekzya parasTAne kiYcit karmma vyavaso (c. 4. -syati -sAtuM) or aDyavaso. — (Farm the tolls) nirUpitamUlyaM dattvA rAjasTAne GawwanadItarAdideyaSulkAn grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM). — (Cultivate land) kzetraM or BUmiM kfz (c. 6. kfzati, c. 1. karzati, krazwuM).
FARM-HOUSE , s. kzetrikagfhaM, karzakagfhaM, kzetrikaveSma n. (n), kzetrapatigfhaM.
FARM-YARD: kuSUlacatvarama; kuSUlANganam; etc.
FARM-YARD , s. kzetrikagfhopAnte vAwI or vAwikA or catvaraM.

sanskrit.slp1: iti sanDiM kftvA SulkakarAdi gfhlAti yo janaH
sanskrit.word: इति सन्धिं कृत्वा शुल्ककरादि गृह्लाति यो जनः
sanskrit.iast: iti sandhiṃ kṛtvā śulkakarādi gṛhlāti yo janaḥ

details.body: FARMER: I A cultivator:(1) kzetrapatiH;(2) kzetrasvAmin (m);(3) kzetrikaH.II A lease- -holder: q.v.

FARMER , s. kzetrakarzakaH, kzetrikaH, kzetrI m. (n), karzakaH, kfzikaH, kfzakaH, kzetrAjIvaH, kfzijIvI m. (n), kfzIbalaH, kArzakaH, kzetrapatiH m. — (Of the revenue) Sate Sate niyamitaBAgo madvetanArTam udDaraRIya iti sanDiM kftvA SulkakarAdi gfhlAti yo janaH.
FARMING (subs.): (1) kfzikarman (n.);(2) kzetra- karman (n.)
FARMING , s. kfzikarmma n. (n), kfziH f., kArziH f., kzetrikavyApAraH, anftaM.
FARRAGINOUS , a. sAnnipAtikaH -kI -kaM, sannipatitaH -tA -taM, prakIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, bahudravyanirmmitaH -tA -taM, nAnAdravyaGawitaH -tA -taM.
Farrago, s. sannipAtaH, prakIrRakaM, saMmiSraRaM. Farraginous, a. saMkIrRa, saMmiSrita, sannipatita.
FARRAGO (subs.): Golam (?): v. Medley.
FARRAGO , s. sannipAtaH, prakIrRakaM, nAnAdravyasammiSraRaM.
Farrier, s. aSvavEdyaH-cikitsakaH. 2 aSva-pAdatrakAraH. [Farrier]y, s. aSvacikitsA.
FARRIER: (1) aSvavEdyaH;(2) aSvacikitsakaH;(3) aSvalAkzaRikaH.
FARRIER , s. aSvacikitsakaH, aSvavEdyaH. — (Shoer of horses) aSvapA- dukAbanDA m. (nDf), aSvapAdukAkAraH.
FARRIERY: aSvacikitsA.
FARRIERY , s. aSvacikitsA, aSvarogacikitsanavidyA.
Farrow, s. SUkarApatyagaRaH.
FARROW , s. SUkaraSAvakagaRaH, SUkarapotakagaRaH, SUkarApatyaM.
To FARROW , v. n. SUkarIprakAreRa SAvakagaRaM su (c. 2. sUte, c. 4. sUyate, sotuM) or prasu.
FART , s. pardaH -rdanaM, gudaravaH, pAyuSabdaH, SardDaH,
Farther, a. dUratara, davIyas. 2 apara; ‘the f(arther) end’ pAraH, aparaprAMtaH. adv. dUrataraM, aDikadUraM. 2 agre, agrataH, puraH, purataH.

FARTHER , adv. dUrataraM, vidUrataraM, aDikadUre, agre, agrataraM, agratas, puratas, puras. — (Moreover) aparaM, aparaYca, aDikaM, aDikantu, anyacca, apica, kiYca, parantu. See the more correct word further.
FARTHER , a. dUrataraH -rA -raM, vidUrataraH -rA -raM, davIyAn -yasI -yaH (s), aDikadUrasTaH -sTA -sTaM, aparaH -rA -raM; ‘the farther side,’ pAraH; ‘on the farther side,’ pAre.
Farthest, a. davizWa, dUratama, sudUra. adv. su-dUraM, atidUraM-re.
FARTHEST , a. dUratamaH -mA -maM, vidUratamaH -mA -maM, davizWaH -zWA -zWaM, sudUraH [Page261-a+ 51] -rA -raM, atyantadUrasTaH -sTA -sTaM.
Farthing, s. tAmramudrA; ‘not even a f(arthing)’ na kAkiRI api, na kimapi.
FARTHING: tAmramudrAviSezaH; *penipAdam.
FARTHING , s. tAmramudrA, kaparddakaH, varAwakaH.
FASCES: daRqaparaSuH.
FASCES , s. DarmmADyakzalakzaRaM, daRqanAyakacihnaM, pUrvvakAle romanagare daRqalAkza- -RikaH kAzWaKaRqasambadDaH paraSuH.
Fascia, baMDanaM, vezwanaM, pawwaH.
FASCIA , s. pawwaH, pawwakaH, banDanaM, vezWanaM, AvezwanaM, kavalikA.
FASCIATION: banDaH: v. Bondage.
FASCIATION , s. pawwabanDanaM, kavalikAbanDanaM, anuvellitaM.
FASCICULAR: puYjitaH (tA, taM).

Fascinate, v. t. muh c., aBimaMtr 10 A, aBicar c. maMtradvAreRa vaSIkf 8 U. 2 hf 1 P, Akfz 1 P, pra-vi-luB c., grah 9 P, ram c. (ramayati). [Fascinat]ing, a. mohin, hArin, hfdayagrAhin, manohara, cittAkarzin, hfdayaMgama. [Fascinat]ion, s. mohaH-hanaM, saM-pari-vi-mohanaM, aBi cAraH, aBimaMtraRaM, mAyA, iMdrajAlaM, vaSakriyA. 2 AkarzaH, cittApahAraH, cittaviloBanaM.
FASCINATE (v.): mohayati, vi- (c. of muh), what man you may not f.: pumAMsaM kaM na mohayeH, Mah.: v. To bewitch, charm.

To FASCINATE , v. a. (Bewitch) muh in caus. (mohayati -yituM), mohaM kf, mAyAM kf, mantradvAreRa vaSIkf or aBimantr (c. 10. -mantrayate -yituM) or anumantr or aBicar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM). — (Captivate) cittaM or mano hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM) or ram in caus. (ramayati -yituM) or Akfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM), hfdayaM grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM).

FASCINATED , p. p. mohitaH -tA -taM, vimohitaH -tA -taM, sammohitaH -tA -taM, parimUQaH -QA -QaM, sammugDaH -gDA -gDaM, AkfzwacittaH -ttA -ttaM, hftamAnasaH -sI -saM, vaSIkftaH -tA -taM, vaSIBUtaH -tA -taM.
FASCINATING (adj.): (1) mohanaH (nI, naM);(2) vimohin (f. nI), world-f. Sitā: sItA loka- vimohinI, A.r.: v. Charming. Ph: a woman with f. eyes: madirAkzI, R.; mugDAkzI, Mal.; etc.

FASCINATING , a. cittahArI -riRI -ri (n), cittApahArI &c., manoharaH -rA -raM, mohanaH -nA -nI -naM, vimohanaH &c., mohI -hinI -hi (n), parimohI &c., AkarzakaH -kI -kaM, AkarzikaH -kI -kaM, AkfzwavAn -vatI -vat (t), hfdayagrAhI -hiRI -hi (n); ‘a fascinating wo- -man,’ mugDA, pramadA, madirekzaRA.
FASCINATION: I The art: mohanam, vi-; better by verb.II The power: mohanI SaktiH, etc.
FASCINATION , s. mohaH -hanaM, parimohanaM, vimohanaM, sammohaH, AkarzaH, mAyA, vaSakriyA, aBimantraRaM, aBicAraH, indrajAlaM, kArmmaRaM -RatvaM.
FASCINE , s. yudDe vyavahAritaH kAzWaBAraH or kAzWakUrccaH.

Fashion, s. rIti f., prakAraH, viDiH, viDaH, mArgaH; ‘f(ashion) of dress’ BUzAprakAraH. 2 rUpaM, AkAraH, Akfti f., mUrti f., saMsTAnaM. 3 lokAcAraH, saMpradAyaH, lokamArgaH-rItiH, lokavyavahAraH, lOkikavyavahAraH, lOkikAcAraH. v. t. nirmA 3 A, 2 P, vi-rac 10, vi-DA 3 U, Gaw c. (Gawayati), saM-pari-kxp c., takz 1, 5 P, tvakz 1 P. 2 yuj 7 U, 10, saM-samA-DA. [Fashion]able, a. lOkika-vyAvahArika (kI f.), lokAcArAnurUpa, lokavyavahArAnu-sArin, lokamArgAnuyAyin. Fashionably, adv. lokAcArAnurUpaM, lokarItivat.
FASHION (subs.): I Shape, make: q.v.: gaWanam.II Prevailing custom: rItiH (?), this is the new f.: *iyamaminavA rItiH.III Manner, way: q.v.
FASHION (v.): I To form: q.v.: gaWati (gaW, c. 1.).II To fit, adopt: q.v.: “laws ought to be f. ed to the manners of the people”: *lokAcArAnurUpiRo viDayo viDeyAH.

FASHION , s. (Form) AkAraH, AkftiH f., rUpaM, saMskAraH, mUrttiH f., viDAnaM, saMsTAnaM. — (Cut, shape) AkAraH, AkftiH f., rItiH f. — (Prevailing custom) lOkikAcAraH, lokAcAraH, lokavyavahAraH, lokarItiH f., lokamArgaH, lokavyApAraH, DArA, lokamataM. — (Manner, mode) prakAraH, viDaH, viDiH m., rItiH f., mArgaH; ‘after this fashion,’ anena prakAreRa, evaMviDaM; ‘after one's own fashion,’ svAnurUpaM.

To FASHION , v. a. (Form) nirmA (c. 2. -mAti, c. 3. -mimIte, c. 4. -mAyate -mAtuM), vinirmA, rac (c. 10. racayati -yituM), virac, kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM), viDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), Gaw (c. 10. Gawayati -yituM), kf, saNkf. — (Adapt) yuj (c. 10. yojayati -yituM), sanDA, samADA.
FASHION-MONGER: *rItyEkadfS (mfn.): v. Fop.
FASHIONABLE: I Approved.: lokasammataH (tA, taM): v. Good.II Current: q.v.: pracalitaH (tA, taM).III Observing fashions: no equiv.: *rItyanuyAyin (f. nI).IV Gentle, good: q.v.

FASHIONABLE , a. lOkikaH -kI -kaM, vyAvahArikaH -kI -kaM, AcArikaH -kI -kaM, lokasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, lokaprasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, vyavahArasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, lokAcArAnusArI -riRI -ri (n), lokavyavahArAnusArI &c., lokamatAnusArI &c., lOkikAcArAnurUpaH -pA -paM, lOkikarItyanurUpaH -pA -paM, lokamArgAnuyAyI -yinI -yi (n).
FASHIONABLY: *rItyanusAreRa; yaTArIti.
FASHIONABLY , adv. lokAcArAnusAreRa, lokavyavahArAnusArAt, loka- -rItivat.
FASHIONED , p. p. nirmmitaH -tA -taM, racitaH -tA -taM, viracitaH -tA -taM, kalpitaH -tA -taM, kxptaH -ptA -ptaM, GawitaH -tA -taM, kAritaH -tA -taM.

Fast, a. dfQa, gAQa, sTira, acala, sTAvara, ni-Scala, sTAyin, dfQabadDa; ‘f(ast) friend’ dfQa-sOhfdaH; ‘f(ast) sleep’ gAQanidrA, sunidrA. 2 drutagamin, tvaritagati, SIGra, javin, javavat, SIGragati. adv. dfQaM, gAQaM, sTiraM; in comp. ex. by dfQa or su; ‘f(ast) bound’ su-dfQa-badDa; ‘f(ast) roote’ badDamUla, surUQa; ‘f(ast) asleep’ suKasupta, gAQanidrAM gata. 2 SIGraM, ASu, satvaraM, kzipraM, tvaritaM ‘not so f(ast)’ alamalamIdfSyA tvarayA. [Fast]ness, s. dfQatA, sTiratA. 2 durgaM, kowaH. Fasten, v. t. baMD 9 P, sa-ni°, pi-nah 4 U, graMT 9 P, (together); saMyuj 7 U, 10, saM-Sliz c., saM-DA 3 U, yoktrayati (D.). 2 pi-DA 3 U, saM-vf 5 U, niruD 7 U, argalena baMD. 3 dfQIkf 8 U, sTirIkf, saMstaMB 9 P or c. [Fasten]ing, s. baMDanaM-nI, graMTiH. 2 saMDiH, kuqupaH.

Fast, v. i. upa-vas 1 P, AhArAd nivft 1 A; ‘f(ast) to death’ prA-yopaveSanaM kf 8 U, anaSanena mf 6 A. [Fast]ing, s. upavAsaH, anaSanaM, anAhAraH, laM-GanaM, upozaRaM, AkzepaRaM, prAyaH; ‘f(ast)ing to death’ prAyo-paveSanaM. [Fast]er, s. sopavAsaH, kftopavAsaH.

FAST (adj.): I Firm: q.v.: dfQaH (QA, QaM). Ph.: f. sleep: gAQanidrA; very f. friend: GanizWamitram.II Swift: q.v.: SIGragAmin (f. nI).III Rash: q.v.: pramattaH (ttA, ttaM). A f. girl: pragalBavanitA, K.; f.-handed: badDamuzwi (mfn.), N.
FAST (adv.): I Firmly: q.v.: dfQam.II Swiftly: q.v.:(1) SIGnam;(2) ASu, f. er than the mind itself: manaso'pyASutaram.
FAST (subs.): I F. ing:(1) upavAsaH;(2) anaSanam, nirAhAraH (= not taking food);(3) prAyaH (rare), R.II F. ing time: upavAsakAlaH, f. day: upavAsadinam.

FAST (v.i.): (1) upavasati (vas, c. 1.) or upavAsaM karoti or kurute, but (they) all f. ed that day: tasmiMstu divase sarve upavAsaM pracakrire, A r.;(2) na aSnAti (aS, c. 9.), etc.: v. To eat, not. To f. to death: anaSanena uparamate (ram, c. 1.), D. vi.

FAST , a. (Firm, close) dfQaH -QA -QaM, sTiraH -rA -raM, sTAvaraH -rA -raM, stabDaH -bDA -bDaM, acalaH -lA -laM, niScalaH -lA -laM, dfQasanDiH -nDiH -nDi, gAQaH -QA -QaM. — (Fixed) badDaH -dDA -dDaM, sannivadDaH -dDA -dDaM; ‘a fast colour,’ sTiraraNgaH; ‘a fast friend,’ dfQasOhfdaH, dfQaBaktiH m; ‘a fast sleep,’ suzuptiH f., sunidrA, atiSayanidrA, aGoranidrA. — (Quick in motion) tvaritagatiH -tiH -ti, SIGragAmI -minI -mi (n), drutagatiH -tiH -ti, SIGraH -GrA -GraM, mahAvegaH -gA -gaM, vegavAn -vatI -vat (t)

FAST , adv. (Firmly) dfQaM, gAQaM, sTiraM; ‘fast-rooted,’ badDamUlaH -lA -laM; ‘held fast,’ sugfhItaH -tA -taM, suDftaH -tA -taM, kararudDaH -dDA -dDaM; ‘fast bound,’ dfQabadDaH -dDA -dDaM; ‘shut fast,’ dfQasaMvftaH -tA -taM, [Page261-b+ 51] dfQapihitaH -tA -taM; ‘fast asleep,’ suzuptaH -ptA -ptaM, sunidritaH -tA -taM, atiSayanidritaH -tA -taM, suKasuptaH -ptA -ptaM, or suKaM suptaH -ptA -ptaM. — (Swiftly) SIGraM, tvaritaM, drutaM, kzipraM, satvaraM, ASu, avilambitaM, aSanEH; ‘going fast,’ tvaritagatiH -tiH -ti; ‘spoken fast,’ tvaritoditaH -tA -taM.

To FAST , v. n. upavas (c. 1. -vasati -vastuM), laNG (c. 1. laNGate -NGituM), nirUpitakAlaparyyantaM BojanAt or AhArAd nivft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), upavAsaM kf, anaSanaM kf, AhAranivfttiM kf; ‘to death,’ prAyopaveSanaM kf.
FAST , s. upavAsaH, upavastaM, upozitaM, upozaRaM, OpavastaM, anaSanaM, anAhAraH, aBojanaM, laNGanaM, AkzapaRaM.
FAST-DAY , s. upavAsadinaM, upozaRadinaM, anAhAradivasaH, laNGanadivasaH
FASTED , p. p. upozitaH -tA -taM, kftopavAsaH -sA -saM.

FASTEN (v.): baDnAti, ni-, A-, saM-, (banD, c. 9), f. ing a chain to the feet: SfNnalayA caraRayornibaDya, V.t.; did not f. her affection on him: tasmin BAvaM na babanDa, R. vi. 36.; she took off (her) necklace and f. ed on a bark: sA hAraM vimucya valkalaM babanDa, Ku. v. 8; f. ed. (secured) by the glances of beauties: sundarIRAM kawAkzErbadDaH, Ku. iii. 5.: v. To bind, tie. Ph.: to f. a door: dvAraM dadAti, Vi. or kapAwaM dadAti, Va.

To FASTEN , v. a. (Make fast) banD (c. 9. baGnAti, banDuM), sambanG, nibanD, anubanD. — (Shut up) piDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), niruD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM). — (Bar) argalena banD, kIla (nom. kIlayati -yituM). — (Unite together) sambanD, saMyuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yoktuM), saMSliz in caus. (-Slezayati -yituM), sanDA, saMlagnIkf. — (Tie) yoktra (nom. yoktayati -yituM), granT (c. 9. graTnAti, c. 1. granTati -nTituM). — (Tie on) pinah (c. 4. -nahyati -nadDuM), Anah, AbanD, anubanD. — (Impress) praRiDA. — (Make firm) dfQIkf, sTirIkf, saMstamB (c. 5. -staBnoti -stamBituM, c. 10. -stamBayati -yituM).

FASTENED , p. p. badDaH -dDA -dDaM, pihitaH -tA -taM, piDAnavAn -vatI -vat (t), sapiDAnaH -nA -naM, nirudDaH -dDA -dDaM, yuktaH -ktA -ktaM, saMyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, saMyojitaH -tA -taM, saMlagnIkftaH -tA -taM, lagnaH -gnA -gnaM, pinadDaH -dDA -dDaM, AnadDaH -dDA -dDaM, kIlAyitaH -tA -taM, kIlitaH -tA -taM.
FASTENING (subs.): I The act: banDanam.II That which binds: banDaH, -naH, -nI.
FASTENING , s. (Any thing that binds) banDanaM -nI, banDanagranTiH m. — (Joining) sanDiH m. — (Of a bracelet) kuqupaH, sanDiH m.
FASTER: (1) upavAsakArin (f. RI);(2) kftopavAsaH (sA, saM)
FASTER , s. upavAsI m. (n), upavAsakarttA m. (rttf), kftopavAsaH, sopavAsaH.
FASTER , adv. (More rapidly) SIGrataraM, aDikavegena, laGutaraM.
Fastidious, a. dustozaRIya, durlalita, durA-rADya. 2 sAvajYa, avamAnin, upekzaka; ‘a f(astidious) critic’ dozEkadfS. [Fastidious]ly, adv. sAvamAnaM, durArADyatayA.
FASTIDIOUS: (1) dozadfS (mfn.) (= fault-find- -ing);(2) asantuzwaH (zwA, zwaM) (=discontented); (3) kazwaprItaH (tA, taM) (?).

FASTIDIOUS , a. upekzakaH -kA -kaM, avamAnI -ninI -ni (n), sAvahelaH -lA -laM, sAvajYaH -jYA -jYaM, GfRI -RinI -Ri (n), dustozaRIyaH -yA -yaM, duHKatozaRIyaH -yA -yaM, duHKena santozaRIyaH -yA -yaM or tarpaRIyaH -yA -yaM.
FASTIDIOUSLY , adv. sAvajYAnaM, upekzayA, sAvahelaM, sAvamAnaM, dustozaRIyaM.
FASTIDIOUSNESS: (1) dozadarSitA;(2) asantuzwatA: v. Fastidious.
FASTIDIOUSNESS , s. avamAnaSIlatA, upekzakatvaM, sAvahelatvaM, dustozaRIyatA, dustarpaRIyatA, avamAnitA.
FASTING , s. upavAsaH, upozaRaM -zitaM, anaSanaM, niraSanaM, aBojanaM, aBakzaRaM, anAhAraH, laNGanaM, AkzapaRaM, apatarpaRaM; ‘to death,’ prAyaH -yaRaM, prAyopaveSanaM -SanikA.
FASTING , part. or a. upavAsI -sinI -si (n), nirAhAraH -rA -raM, anaSanaH -nA -naM, aBakzaH -kzA -kzaM, anASakaH -kA -kaM, akftAhAraH -rA -raM; ‘to death,’ prAyopavizwaH -zwA -zwaM.
FASTLY: dfQam: v. Firmly.
FASTNESS: I Firmness; q. v.: dfQatA.II A fort: durgam.
FASTNESS , s. (Firmness) dfQatA, sTiratA, stabDatA, acalatA, niScalatA. — (Strong-hold) durgaM, kowiH f., SiKarI m. (n).
FASTUOUS , a. garvvI -rvviRI -rvvi (n), sAvalepaH -pA -paM, udDataH -tA -taM.

Fat, a. pIna, pIvara, puzwa, mAMsala, ApyAna, sTUla, sPIta; medasvin, puzwAMga (gI f.), sTUladeha; ‘f(at) land’ urvarA. s. medas n., vasA(SA), vapA, mAMsasAraH-snehaH. [Fat]ten, v. t. A-pyE v., sPAy c. (sPAvayati), saM-vfD c., pIvarIkf 8 U, paripuz c. v. i. ApyE 1 A, pInIBU, saMvfD 1 A, sPAy 1 A, upabfMh 1 P. [Fat]ness, s. medasvitA, pInatA, sTUlatA, medovfdDi f., sPIti f. [Fat]ty, a. mAMsala, medasvin.

FAT (adj.): I Corpulent:(1) pInaH (nA, naM); (2) pIvaraH (rA, raM);(3) medasvin (f. nI), f. men: medasvinaH, Bha.;(4) puzwANga (f. NgI) (in body), H.II Oily, rich:(1) GftasaMsfzwaH (zwA, zwaM) (in ghee);(2) medasvin (f. nI) (?) (in fat).III Dull, stupid: q.v.IV Productive, rich: sPItaH (tA, taM), of f. capital: sPItasAraDanaH (nA, naM), D.; the country became f.: sPIto janapado'Bavat, Mah. ii. 33. 2.
FAT (subs.): (1) medas (n.);(2) vasA;(3) vapA.

FAT , a. pIvaraH -rA -rI -raM, pInaH -nA -naM, medasvI -svinI -svi (n), puzwaH -zwA -zwaM, puzwANgaH -NgI -NgaM, mAMsalaH -lA -laM, sTUlaH -lA -laM, sTUlakAyaH -yA -yaM, pyAnaH -nA -naM, ApyAnaH -nA -naM, prapyAnaH -nA -naM, sPItaH -tA -taM, sPAtaH -tA -taM, pIvA -vA -va (n), tundI -ndinI -ndi (n), tundikaH -kA -kaM, ucCUnaH -nA -naM, kuRwakaH -kI -kaM. — (Fertile) sPItaH -tA -taM; ‘fat land,’ urvvarA.
FAT , s. medaH n. (s), vasA, vapA, mAMsasAraH, mAMsasnehaH, GftaM.
To FAT , v. a. pyE in caus. (pyAyayati -yituM), ApyE, puz in caus. (poza- [Page262-a+ 51] yati -yituM), sPAy in caus. (sPAvayati -yituM), sTUlIkf, pIvarIkf, puzwIkf.
To FAT , v. n. ApyE (c. 1. -pyAyate -pyAtuM), puz (c. 4. puzyati, pozwuM), pIvarIBU.
FAT . s. (tub) BARqaM. See VAT.
FATAL: I Inevitable: q.v.II Deadly, mortal:(1) prARaharaH (rI, raM);(2) sAMGAtikaH (kI, kaM);(3) AtyayikaH (kI, kaM);(4) durantaH (ntA, ntaM).

FATAL , a. (Proceeding from fate, relating to it) dEvaH -vI -vaM -vikaH -kI -kaM, dEzwikaH -kI -kaM, kArttAntikaH -kI -kaM, dEvaprayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, dEvavaSaH -SA -SaM, niyataH -tA -taM, AvaSyakaH -kI -kaM. — (Deadly, calamitous) prARaGAtakaH -kA -kaM, prARaharaH -rA -raM, prARA- ntikaH -kI -kaM or prARAntakaH, prARanASakaH -kI -kaM, mftyujanakaH -kA -kaM, mArAtmakaH -kA -kaM, sANGAtikaH -kI -kaM, mArakaH -kA -kaM, antakaraH -rA -raM, vyApAdakaH -kA -kaM, AtyayikaH -kI -kaM, anAyuzyaH -zyA -zyaM, marmmA- -ntikaH -kI -kaM, marmmaBedI -dinI -di (n), durantaH -ntA -ntaM, durvipAkaH -kA -kaM.
FATALISM: dEzwikatA, Si. ii. 86.
FATALISM , s. dEvAyattatA, dEvADInatA, dEvavaSitvaM, dEvacintA, dEvikatA, dEzwikatA.
FATALIST: (1) dEzwikaH;(2) dEvapramARakaH, M.n.
FATALIST , s. dEvaparaH, dEvADInaH, dEvAyattaH, dEvaparAyaRaH, dEvacintakaH.
FATALITY: I Inevitable necessity: dEvanirbanDaH. II Mortality:(1) prARaharatvam;(2) sANGAtikatA; (3) better by adj.III Fate: q.v.: BavitavyatA.
FATALITY , s. AvaSyakatA, avaSyakatvaM, BavitavyatA, kftAntaH, niyatiH f.
FATALLY: I Inevitably dEvanirbanDena.II Mortally: expr. by adj.: to wound f.: prARaharavraRaM karoti; f. deceived: AtyayikavaYcanAgataH (tA, taM) (?)
FATALLY , adv. (By necessity) dEvAt, dEvavaSAt, dEvaniyogAt. — (Mortally) prARanASena, sanASaM, AtyayikaM.

Fate, s. dEvaM, BAgyaM, BAgaDeyaM, dizwaM, adfzwaM, karman n., niyati f., prAktanaM, BavitavyatA; ‘personified f(ate)’ viDiH, viDAtA, kftAMtaH, kAlaH; ‘it is our f(ate) to do wrong’ pApAcaraRaM dEvAyattaM-dEvADInaM. 2 mftyuH, nASaH, kzayaH, aMtaH; gati f., pariRAmaH; ‘he met with a sad f(ate)’ SocanIyaH-kazwaH-tasya aMtaH samajAyata; ‘what was Sītāʼs f(ate)’ sItAdevyAH kiM vfttaM (U. 2); ‘such has been the f(ate) of your birth’ IdfSaste nirmARaBAgaH pariRataH (U. 4); ‘ill-f(ate)’ durdEvaM, maMdaBAgyaM, dEvadurvipAkaH-viparyayaH-viparyAsaH. [Fat]ed, a. niyata, dEvaniyukta, nirdizwa, Bavitavya; ‘whose f(ated) time has come’ prAptakAlaH; ‘ill-f(ated)’ dEvopahata, durdEva, maMdaBAgya; ‘well-f(ated)’ BAgyavat, Danya, sasOBAgya. Fatal, a. prARahara, prARanASaka, jIvitApaha, aMtakara, prARaGAtin, mftyujanaka, durvipAka, marmaBedin. 2 dEva (vI f.), niyata, dEvayukta, AvaSyaka (kI f.). [Fatal]ism, s. dEvaparatA, dEvADInatA. [Fatal]ist, s. dEvaparaH, dEvAyattaH, dEvaparAyaRaH, dEvADInaH, yadBavizyaH, dEvapramARakaH. [Fatal]ity, s. prARaharatvaM; niyatiH, BavitavyatA, avaSyakatvaM. [Fatal]ly, adv. sanASaM, prARAMtikaM, ‘f(atally) wounded’ taTA kzato yaTA'saMdigDo mftyuH.

FATE: I In abstract sense:(1) dEvam, f. can- not be altered: na SakyaM dEvamanyaTA kartum, K.;(2) niyatiH, f. is the cause in the world: niyatiH kAraRaM loke, Ram.;(3) BavitavyatA, foltowingfollowing f.: BavitavyatAnuviDAyin (f. nI), V.;(4) viDiH, f. dominates: praBavati viDiH, K.;(5) dizwam;(6) adfzwam.II Appointed lot: dizwam, has met end of f.: dizwAntaM samanuprAptaH, Ram. ii. 74. 25.

FATE , s. dEvaM, kftAntaH, viDAtA m. (tf), viDiH m. BAgaDeyaM, BAgyaM, niyatiH f., BavitavyatA, dizwaM, dEvikaM, adfzwaM, kAlaniyogaH, kAlaH, kAla- -DarmmaH, gatiH f., vyasanaM, karmma n. (n), karmmavaSaH, kAryyavaSaH, prAktanaM. — (Death) mftyuH m., nASaH, vinASaH, kzayaH; ‘ill-fate,’ durdEvaM, dOrBAgyaM; ‘good-fate,’ sOBAgyaM.
FATED: (1) dEvavihitaH (tA, taM);(2) viDikftaH (tA, taM);(3) dizwaH (zwA, zwaM).

FATED , a. dEvaniyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, kAlaniyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, dEvanirdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, niyataH -tA -taM, dEvikaH -kI -kaM, dEzwikaH -kI -kaM, BavitavyaH -vyA -vyaM; ‘one whose fated time is come,’ prAptakAlaH -lA -laM; ‘well- -fated,’ suBAgyaH -gyA -gyaM, sOBAgyavAn -vatI -vat (t), puRyavAn &c.; ‘ill-fated,’ durdEvagrastaH -stA -staM, dEvopahataH -tA -taM.

Father, s. pitf m., janakaH, janitf-janayitf m., janmadaH, tAtaH; ‘f(ather) and mother’ pitarO, mAtApitarO, mAtarapitarO. 2 guruH, pUjyaH; ‘f(ather)-in-law’ SvaSuraH; ‘f(ather)land’ janma-pEtfka-BUmi f. v. t. svIkf 8 U, parigrah 9 P. 2 A-ruh c. (ropayati), niviS c., (with loc.). [Father]hood, s. pitfBAvaH-DarmaH, pitftvaM. [Father]less, a. apitfka, tAta-pitf-hIna, anATa. [Father]ly, a. tAta-pitf-tulyaM, pitfnirviSeza; gen. by comp.; ‘f(atherly) affection’ pitf-vAtsalyaM. adv. pitfvat, tAtarUpeRa.

FATHER: (subs.): (1) pitf (m.), he was the f., their f. s were only begetters: sa pitA pitarastAsAM kevalaM janmahetavaH, R. i. 24.; you are the f. of f.s: tvaM pitFRAmasi pitA, Ku. ii. 14.;(2) janakaH; (3) janayitf (m.);(4) tAtaH (= papa).

FATHER , s. pitA m. (tf), janakaH, jananaH, janitA m. (tf), janayitA m. (tf), janmadaH, tAtaH, prasavitA m. (tf), prajAvAn m. (t), DAtA m. (tf), vaptA m. (ptf), vApaH, dehakft m., samBUH m.; ‘of a family,’ kulapatiH m.; ‘of a son,’ putrI m. (n), sutI m. (n); ‘father and mother,’ mAtApitarO m. du. or mAtarapitarO, tAtajanayitryO f. du.; ‘father of all,’ viSvaDAtA. m. (tf). — (Title of respect) guruH, AcAryyaH.

To FATHER , v. a. putraM grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM), pozyaputraM or kftrimaputraM grah. — (Acknowledge as one's own) svIkf. — (Ascribe to another as his offspring, or production) putrAropaRaM kf, kiYcit parasmE Aruh in caus. (-ropayati -yituM), tena prasutaM or tena viracitam iti vijYA in caus. (-jYApayati -yituM).
To FATHER , v. a. pitftvAropaM kf, pitftAropaRaM kf.
FATHER-IN-LAW: SvaSuraH, your f. is my friend: tava SvaSuro me saKA, R.
FATHER-IN-LAW , s. SvaSuraH, DarmmapitA m. (tf), pUjyaH; ‘father and mother -in -law,’ SvaSrUSvaSurO m. du.
FATHER-LAND: (1) pEtfkaBUmiH;(2) pitfBUmiH; etc.
FATHER-LAND , s. pEtfkaBUmiH f., pEtfkadeSaH, pEtfkavizayaH, janmaBUmiH f., mUlaBUmiH.
FATHERHOOD: pitftvam: v.: Paternity.
FATHERHOOD , s. pitftvaM -tA, janakatvaM -tA -pitfBAvaH, prajAvattvaM, pitfDarmmaH.
FATHERLESS: (1) pitfhInaH (nA, naM);(2) apitfkaH (kA, kaM).
FATHERLESS , a. apitfkaH -kA -kaM, pitfhInaH -nA -naM, tAtahInaH -nA -naM, CamaRqaH or CemaRqaH m. only, anATaH -TA -TaM, nirRATaH -TA -TaM.
FATHERLINESS: (1) expr. by adj.;(2) vAtsalyam (= fatherly affection).
FATHERLINESS , s. pitftulyatA, tAtatulpatA, pEtfkatvaM, vAtsalyaM.
FATHERLY (adj.): (1) pitfsanniBaH (BA, BaM) and sim. comp. s.;(2) by adv.
FATHERLY (adv.) (1) pitfvat;(2) piteva.
FATHERLY , a. pitfsanniBaH -BA -BaM, pitftulyaH -lyA -lyaM, tAtatulyaH -lyA -lyaM, tAtalaH -lA -laM, pEtfkaH -kI -kaM or pEtrikaH, pEtraH -trI -traM, pitfnirviSezaH -zA -zaM, manojavaH -vA -vaM.
FATHERLY , adv. pitfvat, janakavat, tAtavat, pitfrUpeRa, janakarUpeRa.

Fathom, v. t. (talaM or veDaM) parIkz 1 A, nirUp 10, mA 3 A or c. (mApayati), vyaD 4 P; ‘f(athom) anotherʼs thoughts’ manaH parIkz or gAh 1 A or nirUp. s. vyAmaH, vyAyAmaH. [Fathom]less, a. agADa, atalasparSa, anavagAhya, agamyatala.
FATHOM: I Subs.: vyAmaH or vyAyAmaH.II Verb: mApayati (c. of mA): v. To measure.
FATHOM , s. (Measure of length) vyAmaH, vyAyAmaH, nyagroDaH. — (Pene- -tration) veDaH -DanaM, marmmaveDaH.

To FATHOM , v. a. (Sound the depth) veGaM or gAmBIryyaM or talaM parIkz [Page262-b+ 51] (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM) or nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM) or mA in caus. (mApayati -yituM). — (Penetrate) vyaD (c. 4. viDyati, vyadDuM); ‘one's designs,’ marmma vyaD, aBiprAyaM parIkz or nirUp.
FATHOMLESS: (1) agADaH (DA, DaM);(2) atalasparSaH (rSA, rSaM).
FATHOMLESS , a. atalasparSaH -rSA -rSaM, agADaH -DA -DaM, anavagAhyaH -hyA -hyaM, agamyaH -myA -myaM, agamyatalaH -lA -laM.
FATIDICAL , a. BavizyadvAcakaH -kA -kaM, BavizyatpradarSakaH -kA -kaM.

Fatigue, s. AyAsaH, klamaH, SramaH, avasAdaH, KedaH, pariSramaH, kleSaH, glAni-klAMti-SrAMti f., taMdrA, ‘inured to f(atigue)’ SramasahizRu, jitaSrama. v. t. Kid c., Ayas c., avasad c., klam c. or Sram c. (kla-Sra-mayati), kliS 9 P, glE c. (gla-glA-payati). [Fatigu]ed, a. SrAMta, klAMta, Kinna, glAna, avasanna, SramArta, saSrama, jAtaKeda-Srama; ‘to be f(atigued)’ Sram 4 P, klam 1, 4 P, Ayas 1, 4 P, Kid pass.

FATIGUE (subs.): (1) AyAsAH, Ki. vii. 3.;(2) KedaH (= exhaustion), Si. vii. 75.;(3) klAntiH or klamaH (= weariness), Ki. ix. 75.;(4) SramaH or pariSramaH (= by exertion), R. ix. 49. Ph.: inured to f.: jitaSramaH (mA, maM), Ka.; able to bear f.: AyAsasahaH (hA, haM), V. p.
FATIGUE (v.): (1) AyAsayati (c. of yas);(2) Kedayati (c. of Kid);(3) klamayati, pari-, (c. of klam);(4) SramaM janayati (c. of jan).

FATIGUE , s. klAntiH f., SrAntiH f., klamaH, SramaH, AyAsaH, pariSramaH, pariSrAntiH f., KedaH, kleSaH, klamitvaM, klamaTaH, avasAdaH, glAniH f., kazwaM, vyAyAmaH, kAyakleSaH, tandrA; ‘inured to fatigue,’ jitaSramaH -mA -maM.

To FATIGUE , v. a. Kid in caus. (Kedayati -yituM), klam in caus. (klama- yati -yituM), pariklam, Ayas in caus. (-yAsayati -yituM), Sram in caus. (Sramayati -yituM), pariSram, sad in caus. (sAdayati -yituM), avasad, glE in caus. (glapayati -yituM), pariglE, kliS (c. 9. kliSnAti, kleSituM), SrAntiM jan in caus. (janayati -yituM).

FATIGUED: (1) SrAntaH or pariSrAntaH (ntA, ntaM), f. by watering the trees: vfkzasecanAt pariSrAntA, Sa.; (2) klAntaH or pariklAntaH (ntA, ntaM);(3) KinnaH (nnA, nnaM);(4) AyAsitaH (tA, taM). To be f.:(1) SrAmyati, pari-, (Sram, c. 4.);(2) klAmyati (klam, c. 4.);(3) Kidyate (Kid, c. 4.).

FATIGUED , p. p. SrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, pariSrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, klAntaH -ntA -ntaM, SramArttaH -rttA -rttaM, jAtaSramaH -mA -maM, KinnaH -nnA -nnaM, KeditaH -tA -taM, klizwaH -zwA -zwaM, kliSitaH -tA -taM, kleSitaH -tA -taM, glAnaH -nA -naM, pari- glAnaH -nA -naM, klamI -minI -mi (n), SramI -miRI -mi (n), avasannaH -nnA -nnaM, avasAditaH -tA -taM, saSramaH -mA -maM; ‘to be fatigued,’ Sram (c. 4. SrAmyati, SramituM), Ayas (c. 4. -yasyati -yasituM), Kid (c. 4. Kidyate, KettuM), klam (c. 4. klAmyati, klamituM), kazwa (nom. kazwAyate).
FATIGUING (adj.): (1) SramakaraH (rI, raM);(2) AyAsakaraH (rI, raM); etc.
FATIGUING , a. SramakaraH -rI -raM, SramajanakaH -kA -kaM, kleSakaH -kI -kaM.
FATNESS: (1) medasvitA;(2) pInatA;(3) pIvaratA; (4) puzwANgatA.
FATNESS , s. sTUlatA, sTOlyaM, medasvitA, puzwatA, puzwiH f., pInatA, pIvaratvaM, sPItiH f., medovfdDiH f., sPAtiH f., unmedA, SarIrasTUlatA, sTUlakAyatvaM, ApyAyanaM.
FATTEN (v.t.): (1) pyAyayati, A-, (c. of pyE); (2) pIvarIkaroti;(3) bfMhayati (c. of bfMh);(4) by (adj.).
FATTEN (v.i.): (1) pyAyate, A-, (pyE, c. 1.);(2) by adj.
To FATTEN , v. a. pyE in caus. (pyAyayati -yituM), ApyE, puz in caus. (pozayati -yituM), sTUlIkf, pIbarIkf, puzwIkf; sPAy in caus. (sPAva- yati -yituM), saMvfD in caus. (varDayati -yituM).
To FATTEN , v. n. ApyE (c. 1. -pyAyate -pyAtuM), puz (c. 4. puzyati, pozwuM), sTUlIBU, pIvarIBU, saMvfD (c. 1. -varDate -rDituM), sPAy (c. 1. sPAyate -yituM).
FATTENED , p. p. puzwaH -zwA -zwaM, puzwANgaH -NgI -NgaM ApyAyitaH -tA -taM, vfMhitaH -tA -taM, sTUlIkftaH -tA -taM, saMvarDitamAMsaH -sA -saM.
FATTENING: (1) pOzwikaH (kI, kaM) (= nourishing); (2) bfMhaRa (f. RI).
FATTENING , a. pOzwikaH -kI -kaM, puzwidaH -dA -daM, vfMhaRaH -RA -RaM.
FATTY: medasvin (f. nI). F. tissue: *medojAlam.
FATTY , a. medasvI -svinI -svi (n), mAMsalaH -lA -laM, sasnehaH -hA -haM.
FATUITOUS, FATUOUS: I Foolish, weak: q.v.: durbudDi (mfn.).II Illusory: q.v.
FATUITY: mUrKatA: v. Foolishness, weakness.
FATUITY , s. mUrKatA, mOrKyaM, mUQatA, mohaH, bAliSatA, mugDatA.
FATUOUS , a. mUrKaH -rKA -rKaM, mUQaH -QA -QaM, bAliSamatiH -tiH -ti, durbudDiH -dDiH -dDi, durmatiH -tiH -ti, alpaDIH -DIH -Di.
FAUCET: for drawing liquors: *nizkASakaH.
FAUCET , s. BARqaniveSito jalanirgamayogyo nAqiviSezaH.

Fault, s. dozaH, CidraM, aguRaH, aparADaH, pApaM pramAdaH, sKalitaM, vAcyaM, vAcyatA; ‘find f(ault) with’ dozaM grah 9 U, niMd 1 P, upA-laB 1 A, duz c. (dUzayati), (nAtra kulapatirdozaM grahIzyati S. 3); ‘chase, though found f(ault) with’ dfzwadozApi mfgayA (S. 2); ‘f(ault) finder’ dozadfS, dozEkadfS, CidrAnvezin, dozagrAhin, niMdaka, puroBAgin. [Fault]y, a. sadoza, sAparADa, dozavat, dozin, niMdya, vAcya, avadya, niMdArha. 2 aSudDa, asatya, ayaTArTa, vitaTa, anfta, miTyA-apa- pr.; ‘f(aulty) conclusion’ pakzABAsaH, apasidDAMtaH. [Fault]less, a. a-nir-doza, anavadya, niraparADa, dozahIna, apApa, anaGa, akalmaza, nizka-laMka, viSudDa, nirmala, pavitra. 2 satya, yaTArTa, avitaTa.

FAULT: (1) dozaH, this is not your f.: na te dozo'yam, P. i. 16.; will not find f. with it: dozaM na grahIzyati, Sa.; these are f.s of language: vAkye'pi dozAH santyete, Kav.;(2) aparADaH (not physical), how can a slave be without f.: kaTaM nu dAso niraparADaH, V. ii.; it is not the f. of a stump if a blind man does not see it: nEza sTARoraparADo yadenamanDo na paSyati, Say. To find f. with: dUzayati (c. of duz), bad men in a moment find f. with the excellencies of good men: durjano dUzayatyeva satAM guRagaRaM kzaRAt, J.

FAULT , s. dozaH, aparADaH, santuH m., BramaH, CidraM, aguRaH, pApaM, dUzaRaM, pramAdaH, karmmadozaH, vyatikramaH, paravAcyaM. — (Find fault with) nind (c. 1. nindati -ndituM), upAlaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), dozIkf.
FAULT-FINDER: dozadfS (mfn.), a mere f.: dozEka- dfS (mfn.)
FAULT-FINDER , s. dozagrAhI -hiRI -hi (n), dozagrAhakaH -kA -kaM, nindakaH -kA -kaM, pApadarSI -rSinI -rSi (n), CidrAnusArI -riRI -ri (n), CidrAnvezI -ziRI -zi (n).
FAULTILY: (1) sadozam;(2) sADaparADama;(3) dozeRa.
FAULTILY , adv. dopeRa, aparADena, sadozaM, sAparADaM, pramAdena, anyaTA.
FAULTINESS: (1) sadozatA;(2) duzwatA;(3) sAparADatA.
FAULTINESS , s. aparADitA -tvaM, dozitA -tvaM, dozavattvaM, sAparADatA, sadopatvaM, duzwatA, vAcyatA.
FAULTLESS: (1) nirdozaH (zA, zaM);(2) dozahInaH (nA, naM); dozaSUnyaH (nyA, nyaM), etc.: v. Devoid of;(3) adozaH (zA, zaM): v. Also blameless, innocent, correct.

FAULTLESS , a. nirdozaH -zA -zaM, niraparADaH -DA -DaM, aparADahInaH -nA -naM, apApaH -pA -paM, anaGaH -GA -GaM, anavadyaH -dyA -dyaM, akalmazaH -zA -zaM, anenAH -nAH -naH (s), nirAgAH -gAH -gaH (s), niSCidraH -drA -draM, viSudDaH -dDA -dDaM, nirmmalaH -lA -laM; ‘in form,’ avyaNgaH -NgI -NgaM, [Page263-a+ 51] SudDarUpaH -pI -paM.
FAULTLESS , a. (In form) anavadyANgaH -NgI -NgaM.
FAULTLESSNESS: (1) nirdozatA;(2) dozaSUnyatA; etc.
FAULTLESSNESS , s. nirdozatvaM, niraparADatvaM, dozahInatA, viSudDatA.

FAULTY: (1) dozavat (f. tI), f. girl: dozavatI kanyA, M. ix. 73.;(2) dozin (f. RI);(3) sadozaH (zA, zaM);(3) duzwaH (zwA, zwaM) (often=vicious), afterwards found to be f.: *duzwaM paScAdviBAvitam, Mit.

FAULTY , a. dozI -ziRI -zi (n), aparADI -DinI -Di (n), dozavAn -vatI -vat (t), nindanIyaH -yA -yaM, nindArhaH -rhA -rhaM, sAparADaH -DA -DaM, sadozaH -zA -zaM, dozikaH -kI -kaM, vAcyaH -cyA -cyaM, prAmAdikaH -kI -kaM, pramAdI -dinI -di (n), pramAdavAn -vatI -vat (t), aSudDaH -dDA -dDaM, prApta- -dozaH -zA -zaM, ayaTArTaH -rTA -rTaM, vitaTaH -TA -TaM, anftaH -tA -taM; ‘full of faults,’ bahudozaH -zA -zaM; ‘a faulty statement,’ miTyAvAdaH, mfzAvAdaH; ‘a faulty conclusion,’ apasidDAntaH.
Faun, s. vanadevatA.
FAUN , s. (Sylvan deity) vanadevatA, sTalIdevatA, vanecaraH.
Fauna, s. prARijAtaM.
FAUNA: jantavaH (m. pl.), fossil f.: *SilIBUta- jantavaH: v. Animal.

To FAVOR , v. a. anugrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM), anukUla (nom. anukUla- -yati -yituM), upakf, upakAraM kf, sAhAyyaM, kf, prasAdaM kf, anupAl (c. 10. -pAlayati -yituM), pratipAl, Baj (c. 1. Bajati -te, BaktuM), anuruD (c. 4. -ruDyati -rodDuM), juz (c. 6. juzate, jozituM), rakzAM kf, prasanno BU or as snehaM kf, kfpAM kf, parapriyaM or parahitam iz (c. 6. icCati, ezituM). — (Resemble) sarUpaH -pI -paM BU or as; ‘a child that favors his father,’ pitfrUpaH putraH; ‘fortune favors the brave,’ sAhase SrIH prativasati.

FAVOR , s. (Kind regard, friendly disposition) prasAdaH, anugrahaH, anukUlatA, AnukUlyaM, prasannatA, prItiH f., priyatA, snehaH, anuroDaH, hitecCA, hitepsA. — (Support, countenance) AgrahaH, saNgrahaH, grahaH, ASrayaH, saMSrayaH, ADAraH, anupAlanaM, sAhAyyaM, upakAraH, puraskAraH, saMvarDanaM, varDanaM, SaraRyatA, aByupapattiH f. — (Kind act) upakftaM, upakAraH, sukftaM, sukftiH f., upacAraH, priyaM, hitaM. — (Leave, permission) anumatiH f., anujYA; ‘to ask a favour,’ prasad (c. 10. -sAdayate -yituM), with acc. of person, upakAraM prArT (c. 10. -arTayate -yituM); ‘I ask you as a favor not to be angry with me,’ prasAdaye tvAM na me krodDum arhasi; ‘conciliate the favor,’ ArAD (c. 10. -rADa- -yati -yituM), anuraYj in caus. (-raYjayati -yituM).

FAVORABLE , a. prasannaH -nnA -nnaM, suprasannaH -nnA -nnaM, anugrAhI -hiRI -hi (n), anukUlaH -lA -laM, AnugrAhakaH -kI -kaM, hitEzI -ziRI -zi (n), priyEzI &c., hitakAmaH -mA -maM, hitepsuH -psuH -psu, hitaH -tA -taM, suhitaH -tA -taM, priyakAraH -rI -raM, priyaNkaraH -rI -raM, hitabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, arTakft, upakArakaH -kA -kaM. — (Tending to promote) utpAdakaH -kA -kaM; ‘favorable to wealth,’ arTotpAdakaH -kA -kaM; ‘to longevity,’ AyuzyaH -zyA -zyaM; ‘to be favorable,’ prasad (c. 1. -sIdati -sattuM); ‘I am favorable to you,’ prasanno'smi tava.
FAVORABLENESS , s. prasannatA, anukUlatA, AnukUlyaM, hitabudDitvaM.
FAVORABLY , adv. prasannaM, prasAdena, anugraheRa, sAnugrahaM, sAnukUlyaM, priyaM.
FAVORED , p. p. anugfhItaH -tA -taM, upakftaH -tA -taM, pratipAlitaH -tA -taM.
FAVORER , s. anugrAhI m. (n), anugrAhakaH, upakArakaH, anupAlakaH.

FAVORITE , s. priyaH -yA supriyaH -yA, vallaBaH -BA, suBagaH -gA, hfdayapriyaH -yA, snehapAtraM, prItipAtraM; ‘general favorite,’ sarvvapriyaH; ‘a royal favorite,’ nfpavallaBaH, rAjavallaBaH; ‘a favorite wife,’ suBagA.
FAVORITE , a. priyaH -yA -yaM, priyatamaH mA -maM, hfdayapriyaH -yA -yaM, dayitaH -tA -taM, izwatamaH -mA -maM, aBIzwaH -zwA -zwaM, hfdyaH -dyA -dyaM.
FAVORITISM , s. pakzapAtitA, pakzAnugrahaH, pakzodgrAhitvaM, pakzatA, snehaH.

Favour, v. t. anugrah 9 P, upakf 8 U, pra-sAdaM-upakAraM-kf 8 U, or dfS c., sAhAyyaM dA 3 P, aByupad 4 A; often by (s.); ‘not inclined to f(avour)’ prasAdaparANmuKa; ‘I wish to be f(avour)ed with the mention of it’ ka-TanenAnugrAhyamAtmAnamicCAmi (Ka. 134). 2 anu-pA c. (pAlayati), anu-man 4 A, anu-mud 1 A, anukUlayati (D.). 3 ASri 1 U, A-ava-laMb 1 A, svIkf, aMgIkf. s. a-nugrahaH, prasAdaH, AnukUlyaM, kfpA, prIti f., snehaH; ‘he is in the kingʼs f(avour)’ sa nfpa-prasAdapAtraM-BAjanaM. 2 A-saM-SrayaH; sAhAyyaM, anupAlanaM, aByupapatti f., ADAraH. 3 hitaM, upakftaM-kAraH, priyaM, sukftaM. 4 anujYA, anu-mati f.; ‘in f(avour) of’ pakze (with gen.) ‘I am speaking in your f(avour)’ ahaM tvada-nukUlaM bravImi, tvatpakzaM samarTaye; ‘ask a f(avour)’ pra-sad c., upakAraM prArT 10 A; ‘seek the f(avour) of’ ArAD c., anuraMj c. [Favour]able, a. a-nukUla, prasanna, hitakArin, hitakAma, anugraha-para, hita, hitabudDi, upakAraka; ‘f(avourable) to’ Avaha, utpAdaka in comp. [Favour]ably, adv. sAnugrahaM, sAnukUlyaM, prasannatayA. [Favour]ite, s. priyaH, prIti-sneha-pAtraM-BAjanaM, vallaBaH. a. priya, dayita, aBIzwa, izwa, dayitatama, hfdya, vallaBa. [Favour]itism, s. pakzapAtitA, pakzAnugrahaH.

FAVOUR (subs.): (1) anugrahaH, f. proceeding from remembrance: saMsmaraRapravftto'nugrahaH, Ku. iii. 3; with your f.: tavAnugrahAt; even this my chastise- ment has been made a f. by you: mama tvayA nigraho'pyayamanugrahIkftaH, R. xi. 90.; disposer of f. s and dis-f.s: anugrahAvagrahayorviDAtA, Si. i. 71.;(2) prasAdaH (= a f.), do the f. (to excuse me), Sir: tat prasAdaM karotu svAmI, P. i. 3.; who eagerly longs for your f.: prasAdamAkAMkzati yastovotsukaH, V. III. Ph. in f. with i. e. f. ed: v. F. ite; in f. of i.e. on the side of: pakze (with gen.). v. Side.

FAVOUR (v.t.): (1) anugfhRAti (grah, c. 9.), just favour with a look: vilokanenAnugfhARa tAvat, N. xxii. 3;(2) anukUlayati (nomi.) (= to be friend), even Indra f. s him with ornaments of the Kalpa tree: tamanukUlayatIndro'pi kalpadrumaviBUzaREH, Ku. ii. 39.;(3) by subs., the king ceased to f. Dantila: sa rAjA dantilasya prasAdaparANmuKaH saYjAtaH, P. i. 3.;(4) aByupapadyate (pad, c. 4.), Ku. v. 61.

FAVOURABLE: (1) anukUlaH (lA, laM), considering what was f. to him: asyAnukUlaM vicintya, Ki. xii. 43.; f. wind: anukUlavAtaH;(2) prasannaH (nnA, nnaM) (= cheerful); f. look: prasannadfzwiH;(3) SumaH (BA, BaM) (= auspicious: of time): v. Also conducive, good.
FAVOURABLENESS: (1) anukUlatA;(2) prasannatA: v. FAVOURABLE.
FAVOURER: (1) anugrahakArin (f. RI);(2) better by verb.

FAVOURITE (subs.): (1) priyapAtram, priyamAjanam, and sim. comp.s, I was her greatest f.: tasyAH paraM prasAdapAtramAsam, D. ii.;(2) vallaBa (f. mA), and to the f.s of a king: vallaBeByaSca BUpateH, Ka. v. 19.
FAVOURITE (adj.): priyaH (yA, yaM): v. Dear, favourite (subs.).
FAVOURITISM: (1) vallaBapriyatA (?);(2) pakzapAtitA (= partiality).

Fawn, s. mfgaSAvaH-vakaH, mfgapotaH-SiSuH, hariRavatsaH, kuraMgakaH. v. i. (upon) cAwu-vacanEH ArAD c. or tuz c., sAzwAMgapAt sAMtv 10 or upa-lal 10, upacCaMd 10, CaMdaM anuvft 1 A or anuruD 4 A. [Fawn]er, s. cAwukAraH, sAMtvavAdaH. [Fawn]ing, s. upalAlanaM, cAwUktiBiH ArADanaM, upacCaMdanaM, cAwuvacanaM. [Fawn]ingly, adv. cAwUktyA, stutipUrvaM.
FAWN (subs.): (1) mfgaSAvaH, -kaH;(2) mfgapotaH; (3) hariRaSiSuH; etc.
FAWN (v.): I To bring forth a f.: prasUte (sU, c. 2.), f. ing of deer: mfgIRAM prasUtiH, R.II To flatter: q.v.: cAwuSataM karoti.
FAWN , s. mfgaSAvakaH, mfgapotakaH, hariRaSiSuH m., hariRavatsaH, kuraNgaH; ‘fawn-eyed,’ kuraNganayanaH -nA -nI -naM.
To FAWN , v. n. (Bring forth a fawn) mfgaSAvakaM or kuraNgaM su (c. 2. sUte, c. 4. sUyate, sotuM) or prasu or jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM).
To FAWN UPON , v. n. sAzwANgapAtaM praRamya sAntv or SAntv (c. 10. sAntva- -yati -yituM), aBiSAttv, upasAntv, pariSAntv or lal (c. 10. lAla- -yati -yituM).
FAWNER , s. sAzwANgapAtaM praRamya sAntvakAraH, lAlI m. cAwukAraH.
FAWNING , s. azwANgapraRAmapUrvvaM sAntvanaM or lAlanaM, aticAwukAraH.
FAWNINGLY: (1) cAwuSatEH, H.;(2) stutIH kftvA.
FAWNINGLY , adv. sAzwANgapAtaM, aYjalikarmmapUrvvaM, ekAntacAwukAreRa.
FAY: I Subs., a fairy: q.v.: vidyADarI.II verb., to fit, suit: q.v.
FAY , s. vidyADarI, piSAcI, yoginI, rAkzasI. See FAIRY.
Fealty, s. anurAgaH, Bakti f., nizWA, praBuBaktiH.
FEALTY: praBuBaktiH (?): v. Also loyalty.
FEALTY , s. BaktiH f., praBuBaktiH f., BaktatA, praBuBaktatA, AsaktiH f., anuzaNgaH.

Fear, v. BI 3 P, udvij 6 A, saMvi-tras 4 P, (with abl.). 2 vi-, A-, SaMk 1 A, tark 10. 3 BayArta a. BU, tras, BI; ‘do not f(ear)’ mA BEzIH. s. BayaM, BIH, BIti f., saM-, trAsaH, sADvasaM, ASaMkA, daraH-raM; ‘put in f(ear)’ See Frighten; ‘through f(ear)’ BayAt, BItyA. [Fear]ful, a. BayaMkara, BayAvaha, Bayaprada, BIzaRa, BayAnaka, dAruRa, BIma, rOdra (drI f.), ugra, BErava (vI f.), Gora, BIzma, pratiBaya. 2 (Afraid) BIta, saBaya, sasADvasa, BayArta, BIru, SaMkila, sASaMka, trasta. [Fear]fully, adv. saBayaM, satrAsaM, Bayena. 2 dAruRaM, GoraM, ugraM. [Fear]less, a. aBaya, nirBaya, aBIta, niHSaMka, nirBIka, nirviSaMka, aBIru, akutoBaya; sAha-sika (kI f.), pragalBa, sAhasin. [Fear]lessly, adv. nirBayaM, niHSaMkaM, sAhasena.

FEAR (subs.): I Lit.:(1) mayam, out of f.: BayAt, Sa.; or, through f. of the ascetic: Bayena vA muneH, Ki.;(2) BItiH (rare);(3) trAsaH, sam-, pari-, (= terror, q.v.).II Source of (1).: mayam, the f. from the titan is over: surArisamBavaM BayaM gatam, V. i.; you have no f. from me: na matto'sti BayaM tava, Mah., ii. 43. 20.

FEAR (v.t.): (1) biBeti (mI, c. 3.) (with abl.), f. s. thieves: cOrAdviBeti, S. k.; f. s in the forest: araRye biBeti, S.k.:(2) trasyati, saM-, vi-, pari-, (trasa, c. 4.) (with abl.): stronger [Page271] than f., if he did not f. the god Śiva: yadi tena devAdBavAnIpaterna trastam, Vi. ii. 28.
FEAR (v.i.): I Lit.: biBeti.II To appre- -hend: q.v.: SaNkate, A-, (SaNk, c. 1.), affection f. s of evil: snehaH pApaSaNkI, Sa.

FEAR , s. BayaM, BItiH f., BIrutA, trAsaH, santrAsaH, paritrAsaH, sADvasaM, SaNkA, ASaNkA, daraH -raM, BIpmaMBIzmaM, BIzaRaM; ‘removal of fear,’ BayapratIkAraH; ‘causing fear,’ BayaNkaraH -rA -raM, BayakArakaH -kA -kaM, BayadaH -dA -daM, BayapradaH -dA -daM; ‘cause of fear,’ BayahetuH m.; ‘agitated by fear,’ BayavihvalaH -lA -laM; ‘through fear,’ BayAt, trAsAt, BItyA, BIteH, SaNkayA; ‘through fear of punishment,’ daRqaBayAt.

To FEAR , v. a. BI (c. 3. biBeti, BetuM) with abl. or gen. c. So also praBI, viBI, tras (c. 4. trasyati, trasituM), vitras, udvij (c. 6. -vijate -jituM), vyaT (c. 1. vyaTate -TituM), pravyaT all with abl. c., SaNk (c. 1. SaNkate -NkituM), ASaNk with acc. c., tark (c. 10. tarkayati -yituM).
To FEAR , v. n. tras (c. 4. trasyati, trasituM), vyaT (c. 1. vyaTate -TituM), udvignIBU, BayArttaH -rttA -rttaM BU or as; ‘do not fear,’ mA BEzIH, mA trAsIH or mA trasIH.
FEAR , s. AtaNkaH. FEATURE, s. muKalakzaRa muKacihnaM.

FEARFUL (adj.): I Inspiring fear:(1) BayaNkaraH (rI, raM);(2) BayAvahaH (hA, haM);(3) BayadaH (dA, daM);(4) BayadAyin or -viDAyin (f. nI);(5) BayAnakaH (kA, kaM);(6) BIzaRaH (RA, RaM): v. Dreadful, terrible.II Full of fear:(1) BItaH (tA, taM) (with abl. of the source of fear): v. Afraid;(2) saBayaH (yA, yaM) (= possess- -ed of fear);(3) BayAturaH (rA, raM) (= habi- -tually);(4) trasnu (mfn.): v. Timid.

FEARFUL , a. (Affected by fear, timid) BayArttaH -rttA -rttaM, BayAturaH -rA -raM, BIruH -ruH -ru -rukaH -kA -kaM, saBayaH -yA -yaM, BItaH -tA -taM, sasADvasaH -sA -saM, saSaNkaH -NkA -NkaM, SaNkitaH -tA -taM, trastaH -stA -staM, santrastaH -stA -staM, dInaH -nA -naM, trasnuH -snuH -snu, BIlukaH -kA -kaM, daritaH -tA -taM. — (Terrible) BayaNkaraH -rA -raM, BayAnakaH -kI -kaM, BayAvahaH -hA -haM, trAsakaraH -rI -raM, BIrumayaH -yI -yaM, dAruRaH -RA -RaM, rOdraH -drI -draM, GoraH -rA -raM, BImaH -mA -maM, BIzaRaH -RA -RaM, BIzmaH -zmA -zmaM, BEravaH -vI -vaM.
FEARFULLY: I Timidly:(1) saBayam;(2) sasADvasam;(3) satrAsam, Y.II Frightfully, terribly: q.v.: mIzaRam.
FEARFULLY , adv. (With fear) saBayaM, satrAsaM, Bayena, sasADvasaM, saSaNkaM. — (Terribly) dAruRaM, GoraM, BEravaM, BayAnakaM.
FEARFULNESS: I Timidity:(1) BItiH (with abl.): v. Fear;(2) BIrutA (habitual).II Dreadfulness: q.v.: BIzaRatvam.
FEARFULNESS , s. BIrutA, BItatvaM, saBayatvaM, santrastatA, rOdratA.
FEARLESS: (1) nirBayaH (yA, yaM);(2) nirBIkaH (kA, kaM);(3) akutoBayaH (yA, yaM).

FEARLESS , a. nirBayaH -yA -yaM, aBayaH -yA -yaM, aBItaH -tA -taM, viBItaH -tA -taM, aSaNkaH -NkA -NkaM, niHSaNkaH -NkA -NkaM, viSaNkaH -NkA -NkaM, nirviSaNkaH -NkA -NkaM, aBIruH -ruH -ru, apaBIH -BI -Bi, apaSaNkaH -NkA -NkaM, niH- -sADvasaH -sA -saM, vigataBayaH -yA -yaM, akutoBayaH -yA -yaM, niHsaMSayaH -yA -yaM, sAhasikaH -kI -kaM.
FEARLESSLY: (1) nirBayam;(2) by the adj.s: apaBayaH (yA, yaM), apaBI, gataBI, vigataBI (n. Bi) etc. R. iii. 51.; xi. 70.;(3) niHSaNkam (with- -out any apprehension).
FEARLESSLY , adv. nirBayaM, aBayaM, niHSaNkaM, aBItavat, sAhasena; ‘acting fearlessly,’ nirvAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM.
FEARLESSNESS: (1) nirBIkatA;(2) nirBayatA;(3) aBItiH.
FEARLESSNESS , s. nirBayatvaM, aBItiH f., aBItatA, aBayaM -yatvaM, SOryyaM.
FEASIBILITY: (1) sADyatA;(2) upAdeyatA (com- -bining utility).
FEASIBILITY , s. SakyatA, sADyatA, karaRIyatA, samBAvyatA, upapAdyatvaM.
Feasible, a. sADya, Sakya, karaRIya, saMBAvya, sukara, upapAdya.
FEASIBLE: (1) sADya (f. DyA);(2) upAdeyaH (yA, yaM) (f. and useful).

FEASIBLE , a. sADyaH -DyA -DyaM, karaRIyaH -yA -yaM, SakyaH -kyA -kyaM, karttuM SakyaH -kyA -kyaM, sukaraH -rA -raM, samBAvyaH -vyA -vyaM, samBAvanIyaH -yA -yaM, upapAdyaH -dyA -dyaM, kftyaH -tyA -tyaM, sugamaH -mA -maM, laByaH -ByA -ByaM, sulaBaH -BA -BaM.

Feast, s. utsavaH (lit. & fig.), mahaH, parvan n., udDarzaH; ‘f(east) to the eyes’ nayanotsavaH. 2 saMBojanaM, viSizwAnnasaMBAraH, sahaBojanaM. v. i. prakAmaM Bakz 10; ‘f(east)ing on grass’ tfRaM prakAmaM Bakzayan. 2 uttamAnnena tfp 4 P or saMtuz 4 P. v. t. BojanaviSezEH saMtfp c. or saMtuz c. 2 (fig.) AnaMd c., pramud c.; naya-nAByAM pA 1 P.
FEAST (subs.): I Festival: q.v.: utsavaH “moveable f.”: asTirotsavaH (?).II Banquct: samBojanam (?).III Fig.: utsavaH, f. to the eye: nayanotsavaH.
FEAST (v.i.): I Lit.: viSizwaBojanaM karoti (?). II Fig.: modate, pra-, (mud, c. 1.).
FEAST (v.t.): I Lit: viSizwaBojanaM dadAti (dA, c. 3.) (?).II Fig.: to delight: q.v.: modayati, pra- (c. of mud).

FEAST , s. (Festival) utsavaH, mahaH, parvva n. (n), yAtrA, yAtrotsavaH, udDarzaH, udDavaH, parvvarIRaM, aByudayaH, kzaRaH, carcarI; ‘a great feast,’ mahotsavaH. — (Entertainment) satkriyA, sahaBojanaM, samBojanaM, uttamA- -nnasamBAraH, paramAnnasamBAraH; ‘feast of lanterns,’ dIpotsavaH; ‘feast to the eye,’ nayanotsavaH.
To FEAST , v. n. paramAnnAni Buj (c. 7. BuMkte, BoktuM), uttamAhAraM kf, uttama- -BojanaM kf, uttamAnnena tfpa (c. 4. tfzyati), utsavaM kf, mahotsavaM kf.
To FEAST , v. a. uttamAnnEH or BojanaviSezEH santfp (c. 10. -tarpayati -yituM) or mantuz in caus. (-tozayati -yituM), paramAnnAni Buj in caus. (Boja- -yati -yituM), satkf.
To FEAST , v. n. for mantuz, read santuz.
FEASTED , p. p. satkftaH -tA -taM, paramAnnasantarpitaH -tA -taM.
FEASTING , s. utsavakaraRaM, paramAnnaBojanaM, uttamAhArakaraRaM, sahaBojanaM.
Feat, s. avadAtaM or adButaM karman n., AScarya-karman n., cezwitaM, karman n., kriyA.
FEAT (subs.): avadAnam, whose f.s are seen: dfzwAvadAnaH (nA, naM), K. xviii. 16.: v. Deed, exploit.
FEAT , s. karmma n. (n), caritraM, cezwitaM, aqButakarmma n., AScaryyakarmma n.

Feather, s. picCaM, pakzaH, garut m., patraM, vAjaH, parRaM; ‘peacockʼs f(eather)’ barhaH-rhaM; ‘f(eather) of arrows’ puMKaH, patraM, vAjaH; ‘f(eather) bed’ mfduSayyA, komalaSayanaM; ‘he thinks it a f(eather) in his cap’ sa tadAtmano viSizwagOravapadaM manyate. [Feather]ed, a. pakzayukta, sapakza, pakzin, garu-tmat, patrin, patatrin. [Feather]y, a. pakzatulya-samAna.

FEATHER (subs.): I Lit.:(1) patram, I am throw- ing away this one f.: etatpatraM tyajAmyekam, Mah. i. 30. 21.; f. -bed: (*pataga-) patrasaMstaraH; to win a f. in the cap: suBagapatAkAM harati, D.;(2) parRaH, good f. ed: suparRaH, Mah.II Of an arrow:(1) patram, heron- f. ed (arrows): kaNkapatrAH, U.;(2) pakzaH, of f. supported arrows: pakzASrayiRAM SilImuKAnAm, Si. xx. 9.III A species: q.v.: jAtiH.
FEATHER , s. pakzaH, parRaH, garut m., picCaM, patatraM, patraM, pakzma n. (n), vAjaH, tanuruhaH; ‘of a peacock,’ mayUrapicCaM; ‘of an arrow,’ puNKaH, SarapuNKA, SarapakzaH, patraM, vAjaH, maRikAcaH.
FEATHER-BED , s. pakzapUritaM SayanaM, pakzaSayyA, mfduSayanaM, komalaparyyaNkaH, suKasparSaprastaraH.

FEATHERED , a. pakzI -kziRI -kzi (n), pakzavAn -vatI -vat (t), pakzA- -cCAditaH -tA -taM, pakzayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, sapakzaH -kzA -kzaM, garutmAn -tmatI -tmat (t), patrI -triRI -tri (n), patatrI -triRI -tri (n).
FEATHERY , a. pakzatulyaH -lyA -lyaM, pakzasadfSaH -SI -SaM, pakzasaguRaH -RA -RaM.
FEATLY: vAmam: v. Cleverly.
Feature, s. rUpaM, Akfti f., AkAraH, lakzaRaM; ‘inauspicious f(eature)s’ aBadralakzaRAni, amaMgalAkAraH. 2 vadanAkftiH; muKareKA, vadanA-kAraH. 3 (Sign) cihnaM, lakzaRaM, liMgaM.
FEATURE: I Form: q.v.: rUpam, the same digni- fied f.s.: rUpaM tadojasvi, R.; what sort of f.s he has: kIdfSaM tasya rUpam, K.II The face: q.v.: muKam.
FEATURE , s. (Form of the face) vadanAkftiH f., vadanAkAraH, vadanareKA, muKareKA, muKAvayavaH, vadanAvayavaH. — (Form, cast) AkAraH, AkftiH f., saMskAraH, saMsTAnaM, rUpaM, mUrttiH f.
To FEAZE , v. a. udgranT (c. 1. -granTati -nTituM, c. 9. -graTnAti), samudgranT.
FEBRICULOSE , a. IzajjvarI -riRI -ri (n), IzajjvarAturaH -rA -raM.
Febrifacient, a. jvarotpAdaka.
FEBRIFACIENT , a. jvarakaraH -rA -raM, jvarotpAdakaH -kA -kaM.
Febrifuge, a. jvaraGna (GnI f.), jvaranASaka-nivAraka. s. jvarApahaM OzaDaM.
FEBRIFUGE: javaraGna (f. GnI) and sim. comp.s., a f.; jvaraGnaBOzaDam; etc.
FEBRIFUGE , a. jvaraGnaH -GnI -GnaM, jvaranASakaH -kA -kaM, jvarAntakaH -kA -kaM, jvarahantA -ntrI -ntf (ntf), jvaranivArakaH -kA -kaM; ‘a febrifuge,’ jvaranASakam OzaDaM, jvarApahA.
Febrile, a. sajvara, jvarita, jvarArta.
FEBRILE: expr. by comp. or gen., f. symp- toms: jvarasya lakzaRam, Bha.
FEBRILE , a. jvarI -riRI -ri (n), jvaritaH -tA -taM, jvarajaH -jA -jaM.
February, s. mAGaH, PAlgunaH, tapasyaH.
FEBRUARY: uttaramAGapUrvaPAlgunasaMvAdIyurUpIyavarzasya dvitIyo mAsaH.
FEBRUARY , s. PAlgunaH, mAGaH, tapasyaH, PAlgunikaH, vatsarasya dvitIyamAsaH.
FECAL: expr. by comp., f. ditch: ameDyaKAtam; f. matter: malam: v. Dung.
FECAL , a. malamayaH -yI -yaM, SakfnmayaH -yI -yaM, viRmayaH -yI -yaM, malinaH -nA -naM, ameDyaH -DyA -DyaM, KalI -linI -li (n).

Feces, s. malaM, purIzaM, viz f., uccAraH, apa(va)skaraH, vizWA; See Dung. 2 KalaM, ucCizwaM, SezaM. Fecal, a. viRmaya-malamaya (yI f.), aSudDa, ameDya. Feculent, a. samala, kaluza, ameDya, maladUzita, Kalin.

FECES , s. malaM, purIzaM, vizWA, viw f. (z), uccAraH, uccaritaM, SamalaM, gUTaH, avaskaraH, apaskaraH, varccaskaH, dUryyaM. — (Dregs) malaM, KalaM, kalkaM, kiwwaM, ucCizwaM, SezaM, kalaNkaH; ‘to discharge feces,’ purIzotsargaM kf, viRmUtrotsargaM kf.
FECULENCE: paNkilatA: v. Muddiness, foul- -ness.
FECULENCE , s. mAlinyaM, samalatA, ameGyatA, malavattvaM, kaluzatA, malaM.
FECULENT: ameDya (f. DyA): v. Foul, muddy.

FECULENT , a. samalaH -lA -laM, malavAn -vatI -vat (t), malinaH -nA -naM, malImasaH -sA -saM, maladUzitaH -tA -taM, ameDyaH -DyA -DyaM, KalI -linI -li (n), kalkI -lkinI -lki (n), kaluzaH -zA -zaM -zI -ziRI -zi (n), viqBavaH -vA -vaM, kalaNkI -NkinI -Nki (n).
Fecund, a. bahupraja, bahvapatya. 2 avaMDya, bahu-Palaprada, urvara (as soil). Fecundate, v. t. saPalIkf 8 U; retaH sic 6 P. Fecundity, s. saPalatA, avaMDyatvaM, prasava-naM, PalavattvaM, sPIti. f.
FECUND , a. bahuprajaH -jA -jaM, bahvapatyaH -tyA -tyaM, abanDyaH -nDyA -nDyaM, bahuPaladaH -dA -daM, prajanizRuH -zRuH -zRu; ‘fecund soil,’ urvvarA.
FECUNDATE: I Lit.: bahuprajaM (f. jAM) karoti (?). II To impregnate.: q.v.
To FECUNDATE , v. a. saPalIkf, bahuPaladIkf, retaH or parAgaM sic (c. 6. siYcati, sektuM).
FECUNDATION , s. saPalIkaraRaM, abanDyIkaraRaM, parAgasekaH, retaHsecanaM.
FECUNDITY: I Of seeds or plants:(1) Pala- vattA;(2) better by adj. PaladaH (dA, daM).II Of females:bahuprajAtvam (?).
FECUNDITY , s. sAPalyaM, saPalatA, PalavattvaM, janakatA, abanDyatA, sPItiH f., prasavanaM, prasavitvaM, sAvakatvaM, prajanizRutA.

FED , p. p. puzwaH -zwA, -zwaM, puzitaH -tA -taM, pozitaH -tA -taM, BftaH -tA -taM, pAlitaH -tA -taM, santozitaH -tA -taM, santarpitaH -tA -taM, aSitaH -tA -taM, ASitaH -tA -taM; ‘well-fed,’ supuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, hfzwapuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, svASitaH -tA -taM; ‘ill-fed,’ vipuzwaH -zwA -zwaM; ‘fed on by cattle,’ aSitaNgavInaH -nA -naM; ‘having fed,’ BojayitvA.
Federal, Federate, a. saMhata, saMGAtavat, sA-mayika-sAMGAtika (kI f.), kftasaMDi, saMyukta, saMDisaMSlizwa.
FEDERAL: *saMhataH (tA, taM), f. constitution: *saMhata- tantram.
FEDERAL, FEDERALIST: *saMhatiDvajaH (jA, jaM); saMhativAdin (f. nI).
FEDERAL , a. sANGAtikaH -kI -kaM, sAmayikaH -kI -kaM, sahitaH -tA -taM.
FEDERALISM: *saMhativAdaH; saMhatiDvajAnAM matam.
FEDERATE , a. sanDitaH -tA -taM, kftasanDiH -nDiH -nDi, kftasambanDaH -nDA [Page264-b+ 51] -nDaM, saMhataH -tA -taM, sahitaH -tA -taM, saNGAtavAn -vatI -vat (t), saMyuktaH -ktA -ktaM.

sanskrit.slp1: AdadIta na SUdro'pi SulkaM duhitaraM dadat
sanskrit.word: आददीत न शूद्रोऽपि शुल्कं दुहितरं ददत्
sanskrit.iast: ādadīta na śūdro'pi śulkaṃ duhitaraṃ dadat

details.body: Fee, s. SulkaH-lkaM, vetanaM, pratiPalaM, upAyanaM, nistAraH, pAritozikaM; ‘monthly f(ee)’ mA-sikaM; ‘f(ee) simple’ svADInA-svataMtrA-BUmiH.

FEE (subs.): I Property, possession: q.v. II Charge, pay: Sulka (mn.), even a Śūdra should not take f., giving away a daughter: AdadIta na SUdro'pi SulkaM duhitaraM dadat, M. ix. 98.; f. giver: SulkadaH, M. iii. F. -simple: cirasTAyinI BUmiH (?).
FEE (v.): I Lit.: SulkaM dadAti (dA, c. 3.).II To bribe: q.v.

FEE , s. (Recompense) SulkaH -lkaM, pAritozikaM, vetanaM, BAwiH f., BAwakaH, dakziRA, upapradAnaM, upAyanaM, nistAraH, pratiPalaM. — (Land granted by a lord) BUsvAminA svaparicarahaste samarpitA BUmiH; ‘fee-simple,’ svADInaBUmiH f.
To FEE , v. a. pAritozikaM dA, vetanaM dA, upapradAnena parituv in caus. (-tozayati -yituM) or santuz, utkocaM dA.

Feeble, a. durbala, aSakta, SaktihIna, nirbala, kzIRaSakti, alpaSakti, alpabala-vIrya-sattva, kzIRa, avasanna, kzAma, asamarTa, SiTilabala niHsatvaniHsattva. [Feeble]ness, s. dOrbalyaM, kzIRatA, alpa-balaM, alpavIryaM, tejohAni f., vIryahAniH, asAmarTyaM, avasAdaH, aSakti f., SaktikzayaH, sattvanASaH, niHsatvaniHsattvatA. Feebly, adv. durba-latayA, alpaSaktyA, maMdaM.

FEEBLE: durbalaH (lA, laM), the king is the strength of the f.: durbalasya balaM rAjA, J.; having f. hope [Page272] for the fulfilment of his object: svArTopapattiM prati durvalASaH, R. v. 12.: v. Weak.

FEEBLE , a. alpabalaH -lA -laM, durbalaH -lA -laM, alpaSaktiH -ktiH -kti, alpavIryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, alyasattvaH -ttvA -ttvaM, alpatejAH -jAH -jaH (s), SiTilabalaH -lA -laM, SiTilaSaktiH -ktiH -kti, nirbalaH -lA -laM, balahInaH -nA -naM, sAmarTyahInaH -nA -naM, kzIRabalaH -lA -laM, asamarTaH -rTA -rTaM, SiTilaH -lA -laM, PalguH -lguH -lgu, visrastatejAH -jAH -jaH (s), kzIRaH -RA -RaM, avasannaH -nnA -nnaM, kzAmaH -mA -maM, klIvaH -vA -vaM, CAtaH -tA -taM, SAtaH -tA -taM, amAMsaH -sA -saM.
FEEBLE-MINDED , a. alyabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, durmatiH -tiH -ti, alpaDIH -DIH -Di.
FEEBLENESS: (1) dObalyam;(2) durbalatA: v. Weakness.

FEEBLENESS , s. dOrbalyaM, alpaSaktitvaM, alpabalaM, balaSETilyaM, SaktiSETilyaM, SiTilatA, kzIRatA, kzIRaSaktitvaM, vIryyahAniH f., SaktihInatA, sattva- hAniH f., tejohInatA, atejaH n. (s), aSaktiH f., asAmarTyaM, sAmarTyahInatA, avasAdaH, visraMsA, klEvyaM.
FEEBLY: (1) by adj.;(2) durbalatayA or balakzayAt mandaM mandam (= slowly).
FEEBLY , adv. alpabalena, alpaSaktyA, durbalaM, nirbalaM, dOrbalyena.

Feed, v. t. Buj c., aS c., annadAnena A-pyE c. or pari-puz c. 2 puz 1, 9 P or c.; saM-Bf 3 U, pA c. (pAlayati), annena saMvfD c., or saMtfp c. or saMtuz c. 3 car c. 4 upakxp c., upasTA c. (sTApayati). v. i. (on) Bakz 10, ad 2 P; See Eat; oft. by aSana, Buj in comp.; piSitASanaH, hutaBuk &c. 2 (Grass) car 1 P. s. BakzyaM, BojyaM. [Feed]er, s. Bojayitf m., annadAtf m. ASayitf m. 2 pozakaH, upa-kalpakaH. 3 BakzakaH, Bojin m., attf m. Boktf m., ASin m.; ad-Buj-ASin-aSana in comp. [Feed]ing, s. annadAnaM, pAlanaM, pozaRaM, BaraRaM. 2 BakzaRaM, KAdanaM, BojanaM, aSanaM.
FEED (subs.): I Food: q.v.: Bojanam, she is my f.: sA BojanaM me, M.n.II Pasture-land: pracAraBUmiH.III Of a boiler. *pozakam; jalam.

FEED (v.t.): I Lit.:(1) Bojayati (c. of Buj), should f. hundred Brahmins: SataM dvijAn Bojayet, Shat.; employed Duḥśāsana about f. ing people: BakzyaBojyADikArezu duHSAsanamAyojayat, Ma. n.;(2) ASayati, pra-, (c. of aS) (rare).II To graze: q.v.: cArayati (c. of car).III To fill the wants of: pUrayati (pUr, c. 10.).IV To supply: dadAti (dA, c. 3.).
FEED (v.i.): I Lit.:(1) BojanaM karoti;(2) atti (ad, c. 2.): v. To eat.II To graze: q.v. III Fig., to grow fat: sPItaH (tA, taM) Bavati.

To FEED , v. a. (Give to eat) Buj in caus. (Bojayati -yituM), aS in caus. (ASayati -yituM), prAS in caus., BojanaM or annaM dA. — (Nourish) puz (c. 1. pozati -zituM, c. 9. puzRAti, c. 10. pozayati -yituM), paripuz, pAl (c. 10. pAlayati -yituM), pratipAl, Bf (c. 3. biBartti, BarttuM), samBf, annena santuz in caus. (-tozayati -yituM) or santfp in caus. (-tarpayati -yituM) or saMvfD (c. 10. -varDayati -yituM). — (Pasture) car in caus. (cArayati -yituM). — (Supply) upasTA in caus. (-sTApa- yati -yituM), upakxp (c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM); ‘to be plentifully fed,’ ApF in pass. (-pUryyate).

To FEED , v. n. (Eat) Buj (c. 7. BuMkte, BoktuM), upaBuj, aS (c. 9. aSnAti, aSituM), samaS, paryyaS, prAS, KAd (c. 1. KAdati -dituM), ada (c. 2. atti -ttuM), Bakz (c. 10. Bakzayati -yituM), annena pF in pass. (pUryyate) or puz (c. 4. puzpati, pozwuM). — (Graze) car (c. 1. carati -rituM), tfR (c. 8. tfRoti, tarRoti -rRituM tfRaM Buj.

FEED , s. (Provender, fodder) BakzyaM, BojyaM, viDA, viDAnaM, viDiH m., gavAdanaM, aSvAdanaM. — (Quantity of corn, &c. eaten by a horse at once) yat tfRaDAnyAdi ekavAre aSvena Bujyate; ‘day's feed for a cow,’ gavAhnikaM.

FEEDER: I An eater: q.v.II One who gives food:(1) Bojayitf (f. trI);(2) ASayitf (f. trI), Si.III An encourager: utsAhadAtf (f. trI).IV A breeder: pozaka (f. zikA).V Of roads and canals: f. road: *aNgapaTaH, pozakapaTaH.

FEEDER , s. (Giver of food) BojayitA m. (tf), ASayitA m. (tf), pozwA m. (zwf), pozayitA m. (tf), AhAradAtA m. (tf), annadAtA m. — (One that eats) BakzakaH, KAdakaH, attA m. (ttf), BoktA m. (ktf), BakzayitA m. (tf), BojI m. (n), ASI m. (n); ‘on grain,’ SasyaBakzakaH, SasyAdaH, SasyAd; ‘on grass,’ tfRajamBaH; ‘on flesh,’ mAMsaBakzaH, piSitASanaH, kravyAdaH, kravyAd, mAMsaBuk m. (j); ‘on fruit,’ PalASI m. (n), PalASanaH.
FEEDING (subs.): I The act: expr. by verb. II Food: q.v.: Bojanam.III Pasture-land: pracAraBUmiH.
FEEDING , s. (Giving food) AhAradAnaM, annadAnaM, pozaRaM, pAlanaM, BaraRaM. — (Eating) BakzaRaM, KAdanaM, BojanaM, aSanaM, prASanaM, jakzaRaM, grasanaM, aByavaharaRaM; ‘upon grain,’ SasyaBakzaRaM.

Feel, v. t. anuBU 1 P, vi-BU c., (pAdacArama-pi na vyaBAvayat R. xi. 10), jYA 9 U, upa-laB 1 A, vid 2 P, 10 A; ‘f(eel) certain’ dfQaM jYA, prati-i 1 P; ‘I felt his remarks much’ tasya vaco mama hfdayamarmARi aspfSa-t-aBinat. 2 (Think) man 4 A, gaR 10, Akal 10; See Consider; ‘are felt by the mind as pleasant’ maDuratarARyApataMti manasaH (Ka. 103). 3 spfS 6 P, parAmfS 6 P, AlaB 1 A, sparSena parIkz 1 A or ni-rUp 10; ‘f(eel)ing the pulse’ nAqIM spfzwvA. v. i. (AtmAnaM) gaR, man. 2 (for) anukaMp 1 A, samaduHKa a. BU; ‘I f(eel) sorry for you’ ahaM tava kfte duHKAkulosmi; ‘felt proud of his company’ tatsamA-gamenArUQagOravamivAtmAnaM mene; ‘I f(eel) easy now’ labDaM mayedAnIM svAsTyaM (S. 4); ‘I f(eel) better’ asti me viSezaH (S. 3). [Feel]er, s. sparSaSfMgaM; ‘it was intended as a f(eeler)’ sADAraRalokamatajYAnAya idaM prayuktamAsIt. [Feel]ing, s. anuBavaH, anuBUti f., saMvedanaM, boDaH, jYAnaM, upalaMBaH, upalabDi f., upAgamaH, cEtanyaM, cetanA; saMjYA. 2 sparSaH, parAmarSaH, saMparkaH, sparSajaM jYAnaM. 3 vftti f., rasaH, BAvaH, rAgaH, vi-kAraH, citta-mano-vfttiH, manovikAraH-DarmaH; ‘f(eeling) of anger’ kopavfttiH. 4 kfpA, dayA, anukaMyA, karuRA, samaduHKitA; ‘a man of f(eeling)’ sahfdayaH, sacetas m. ‘what man of f(eeling) in not affected at heart’ sacetasaH kasya mano na dUyate (K. v. 48). a. cetana, ceta-nAyukta, cEtanya-boDa-viSizwa. 2 rasavat, rAgin BAvika, sarasa. [Feel]ingly, adv. sarasaM, sarAgaM, jYAnapUrvaM, svAnuBUtipUrvaM. 2 sadayaM, sAnukaMpaM.

FEEL (v.t.): I To perceive:(1) anuBavati (BU, c. 1.), much more, Mahāśvetā who has felt the ways of love: kimutAnuBUtamadanavfttAntA mahASvetA, K., as if f. ing the pain of those who ask: vedanA- manumavannivArTinAm Ki. xiii. 60.;(2) upalaBate (laB, c. 1.) (= to receive), then Śiva f. ing pleasure: upalabDasuKastadA haraH, Ku. iv. 42.:(3) vetti, saM- (vid, c. 2.) (= to know), which one f.s but cannot express: anAKyeyaH (yA, yaM), saMvedyaH (dyA, dyaM), K.II To be conscious of: jAnAti (JA, c. 9.), the two sons of Daśaratha were not seen but felt: JAtAvuBO dASaraTI na dfzwO, R.: v. To know. III To touch: q.v.: spfSati (spfS, c. 6.). IV To examine by touching: spfSati, should carefully f. the pulse: nAqImavahitaH spfSet, Bha.: v. Also to examine.
FEEL (v.i.). I To appear to the touch: expr. by sparSaH.II In other senses: v. Feel (trans.)
FEEL (subs.): I F. ing: q.v.II Touch: q.v.: sparSaH.

To FEEL , v. a. (Perceive by the touch) spfS (c. 6. spfSati, sprazwuM), saMspfS, parispfS, hastena or pARinA parAmfS (c. 6. -mfSati -mrazwuM) or parimfS or mfS or AlaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM). — (Try by touch) [Page265-a+ 51] sparSena or hastasamparkeRa parokz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM) or nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM); ‘to feel the pulse,’ nAqIM parIkz, nAqIparIkzAM kf. — (Suffer, experience) anuBU, upagam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), upAgam, vid (c. 10. vedayate -yituM), suc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM); ‘one who feels pain,’ anuBUtavpaTaH, jAtavyaTaH, AhitavyaTaH. — (Be af- fected with) upahataH -tA -taM, BU or as. — (Know) jYA (c. 9. jAnAti, jYAtuM). — (Feel for the woes of another) parasya samaduHKaH -KA -KaM BU or as, paraduHKavfttAntaM SrutvA kAruRyaM sUc or kf, anukamp (c. 1. -kampate -mpituM).
FEEL , s. sparSaH, spfzwiH f., saMsparSaH, samparkaH, parimarSaH.
FEELER: I Lit.: expr. by verb.II Fig.: expr. by circumlo, it is a f.: *mataJAnAyedaM prayuktam.
FEELER , s. (Of an insect) kIwamastakAgre parAmarSayogyaM sUkzmaSfNgaM.

FEELING (subs.): I The sense: sparSaH.II Perception:(1) anuBavaH, (rarely) anuBUtiH; upalabDiH; (rarely),(2) upalammaH. (actual f.), from the f. of pleasure: suKopalamBAt, R.;(3) saMvedaH, -nam (= knowledge), only for f. pain: duHKasaMvedanAyEva, U. i. 47.III Susceptibility to emotions: expr. by hfdayam (= heart), a man of f.: sahfdayaH (yA, yaM), destitute of f.: nizkaruRa (f. RA): v. Hard.IV Any state of mind:(1) BAvaH; (2) vfttiH. Ph.: f. of pride: aBimAnitA.

FEELING , s.
