FEN , s. anUpaH, anUpaBUH f., kacCaH, kacCaBUH f., paNkaH, karddamaH.

Fence, s. vfti f., AvaraRaM, prAkAraH, prAcIraM, vezwanaM, varaRaH, SA(sA)laH. 2 rakzA-kzaRaM, gupti f. v. t. vftyA rakz 1 P or A-pari-vf 5 U or c. or parivezwa c. or ava-ni-ruz 7 U, v. i. daMqayudDaM aByas 4 U or Sikz 1 A. 2 muzwiyudDaM kf 8 U, daMqAdaMqi yuD 4 A. [Fenc]er, s. asi-gadA-yoDaH, daMqayodDf m. [Fenc]ing, s. yazwi-daMqa-yudDaM, AyuDa-Sastra-vidyA. [Fence]less, a. a-rakzita, anAvfta.
FENCE (subs.): I Enclosure: q.v.: vftiH.II F. ing: q.v.
FENCE (v.): I To defend: q.v.: rakzati (rakz, c. 1.).II To enclose: vftinA A-vfRoti, pari-, (vf, c. 5.) or vezwayati, pari-, (vezw, c. 10.).

FENCE , s. AvaraRaM, vftiH f., prAntato vftiH, prAvftiH f., prAkAraH, prAcIraM, avaroDakaM, vezwakaH, vezWanaM, vezWaH, AvezwakaH, prAvaraH, AvAraH, vAraRaM -RI, varaRaH, stamBakaraH, mattavAraRaM, mattAlambaH, gaqaH, nemaH, moGaH, mo- -GAlI. — (Defence) rakzA -kzaRaM, guptiH f., trARaM.

To FENCE , v. a. (Inclose with a hedge) prAcIreRa parivezw (c. 1. -vezwate -zwituM, c. 10. -vezwayati -yituM) or Avf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM -rItuM) or parivf or avaruD (c. 7. -ruRadDi -rodDuM) or niruD or vf in caus. (vArayati -yituM). — (Fortify) pariKAprAkArAdinA parivf or Avf or saMvezw. — (Defend) rakz (c. 1. rakzati -kzituM), parirakz.

To FENCE , v. n. (Practise the art of fencing) yazwidvAreRa SastravidyAM or AyuDavidyAm aByas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM) or Sikz (c. 1. Sikzate -kzituM), tsarumArgAn kf, yazwimArgAn kf. — (Fight with foils) yazwiyudDaM kf, daRqAdaRqi yudDaM kf, yazwikrIqAM kf, daRqakrIqAM kf.
FENCED , p. p. or a. prAcIreRa vftaH -tA -taM, sAvaraRaH -RA -RaM, prAkArA- -dyAvftaH -tA -taM, prAvftaH -tA -taM, prAkArIyaH -yA -yaM, avarudDaH -dDA -dDaM.
FENCELESS , a. anAvftaH -tA -taM, arakzitaH -tA -taM, arudDaH -dDA -dDaM.
FENCER: (1) asiyoDaH (with sword);(2) daRqayoDaH (with stick);(3) BkallaH (= 2), Nil.
FENCER , s. yazwiyudDakarttA m. (rttf), AyuDavidyAByAsI m. (n), yazwikrIqASikzakaH.
FENCING (subs.): (1) asicaryA (with sword), Mah.;(2) daRqayuDam (with stick);(3) gadAyudDam (= 2), Mah.
FENCING , s. AyuDavidyA, SastravidyA, yazwiyudDaM, daRqayudDaM, yazwikrIqA.
FENCING-MASTER , s. AyuDavidyopadeSakaH, yazwikrIqopadeSI m. (n).
FENCING-SCHOOL , s. AyuDavidyAveSma n. (n), AyuDaSikzASAlA, Sastravi- dyASikzAlayaH, yazwikrIqASikzASAlA.
Fend, v. t. vF c. nivf 10, pratihan 2 P.
FEND: nivArayati (vf, c. 10.): v. To prevent, ward off.
To FEND , v. a. vf in caus. (vArayati -yituM), nivf, pratihan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM).
Fender, s. aMgAragupti f. 2 varUTaH, raTaguptiH.
FENDER: I For coals of fire: *aNgAraguptiH.II Of a car:(1) varUTaH;(2) raTaguptiH.
FENDER , s. aNgAraguptiH f., aNgAravAraRI -RaM, aNgArAvaroDakaM, aNgArasta- -mBakaraH. — (Of a carriage) varUTaH, raTaguptiH f.
Fennel, s. SA-sA-leyaH, CatrA, maDurikA.
FENNEL: (1) SatapuzpA (a species of f.);(2) miSI (another species).
FENNEL , s. SAleyaH, sAleyaH, SatapuzpA, BUripuzpA, skanDabanDanA, CatrA, SItaSivaH, maGurikA, miSI, miSreyA, kAravI, GozA.
FENNY: (1) anUpaH (pA, paM), f. land: anUpaBUmiH; (2) paNkilaH (lA, laM) (= muddy).
FENNY , a. anUpaH -pA -paM, AnUpaH -pI -paM, kacCaH -cCA -cCaM, jalAQyaH -QyA -QyaM, ApyaH -pyA -pyaM, sajalaH -lA -laM, paNkilaH -lA -laM.

sanskrit.slp1: yudDe mamopakArI Baveti sanDiM kftvA BUsvAminA parahaste samarpitA
sanskrit.word: युद्धे ममोपकारी भवेति सन्धिं कृत्वा भूस्वामिना परहस्ते समर्पिता
sanskrit.iast: yuddhe mamopakārī bhaveti sandhiṃ kṛtvā bhūsvāminā parahaste samarpitā

details.body: FEOD , s. yudDe mamopakArI Baveti sanDiM kftvA BUsvAminA parahaste samarpitA BUmiH or parasmE visarjjitaH kzetrADikAraH.
FEOFF (v.): dadAti (dA, c. 3.): v. To enfeoff.
To FEOFF , v. a. pUrvvoktasanDinA kzetrAdyaDikAraM parahaste or parasmE samf in caus. (-arpayati -yituM) or paraM kzetrAdyaDikAre niyuj (c. 10. -yoja- yati -yituM).
FEOFFEE , s. pUrvvoktasanDipuraHsaraM, BUsvAminA kzetrAdyaDikAre niyuktaH or kzatrAdyaDikAravAn m. (t).
FEOFFER , s. pUrvvoktasanDipuraHsaraM parasmE kzetrAdyAvikArasamarpakaH.
FEOFFMENT , s. pUrvvoktasanDipuraHsaraM parasmE samarpito BUmyaDikAraH.
FERACIOUS , a. sPItaH -tA -taM, PalI -linI -li (n), abanDyaH -nDyA -nDyaM.
FERACITY , s. PalavattvaM, sAPalyaM, sPItatA, abanDyatA, urvvarAtvaM.
FERINE: (1) hiMsraH (srA, sraM);(2) vanyaH (nyA, nyaM) (= wild).
FERINE , a. pASavaH -vI -vaM, SOvApadaH -dI -daM, SvApadaH -dI -daM, paSaSIlaH -lA -laM, paSuvyavahAraH -rA -raM, paSuGarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n), vanyaH -nyA -nyaM.
FERITY , s. paSutA -tvaM, paSuSIlatA, krUrAcAratvaM, nizWuratA.

Ferment, [Ferment]ation, s. maMqaH-qaM, aBizavaH, PeRaH-naH, kiRvaH-RvaM, surAmaMqaH, kArottaraH, nagnahUH (m.). 2 aMtraH-kzoBaH-tApaH-dAhaH-utsekaH-vegaH, uttApaH. v. t. AkulIkf 8 U, aMtaH kzuB c., utsitt 6 P or c., uttap c., aMtarvegaM utpad c., aMtaH-tap c. v. i. PenAyate (D.), utsic pass., aMtaH kzaB 4 P or tap 4 A, aMtastApaM yA 2 P. 2 kzuB, uttap.
FERMENT (subs.) I Lit.:(1) kiRva (mn.);(2) maRqa (mn.).II Heat, agitation: q.v.: kzoBaH.
FERMENT (v.t.): kzoBayati (c. of kzuB): v. To agitate.
FERMENT (v.i.): I To effervesce: q.v.: PenAyate (nomi.) (?).II To be agitated: kzuByati (kzuB, c. 4.).
To FERMENT , v. a. antaHkzoBaM or antaScalanaM or antastApaM or uqBAvaM jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM), utsecanaM jan, antaH kzuB (c. 10. kzoBayati -yituM), uttap (c. 10. -tApayati -yituM).

To FERMENT , v. n. antaHkzuB (c. 4. kzuByati, kzoBituM), antaHkzoBaM or antastApam upagam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM) or gam or i (c. 2. eti -tuM), uttaptaH -ptA -ptaM BU or as, udBU, Pena (nom. PenAyate).

FERMENT , s. (Intestine motion, heat) antaHkzoBaH, antastApaH, antardAhaH, antarvegaH, antarutsekaH, uttApaH, antarAloqanaM, antaruzmaH, ugratvaM, pracaRqatA. — (That which causes fermentation, yeast) nagnahUH m., kiRvaH -RvaM, maRqaH -RqaM, surAmaRqaH, aBizavaH, kArottaraH, kArottamaH, kAdambarIvIjaM.
FERMENTABLE , a. antarutsekayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, antarutsecanakzamaH -mA -maM, antaHkzoBaRIyaH -yA -yaM.
FERMENTATION: (1) sanDAnam (?);(2) sPUrtiH (?)

FERMENTATION , s. sanDAnaM, sanDikA, antardahanaM, antaHkzoBaH, antastApaH, antardAhaH, antarutsekaH, utsekaH, utsecanaM, udBAvaH, uttApaH, ugratvaM, antaruzmaH, uccaRqatA, antaScaRqatA, antarAloqanaM, vikAraH.
FERMENTATIVE: (1) sPUrtikaraH (rI, raM) (?);(2) maRqajananaH (nI, naM) (?).
FERMENTATIVE , a. udBAvakArI -riRI -ri (n), antaHkzoBakArI &c., utsekajanakaH -kA -kaM, maRqajanakaH -kA -kaM.
FERMENTED , a. vikftaH -tA -taM, vikAritaH -tA -taM, sanDitaH -tA -taM, sanDAnopagataH -tA -taM, antaHkzubDaH -bDA -bDaM, utsiktaH -ktA -ktaM; ‘fer- -mented liquor,’ surAsavaH, yavasuraM.
Fern, s. vahupatrakaH.
FERN: latAjAtiviSezaH; *patraprasUH.
FERN , s. samaNgA, guptapuzpa ozaDiBedaH, bahupatrakaH.
FERNY , a. samaNgAviSizwaH -zwA -zwaM, samaNgAvftaH -tA -taM, saMmaNgAmayaH -yI -yaM.
Ferocious, a. rOdra (drI f.), ugra, krUra, ati-krUra, dAruRa, krUrakarman, mArAtmaka, sAhasika (kI f.); See Grim, Dreadful also. [Ferocious]ness, Ferocity, s. rOdratA, krOryaM, ugratA, &c.
FEROCIOUS: (1) rOdraH (drI, draM);(2) ugraH (grA, graM): v. Dreadful, cruel.

FEROCIOUS , a. rOdraH -drI -draM, krUraH -rA -raM, atikrUraH -rA -raM, mArAtmakaH -kA -kaM, ugraH -grA -graM, SOvApadaH -dI -daM, SvApadaH -dI -daM, vyAlaH -lA -laM, sAhasikaH -kI -kaM, dAruRaH -RA -RaM, krUracaritaH -tA -taM, krUrakarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n), rOravaH -vI -vaM, vyAlatamaH -mA -maM.
FEROCIOUSLY: (1) dAruRam (= dreadfully);(2) krUram (= cruelly).
FEROCIOUSLY , adv. atikrUravat, atikrOryyeRa, SvApadavat, vyAlavat, ugraM.
FEROCIOUSNESS, FEROCITY: (1) rOdratA;(2) ugratA;(3) krOryam (=cruelty);(4) dAruRatA (= dreadfulness).
FEROCITY , s. rOdratA, krUratA, atikrUratA, krOryyaM, ugratvaM, vyAlatvaM.
Ferreous, a. lOha (hI f.), Ayasa (sI f.), lohamaya (yI f.), ayoDarman.
FERREOUS , a. lOhaH -hI -haM, AyasaH -sI -saM, lohalaH -lA -laM, lohamayaH -yI -yaM, ayomayaH -yI -yaM, lohasaBAvaH -vA -vaM.
Ferret, s. baBruH, nakulaH.
FERRET , s. vaBruH m., nakulaH, aNgUzaH, nakulajAtIyo jantuH.
To FERRET , v. a. SaSakAdivilevAsino kzudrajantUn baBuBir gartteByo niHsf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM) or gartteByo vahizkftya anusf, indurAdIn garttASrayAn niHsf in caus.
Ferruginous, a. lohamalayukta.
FERRUGINOUS , a. lohakalaNkamayaH -yI -yaM, ayomalavAn -vatI -vat (t).
Ferrule, s. lohavalayaH-yaM, lOharakzaRI.
FERRULE: lohavalayaH, Monier Williams.
FERRULE , s. lohavalayaH, lohabanDanI -naM, lOharakzaRI, daRqAgratrARaM.

Ferry, s. taraH, taraRasTAnaM, GawwaH; ‘f(erry) boat’ taranOH, ta(tA)raRaH-Ri f., tarIH, tarAluH, u-qupaH, vahitraM; ‘f(erry)-man’ taranAyakaH, nAvikaH, tArakaH, tAraRaH. v. t. (over) nAvA tF 1 P or pAraM gam 1 P.
FERRY (v.): I Intran: tarati (tF, c. 1.).II Trans.: tArayati (c. of tF).
FERRY (subs.): taraH, should employ confidential men in charge of mines, customs, and f.s: AkaraSulka- tarezvAptAnniyuYjIta, V.s.; f. boat: taranOH, taraRanOkA.
FERRY , s. (Place of passing over rivers) nadItarasTAnaM, tarasTAnaM, taraRasTAnaM, uttaraRasTAnaM, taraH, GawwaH -wwI, umaH.
To FERRY OVER , v. a. nAvA or nOkayA nadIM or nadIpAraM tF in caus. (tArayati -yituM).
To FERRY OVER , v. n. nOkayA nadIM or nadIpAraM tf (c. 1. tarati -rituM -rItuM) or santF.
FERRY-BOAT , s. taraRanOkA, taraRaH -RiH f., tAraRaH -RiH f., taritrI, tariH f., tarikaM -kA, tArakaH -kaM, taraRqaH -RqA -RqI, tarAluH m., tarAnDuH m., vahitraM, udupaH -paM.
FERRY-MAN , s. tArakaH, tarikaH -kI m. (n), tAraRaH, taritA m. (tf).
FERRYMAN: (1) GawwajIvin (m.);(2) taranAyakaH. (?)

Fertile, a. Sasyaprada, urvara, bahuPalaprada, bahuSa-syada, avaMDya, sPIta; ‘f(ertile) in produce’ samfdDa-Sasya. 2 (Fig.) nirmARakuSala, kalpaka, saMviDAyaka. [Fertil]ity, [Fertile]ness, s. PalavattA, PaladatA, saPalatA, avaMDyatvaM, sPIti f. [Fertil]ize, v. t. saPala-Palaprada a. kf 8 U, PaladI-kf, ApyE c., sPItIkf.

FERTILE: I Fruitful: q.v.:(1) SasyapradaH (dA, daM);(2) u(U)rvarA (of soil), f. land: urvarA BUmiH. II Fig., rich, inventive: nirmARakuSalaH (lA, laM) and sim. comp.s, he has f. mind: *tasya nirmARadakzaM manaH.

FERTILE , a. bahuPalaH -lA -lI -laM, bahuPaladaH -dA -daM, -dAyI -yinI -yi (n), bahuPalotpAdakaH -kA -kaM, bahuSasyadaH -dA -daM, pracuraSasyotpAdakaH -kA -kaM, PalI -linI -li (n), PalavAn -vatI -vat (t), saPalaH -lA -laM, sPItaH -tA -taM, pInaH -nA -naM, abanDyaH -nDyA -nDyaM; ‘fer- -tile soil,’ urvvarA or UrvvarA.
FERTILELY , adv. saPalaM, sabahuPalaM, sPItaM, sPItyA, yaTA bahuPalam utpadyate taTA, abanDyaM.
FERTILENESS, FERTILITY: I Fruitfulness: (1) PalavattA;(2) by adj.II Inventiveness: nirmARadakzatA (?) and sim. comp.s.
FERTILENESS , FERTILITY, s. PalavattvaM, saPalatA, PalitA, sAPalyaM, sPItiH f., bahuPalotpAdakatvaM, abanDyatvaM, urvvarAtvaM, UrvvaratvaM.
FERTILIZATION (1) expr. by verb;(2) PaladI- karaRam (?).
FERTILIZE (1) PalavantaM (tIM, t) karoti;(2) PaladIkaroti (?).
To FERTILIZE , v. a. saPala (nom. saPalayati -yituM), saPalIkf, sPItIkf, sPAy in caus. (sPAvayati -yituM), ApyE in caus. (-pyAyayati -yituM).
FERTILIZED , p. p. saPalIkftaH -tA -taM, sPItIkftaH -tA -taM, ApyAyitaH -tA -taM.
Ferule, Ferula, s. vetraM, daMqakAzWaM.
FERULE: daRqakAzWam (?); vetram (= cane).
FERULE , FERULA, s. kAzWaPalakaviSezo yena hastatale SizpatAqanaM kriyate.
To FERULE , v. a. pUrvvoktakAzWaPalakena karatale SizyaMtaq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM).
FERVENCY: (1) Otsukyam;(2) utsAhaH: v. Zeal.

FERVENCY , s. vyagratA, caRqatA, uccaRqatA, pracaRqatA, uzRatA, uzmaH, uttApaH, tEkzRyaM, tIkzRatA, udyogaH, udyuktatA, ugratA, OtsukyaM, anurAgaH, AsaktiH f., cittAsaktiH f., manonirbanDaH, utsAhaH; ‘pious ardour,’ atiSayaBaktiH f., BaktivyagratA.

Fervent, a. caMqa, utsuka, tIkzRa, sAtiSaya, ugra, sotsAha, Asakta, vyagra, utkawa, uttapta, udyukta, sodyoga; ‘f(ervent) in piety’ Baktivyagra, atiBakta. [Fervent]ly, adv. sotsAhaM, sASaMsaM, sotsukaM, vyagratayA, Otsukyena, utkawatayA. Fervency, s. vyagratA, utsAhaH, OtsukyaM, utkawatA, tIkzRatA, caMqatA, Asakti f., manonirbaMDaH.
FERVENT: I Hot: q.v.II Eager, earnest: q.v.: utsukaH (kA, kaM).

FERVENT , a. vyagraH -grA -graM, caRqaH -RqA -RqaM, pracaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, uccaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, uttaptaH -ptA -ptaM, uzRaH -zRA -zRaM, udyogI -ginI -gi (n), udyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, sodyogaH -gA -gaM, tIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM, anuraktaH -ktA -ktaM, atpanurAgI -giRI -gi (n), utsukaH -kA -kaM, AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, samudyataH -tA -taM, ugraH -grA -graM; ‘in piety,’ atiBaktaH -ktA -ktaM, BaktivyagraH -grA -graM.
FERVENTLY: sotsAham: v. Eagerly, zealously.
FERVENTLY , adv. vyagraM, atpanurAgeRa, satEkzRyaM, uttApena, sodyogaM, Otsukyena, utsukaM, upraM, sAnurAgaM, pracaRqaM, vyavasitaM, atikutUhalena.

Fervid, a. pracaMqa, tIvra, tIkzRa, uttapta, sAti-Saya, praKara, tigma, ugra. Fervour, s. pra-, caMqatA, tIvratA, tIkzRatA, uttApaH, utkawatA, vyagratA; ‘religious f(ervour)’ atiBakti f., BaktivyagratA, SradDonmAdaH.
FERVID: I Very hot: pracaRqaH (RqA, RqaM), when the sun is f.: pracaRqasUryaH, f. heat: pracaRqatApaH, Rit. II Vehement: q.v.: pracaRqa (f. RqA).

FERVID , a. taptaH -ptA -ptaM, santaptaH -ptA -ptaM, upataptaH -ptA -ptaM, aBitaptaH -ptA -ptaM, [Page267-b+ 51] uttaptaH -ptA -ptaM, caRqaH -RqA -RqaM, pracaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, uzRaH -zRA -zRaM, tIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM, tIvraH -vrA -vraM, tigmaH -gmA -gmaM.
FERVOUR: I Heat: q.v.: pracaRqatA.II Ardour: pracaRqatA.
FERVOUR , s. tApaH, uttApaH, santApaH, upatApaH, aBitApaH, uzRatA, OzRyaM, dAhaH caRqatA, tIkzRatA, tEkzRyaM, tigmatA, tIvratA. See FERVENCY.
Festal, a. Otsavika (kI f.).
FESTAL: expr. by comp., f. day: utsavadinam.
FESTAL , a. pArvvaH -rvvI -rvvaM, OtsavikaH -kI -kaM, yAtrikaH -kI -kaM.
Fester, v. i. pUy 1 A, pUtIBU 1 P, pakva a. BU, sapUya a. BU.
To FESTER , v. n. pUy (c. 1. pUyate -yituM), pAkaM kf, pakvaH -kvA -kvaM BU, sapUyaH -yA -yaM BU, pUtIBU, vraRavad duz (c. 4. dupyati, dozwuM).
Festival, s. utsavaH, mahaH, parvan n., kzaRaH, udDarzaH, udDavaH, yAtrA, aByudayaH; ‘public or general f(estival)’ yAtrotsavaH.

FESTIVAL: (1) utsavaH, the great f. of the birth of the prince increased every moment: pratikzaRamavarData rAjasUnorjanmano mahotsavaH, K.;(2) aByudayaH (rare), even in f.s: aByudayezvapi, M. ix. 84.;(3) mahaH or mahas (n.) (rare), the f. of cupid: madanamahaH, Ra.

FESTIVAL , s. utsavaH, parvva n. (n), parvvAhaH, parvvarIRaM, utsavadinaM, mahaH, mahaH n. (s), udDarzaH, yAtrA, udDavaH, kzaRaH, aByudayaH, carcarI; ‘great festival,’ mahotsavaH; ‘public festival,’ yAtrotsavaH; ‘fixed,’ nEScityaM; ‘completion of a festival,’ parvvapUrRatA.
Festive, a. AnaMdaprada, sotsava, harzaRa, sA-naMda, utsava in comp.; ‘f(estive) day’ utsava-dinaM. [Festiv]ity, s. utsavaH, samutsavaH, utsava-kAlaH. 2 pramodaH, harzaH, AnaMdaH, AhlAdaH.
FESTIVE: (1) by comp.;(2) pArvaRaH (f. RI) (= relating to parva=holiday), the chief citi- zens take to desired f. work: Bajante viDimaBilazitaM pArvaRaM pOramuKayAH, Mu. iii.
FESTIVE , a. AnandI -ndinI -ndi (n), sAnandaH -ndA -ndaM, AnandasUcakaH -kA -kaM, sotsavaH -vA -vaM, utsavakArI -riRI -ri (n), harzaRaH -RA -RaM.
FESTIVITY: I Festival: q.v.II Joy: q.v.: pramodaH.
FESTIVITY , s. samutsavaH, utsavaH, mahotsavaH, utsavakAlaH, harzaH, AnandaH, AhlAdaH, AmodaH, pramodaH, viSramBaH.
Festoon, s. mAlA, hAraH, sraj f.
FESTOON: adorned with f.s: dAmaBirvaramAlyAnAM prAlambEH samalaNkftam, Ram. ii. 12. 31.: v. Wreath.
FESTOON , s. mAlA, hAraH, prAlambikA; ‘of flowers,’ kususramAlA.
FETAL , a. gArBaH -rBI -rBaM, gArBikaH -kI -kaM, BrURasambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n).

Fetch, v. t. Ahf 1 P, upA-A-nI 1 P, upA-dA 3 A. 2 nizkfz 1 P, utpad c., sru c.; ‘f(etch) a deep sigh’ dIrGaM niSvas 2 P; ‘what price does the book f(etch)’ ki-yatA mUlyena tatpustakaM vikrIyate; ‘f(etch) up’ ud-Df 1 P, 10; A-sad c.; See Overtake. s. kapawaM, vyAjaH, apadeSaH, upAyaH.

FETCH (v.): I To bring: q.v.: Aharati (hf, c. 1.), went to Kichaka's house to f. wine: prAtizWata surAhArI kIcakasya niveSanam, Mah. iii. 16. 17.II To sell for, expr. by laBate (laB, c. 1.), friend, what price will fourteen f.: caturda Sa saKe mUlyaM laBante kiyat, Li.III To arrive at: q.v.: prApnoti (Ap, c. 5.).IV To fell: q.v.: pAtayati. (c. of pat). V. To make, do: q.v.: karoti.
FETCH (subs.): Calam: v. Trick, artifice.

To FETCH , v. a. (Bring) AnI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM), upAnI, Ahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM). — (Derive) AnI, nirRI, nI, apavah (c. 1. -vahati -voQuM). — (Draw, cause to appear) nizkfz (c. 1. -karzati -krazwuM), sru in caus. (srAvayati -yituM), utpad in caus. (-pAdayati -yituM), jan in caus. (janayati -yituM); ‘draw blood,’ SoRitam utpad in caus., raktaM sru in caus.; ‘fetch a sigh,’ dIrGaM niHSvas (c. 2. -Svasiti -tuM), or niSvas. — (Perform) kf. — (Fetch a price) amukamUlyena vikrI in pass. (-kIyate); ‘what price does it fetch?’ kiyatA sUlyena vikrIyate.
FETCH , s. upAyaH, vyapadeSaH, apadeSaH, CalaM -lanA, kapawaH, vyAjaH.
FETCHED , p. p. AnItaH -tA -taM, upAnItaH -tA -taM, AhftaH -tA -taM.
FETCHER: (1) Ahartf (f. trI); sam-;(2) by verb.
Fete, v. t. tfp c., tuz c. s. utsavaH.
FETE: I Subs.: parvan (n.): v. Festival.II Verb, to feast: tarpayati, saM-, (c. of tfp), f.d the great Brahmins: tarpayAmAsa viprendrAn, Mah.
FETE , s. utsavaH, mahotsavaH, utsavadinaM, udDarzadinaM.
Fetid, a. pUtigaMDi, pUta, asugaMDi, ugragaMDa, durgaMDa.
FETID (adj.): (1) durganDaH (nDA, nDaM);(2) durganDi (mfn.);(3) pUtiganDiH (mfn.);(4) pUti (mfn.);(5) ugraganDi (mfn.) (= strong-smell- -ing).
FETID , a. durganDaH -nDA -nDaM, durganDI -nDinI -nDi (n), asuganDaH -nDA -nDaM, ugraganDiH -nDiH -nDi, pUtiganDikaH -kI -kaM, asuraBiH -BiH -Bi, pUtaH -tA -taM.
FETIDNESS: (1) durganDa(nDi)tA;(2) pUtiganDitA.
FETIDNESS , s. durganDatvaM, dOrganDiH m., pUtiganDatA, pUtiH f., pUtatvaM.
FETISH, FETICH: BUtam (?). F. ism: BUtaBaktiH (?).
FETLOCK , s. aSvAnAM pAdajaNGAsanDiH m. or caraRajaNGAparvva n. (n) or pAdajaNGAsanDiruho lomapiRqaH or lomagucCakaH.
Fetor, s. durgaMDaH, pUti-ugra-gaMDaH.
FETOR: (1) pUtiganDaH;(2) durganDaH: v. Fetid- -ness.
FETOR , s. durganDaH, pUtiganDaH, kutsitaganDaH, ugraganDaH, asuganDaH.
Fetter, s. nigaqaH-qaM, baMDanaM, pASaH, SfMKalA-laM. v. t. nigaqena baMD 9 P, saMyam 1 P, yaMtr 10, nigaqayati (D.). [Fetter]ed, a. nigaqita, pASa-badDa, saMyata, SfMKalita, saMdAnita.
FETTER (subs.): SfNKalaH, (-lA, -laM): v. Chain.
FETTER: (v.): nigaqayati (nomi.): v. To en- -chain, confine.

FETTER , s. nigaqaH -qaM, banDanaM, banDaH, pASaH, SfNKalaH -lA -laM, yantraRaM, yantraM, yoktaM, cAraH, prasitiH f., ‘for the feet,’ pAdapASaH -SI, caraRapASaH, pAdabanDanaM; ‘of iron,’ lOhabanDaH -nDaM -nDanaM, SfNKalA.

To FETTER , v. a. nigaqena or pASena or SfNKalayA banD (c. 9. baGnAti, banDuM), nigaqa (nom. nigaqayati -yituM), pASa (nom. pASayati -yituM), SfNKala (nom. SfNKalayati -yituM), yoktra (nom. yoktrayati -yituM), yantr (c. 10. yantrayati -yituM), pASIkf, pASena yam (c. 1. yacCati, yantuM), or saMyam.
FETTER , s. saMroDaH. To FETTER, v. a. saruD.
FETTERED , p. p. nigaqitaH -tA -taM, nigaqena badDaH -dDA -dDaM, pASitaH -tA -taM, pASIkftaH -tA -taM, SfNKalitaH -tA -taM, yantritaH -tA -taM, saMyamidgacaraRaH -RA -RaM, badDapAdaH -dA -daM.
Fetus, s. garBaH, BrURaH, piMqaH, kalalaM-naM, garBasTaH, SiSuH.
FETUS: garBaH, dead f.: mUQagarBaH, Sr.
FETUS , s. BrURaH, garBaH, kalanaM, kalalaH -laM, piRqaH, zaM, garBasTabAlakaH, jarAyusTo bAlakaH, udarasTaH SiSuH m., jaWarasTaSiSuH m., antarApatyaM.
Feud, s. kalahaH, kaliH, vigrahaH, viroDaH, vipakzatA, dvaMdvaM, yudDaM; ‘family f(eud)’ gfhacCidraM, gfharaMDraM, aMtarBedaH.
FEUD: I Quarrel: q.v.: kalaham,II An estate: karmaRopaBogyA BUmiH (?). *karmottaraBUmiH.
FEUD , s. (Quarrel) kalahaH -haM, kaliH m., viroDaH, vigrahaH, vipakzatA, yudDaM, dvandvaM; ‘family feud,’ kuwumbakalahaH, gfhaCidraM, gfharanDraM. — (Right to land). See FEOD.
FEUDAL: the f. system: *karmottaraBUmipraRAlI; f. rights *karmottaraBUmyaDikArAH.
FEUDAL , a. pUrvvakAle kzetrADikAravizaye yo niyamas tatsambanDI -nDinI nDi (n) or kzetrasvAmikzetrADikAriRor maDyeyaH samayas tadvizayakaH -kA -kaM.
Feudatory, s. sAmaMtaH.
FEUDATORY: f. chiefs: karmakAriRo BUpAlAH: v. Also tributary.
FEUDATORY , s. pUrvvakAleBUsvAmyaDInaH kzetrADikArI m. (n), upajIvI m. (n).

Fever, s. jvaraH (lit. & fig.), tApaH, deha-dAhaH-tApaH; ‘inflammatory f(ever)’ dAhajvaraH; ‘typhoid f(ever)’ saMnipAtajvaraH, taMdrikasaMnipAtaH; ‘ardent f(ever)’ tApolbaRaH; ‘relapsing f(ever)’ muktAnubAMDin m., saMtataH. v. t. ut-saM-tap c., jvar c. (jvarayati). [Fever]ish, a. jvarArta, jvaragrasta, jvarAtura, jvarapIqita, jvarita, sajvara, jvarin. 2 jvarotpAdaka, jvarajanaka.

FEVER: I Lit. jvaraH, acute (lit. new) f.: nava- jvaraH; chronic (lit. old) f.: jIrRajvaraH, Bha.; inflammatory f.: dAhajvaraH; cold f.: SItajvaraH; typhoid f.: sannipAtajvaraH (?); he will have f. again: asya punareva BavejjvaraH; Sr.; recovered from f.: jaro- tsfzwaH (zwA, zwaM), Sr, or jvaramuktaH (ktA, ktaM), Bha. II Fig.: jvaraH, speak it without f.: tadbrUta vigata- jvarAH, Mat.: v. Excitement.

FEVER , s. jvaraH, saMjvaraH, tApaH, SarIratApaH, SarIradAhaH, dehadAhaH, antardAhaH, jUrttiH f., mahAgadaH; ‘common fever,’ prAkftajvaraH; ‘bilious fever,’ pittajvaraH; ‘continued fever,’ satatajvaraH; ‘remittent,’ santatajvaraH; ‘slow fever,’ pralepakaH; ‘ill of fever,’ see FEVERISH. ‘To be ill of fever,’ jvar (c. 1. jvarati -rituM), saMjvar; ‘attack of fever,’ jvarAvataraRaM, jvarAkramaRaM, AtapalaNGanaM.
To FEVER , v. a. jvar in caus. (jvarayati -yituM), saMjvar, in caus. jvaraM kf, tap in caus. (tApayati -yituM), santap, dah (c. 1. dahati, dagDuM).

FEVER , s. (Arising from vitiation of the humour bile) pitta- jvaraH. — (Of the humour phlegm) kaPajvaraH. — (Of the humour wind) atajvaraH. — (Of the three humours) tridozAtmakajvaraH. — (Of the bile and wind) pittavAtajvaraH. — (Of the bile and phlegm) pittakaPajvaraH. — (With ague) SItajvaraH; ‘illusions of f.,’ jvarasfzwiH f.; ‘inflammatory f.,’ dAhajvaraH; ‘slow f.,’ jIrRajvaraH.

FEVERISH: I Affected with fever:(1) jvaritaH (tA, taM);(2) jvarin (f. RI);(3) jarArta (f. rtA);(4) jvaragrasta (f. stA); and sim. comp.s. II Indicating fever: expr. by jvaraBAvaH. III Hot.: q.v.IV Fickle: q.v.

FEVERISH , a. (Ill with fever) jvarI -riRI -ri (n), jvaritaH -tA -taM, sajvaraH -rA -raM, saMjvArI -riRI -ri (n), jvarAturaH -rA -raM, saMjvarAturaH -rA -raM, jvarapIqitaH -tA -taM, jvaragrastaH -stA -staM. — (Having a slight fever) IzajjvarI -riRI -ri (n). — (Producing fever) jvarajanakaH -kA -kaM, jvarotzAdakaH -kA -kaM.
FEVERISHNESS: (1) jvaritatA (=actual f.);(2) jvaraBAvaH.
FEVERISHNESS , s. sajvaratvaM, IzajjvaragrastatA, jvaraBAvaH, jvaritvaM.
Few, a. alpa, katipaya, stoka, parimita, mita, apracura, abahu; ‘a f(ew)’ katicit, stokAH katipayAH. [Few]ness, s. alpatvaM, stokatvaM.

FEW: (1) alpaH (lpA, lpaM), in a very f. days: svalpIyoBireva divasEH, C.; in f.: alpena;(2) katipayaH (yA, yaM) or katicit (= a small number), a f. nights: katicit SarvarIH, R. xi. 93. v. Also some, small.

FEW , a. alpaH -lpA -lpaM, svalpaH -lpA -lpaM, svalyakaH -kA -kaM, abahuH -huH -hvI -hu, katipayaH -yA -yaM, apracuraH -rA -raM, stokaH -kA -kaM, alpasaM KyakaH -kA -kaM, avfMhitaH -tA -taM, anekaH -kA -kaM, mitaH -tA -taM, parimitaH -tA -taM, aBfSaH -SA -SaM; ‘a few,’ alpe, svalpe, katicit, aneke, katipayajanAH m. pl., katicijjanAH m. pl., stokAH m. pl., kati kati; ‘a few paces,’ katicitpadAni n. pl.; ‘fewest,’ nyUnaH -nA -naM, avaraH -rA -ra.
FEWNESS: alpatA: v. Also smallness.
FEWNESS , s. alpatA, svalpatA, abahutvaM, aprAcuryyaM, stokatvaM.
FFECTEDLY , adv. vElakzyeRa, sAhaNkAraM, ahaNkAreRa.
Fiance, s. vaDU.
Fiasco, s. BaMgaH, anizpatti f., asidDi f.
Fiat, s. AjYA, nirdeSaH, SAsanaM, niyogaH, vyavasTApatraM.
FIAT: SAsanam: v. Decree.
FIAT , s. AjYA, AdeSaH, nideSaH, niyogaH, SAsanaM, vyavasTA.
FIB (subs.): (1) anftam;(2) asatyam;(3) alIkam.
FIB , s. asatpaM, anftaM, vitaTaM, alIkaM, miTyAvAdaH, mfzAvAdaH.
To FIB , v. n. asatpaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), mfzA or miTyA vad.
FIBBER , s. asatyavAdI m. (n), miTyAvAdI m. mfzAvAdI m., anftI m. (n).

Fibre, s. taMtuH, sUtraM, guRaH, taMtraM. 2 kesa(Sa)-raH-raM, aMSuH, pakzman n. 3 SirA, nAqI, snasA; ‘f(ibre) of a lotus’ mfRAlaH-laM-lI, bisaM. [Fibr]ed, [Fibr]ous, a. taMtumat, sUtrin, kesarin-taMtumaya (yI f.), SirAla.
FIBRE: I Thread: q.v.: tantuH.II Of animals or plants: SirA.

FIBRE , s. (Thread) tantuH m., tantraM, sUtraM, guRaH. — (Filament) keSaraH, pakzma n. (n), aMSuH m. — (Fibre of the body) SirA, sirA, nAqI, srAyuH m., srasA, vahIruH m. — (Of a leaf) patraSirA, patranAqikA, dalasnasA. — (Of the lotus) mfRAlaH -laM, viSaM, vizaM, visaM, tantulaM.
FIBRED , a. mfRAlI -linI -li (n), tantumAn -matI -mat (t), aMSumAn &c.
FIBRIL: sUkzmatantuH.
FIBRIL , s. sUkzmatantuH m., sUkzmatantraM, sUkzmakeSaraH, sUkzmaSirA.
FIBROUS: (1) tantumayaH (yI, yaM) (?);(2) tantuGawitaH (tA, taM) (?).
FIBROUS , a. tantrI -ntriRI -ntri (n), tantumAn -matI -mat (t), tantumayaH -yI -yaM, keSarI -riRI -ri (n), sUtrI -triRI -tri (n), sUkzmanAqivi- -SizwaH -zwA -zwaM, SirAlaH -lA -laM.
FIBULA , s. jaNGAyA vahirasTi n., jaNGAbadDAsTi. — (Clasp) kuqupaH.

Fickle, a. capala, caMcala, lola, tarala, cala, asTira, anavasTita, aDIra; (of persons only) calacitta, caMcalahfdaya, lolabudDi, nEkaBAvASraya, prakftitarala, lola-caMcala-mati, asTirabudDi. [Fickle]ness, s. cApalyaM, taralatA, lolatA, cAMcalyaM, aDIratA, asTiratA, calacittatA, manolOlyaM.

FICKLE: (1) caYcalaH (lA, laM), fortune is f.: caYcalaM vasu, Ki.;(2) capalaH (lA, laM); this Brahmin youth is f.: capalo'yaM brAhvaRavawuH, Sa. ii.;(3) asTiraH (rA, raM) (= inconstant);(4) anavasTitaH (tA, taM) (= 3).

FICKLE , a. caYcalaH -lA -laM, caYcalahfdayaH -yA -yaM, caYcalabudDiH -dDiH -dDi, capalaH -lA -laM, capalAtmakaH -kA -kaM, calacittaH -ttA -ttaM, saNkasukaH -kA -kaM, asTiraH -rA -raM, anavasTaH -sTA -sTaM, anavasTAnaH -nA -naM, anavasTitaH -tA -taM, lolaH -lA -laM, taralaH -lA -laM, prakftitaralaH -lA -laM, aDIraH -rA -raM, anyamanAH -nAH -naH (s), nEkaBAvASrayaH -yA -yaM, saYcArI -riRI -ri (n).
FICKLENESS: (1) caYcalatA;(2) capalatA;(3) asTi- ratA;(4) cAYcalyam;(5) cApalyam(6) asTEryam;(7) calacittatA (= f. of mind).
FICKLENESS , s. caYcalatvaM, cAYcalpaM, capalatA, cApalyaM, asTiratA, aTEryyaM, calacittatA, lolatA, lOlyaM, manolOlyaM, taralatA, tAralyaM, saNkasukatvaM, anavasTitiH f., aDIratvaM, aGftiH f.
FICKLY: (1) asTiram;(2) cApalyena;(3) caYcalatayA.
FICKLY , adv. caYcalaM, capalaM, taralaM, asTiraM, asTEryyeRa, manolOlyAt.

Fiction, s. kalpanA, racanA, sfzwi f.; manaH-kalpanA-sfzwiH, mAnasI sfzwiH. 2 miTyAkaTA, kalpitA kaTA. Fictitious, a. kftaka, kftrima, kalpita, asatya, mfzArTaka, kUwArTa, kapawa-miTyA-kUwa in comp. [Fictitious]ly, adv. miTyA, sakapawaM, mfzA, sakUwaM, savyAjaM.
FICTION: kalpanA, this is a f. of his own creation: tasya manaHkalpitamalIkametat: v. Invention, untruth.

FICTION , s. (Feigning, invention) kalpanA -naM, kxptiH f., parikalpanaM -nA, racanA, sfzwiH f., manaHsfzwiH f., kalpanAsfzwiH f., kftrimakaraRaM. — (That which is feigned, false story) manaHkalpitA kaTA, kUwArTo- -pAKyAnaM, kUwArTaBAzitA, parikaTA, miTyAkaTA, miTyAvAkyaM, pravanDakalpanA, [Page268-b+ 51] anftaM; ‘a poetical fiction,’ prakaraRaM.
FICTITIOUS: (1) kftrimaH (mA, maM);(2) alIkaH. v. False;(3) kAlpanikaH (kI, kaM).

FICTITIOUS , a. kalpitaH -tA -taM, parikalpitaH -tA -taM, kAlpanikaH -kI -kaM, manaHkalpitaH -tA -taM, kftrimaH -mA -maM, kftakaH -kA -kaM, kUwArTaH -rTA -rTaM, miTyArTakaH -kA -kaM, mfzArTakaH -kA -kaM, asatyaH -tyA -tyaM, aprakftaH -tA -taM, viqambitaH -tA -taM, kapawI -winI -wi (n), miTyA in comp.; ‘fictitious coin,’ kUwasvarRaM.
FICTITIOUSLY , adv. miTyA, asatyaM, sakapawa, sakUwaM, savyAjaM, mfzA, kftrimaM, kAlpanikaprakAreRa, saviqambanaM.
Fiddle, s. SA(sA)raMgI, pinAkI. v. t. sAraMgIM vad c., ‘f(iddle) stick’ SArikA, koRaH, GarGarikA.
FIDDLE (subs.): SA(sA)raNgI. Ph.: to play the second f. to: perh. pratiDvaniM karoti, K.; f. -stick: koRaH (gen. term), B. xiv. 2.
FIDDLE (v.): I Lit.: SAraNgIM vAdayati (c. of vad). II To tweedle: q.v.
FIDDLE , s. (Violin) sAraNgI, SAraNgI, pinAkI.
To FIDDLE , v. n. sAraNgIM vad in caus. (vAdayati -yituM) or saMvad, SArikAMsf in caus. (sArayati -yituM). — (Trifle, fidget) capalaH -lA -laM BU, tucCakarmma kf, tfRAdi mf in caus.
FIDDLE-FADDLE: nirarTakakaTA, yattat or yatkiYcit, Vi.
FIDDLE-FADDLE , s. mfzArTakaM, vfTAkaTA, AlasyavacanaM, asambadDavAkyaM.
FIDDLE-FADDLE , a. tfRaprAyaH -yA -yaM, asambadDaH -dDA -dDaM, tucCaH -cCA -cCaM.
FIDDLE-STRING , s. tantrI, tantraM, sAraNgItantuH m., sAraNgIsUtraM.
FIDDLER: I Lit.: SAraNgIvAdaH, -kaH.II Fig.: yatkiYcanakArI, K.
FIDDLER , s. sAraNgIvAdakaH, pinAkIvAdakaH, sAraNgIpARiH m.
FIDDLESTICK , s. SArikA, koRaH, raRaH, parivAdaH, GarGarikA.
Fidelity, s. Bakti f., AsaktatA, anurAgaH, nizkapawatvaM, viSvAsyatvaM, svAmi praBu-nizWA-BaktiH, aBedyatA; ‘f(idelity) to a husband’ pAtivratyaM, patisevA, satItvaM, cAritryaM

FIDELITY: I Loyalty: BaktiH, with (your) f. to (your) preceptor: BattayA gurO, R. ii. 63. Honesty, nizkapawatA.III Attachment:(1) AsaktiH;(2) saNgaH (rare), gaRikAyASca gamyaM prati sajjatEva na saNgaH, D.
FIDELITY , s. BaktiH f., BaktimattvaM, BaktatA, viSvAsyatvaM, DIratvaM, aBedyatA, viSrabDatA, viSvastatA, sevA; ‘to a master,’ praBuBaktiH f.; ‘to a husband,’ pativrataM, prAtivratyaM, patisevA.
Fidget, v. i. capala-caMcala a. BU 1 P. s. cApalyaM, caMcalatA. [Fidget]y, a. capala, caMcala, lola, aSAMta, aDIra; See Fickle.
To FIDGET , v. n. capalaH -lA -laM, BU, caYcalaH -lA -laM, BU, cApalyaM kf; ‘with the hands,’ pARicApalyaM kf.
FIDGET , s. (Restlessness) cApalyaM, caYcalatvaM, aSAntiH f., sadAcalatvaM.
FIDGETY: capalaH (lA, laM) (?): v. Restless.
FIDGETY , a. capalaH -lA -laM, caYcalaH -lA -laM, sadAcalaH -lA -laM, satata- gatiH -tiH -ti, aSAntaH -ntA -ntaM, asusTaH -sTA -sTaM.
Fiducial, a. viSvAsin, viSvasta, asaMdigDa.
FIDUCIAL , a. viSvAsI -sinI -si (n), viSvastaH -stA -staM, asandigDaH -gDA -gDaM.
Fiduciary, a. nyasta, nikzipta. s. nyAsa-nikzepa-DArin.
FIDUCIARY: I Adj.: expr. by viSvAsaM samAlambya, Mr.: v. Also confident, firm.II Subs.: v. Trustee.
FIDUCIARY , a. pratyayI -yinI -yi (n), dfQaviSvAsaH -sA -saM.
FIDUCIARY , s. (Trustee) nyAsaDArI m. (n), nikzepaDArI m. (n), viSvastajanaH.
Fie, interj. Dik (with acc.), sometimes with gen.
FIE (interj.): Dik (with acc.): v. Shame.
FIE , exclam. Dik, SAntaM, dyE, apEhi, apasara.
Fief, s. kzetraM, BUmi f., kzetraBUmiH.
FIEF: *karmottaraBUmiH; yoDaBUmiH.
FIEF , s. kzetraM, BUmiH f. See FEOD.

Field, s. kzetraM, BUmi f., vapraH-praM; ‘a collection of f(ield)s’ kEdArakaM, kEdAryaM, kzEtraM, kEdArikaM; ‘f(ield) of battle’ raRaBUmiH, raRAjiraM, raRAMganaM-RaM, raRaM, samaraBUmiH; ‘f(ield) marshal’ senApatiH, balADyakzaH, camUpatiH, daMqanAyakaH, senAnI m. ‘f(ield) sports’ vanakrIqA, araRya-mfgayA-vihAraH; ‘the general took the f(ield)’ senAnIryu-dDAya pravfttaH; ‘they lost the f(ield)’ tasminyu-dDe parAjigyire. 2 avasaraH, prasaraH, sTAnaM, vizayaH.

FIGURE , s. (In geometry) kzetraM. — (In arithmetic) aNkaH; ‘figures,’ aNkavidyA. — (Emblem) pratirUpaM, prativimbaM. — (In rhetoric) ala- NkAraH. The following are some of the common figures in rhetoric: ‘Simile,’ upamA; ‘Breaking the natural order of words in a sentence,’ ananvayaH; ‘Identification of the objects of a comparison,’ rUpakaM; ‘Irony,’ AkzepaH; ‘Allite- ration,’ anuprAsaH; ‘Comparison,’ utprekzA; ‘Hyperbole,’ ati- SayoktiH f.; ‘Explanation of any peculiar condition, by coupling cause with effect,’ viSezoktiH f.; ‘Dilating upon an idea, or accumulating expressions to throw light on an idea.’ dIpakaM; ‘Dissimilitude of things compared in some respect to each other,’ vyatirekaH; ‘Describing the past or future as present,’ BAvikaM; ‘Inverse comparison, or comparing new objects with some known object, as the moon, &c.,’ pratIpaM; ‘Identity of objects compared to one another,’ samaM; ‘Connexion of different objects by [Page857-b+ 50] common properties,’ sAmAnyaM; ‘Punning on words,’ SlezaH; ‘Climax,’ sAraM; ‘Rhetorical use of the word without,’ vi- noktiH f.; ‘Rhetorical use of the word with or along with,’ sahoktiH f.; ‘Change,’ pariRAmaH; ‘Recollection,’ smftiH f.; ‘Mistake,’ BrAntiH f.; ‘Doubt,’ sandehaH; ‘Applying a simile to other than its obvious application,’ apahnutiH f. And the following, the meaning of which is doubtful, prAsaH, ulleKaH, tulyayogitA, carvaRA.

First, a. praTama, Adya, Adima, pUrva, agrima, prAktana (nI f.). 2 muKya, pramuKa, praDAna, agrya, pravara, SrezWa, vareRya, agraRI, agresara, vara in comp.; See Principal, ‘f(irst) half’ pUrvArDaH; ‘f(irst) part of day’ pUrvAhRaH; ‘f(irst) part of night’ pUrvarAtraH, ‘for the f(irst) time’ praTamaM; ‘from the f(irst)’ praTamAvaDi, ApraTamaM; ‘f(irst) of all, in the first place’ praTamaM-AdO-tAvat; ‘f(irst) born’ agrajaH, pUrvajaH, agrajanman m., jyezWaH, agryaH, agrimaH; ‘f(irst)-fruits’ praTama-Adi-agra-PalaM, praTa-motpannaM; ‘f(irst)-rate’ SrezWa, utkfzwa, viSizwa-tama, parama, uttama. FIRST (adj.): (1) praTamaH (mA, maM) (of time, place, or rank), on the f. day. of Aṣāḍha: AzaQasya praTamadivase, Me. i. 1.; in the f. court: praTame prakozWe, Mr. iv.; f. of those, who share in sacrifices: maKAMSaBAjAM praTamaH, R. iii. 44.: v. Also chief; (2) Adi- in comp. or AdyaH (dyA, dyaM) or AdimaH (mA, maM) (= the beginning), the f. poet: AdikaviH; on the f. day of separation: Adye virahadivase, Me. ii. 31.;(3) pUrva-, in comp. (when there is [Page280] comparison), the f. half: pUrvArdDam, R.; the f. part of the day: pUrvAhRaH;(4) agyraH (gyrA, gyraM) or agrimaH (mA, maM) or agraRI (n. RI) (= foremost), you are the f. to eat: BoktuM BavAnagraRIH, Ma. n. ix. 86. Ph.: for the f. time:(1) tatpraTamam, Si xv. 42.;(2) tatpUrvam, Ki. vii. 11.; the f. of archers: cApaBftAM purogaH, R.

FIRST (adv.): (1) praTamam, f. of all, this is itself a great wonder: praTamaM tAvadidameva mahadAScaryam, K.; (2) pUrvaMm, f. of all, I am a fool: pUrvaM tAvadahaM mUrKaH, P. iii. 13; the king f. reflected in this way; itTaM nfpaH pUrvamavAluloce, B. i. 23.;(3) prAk, f. (took her) to the king of Magadha: prAk sannikarzaM magaDeSvarasya, R. vi. 20.;(4) purA, f. ascertained to be an assemblage of light: cayastvizAmityavaDAritaM purA, Si. i. 3.;(5) AdO (= in the beginning), at f. Jivasiddhi was banished from the city: AdAveva- jIvasidDirnagarAnnirvAsitaH, Mu. ii.;(6) agre (= before anything else), D. vi. N.B.(3) and (4) with ref. to time only.

Flagon, s. pAnapAtraM-BAjanaM, puwagrIvaH, kaMsaH-saM.
FLAGON: puwagrIvaH (?): v. Vessel.
FLAGON , s. puwagrIvaH, surABAjanaM, pAnaBAjanaM, pAnapAtraM.
FLAGRANCY: I Enormous:(1) GoratA;(2) dAruRatA, -tvam GoraH (rA, raM);(3) dAruRa (f. RA). II Glowing, raging: dIpyamAnaH (nA, naM).
FLAGRANCY , s. sarvvaprakASatA, sarvvaprAkawyaM, vAcyatA, atiduzwatA, GoratA.
Flagrant, a. Gora, dAruRa, atiduzwa, ati-niMdya, pApizWatama. 2 sarvajYAta, lokaprasidDa, suprakASa, suvyakta, puraHsPurat. Flagrancy, s. GoratA, atiduzwatA; suvyaktatA.
FLAGRANT , a. prakASaH -SA -SaM, sarvvaprakASaH -SA -SaM, sarvvaprasidDaH -dDA -dDaM, lokaviditaH -tA -taM, atiduzwaH -zwA -zwaM, GoraH -rA -raM, puraHsPuran -rantI -rat (t).
FLAGRANTLY , adv. prakASaM, suprakASaM, sarvvaprasidDaM, atiduzwaM.
FLAGRATION , s. dAhaH, dahanaM, dAhanaM, jvalanaM, jvAlaH, plopaH.
Flail, s. musalaH-laM, kaMqanI.
FLAIL: kaRqanayazwiH (?).
FLAIL , s. DAnyamarddanayazwiH m. f., SaspakaRqanayantraM, kaRqanI, SasyamarddanI, SiTiladaRqaviSepo yadAGAtena DAnyAdi nistupIkriyate.
Flake, s. hima or tuzAra-lavaH or kaRaH, himatUlaM, tuzAra-hima-GanaH. 2 SakalaH-laM, lavaH, kaRaH, alpaBAgaH. 3 PalakaH, saMstaraH. v. i. Saka-lIBU 1 P. [Flak]y, a. saSakala.
FLAKE: perh. piRqa (mn.).
FLAKE , s. (Of snow) himalavaH, himakaRaH, tupAraGanaH, nIhAraGanaH, himatUlaM, himANkuraH, tupAragaqaH, tUlopamo himAnIlavaH. — (Layer) PalakaH -kaM. — (Scale, loose piece) valkaM, SalkaM, SakalaM.
To FLAKE , v. n. SakalIBU, SakalAni vanD (c. 9. baDnAti, banDuM).
FLAKY: piRqamayaH (yI, yaM).
FLAKY , a. saSalkaH -lkA -lkaM, SakalI -linI -li (n), PalakI -kinI -ki (n).
FLAM , s. anarTakaM, mfzArTakaM, mAyA, CalaM, pratAraRA, Cadma n. (n).
Flambeau, s. ulkA, alAtaM, ulmukaM.
FLAMBEAU: ulkA, then they went about at the head of the battle with f. s in their hands: ulkAhastO tadA rAtrO raRamUrDni viceratuH, Ram.
FLAMBEAU , s. ulkA, ulmukaM, jvalanakAzWaM, agnikAzWaM, alAtaM.

Flame, s. jvAlA, SiKA, arcis f., n., kIlaH-lA, agnijvAlA-jihvA; ‘in f(lame)s’ jvalat, hutavahaparIta, dahyamAna. v. t. jval c., dIp c., dah c. v. i. jval 1 P, dIp 4 A, dah pass. [Flam]ing, a. ucCiKa, pradIpta, arcizmat, ujjvala, jvalita, jvalat; ‘f(laming) fire’ jvAlAgniH. [Flam]y, a. SiKA-jvAlA-maya (yI f.), SiKin.

FLAME (subs.): SiKA, as if coming out in f. s: SiKABirviniScaran, Vi. v. 26.; (2) jvAlA, with hairy f.s.: jvAlAsawEH, Ki. xvi. 50.;(3) arcisa [Page282] (f.), with circles of fiery f. s.: aruRErarcizAM cakravAlEH, Vi. vi. 4.
FLAME (v.): I Intrans: jvalati (jval, c. 1.): v. To burn.II Trans.: v. To inflame.

FLAME , s. SiKA, agniSiKA, arcciH f. (s), arcciH f., jvAlaH -lA, agnijvAlA, jvalaH -lakA, jvAlAgniH m., agnijihvA, SiKiSiKA, kIlaH -lA, agnikIlaH, hetiH f., ulkA, tejaH n. (s); ‘in flames,’ jvalan -lantI -lat (t), jyotissAt.
To FLAME , v. a. jval in caus. (jvAlayati, jvalayati -yituM), prajval, samprajval.
To FLAME , v. n. jval (c. 1. jvalati -lituM), prajval, ujjval, samprajval, jval in freq. (jAjvalyate), dIp (c. 4. dIpyate -pituM), pradIp, AdIp.
FLAME-COLOURED , a. agnivarRaH -rRA -rRaM, vahnivarRaH -rRA -rRaM, pItaH -tA -taM.

FLAMING , part. and a. jvalan -lantI -lat (t), jvalayan -yantI -yat (t), jvalaH -lA -laM, jvalI -linI -li (n), jvAlI &c., jvAlaH -lI -laM, jvalitaH -tA -taM, ujjvalaH -lA -laM, jAjvalyamAnaH -nA -naM, prajvalitaH -tA -taM, ucCiKaH -KA -KaM, pradIptaH -ptA -ptaM, arccizmAn -zmatI -zmat (t).
Flamingo, s. marAlaH, rAjahaMsaH.
FLAMINGO: pakziviSezaH; *SoRacCadaH, marAlaH (??).
FLAMINGO , s. rAjahaMsaH, haMsakaH, raktapakzaH, agnivarRaH pakziBedaH.
FLAMINGO , s. marAlaH. FLIGHT, (Of arrow) SarAyaRaM, vAtarAyaRaM.
FLAMY: (1) SiKAvat (f. tI);(2) SiKin (f. nI);(3) jvAlAmayaH (yI, yaM).
FLAMY , a. SiKI -KinI -Ki (n), SiKAvalaH -lA -laM, AgneyaH -yI -yaM.
Flank, s. pArSvaH-rSvaM, pakzaH, kukziH, utsaMgaH, pArSva-pakza-BAgaH, pArSvaMgaM. v. pArSvataH rakz or gup 1 P. 2 pArSvataH aBidru 1 P. 3 spfS 6 P, nikawe-pArSve-vft 1 A; See Border.
FLANK (subs.): pASrva (mn.) or pArSvadeSaH, in front, on the rear, and on the f. s.: agre pfzWe ca pArSvayoH, A. r.; (the horse) as if painted on the f. s: ulliKitamiva pArSvayoH, K.
FLANK (v.): I To border, touch: q.v.II To attack the f.: pArSvaM hanti, aBi-, (han, c. 2.), Ka.III To guard the f.: pArSve or pArSvayoH rakzati (rakz, c. 1.).
FLANK , s. pArSvaH -rSvaM, pArSvaBAgaH, pArSvANgaM, pakzaH, pakzaBAgaH, utsaNgaH, kukziH m., aNkaH, kolaH, kftsnaM, taH; ‘of a horse,’ kaSyaM; ‘on the flank,’ pArSvatas.

To FLANK , v. a. and n. (Attack the flank) pArSvaM or pASveBAgam Akram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM). — (Guard on the flank) pArSvato rakz (c. 1. rakzati -kzituM) (Border, be posted on the side) pArSvataH or nikawe or pArSvaBAge sTA (c. 1. tizWati sTAtuM) or vft (c. 1. varttate -rttituM), spfS (c. 6. spfSati, sprazwuM).
Flannel, s. urRAyuH, OrRapawaM.
FLANNEL: *prARalam, F. led: *prARalavastrAvftaH (tA, taM).
FLANNEL , s. kambalaH, UrRAyuH m., OrRapawaH, OraBraM, UrRAnirmmitaM or meza- lomamayaM viralavastraM, sahasraroma n. (n), sASUkaH, kutapaH.

Flap, v. t. vi-DU 5 U, 9 U, 6 P, utkzip 6 P, cal c., A-sPal c. v. i. AsPal 1 P, viDU-utkzip- pass. s. prAlaMbaH, lolakaH. 2 (‘f(lapp)ing’) AsPAlanaM, viDUnanaM, viDuvanaM, u-tkzepaH-paRaM; ‘f(lapp)ing of ears’ karRatAlaH.
FLAP (subs.): I Anything that hangs loose: prAlambaH (?).II F. -ping;(1) DUnanam, vi-;(2) AsPAlanam.III In pl. aSvAnAmozWarogaBedaH.
FLAP (v.t.): I To strike: q.v.: tAqayati (taq, c. 10.).II To shake:(1) DUnAti or DUnIte (DU, c. 9.);(2) AsPAlayati (c. of sPal).
FLAP , s. (Any thing that hangs loose) lambikA, lolA, lolakaH, lambamAnavastu n., pralambavastu, pralambitaM. — (The motion of it) AsPAlaH -lanaM -litaM.
To FLAP , v. a. (The wings) pakzO sPal in caus. (sPAlayati -yituM) or AsPal or cal in caus. (cAlayati -yituM) or utkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM).
To FLAP , v. n. AsPAlitaM kf, AsPal (c. 1. -sPalati -lituM), JalaYJalA (nom. JalaYJalAyate).
FLAPPED , p. p. AsPAlitaH -tA -taM, cAlitaH -tA -taM, lolitaH -tA -taM.
FLAPPING , s. (Of wings) AsPAlanaM, pakzAsPAlanaM, pakzasPAlanaM, pakzo- -tkzepaH, JalaYJalA. — (Of ears) karRatAlaH.
Flare, v. i. lolaSiKayA jval 1 P. s. lola-SiKA, kaMpitajvAlA.
FLARE (subs.): (1) lolaSiKA;(2) cAYcalyapraBA, and sim. comp.s.
To FLARE , v. n. caYcalaSiKayA or sacaYcalaSiKaM or caYcalarUpeRa jval (c. 1. jvalati -lituM) or ujjval or jval in freq. (jAjvalyate).
FLARE , s. caYcalaSiKA, caYcalajvAlaH, kampitajvAlA, sPuradyutiH f.
FLARING , a. caYcalaSiKayA jAjvalyamAnaH -nA -naM or ujjvalaH -lA -laM.
FLARINGLY: (1) lolam;(2) caYcalam;(3) by adj. na stimitaH (tA, taM).

Flash, v. i. sPur 6 P, dIp 4 A, vi-las 1 P, vidyut 1 A, sahasA prakAS 1 A or jval 1 P, aciraM pra-BA 2 P. 2 vidyudvegena-akasmAd-udi 2 P or AvirBU 1 P or utpad 4 A. s. sPuraRaM, sPuritaM, vilAsaH, sahasA dIpti f., ABAsaH, viBramaH, acira-kzaRa-praBA, praBAkaMpaH, kzaRadyuti f., aciradyutiH. [Flash]y, a. kzaRapraBa, tEjasa (sI f.). 2 asAra, nIrasa, Palgu, niHsattva.
FLASH (subs.): (1) sPuritam, terrified with f. es of wreathy lightning: vidyuddAmasPuritacakitaH (tA, taM), Me. i. 28.;(2) sPuraRam.
FLASH (v.i.): sPurati (sPur, c. 6.) (lit. and fig.), they are f. ing with rage: sPuritamanayoH kroDena, U. v.

FLASH , s. jvAlA, sPuritaM, sPuraRaM, dyutisPuraRaM, praBAkampaH, akasmAtsPuraRaM, akasmAddIptiH f., kzaRapraBA, kzaRadyutiH f., acirapraBA, aciradyutiH f. — (Of lightning) vidyutsPuraRaM, sOdAminIsPuraRaM, vidyutprakASaH, vidyutkampaH, vidyuddAma n. (n), meGajyotiH n. (s), vidyujjvAlA, irammadaH.

To FLASH , v. n. sPur (c. 6. sPurati -rituM), vidyut (c. 1. -dyotate -tituM), akasmAt prakAS (c. 1. -kASate -SituM) or jval (c. 1. jvalati -lituM) or ujjval or prajval, vidyudvat kamp (c. 1. kampate -mpituM).

FLASHING , a. or part. sPuran -rantI -rat (t), sPuritaH -tA -taM, vidyota- [Page275-a+ 51] mAnaH -nA -naM, dyotamAnaH -nA -naM, kampamAnaH -nA -naM, kampitapraBaH -BA -BaM, kzaRaprakASan -SantI -Sat (t).
FLASHY: I Lit.: kzaRapraBa (f. BA) and sim. comp.s.II Insipid: nIrasaH (sA, saM).
FLASHY , a. kzaRamAtradyotI -tinI -ti (n), miTyAdyotI &c., miTyAtEjasaH -sI -saM, miTyAtejomayaH -yI -yaM. — (Unsubstantial) asAraH -rA -raM, nissattvaH -ttvA -ttvaM.
Flask, s. kAcapAtraM-BAjanaM, pAnapAtraM, puwagrIvaH.
FLASK: (1) BARqam (gen. term.);(2) mahAkUpI (?).
FLASK , s. kUpI, puwagrIvaH, kAcapAtraM, kAcaBAjanaM; ‘of wine,’ madyaBAjanaM.
FLASKET: I For viands: annapAtram (?).II A basket: q.v.
FLASKET , s. annaBAjanaM, annapAtraM, KAdyadravyaBAjanaM.

Flat, a. sama, samasTa, samareKa, sapAwa, aBugna. 2 nimna, anucca, nata, anunnata. 3 asAra, nIrasa, Palgu, virasa, rasa-svAda-hIna, niste-jas, niHsattva. 4 spazwa, sPuwa, vyakta, avakra, asaMdigDa, suvyakta, parisPuwa. 5 avaniM gata, daMqavat kzipta; ‘he laid himself f(lat) on the ground’ BUmO daMqavatpatitaH; ‘f(lat) surface’ samapfzWaM; ‘f(lat) roof’ pfzWaM; ‘f(lat)-nosed’ ava nAwa, avawIwa, avaBrawa, nata-cipiwa-nAsika. s. samaBUmi f., samasTalaM-lI, samasTAnaM, pAwaH. 2 nimnaBUmiH. 3 sEkataM, pulinaM. 4 patraM, PalakaH-kaM. 5 maMdaH, anudAttaH, maMdraH. [Flat]ly, adv. samaM. 2 sPuwaM, suvyaktaM, avakraM, asaMdehaM. [Flat]ness, s. samatA, nimnatA, asAratvaM, &c. [Flat]ten, v. t. samIkf 8 U. 2 A-ava-nam c. (namayati), namrIkf, nimnIkf. 3 rasaM hf 1 P, nIrasIkf. v. i. samIBU, namrIBU.

FLAT (adj.): I Plain, level: samaH (mA, maM), to lay f.: samIkaroti, Ku. or fig. pAtayati (c. of pat) (= to fell), V. p.II Dull, insipid: nIrasaH (sA, saM).III Positive, clear: sPuwaH (wA, waM), “that is f.”: sPuwametat.IV Of letters: Gozavat (f. tI), T. p. i. 14. V. Of nose, etc.: sTUlaH (lA, laM).
FLAT (subs.): I Lit.: samaBUmiH.II A shallow: q.v.III A boat:(1) tarAlu;(2) tarAnDu.IV A car: yAnaviSezaH.V A dull fellow: sTUla- budDi (mfn.), K.VI Story: q.v.VII A f. part: perh. pfzWam.
FLAT (v.): I Lit.: samIkaroti.II To depress: q.v.

FLAT , a. (Even) samaH -mA -maM, samAnaH -nA -naM, samasTaH -sTA -sTaM, sapAwaH -wA -waM, samareKaH -KA -KaM, nirBugnaH -gnA -gnaM, aBugnaH -gnA -gnaM. — (Not elevated) anuccaH -ccA -ccaM, anunnataH -tA -taM, nimnaH -mnA -mnaM, nataH -tA -taM. — (Prostrate, lying flat) daRqavatyatitaH -tA -taM, BUmO kziptadehaH -hA -haM, avaniNgataH -tA -taM. — (Vapid, tasteless) virasaH -sA -saM, nIrasaH -sA -saM, arasikaH -kA -kaM, PalguH -lguH -lgu, asAraH -rA -raM, nissAraH -rA -raM, alavaRaH -RA -RaM, sArahInaH -nA -naM, lavaRa- hInaH -nA -naM, nistejAH -jAH -jaH (s), tejohInaH -nA -naM, klIvaH -vA -vaM, niHsvAduH -duH -du, visvAdaH -dA -daM. — (Plain) avakraH -krA -kraM; ‘flat roof,’ pfzWaM; ‘flat surface,’ samapfzWaM, samatalaM.

FLAT , s. (A plain) samaBUmiH f., samasTalaM -lI, samaBUBAgaH, samasTAnaM, AjiH f., pAwaH, samaM. — (Low ground) nimnaBUmiH f. — (Snoal) sEkataM. — (Of a sword, &c.) PalakaH -kaM, patraM. — (In music) anudAttaH, mandaH, mandraH, udAttetaraH SabdaH. — (Flat-bottomed boat) tarAluH m., tarAnDuH m. — (Stupid fellow) mandabudDiH m., sTUlaDIH m.
To FLAT , v. a. samIkf, samAnIkf, samasTalIkf, nimnIkf.
FLAT-BOTTOMED , a. samatalaH -lA -laM, samADoBAgaH -gA -gaM, samADaHsTAnaH -nA -naM.
FLAT-NOSED , a. natanAsikaH -kA -kaM, avanAwaH -wA -waM, avawIwaH -wA -waM, avaBrawaH -wA -waM, KuraRasaH -sA -saM or -RAH -RAH -RaH (s).
FLATLY I Evenly: samam.II Openly: sPuwam.
FLATLY , adv. samaM, samAnatas. — (Plainly) avakraM, suvyaktaM.
FLATNESS: I Lit.: samatA.II Of nose, etc.: sTUlatA.III Dejection: q.v.: vizAdaH.IV Insipidity: nIrasatA.

FLATNESS , s. (Evenness) samatA, sAmyaM, samAnatA -tvaM, sAmyatA, pAwaH, nirBugnatA, aBugnatA. — (Want of elevation) anuccatA, anunnatiH f., nimnatA, natatvaM. — (Insipidity, dulness) arasikatvaM, ArasyaM, PalgutA, asAratA, niHsvAdutA, alAvaRyaM, AlavaRyaM, atejaH n. (s), tejohInatA.
FLATTEN: I Lit.: samIkaroti.II To fell: q.v.: pAtayati (c. of pat).III To deject, depress: q.v.IV To make vapid: nIrasIkaroti.

To FLATTEN , v. a. samIkf, samAnIkf, samasTalIkf, nimnIkf, vAmanIkf. — (Depress) avanam in caus. (-nAmayati -namayati -yituM), namrIkf. — (Lay flat) daRqavat pat in caus. (pAtayati -yituM). — (Make vapid) rasaM hf (c. 1. harati, harttuM), PalgUkf, virasIkf.
To FLATTEN , v. n. samIBU, nimnIBU, avanatIBU, namrIBU, virasIBU.
FLATTENED , p. p. avanAmitaH -tA -taM, nimIkutaH -tA -taM, namnIkftaH -tA -taM.
FLATTENING , s. avanAmaH, nimnIkaraRaM, namnIkaraRaM, samIkaraRaM.

Flatter, v. t. saM-aBi-pari-stu 2 U, pra-SaMs 1 P, cAwuvacanEH-stutyA-sAMtv 10 or saMtuz c. or upa-lal 10 or pra-luB c. or Akfz 1 P, upacCaMd 10. 2 cAwUni vac-brU- 2 P, priyaM vad 1 P. 3 anu-nI 1 P, A-rAD c., miTyA praSaMs SlAG 1 A. 4 miTyA ASAM utpad c. or vfD c. [Flatter]er, s. cAwukAraH, saMstAvakaH, sAMtvavAdin m., praSaMsakaH, priyaMvadaH, cAwuvAdin m., miTyASaMsakaH. [Flatter]ing, a. stutimaya (yI f.), paritozaka, prItikara (rI f.), praSaMsAmaya. [Flatter]ingly, adv. cAwUktyA, atipraSaMsApUrvaM, sAMtvanapUrvaM. [Flatter]y, s. saMstAvaH, stuti f., stavaH, cAwu m. n., cAwUkti f., atipraSaMsA, sAMtvanaM-nA, upalAlanaM, maDura-priya-vacanaM, sAMtvavAdaH, miTyApraSaMsA, vyAjastutiH, cAwuvAdaH. 2 anunayaH, ArADanaM, saMtozaRaM.

FLATTER: I Lit.:(1) stOti, saM-, aBi-, pari-, (stu, c. 2.), who day and night f. s (him) as super-divine: yo'harniSamaDidEvatamiva stOti, K.: v. To praise;(2) by subs., to f. one's vanity: cAwUktiBirmAnaM varDayati (c. of vfD).II To gra- -tify, please: q.v.: saM-tozayati (c. of tuz).
FLATTER , s. avanAmakaH, samakaraRayantraM, mudgaraviSezaH.

To FLATTER , v. a. (Soothe by praise, &c.) sAntv or SAntv (c. 10. sAntvayati -yituM), pariSAntv, aBiSAntv, atipraSaMsayA or stutivAkyEH or cAwUktyA or maDurErvacoBiH sAntv or praluB (c. 10. -loBayati -yituM) or santuz (c. 10. -tozayati -yituM) or lal (c. 10. lAlayati -yituM). — (Speak what is agreeable) priyaM or priyARi or cAwuvAkyAni vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM). — (Praise falsely) miTyA praSaMs (c. 1. -SaMsati -situM) or SlAG (c. 1. SlAGate -GituM). — (Gratify) ArAD (c. 10. -rADayati -yituM), pramud (c. 10. -modayati -yituM), saBAj (c. 10. saBAja- yati -yituM). — (Raise false hopes) miTyA ASAvfdDiM kf.
FLATTERED , p. p. praSaMsitaH -tA -taM, miTyApraSastaH -stA -staM, lAlitaH -tA -taM, kftasAntvanaH -nA -naM, cAwUktyArADitaH -tA -taM, saBAjitaH -tA -taM, ASvAsitaH -tA -taM.
FLATTERER: (1) stotf (m.), saM-.: v. Praiser.; (2) cAwukAraH;(3) saMstavavaktf (m.), Mah. ii. 44. 6.

FLATTERER , s. praSaMsakaH, priyavAdI m. (n), priyaMvadaH, cAwuvAdI m. sAntvavAdaH, sAntvanakArI m. (n), cAwukAraH, lAlI m. (n), miTyA- praSaMsakaH, SaMstA m. (stf), kapawapraSaMsAkft m., miTyASvAsakaH, ASvAsa- -naSIlaH, kApawikaH.
FLATTERING (adj.): (1) prItivardDanaH (nI, naM) (= gratifying);(2) SoBanaH (nA, naM) (=fine); (3) by subs.
FLATTERING , a. paritozakaH -kA -kaM, santozaRaH -RA -RaM, sAntvanaH -nA -naM, stutimayaH -yI -yaM, praSaMsAkaraH -rI -raM, prItikaraH -rA -raM, ASvAsakaH -kA -kaM
FLATTERINGLY , adv. atipraSaMsayA, cAwUktyA, atiSayastutyA, sAntvanapUrvvaM.
FLATTERY: (1) stavaH, saM- (= praise: q.v.), with false f.: vitaTEH stavEH, Si. xiv. 3.;(2) cAwuH or cAwUktiH.

FLATTERY , s. atipraSaMsA -sanaM, miTyApraSaMsA -sanaM, sAntvaH -tvaM -tvanaM -nA, sAntvavAkyaM, sAntvoktiH f., sAntvakAraH, cAwUktiH f., cAwukAraH, -cAwuH m., -wu n., lAlanaM, priyavAkyaM, maDuravAkyaM, maDuravacaH n. (s), komalavAkyaM, komalatvaM, ASvAsanaM, AlokaH, AlokaSabdaH, anunayaH, ArADanaM.
FLATTING: I The act.: samIkaraRam.II A mode of painting: samIkaraRam (?).
FLATTISH , a. IzatsamaH -mA -maM; IzatsamAnaH -nA -naM, IzannimnaH -mnA -mnaM.

FLOORING , s. PalakAstaraRaM, PalakastaraH, PalakastarimA m. (n), parisrastaraH
Flop, v. t. A-sPal c.
To FLOP , v. a. AsPowanaSabdena saq (c. 10. tAqayati -yituM), AsPal (c. 10. -sPAlayati -yituM).
Flora, s. ozaDijAtaM.
FLORA: I The goddess of flowers: nandana- vanadevatA (?), K.II A list of plants: f. of Bengal: vaNgAnAM puzpAvaliH or latAkozaH (?).
FLORA , s. (The goddess) sItA, puzpadevatA. — (Catalogue of plants) ozaDiparisaMKyA.
Floral, a. kOsuma (mI f.), puzpa in comp.
FLORAL: (1) by comp.;(2) pOzpa (f. zpI); (3) kOsuma (f. mI).
FLORAL , a. pOzpaH -zpI -zpaM -zpikaH -kI -kaM, kOsumaH -mI -maM, sOmanasaH -sI -saM.
Florid, a. rakta, rakta-aruRa-varRa. 2 alaMkfta, ujjvala, alaMkAraSoBita, sAlaMkAra. [Florid]ity, [Florid]ness, s. (kapola)-rAgaH, aruRiman-raktiman m. 2 vAgalaMkAraH, sAlaMkAratvaM, alaMkAraSoBA.
FLORID: I Red: q.v.: rakta (f. ktA).II Ornate: perh. puzpitaH (tA, taM);(2) alaNkftaH (tA, taM);(3) vicitraH (trA, traM);(4) ujjvalaH (lA, laM).

FLORID , a. (In colour or complexion) raktavarRaH -rRA -rRaM, aruRavarRaH -rRA -rRaM, puzpavarRaH -rRA -rRaM. — (As style) puzpitaH -tA -taM, alaNkftaH -tA -taM, vAgalaNkAramayaH -yI -yaM, vyaYjanAmayaH -yI -yaM, SoBitaH -tA -taM.
FLORIDITY: FLORIDNESS: I Redness: raktatA. II Of style:(1) Ojjvalyam;(2) alaNkAraH.
FLORIDITY , FLORIDNESS, s. (Of complexion) kapolarAgaH, vadanaraktatA, muKAruRimA m. (n). — (Of style) alaNkAraH, sAlaNkAratvaM, vAgalaNkAraH, vAgalaNkriyA, vAkSoBA.
Floriferous, a. puzpotpAdaka, puzpaprada.
FLORIFEROUS , a. puzpotpAdakaH -kA -kaM, puzpajanakaH -kA -kaM, puzpadaH -dA -daM.
Florilege, s. puzpacayaH-saMgaH.
FLORILEGIUM , s. puzpacayaH, puzpAvacayaH, puzpapracAyaH, kusumAvacayaH.
FLORIN: mudrAviSezaH, *puzpakam.
FLORIN , s. videSIyamudrAviSezaH, rUpyamudrAviSezaH.
Florist, s. mAlAkAraH, puzpavidyAjYaH.
FLORIST: I Lit.: puzpopajIvin (f. nI), Ram. II Writer of a flora: *puzpAvali- or latAkoza- racayitf (f. trI).
FLORIST , s. puzpAdividyAjYaH, puzpalAvaH, ozaDividyAjYaH, mAlAkAraH, mAlikaH, mAlI m. (n).
FLOTA: potAvaliH. Flotilla: kzudrapotAvaliH.
FLOTA , vfhannOkAsamUhaH, mahAbARijyanOkAsamUhaH
FLOTATION: I The act: plavanam.II The science: plavanam, -JAnam.
Flotilla, s. laGunOsamUhaH.
FLOTILLA , s. kzudranOkAsamUhaH, kzudranOkAsaNgrahaH.
Flounce, v. i. aMgAni vikzip 6 P or itasta-taH cal c. s. AkasmikaH aMgavikzepaH.
FLOUNCE (v.): aNgAni vikzipati (kzip, c. 6.) or saMcAlayati (c. of cal).
FLOUNCE (subs.): aNgavikzepaH (?); aNgacAlanam (?).
To FLOUNCE , v. n. samBramopahatatvAt or saMramBAvizwatvAt SarIrANgAni or SarIram itastataH kzip (c. 6. kzipati, kzeptuM) or vikzip or cal in caus. (cAlayati -yituM) or vical.

FLOUNCE , s. (Sudden jerk of the body) akasmAd aNgavikzepaH or SarIravikzepaH. — (A piece of cloth sewed round a gown with the lower border loose) strIveSaparitaH syUtaH SiTilADoBAgo vastraKaRqaH, strIveSopari SoBArTam aDikavastravinyAsaH.
FLOUNCED , p. p. aDikavastrapaMktiSoBitaH -tA -taM, veSoparisTapawapaMktiSoBitaH -tA -taM.

sanskrit.slp1: yaTA vAjI paNke taTA pAdAdivikzepeRa luW

details.body: Flounder, v. i. itastataH kzip pass., luW 1 A, 6 P, vi-plu 1 A. 2 vi-pari-Bram 1, 4 P.
FLOUNDER: I Verb: v. To flounce.II Subs.: matsyaviSezaH.
FLOUNDER , s. samudrajaH kzudramatsyaBedaH.
To FLOUNDER , v. n. yaTA vAjI paNke taTA pAdAdivikzepeRa luW (c. 6. luWati -WituM), paNkapatitavad nirgamecCayA SarIrANgAni itastataH kzip (c. 6. kzipati, kzeptuM), viplu (c. 1. -plavate -plotuM).
Flour, s. goDUmacUrRaM, cUrRaM, kzodaH, pizwaM, guMqikA, saktavaH (pl.).
FLOUR: I Of wheat:(1) goDUmacUrRam;(2) goDUmapizwam, Raj.II Of other grains: by cUrRaM or pizwam, barllybarley f.: yavacUrRam. Fried-grain-f.: SaktuH.
FLOUR , s. SaktuH m., goDUmacUrRaM, goDUmakzodaH, cUrRaM, kzodaH, apUppaH, pizwaM, guRqikaH -kA, samIdaH, samitA.
FLOUR , s. DAnyacUrRaM. To FLOW, dru (c. 1. dravati, drotuM).

Flourish, v. i. saM-jan 4 A, saM-BU 1 P; ‘when Panini f(lourish)ed’ yadA pARiniH samajAyata. 2 vfdDiM-unnatiM-gam 1 P, saM-FDsaM-fD 4, 5 P, eD 1 A, saM-vi-vfD 1 A, pra-upa-ci pass., sPAy 1 A. v. t. vfD c. 2 citr 10, puzpAdinA alaMkf 8 U or SuB c. or raMj c. 3 Bram c. (Bramayati), GUrR c. s. AqaMbaraH, SoBA, alaMkAraH, maMqanaM. 2 niH-, svanaH (of trumpets). 3 darpavAkyaM, garvokti f. 4 BramaRaM, udgamaH. [Flourish]ing, a. samfdDa, susTita, susTa, varDizRu, udayin, upacIya-mAna.
FLOURISH (subs.): I Show: AqambaraH, with great f.: bahvAqambarapUrvakam.II Of language: ati- SayoktiH.III Brandishing: AsPAlanam.
FLOURISH (v.i.): I To thrive: varDate (c. of vfD).II To decorate: q.v.: atiSayoktiM karoti.III To brandish: q.v.
FLOURISH (v.t.): I To thrive: varDayati (c. of vfD).II To decorate: q.v.: alaNkaroti.III To brandish: q.v.

To FLOURISH , v. n. (Thrive) fD (c. 5. fGnoti, c. 4. fDyati, arDituM), samfD, eD (c. 1. eDate -DituM), sameD, vfD (c. 1. varDate -rDituM), vivfDa, saMvfD, samfdDIBU. — (Use lofty language) garvvitavAkyam ASri (c. 1. -Srayati -yituM).

To FLOURISH , v. a. (Embellish with flowers, &c.) puzpAdyalaNkAreRa SuB (c. 10. SoBayati -yituM) or raYj (c. 10. raYjayati -yituM), alaNkf, samalaNkf, citr (c. 10. citrayati -yituM). — (Brandish) Bram in caus. (Bramayati, BrAmayati -yituM), udBram.
FLOURISH , s. (Show, embellishment) SoBA, alaNkAraH, alaNkriyA, raYjanaM. — (Lofty language) garvvitavAkyaM, darpavAkyaM. — (Brandishing) BrAntiH f., udBramaH, uqBrAntiH f.
FLOURISHED , p. p. (Embellished) alaNkftaH -tA -taM. — (Brandished) [Page278-b+ 51] udBrAntaH -ntA -ntaM.
FLOURISHING (adj.): (1) samfdDa (f. dDA) (= affl- -uent);(2) utkfzwa (f. zwA) (= excellent).
FLOURISHING , a. samfdDaH -dDA -dDaM, varDamAnaH -nA -naM, vardDizRuH -zRuH -zRu, aDikardDiH -rdDiH -rdDi, udayI -yinI -yi (n), SuBAnvitaH -tA -taM, susTaH -sTA -sTaM.
FLOUT: I Verb: avahasati (has, c. 1.) (with acc.)II Subs.; avahAsaH.
To FLOUT , v. a. avahas (c. 1. -hasati -situM), avakzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM), garh (c. 1. garhate -rhituM), avajYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -jYAtuM), tiraskf, muKarIkf.
FLOUTED , p. p. avajYAtaH -tA -taM, muKarIkftaH -tA -taM, garhitaH -tA -taM.

Flow, v. i. pra-, sru 1 P; pra-ni-aBi-syaMd 1 A, kzar 1 P, gal 1 P, sf 1 P; pravah 1 P, rI 4 A, dru 1 P; ‘f(low)ing with tears’ bAzpa-jalanisyaMdin; ‘f(low)ing with nectar’ su-DAsyaMdin, amftasrut; pra-, snu 2 P; ‘f(low)ing (of milk)’ prasravaH. 2 pra-sfp 1 P, pra-sf, pravft 1 A, pra-gam-cal 1 P, pra-yA 2 P. 3 jan 4 A, utpad 4 A, ut-pra-saM-BU 1 P, pra-vft. 4 sraMs 1 A, SiTilIBU, SlaTa-vitata-ga-lita a. BU. s. sravaH, sravaRaM, sruti f., srAvaH, kzaraRaM, galanaM, pravftti f., aBi-ni-syaM(zyaM)-daH-danaM. 2 pravAhaH, srotas n., oGaH, prasravaH, vegaH, rayaH, DAraH-rA; velA, padDati f. 3 samudra-velA, velA; ‘f(low) of tears’ aSrupAtaH-pravAhaH, bAzpavarzaH, DArASru n.; ‘f(low) of words’ vA-goGaH, apratihatA vAksaraRiH-padDatiH. [Flow]ing, a. prasruta, syaMdin, visArin, sravat. 2 apra-tihata, asKalita; ‘a f(lowing) delivery’ asKa-litaBAzaRapadDatiH. [Flow]ingly, adv. asKalita-vAkyena, apratihataM, drutaM, avilaMbitaM.

FLOW (subs.): I A pouring:(1) sravaH, sravaRam or srutiH, pari-, f. of eye-drops: aSrubindusrutiH, N. ix. 104;(2) syandaH, -nam, ni-, aBi-, emission of the f. of heaven: svargABizyandavamanam, Ku. vi. 37.;(3) pravAhaH (= stream): q.v.).II Of tide: varDamAnA velA: v. Tide.

FLOW (v.i.): I In gen.:(1) sravati, pra-, pari-, (sru, c. 1.) (best equiv.), rivers like the Ganges f. towards the east: nadyo gaNgAdyAH pUrvAM diSaM prati sravanti, S.c.; honey- f. ing: maDusravaH (vA, vaM), N.; (2) syandati, pra-, aBi-, ni-, (syand, c. 1.), as if the place from which the quarters f.: nizyandamiva diSAm, K.;(3) pravartate (vft, c. 1.) (= to pro- -ceed: of language), Ki.II Of the tide: v. Tide.III To melt: q.v.IV To hang loose: lambate, pra-, (lamb, c. 1.).

To FLOW , v. n. (Run as water) sru (c. 1. sravati, srotuM), prasru, parisru, spand (c. 1. syandate -ndituM), prasyand, sf (c. 1. sarati, sarttuM), prasf, saMsf, kzar (c. 1. kzarati -rituM), rI (c. 4. rIyate, retuM), gal (c. 1. galati -lituM), jalaM pravah (c. 1. -vahati -voQuM), payas (nom. payasyati). — (Glide along) pramfp (c. 1. -sarpati -sraptuM), visfp, saMsfp, sfp, visf, prasf. — (As the tide) velAvat prasru, velA (nom. velAyate). — (Pro- -ceed) pravft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM), pramf, pragam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM), prayA (c. 2. -yAti -tuM), pracal (c. 1. -calati -lituM). — (Arise from) utpad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM), jan (c. 4. jAyate, janituM), praBU, pravft. — (Hang loose, as hair, &c.) vigalitaH -tA -taM, BU, pravitataH -tA -taM BU, praSlaTaH -TA -TaM BU, visraMs (c. 1. -sraMsate -situM), SiTilIBU.

FLOW , s. (Stream, course) sravaH -vaRaM, pravAhaH, srotaH n. (s), prasravaH, prasravaRaM, prasrAvaH, srAvaH, saMsftiH f., pravfttiH f., jalavAhanaM, syandaH -ndanaM, nisyandaH, aBizyandaH, galanaM, gAlaH, kzaraRaM, udakpravAhaH. — (Current) velA, vegaH, rayaH, DAraH -rA, oGaH, pAtrasaMskAraH, ambupadDatiH f., pAtra- -JaNkAraH, rAyaBAwI, UrmmI. — (Tide) velA, samudravelA, samudrarayaH. — (Flow of words) vAksaraRiH f., vAkcApalyaM; ‘flow of tears, aSrupAtaH, aSrupravAhaH, DArASru n.; ‘flow of blood,’ amfkpAtaH, asfgDArA.

Flower, s. puzpaM, kusumaM, prasUnaM, sumaM, sUnaM, sumanas f. (pl.). 2 avataMsaH, lalAmaBUtaH, alaMkAraH, tilakaBUtaH; ‘Rāma is the f(lower) of his class’ svavargalalAmaBUto rAmaH. 2 sAraH, utkfzwa-SrezWa-BAgaH, uttamAMSaH, sArAMSaH; ‘f(lower) of age’ yOvana; ‘f(lower) of youth’ navayOvanaM; ‘being in the f(lower) of youth’ ArUQayO-vanAraMBa, prOQayOvana. v. t. Pull 1 P, vikas 1 P, sPuw 6 P, Bid pass. 2 maMqAyate-PenAyate (D.). v. t. puzpAdinA alaMkf 8 U or SuB c. [Flower]ed, a. kusumita, puzpita, kusuma-sanATa. 2 vikasita, Pulla, sPuwita. [Flower]ing, a. puzpavat, kusumavat, kusumita, praPulla, sPuwita-puzpa. 2 puzpada. [Flower]less, a. akusuma, kusuma-hIna [Flower]y, a. puzpa-kusuma-maya (yI f.), sa-puzpa, sakusuma, puzpaSAlin; gen. ex. by (s.) in comp.; ‘f(lowery) arrows’ kusumaSarAH. 2 sAlaMkAra, alaMkfta, alaMkArayukta, maMqita.

FLOWER (subs.): I In gen. sense:(1) puzpam, the stars, the f.s of heaven: tArAH KapuzpARi, N.; (2) kusumam, f. -bed: kusumAstaraRam, Ku.;(3) prasUnaM or prasavaH (rare), coming out of f.s: prasUnasyAgamaH, U. In f.: kusumitaH (tA, taM) or puzpitaH (tA, taM), Mah. II Best part: sAramAgaH. F. of life: prOQayOvanam (?).III Menstrual discharge: puzpam.
FLOWER (v.): expr. by subs., ever f. ing: nitya- puzpa (f. zpA), Me. v. Also to blossom.

FLOWER , s. puzpaM, kusumaM, sumanAH m. -naH n. -nasaH f. pl. (s), PullaM, prasavaH, prasUnaM, prasUtaM, sUnaM. ‘flower-gathering,’ puzpacayaH, puzpAvacayaH, puzpapracayaH, puzpapracAyaH, kusumAvacayaH; ‘flower-gatherer,’ puzpacAyI m. (n), puzpAvacAyI m. (n), puzpalAvaH; ‘flower-seller,’ puzpAjIvI m. (n), mAlAkAraH, mAlikaH. — (Prime, best part) sAraH, uttamaBAgaH, SrezWaBAgaH; ‘flower of age,’ yOvanAvasTA; ‘flower of youth,’ yOvanaprOQiH f., navayOvanaM, akzatayOvanaM; ‘of corn,’ DAnyasya KAdyaBAgaH; ‘in the flower of youth,’ prOQayOvanaH -nA -naM. — (Catamenia) pazpaM, kumumaM.

To FLOWER , v. n. (Blossom) puzp (c. 4. puzpyati, puzpituM), kusuma (nom. kusumayati -yituM), Pull (c. 1. Pullati -llituM), sPuw (c. 6. sPuwati -wituM, c. 1. sPowate -wituM), vikas (c. 1. -kasati -situM). — (Be in the prime) prOQayOvanaH -nA -naM BU. — (Froth) Pena (nom. PenAyate) maRqa (nom. maRqAyate).
To FLOWER , v. a. puzpAdyalaNkAreRa SuB (c. 10. SoBayati -yituM).
FLOWER-ARMED , a. (The Hindu Cupid) kusumAyuDaH, kusumezuH m., puzpAstraH, puzpacApaH.
FLOWER-DE-LUCE or FLOWER-DE-LIS, s. utpalaBedaH, padmaviSezaH.
FLOWER-GARDEN , s. puzpodyAnaM, kusumodyAnaM, puzpavAwI -wikA, udyAnaM, kumumAkaraH.
FLOWER-STALK: (1) maYjarI;(2) puzpavfntam;(3) prasavabanDanam (poet).
FLOWER-STALK , s. maYjarI, puzpavfntaM, prasavabanDanaM.
FLOWERED , p. p. or a. puzpitaH -tA -taM, kumumitaH -tA -taM, vikasitaH -tA -taM, PullaH -llA -llaM. — (Embellished with flowers) puzpAdyalaNkA- -raSoBitaH -tA -taM.
FLOWERET: kzudrapuzpam; prasUnam
FLOWERET , s. puzpakaH -kaM, kzudrapuzpaM, kzudrakusumaM.

FLOWERING , a. PullavAn -vatI -vat (t), praPullaH -llA -llaM, puzpI -zpiRI -zpi (n), puppavAn -vatI -vat (t), puzpitaH -tA -taM, kusumitaH -tA -taM, kusumavAn -vatI -vat (t), sPuwitapuzpaH -zpA -zpaM, vikAsI -sinI -si [Page279-a+ 51] (n), puzpadaH -dA -daM.
FLOWERLESS: (1) apuzpa (f. zpA);(2) kusumahInaH (nA, naM); and sim. comp.
FLOWERLESS , a. apuzpaH -zpA -zpaM, apuzpakaH -kA -kaM, apuzpadaH -dA -daM.
FLOWERY: I Lit.:(1) puzpamayaH (yI yaM);(2) kusumamayaH (yI, yaM);(3) puzpabahulaH (lA, laM); etc.II Florid: q.v.: puzpitaH (tA, taM) (?).

FLOWERY , a. (Having flowers) pOzpaH -zpI -zpaM, puzpI -zpiRI -zpi (n), sapuzpaH -zpA -zpaM, puzpitaH -tA -taM, puzpaSAlI -linI -li (n), puzpamayaH -yI -yaM, kOsumaH -mI -maM, sOmanasaH -sI -saM, sakusumaH -mA -maM. — (As style) puzpitaH -tA -taM, alaNkftaH -tA -taM, vAgalaNkAramayaH -yI -yaM, vyaYjanAmayaH -yI -yaM.

FLOWING , part. or a. sutaH -tA -taM, sravan -vantI -vat (t), prasrutaH -tA -taM, syannaH -nnA -nnaM, syandI -ndinI -ndi (n), visArI -riRI -ri (n), prasArI &c., visftvaraH -rA -raM, visfmaraH -rA -raM, rIRaH -RA -RaM, snutaH -tA -taM.
FLOWING , s. sravaH -vaRaM, prasravaH -vaRaM, prasrAvaH, srAvaH, udakpravAhaH, velA.
FLOWINGLY: (1) drutam;(2) anargalam (without restraint).
FLOWINGLY , adv. vAksaraRipUrvvaM, vAkcApalyena, drutaM, drutavAkyena, asKa- -litavAkyena, avilambitaM, avilambitavAkyena.
FLUCTUANT , a. Urmmivad itastato lolamAnaH -nA -naM or vicalaH -lA -laM.

Fluctuate, v. i. itastataH cal 1 P or GUrR 1 A, lul 1, 6 P, viluW 1 A, 6 P. 2 dolAyate (D.), vikxp 1 A, saMdih 2 U; vical, asTira-caMcala a. BU 1 P. [Fluctuat]ing, a. dolAyamAna, asTira, caMcala, anavasTita, lola, tarala, cala. [Fluctuat]ion, s. asTEryaM, calatA, apratizWA, cAMcalyaM, vikalpaH, saMdehaH, anavasTiti f., AMdolanaM.
FLUCTUATE (v.): (1) dolAyate (nomi.): v. To waver;(2) vicikitsate (= to hesitate: q.v.).

To FLUCTUATE , v. n. (Roll or move to and fro) itastato luW (c. 6. luWati -WituM) or lul (c. 1. lolati -te -lituM) or cal (c. 1. calati -lituM) or vical. — (Be unsteady, irresolute) dola (nom. dolAyate -yituM), vical, vicalIBU, asTiraH -rA -raM BU, asTirIBU, anavasTitaH -tA -taM BU, caYcalIBU, pAtotpAtaM kf, viklap (c. 1. -kalpate -lpituM, c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM).

FLUCTUATING , a. dolAyamAnaH -nA -naM, vicalaH -lA -laM, apratizWaH -zWA -zWaM, anavasTitaH -tA -taM, asTiraH -rA -raM, calaH -lA -laM, caYcalaH -lA -laM, lolaH -lA -laM, lolamAnaH -nA -naM, capalaH -lA -laM, taralAyitaH -tA -taM.
FLUCTUATION: I The act: expr. by verb. II Unsteadiness: q.v.: cAYcalyam.II In pl., ups and downs: pAtotpAtAH.
FLUCTUATION , s. asTEryyaM, asTiratA, anavasTitiH f., vicalanaM, caYcalatA, cAYcalyaM, calatA, AndolanaM, dolAyamAnatA, apratizWA, capalatA, pAtotpAtaH.
Flue, s. DUmamArgaH-paTaH.
FLUE: *vAyusrotas (n.); DUmamArgaH.
FLUE , s. (Passage for smoke) DUmapaTaH, DUmamArgaH, DUmavartma n. (n), DUmanirgamapaTaH. — (Soft down) mfduloma n. (n), mfdupakzaH.
FLUENCY: (1) vAkSaktiH;(2) vAkpAwavam: v. Eloquence.
FLUENCY , s. (Of speech) vAksaraRiH f., vAgdrutatA, vAkcApalyaM, vAk- -kzipratA, vAgviBavaH, vAkpawutA, vAkcAturyyaM, SabdacAturyyaM, vAkkOSalaM, vAkSIGratA, vAgbAhulyaM.

Fluent, a. asKalitavAc, asKaladvAkya, vA-kpawu, druta-tvarita-vAc (of persons); anargala, apratihatOGa, aviSrAMta, asKalita, druta, apratihata, anavarata. [Fluent]ly, adv. asKalita-vAcA, drutavAkyena, asKalitaM, drutaM, apratihataM, vAgviBavena. Fluency, s. vAkpawutvaM, vAkcApalyaM, vAgviBavaH, oGaH, anargalatA, apratihatatvaM.
FLUENT: (1) vaSyavAc (mfn.), Vi.;(2) anargalavAc (mfn.);(3) vacasvin (f. nI), Si. xvii. 1.

FLUENT , a. (In speech) vAgdrutaH -tA -taM, drutavAk m. f. n. (c), vAkkzipraH -prA -praM, vAktvaritaH -tA -taM, tvaritavAk m. f. n., vAkpawuH -wuH -wu, asKalitavAkyaH -kyA -kyaM, asKaladvAkyaH -kyA -kyaM, avila- -mbitavAkyaH -kyA -kyaM, SabdacaturaH -rA -raM.
FLUENTLY: (1) anargalam (= without stop);(2) aviSrAntam (= continuously).
FLUENTLY , adv. drutavAkyena, kzipravAkyena, vAkcApalpena, avilambitavAcA, asKalitavAcA, tvaritavAcA, vAgviBavena, drutaM, SIGraM, asKalitaM, avilambitaM.
Fluid, s. dravaH, rasaH, dravavastu n. a. drava, vi-lIna, druta; See Liquid. [Fluid]ity, s. dravatA, vilayaH.
FLUID: I Adj.: dravaH (vA, vaM).II Subs.: dravaH, -dravyam.
FLUID , a. dravaH -vA -vaM, drutaH -tA -taM, vidrutaH -tA -taM, drAvyaH -vyA -vyaM, vilInaH -nA -naM, taralaH -lA -laM, payasyaH -syA -syaM, viBAjanIyaH -yA -yaM.
FLUID , s. dravaH, rasaH, dravadravyaM, dravavastu n., jalavaddravyaM, vAri n., jalaM, payaH n. (s).
FLUIDITY, FLUIDNESS: dravatA, -tvam, Par.
FLUIDITY , s. dravatA -tvaM, drAvyatvaM, drutatvaM, vidrutatvaM, vilInatA, tAralyaM.
FLUKE: (*laNgara-) dantAgraM or dantamuKam (danta being the whole arm).
FLUKE , s. laNgaradantaH, laNgaraBujaH. See FLOOK.
FLUMERY: I A pap: q.v.II Flattery: miTyApraSaMsA; vitaTastavaH, Si.
Flummery, s. miTyApraSaMsA-stuti f.
FLUMMERY , s. miTyApraSaMsA, miTyAstutiH f., kalpitapraSaMsA, anarTakastutiH f.
FLUNG , p. p. kziptaH -ptA -ptaM, prakziptaH -ptA -ptaM, astaH -stA -staM; ‘flung aside,’ apAstaH -stA -staM, apasAritaH -tA -taM, samAkziptaH -ptA -ptaM.
FLUNKEY: pIWamardaH (?).
FLUNKEY , s. dAsaH, nIcakarmmakaraH, tucCakarmmakaraH, kApuruzaH lawakaH.
Flunky, s. dAsaH, cewaH, nIcakarmakaraH.

FLURRIED , p. p. AkulitaH -tA -taM, AkulIkftaH -tA -taM, vyAkulaH -lA -laM -litaH -tA -taM, samBrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, sasamBramaH -mA -maM, viBrAntamanAH -nAH -naH (s), vikziptacittaH -ttA -ttaM, vyagraH -grA -graM, samAkulaH -lA -laM, cittavegavAn -vatI -vat (t), vyastaH -stA -staM, kAtaraH -rA -raM.
Flurry, See Agitate. s. saMBramaH, vyagratA, mohaH.
FLURRY (subs.): (1) vyAkulatAH v. Confusion; (2) tvarA: v. Hurry.
FLURRY (v.): (1) kzoBayati (c. of kzuB): v. To agitate;(2) udvejayati (c. of vij): v. To alarm.
FLURRY , s. AkulatvaM, vyAkulatA, mamBramaH, viBramaH, cittaBrAntiH f., cittavegaH, vyagratA, AvegaH, saMvegaH, vyastatA, kAtaratA, vEklavyaM, vismayaH, mohaH.
To FLURRY , v. a. AkulIkf, vyAkulIkf, vyAkula (nom. vyAkulayati -yituM), kAtarIkf, muh (c. 10. mohayati -yituM), vimuh, cittavegaM jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM).

Flush, v. t. aruRIkf 8 U, aruRayati (D.), raMj c., raktIkf; ‘with her face f(lush)ed with anger’ kopAruRitAnanA. 2 utsic c., dfp c., darpeRa A-DmA 1 P, udDatIkf. v. i. aruRIBU, raktIBU, lohitAyate (D.), raMj pass.; aruRavadana-lohitAnana- a. BU. s. aruRiman m., raktiman m., raktatA, rAgaH, kapola-vadana-rAgaH. 2 praPullatA, bAhulyaM, samfdDi f. a. satejaska, prOQa, tejasvin. 2 samfdDa, DanasaMpanna. 3 muktahasta, ativyayapara. [Flush]ed, a. aruRita, rakta, lohita. 2 udData, dfpta, darpADmAta, utsikta, garvita, sAvalepa.
FLUSH (subs.): I A rush: q.v.:II A blush: q.v. raktiman (m.).
FLUSH (adj.): I Lively: q.v.: praPullaH (llA, llaM).II Affluent: q.v.III Liberal: q.v.: tyAgin (f. nI).IV Level: samaH (mA, maM).
FLUSH (v.t.): I To redden: q.v.: “faintly f. ed”: IzadaruRitaH (tA, taM).II To elate: utsecayati (c. of sic.III To agitate: kzomayati.
FLUSH (v.i.): I To rush: q.v.II To redden: q.v.: aruRIBavati.

To FLUSH , v. n. (Become suddenly red) akasmAd raktodgamatvAd aruRamuKIBU or lohitAnanaH -nA -naM BU or raktavadanaH -nA -naM BU, aruRIBU, raktIBU, lohita (nom. lohitAyate), raYj in pass. (rajyate) saMraYj.

To FLUSH , v. a. (Redden suddenly) akasmAd aruRIkf or raktIkf or aruRa (nom. aruRayati -yituM), sarAgaM -gAM -gaM kf, raYj in caus. (raYjayati -yituM). — (Elate) dfp in caus. (darpayati -yituM), udDatIkf, garvvitIkf.

FLUSH , a. (Vigorous) prOQatejAH -jAH -jaH (s), tejasvI -svinI -svi (n), prOQaH -QA -QaM. — (Affluent) DanAQyaH -QyA -QyaM, samfdDaH -dDA -dDaM. — (Liberal) DanavyayaSIlaH -lA -laM, muktahastaH -stA -staM.
FLUSH , s. kapolarAgaH, kapolaraktatA, muKAruRimA m. (n), vadanarAgaH, navavarRaH. — (Abundance, affluence) bAhulyaM, DanabAhulyaM, samfdDiH f.

FLUSHED , p. p. (Colored) aruRitaH -tA -taM, aruRIkftaH -tA -taM, raYjitaH -tA -taM, raktaH -ktA -ktaM, rAgI -giRI -gi (n), kapolarAgavAn -vatI -vat (t). — (Elated) udDataH -tA -taM, darpADmAtaH -tA -taM, dfptaH -ptA -ptaM, ‘with victory,’ jayagarvvitaH -tA -taM.
FLUSHING , s. aruRIBAvaH, vadanaraktatvaM, raktavarRaH, lohitavarRaH.
Fluster, v. t. pAnAdinA mad c. or muh c. s. cittaBramaH; unmAdaH, mohaH, vyAkulatA.
To FLUSTER , v. a. pAnAdinA mad in caus. (mAdayati -yituM) or unmattIkf or vimuh (c. 10. -mohayati -yituM) or cittaviBramaM jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM).
FLUSTER , s. cittaviBramaH, madyapAnajaH samBramaH, vyagratA, mohaH, vyAkulatA.
Flute, s. veRuH, muralI, vaMSaH. v. i. ‘Blow a f(lute)’ (veRuM) muKamArutena pUr 10 or vaw c., DmA 1 P; ‘f(lute)-player’ vERavikaH, veRuDmAH, vAMSikaH.

FLUTE (subs.): I A pipe:(1) veRuH, a lute is played on, a f. is blown: vIRA vAdyate veRuH pUryate, N.d.;(2) vaMSaH, -SI;(3) muralI, enchanted with the music of the f.: muralInAdamohitaH (tA, taM).II A channel, groove: reKA (?).
FLUTE (v.): I Intrans: veRuM pUrayati (pUr, c. 10.) etc.II Trans: gAyati (gE, c. 1.): v. To sing.

FLUTE , s. (Instrument) veRuH m., vaMSaH -SI, muralI, sAneyI -yikA, sAnikA, vivaranAlikA, darduraH, nandaH; ‘sound of the flute,’ veRuSabdaH, veRuDvaniH m., kzojanaM. — (Channel of a column) stamBareKA, stamBasItA.
To FLUTE , v. n. (Play on the flute) veRuM or vaMSIM DmA (c. 1. Damati, DmAtuM) or praDmA or vad in caus. (vAdayati -yituM) or saMvad or pravad.
To FLUTE , v. a. stamBaparito dIrGareKAH kf or niKan (c. 1. -Kanati -nituM).
FLUTE-PLAYER , s. veRuDmaH, vAMSikaH, vERavikaH, muralIvAdakaH.
FLUTED , p. p. or a. stamBavad dIrGareKAyuktaH -ktA -ktaM or reKApaMktiyuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
FLUTER, FLUTIST: (1) veRuDmaH;(2) vAMSikaH; (3) vaMSIDaraH.

Flutter, v. i. pakzO vi-DU 5, 9 U, 6 P or AsPal c. or utkzip 6 P or vical c. 2 itastataH cal 1 P or DAv 1 P or pra-sf 1 P. 3 kaMp 1 A, sPur 6 P, ucCvas 2 P, spaMd 1 A, kzuB 4 P. v. t. saMkzuB c., Aku-lIkf 8 U, spaMd c., kaMp c., sPur c. s. viDuvanaM, AsPAlanaM, utkzepaRaM. 2 vikaMpaH, sPuraRaM, spaMdanaM, ucCvasanaM. 3 saM-, kzoBaH, saMBramaH, saM-A-vegaH, citravegaH-BramaH. [Flutter]ing, s. pakzAsPAlanaM, pakzacAlanaM. a. vicala, kaMpamAna; ‘f(luttering) in the breeze’ anilodData, pavanAkzipta, pavanADUta.
FLUTTER (v.): I Lit.: pakzO DUnati or DUnute or DUnayati, -te (DU, c. 5. and 10)., N.II To fluctuate: dolAyate (nomi.).III To agitate: q.v.
FLUTTER (subs.): I Vibration, motion: q.v.II Agitation: kzoBaH.

To FLUTTER , v. n. (Flap the wings in mid air) vihAyasA or vyoma- maDye pakzAsPAlanaM kf or pakzaspandanaM kf or pakzO sPal (c. 10. sPAla- -yati -yituM) or AsPal, praqInam akftvA AkASamaDye pakzO vical in caus. (-cAlayati -yituM) or cal. — (Move about with bustle) itastataS cal or DAv (c. 1. DAvati -vituM). — (Vibrate, beat, be agitated) spand (c. 1. spandate -ndituM), kamp (c. 1. kampate -mpituM), vikamp, sPur (c. 6. sPurati -rituM), kzuB (c. 4. kzuByati, kzoBituM), ucCvas (c. 2. -Cvasiti -tuM, rt. Svas), dol (nom. dolAyate -yituM).

FLUTTER , s. (Vibration) spandanaM, pratispandanaM, sPuraRaM, kampaH -mpanaM, vikampaH, ucCvAsaH, ucCvasanaM, itastato vicalanaM or calanaM. — (Hurry, agitation) samBramaH, vegaH, saMvegaH, AvegaH, cittavegaH, kzoBaH.
FLUTTERING , s. pakzAsPAlanaM, pakzaspandanaM, pakzakampanaM, pakzacAlanaM, sPAlaH -lana.

Fluvial, a. nadIsaMbaMDin.

FLUVIAL , FLUVIATIC, a. nAdeyaH -yI -yaM, nadIsambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n).
Flux, s. (Fluxion) pravAhaH, pra-, sravaH, kzaraRaM, galanaM, spaMdanaM. v. t. vi-dra c., vi-lI c. [Flux]ible, a. drAvya, galanIya.
FLUX (subs.): I Flow: q.v.II Concourse: q.v. saMmardaH.

FLUX , s. (Flow) sravaH -vaRaM, prasravaH -vaRaM, prasrAvaH, pravAhaH, syandaH, kzaraRaM, galanaM, gAlaH. — (Of the tide) velA. — (Confluence) saNgamaH, samAgamaH. — (Bloody flux) AmAtisAraH, AmaraktaH.
To FLUX , v. a. vilI in caus. (-lAyayati -lApayati -yituM), dravIkf, dru in caus. (drAvayati -yituM), vidru, gal in caus. (gAlayati -yituM), vilInIkf.
FLUXIBILITY , FLUXILITY, s. dravatvaM, drAvyatvaM, galanIyatA, vilInatA.
FLUXIBLE: vilayanIyaH (yA, yaM): v. Fusible.
FLUXIBLE , a. drAvyaH -vyA -vyaM, galanIyaH -yA -yaM, suvilayaH -yA -yaM.
FLUXION: I Flow: srutiH.II Decoration: udvartanam (?).
FLUXION , s. sravaH -vaRaM, prasravaH -vaRaM, srAvaH, pravAhaH, galanaM, kzaraRaM.

Fly, s. makzikA, varvaRA, nIlA; ‘f(ly)-flap’ avacUlakaH, romagucCaH, ‘f(ly) leaf’ malapfzWaM. v. i. ud-, qI 1, 4 A, ut-pat 1 P, Ke visfp 1 P, AkASena yA 2 P or gam 1 P. 2 apa-yA 2 P, vi-pra-dru 1 P, palAy 1 A; See Flee. 3 tvaritaM-SIGraM gam or cal 1 P or visfp or atikram 1 U, 4 P. v. t. tyaj 1 P, parihf 1 P, vfj 10. 2 AkASe nikzip 6 P or visfp c. or visf c.; ‘f(ly) at’ A-aBi-pat, A-aBi-dru, A-aBi-pra-DAv 1 P; ‘let f(ly)’ muc 6 P, utpat c., visfj 6 P. [Fly]ing, s. qayanaM, visarpaRaM, utpatanaM; ‘f(lying) up and down’ qInAvaqInaM. a. Kavisarpin, AkASagati, AkASagAmin, qayamAna, naBo-gati; ‘f(lying) bridge’ calasetuH, jaMgamasetuH. Flight, s. palAyanaM, vidrAvaH, apayAnaM, apa-kramaH-maRaM, apagamaH; ‘to put to f(light)’ vidru c.; ‘put to f(light)’ vidruta, vidrAvita, kAMdiSIka. 2 (Of birds) qayanaM, qInaM, u-qqayanaM, utpatanaM, udgamanaM; ‘downward f(light)’ avaqInaM. 3 pakzi-mAlA-SreRI. 4 mati-budDi-vilAsaH; ‘f(light) of steps’ sopAnapaMkti-SreRi-RI f., sopAnaparaMparA; ‘f(light) of an arrow’ Sara-pAtaH. [Flight]y, a. calabudDi, BrAMta-lola-mati; a-sTira, lola; See Fickle.
FLY (subs.): (1) makzikA;(2) mAcikA (rare).

FLY (v.i.): I As birds:(1) qIyate or qayate (qI c. 4. and 1.);(2) utpatati: v. To f. up; (3) gacCati: v. To go.II To move rapid- -ly:(1) kzipraM gacCati and sim. ph.s, f.ing more quickly than the mind: manaso'pyASutaraM yataH, Ki. xiii. 22.: v. Go and rapidly;(2) DAvati (DAv, c. 1.), f. ing through the firmament: gIrvARavartmanA DAvan, K.III To flee: q.v.: palAyate (palAy, c. 1.)IV To burst open: q.v.
FLY (v.t.): I To avoid: q.v.: pariharati (hf, c. 1.).II To cause to start: cAlayati (c. of cal), Ki.III As a kite: uqqInaM (f. nAM) karoti.

To FLY , v. n. (As a bird in the air) qI (c. 4. qIyate, c. 1. qayate -yituM), praqI, uqqI, Ke or viyati visfp (c. 1. -sarpati -sraptuM) or sfp, AkASena gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM) or yA (c. 2. yAti -tuM), pat (c. 1. patati -tituM), utpat, protpat, samutpat, sampat. — (Move along swiftly) tvaritaM or satvaraM or SIGraM gam or cal (c. 1. calati -lituM) or sf (c. 1. sarati, sarttuM) or prasf. — (Run away) palAy (c. 1. palAyate -yituM, rt. i), vipalAy, prapalAy, sampalAy, pradru (c. 1. -dravati -drotu), vidru, vipradru, praDAv (c. 1. -DAvati -vituM), apaDAv, apakram (c. 1. -krAmati -kramituM), apagam, nirgam, apasfp (c. 1. sarpati -sraptuM), apayA (c. 2. -yAti -tuM), apasf (c. 1. -sarati -sarttuM), ape (c. 2. apEti -tuM, rt. i). — (Pass rapidly) SIGram atikram or atI (c. 2. atyeti -tuM, rt. i) or ativft (c. 1. -varttate -rttituM); ‘to fly away,’ uqqI, praqI, proqqI, nizpat; ‘he flew away,’ palAyitaH; ‘to fly at,’ aBipat, Apat, upapat, aBidru, Adru, upadru, aBiDAv, ADAv, pratiDAv; ‘to fly up,’ uqqI, utpat, aDiruh (c. 1. -rohati -roQuM); ‘to let fly,’ muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM), sfj (c. 6. sfjati, srazwuM), pat in caus. (pAtayati -yituM).

To FLY , v. a. (Avoid) vfj (c. 10. varjayati -yituM), vivfj, tyaj (c. 1. tpajati, tpaktuM), parihf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM). — (Cause to float in the air) AkASe visfp in caus. (-sarpayati -yituM) or visf in caus. (-sArayati -yituM).
FLY , s. (Insect) makzikA, maSakaH, makzIkA, mAcikA, BamBaH, BamBarAlI, bamBarAlI.
FLY DOWN: avaqIyate: v. To alight.
FLY ROUND: pariqIyate.
FLY TOGETHER: as birds: saMqIyate.
FLY UP: (1) uqqIyate;(2) utpatati (= to go up: q.v.), flew up to the sky: viyadutpapAta, H. ii. 5.
FLY-BITTEN , a. makzikAdazwaH -zwA -zwaM, makzikAdaMSANkitaH -tA -taM.
To FLY-BLOW , v. a. makzikAvad aRqaprasavena KAdyamAMsaM duz (c. 10. dUpa- -yati -yituM).
FLY-BOAT , s. praRAlIplavanayogyA laGunOkA, drutagAminI dIrGanOkA.
To FLY-FISH , v. n. makzikAM vadiSe niveSyamatsyAn grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM).
FLY-FLAP , s. makzikAnivAraRArTaM cAmaraM, avacUlakaM, romagucCaH.
FLY-GATCHER , s. makzikAKAdakaH pakziBedaH, makzikABuk m. (j), makzi- -kAnASakaH.
FLY-LEAF: *SudDapatram.
FLY-LEAF , s. malapfzWaM, pustakasya AdyantayoH SUnyapatraM.
FLY-TRAP: a plant: *kIwagrahaH.
FLYBLOW: makzikARqam. Fly-blown: makzikARqa- dUzitaH (tA, taM).
FLYBOAT: drutanOkA (?).
FLYCATCHER: a bird: *makzikAgrAhakaH.
FLYER , s. qIyamAnaH, KavisarpI m. (n), AkASagAmI. See FLIER. — (Wheel) tulAcakraM.
FLYING: qayanam, f. up: uqqayanam; f. together: saMqInam: v. To fly.
FLYING , s. (Act of) qInaM, qayanaM, praqInaM, visarpaRaM, AkaSagamanaM, patanaM; ‘flying up and down,’ qInAvaqInaM.

FLYING , part. qIyamAnaH -nA -naM, KavisarpI -rpiRI -rpi (n), AkASagatiH -tiH -ti, AkASagAmI -minI -mi (n), AkASayAyI -yinI -yi (n), patan -tantI -tat (t), naBogatiH -tiH -ti; ‘flying up,’ uqqIyamAnaH -nA -naM.
FLYING-BRIDGE , s. nOsetuH m., calasetuH m., jaNgamasetuH.
FLYING-FISH , s. AkASagamanaSIlo matmyaBedaH.
Foal, s. kiSoraH, aSvaSAvaH-vakaH, bAlaGo-wakaH, aMbarIzaH.
FOAL (v.): aSvaSAvaH (of a horse): v. Colt, filly.
FOAL (v.): sUte, pra-, (sU, c. 2.): v. To bring forth.
FOAL , s. aSvaSAvaH -vakaH, kiSoraH, GowakavatsaH, bAlaH, bAlaGowakaH, ambarIpaH.
To FOAL , v. n. kiSoraM or aSvaSAvakaM mu (c. 2. sUte, c. 4. sUyate, sotuM) [Page280-b+ 51] or prasu or jan (c. 10. janayati -yituM) or prajA (c. 4. -jAyate -janituM).

Foam, s. PenaH-RaH. 2 maMqaH, utsekaH; ‘snowy f(oam)’ himaDavalaM, PenapawalaM. v. i. PenAyate-maMqAyate (D.), PenaM utpad c. or nirgam c. (gamayati), utsic-utpIq- pass. [Foam]y, a. Penila, Penala, Penayukta, Penin.
FOAM (subs.): (1) PenaH;(2) hiRqIraH (= sea -f.) (rare): v. Froth.

FOAM , s. PenaH, maRqaH -RqaM, parAYjaH, paraYjaH, kArujaH, utpIqaH, utsekaH, utsecanaM.

FOAMY: PenilaH (lA, laM), R. xiii. 2.: v. Frothy.
FOAMY , a. PenalaH -lA -laM, PenilaH -lA -laM, PenavAn -vatI -vat (t), PenI -ninI -ni (n), PenotpAdakaH -kA -kaM.

FOB: I A little pocket: ADAraH.II To cheat: q.v.
FOB , s. GawIkozaH, GawIpiDAnaM, kzudraGawIDArakaH, kawivastrapArSve kAlamApa- -nayantrADAraH or -kozaH.
To FOB , v. a. Cal (c. 10. Calayati -yituM), vaYc in caus. (vaYcayate -yituM), Cadma kf.
