(Loving) anuraktaH -ktA -ktaM, anurAgavAn -vatI -vat (t), anurAgI -giRI -gi (n), sAnurAgaH -gA -gaM, srehI -hinI -hi (n), snehitaH -tA -taM, kAmI -minI -mi (n), praRayI -yinI -yi (n). — (Attached to, delighting in) AsaktaH -ktA -ktaM, prasaktaH -ktA -ktaM, paraH -rA -raM, tatparaH -rA -raM, rataH -tA -taM, sevI -vinI -vi (n), aBi- -lAzI -ziRI -zi (n), AnandI -ndinI -ndi (n), -nditaH -tA -taM, pramodI -dinI -di (n); ‘fond of one's ease,’ suKABilAzI -ziRI -zi (n); ‘fond of embracing,’ AliNganatatparaH -rA -raM; ‘fond of noise,’ DvanamodI &c. Often expressed by priya in comp.; as, ‘fond of water,’ jalapriyaH -yA -yaM,; ‘fond of mountains,’ giripriyaH -yA -yaM; ‘fond of ornament,’ priyamaRqanaH -nA -naM; or by kAma in comp.; as, ‘fond of flesh,’ mAMsakAmaH -mA -maM; ‘to be fond of,’ anurAgavAn -vatI -vad as or BU, sev (c. 1. sevate -vituM), aBilaz (c. 1. -lazati -zituM), ruc (c. 1. rocate -cituM), with dat. of the person; aBinand (c. 1. -nandati -ndituM). — (Doting) atyanuraktaH -ktA -ktaM. — (Silly) mUQaH -QA -QaM, mugDaH -gDA -gDaM.

Fondle, v. t. upa-lal 10, aMke-pA c. (pAlayati), kroqIkf 8 U, AliMg 1 P, parizvaMj 1 A, A-saM-pIq 10; ‘f(ondl)ed too much’ durlalita. [Fondl]ing, s. upa-, lAlanaM, AliMganaM, BujApIqanaM, parizvaMgaH. 2 prema-sneha-pAtraM-BAjanaM, snehaBUmi f.
FONDLE (v.t.): lAlayati (c. of lal), should f. (a son for the first) five years: lAlayet paYca- varzARi, J.

To FONDLE , v. a. aliNg (c. 1. -liNgati -NgituM), samAliNg, parizvaYj (c. 1. -zvajate -zvaMktuM), parimfS (c. 6. -mfSati -mrazwuM), lal (c. 10. lAla- yati -yituM), kroqIkf, BujApIqitaM -tA -taM kf, prema kf, anurAgaM kf, aNkIkf, aNke kf, aNke pAl (c. 10. pAlayati -yituM).
FONDLED , p. p. lAlitaH -tA -taM, kroqIkftaH -tA -taM, BujApIqitaH -tA -taM.
FONDLING (subs.): I The act: lAlanam.II The object: premapAtram and sim. comp.s.
FONDLING , s. (Caressing) AliNganaM, parizvaNgaH, lAlanaM, kroqIkaraRaM, aNkapAlI -likA -liH m., BujApIqaH. — (The person or thing fondled) premapAtraM, premaBUmiH f., anurAgapAtraM.
FONDLY: I Affectionately: sAnurAgam.II Foolishly: q.v.
FONDLY , adv. sAnurAgaM, vAtsalyena, atisnehena, atiprItipUrvvaM. — (Foolishly) mUQavat.
FONDNESS: I Affection:(1) anurAgaH;(2) anuraktiH;(3) rAgaH (rare), D.II Likeness: priyatA in comp., f. of wine: madyapriyatA.III Foolishness: q.v.
FONDNESS , s. snehaH, prItiH f., anuraktiH f., anurAgaH, prema n. (n), priyatA, vAtsalyaM, vatsalatA, praRayaH, aBiruciH f., ruciH f., santozaH.
FONT: I A fountain: q.v.II A basin: kuRqam (?).III Of types: *mudrAkzaramAlA; mudrAkzara- jAtam.
FONT , s. pUjASAlAmaDye jalasaMskArakaraRe prayuktaH prastaramayo jalADAraH. — (Complete assortment of printing types of one size) samaparimARamudrAkzaraparisaMKyA.
FONTENELLE , s. (In anatomy) AjYAKyaM cakraM.

Food, s. annaM, AhAraH, BojanaM, BojyaM, BakzyaM, KAdyaM, KAdanaM, BakzaRaM, aByavahAryaM; BaktaM, viGasaH, grAsaH, aSanaM, aMDas n.; ‘cooked f(ood)’ odanaH-naM; ‘f(ood) and raiment’ grAsAcCAdanaM, annavastraM; ‘forbidden f(ood)’ aBakzya.

FOOD: I Lit.:(1) AhAraH (best equiv.), in giving me: f.: mamAhAradAne, H.; to take f.: AhAraM karoti, Va.; we have to eat f. consisting chiefly of roasted meat: SUlyamAMsaBUyizWa AhAro'Syate, K.; (2) annam (used absol.), bad f.: kadannam; the ways of preparing f.: annanAM sADanaprakAraH, Bha.;(3) Amizam (= animal f.): v. Meat;(4) Bojanam (often=feeding), M.n.;(5) KAdyam: v. Eat- -able. Ph.: without taking f.: anAhAreRa or anaSanena, K.; f.: and raiment: grAsAcCAdanam, K.b.; forbidden f.: aBakzyam, V.s.II Fig.: Amizam, became the f. of the enemies: dvizAmAmizatAM yayO, R. xii. 11.

FOOD , s. BojanaM, AhAraH, BojyaM, BakzyaM, KAdyaM, adyaM, AdyaM, adanaM, KAdanaM, [Page282-a+ 51] AhAryyaM, aByAhAryyaM, AmizaM, jagDiH f., aSanaM, BakzaRaM, BaktaM, cAmyaM, jemanaM, jamanaM, canaH n. (s), GasiH m., niGasaH, viGasaH, grAsaH, psAnaM, pratyadanaM, ASaH, dehayAtrA, jIvanakaH, SarIrayAtrA, nyAdaH, lepaH, lehaH; ‘choice food,’ paramAnnaM, uttamAnnaM, BojanaviSezaH; ‘bad food,’ kadannaM; ‘food and raiment,’ grAsAcCAdanaM, annAcCAdanaM, aSannAcCAdanaM or -ne n. du., annavastraM, kaSipUH m. du.; ‘food of the gods,’ amftaM, pIyUzaM, peyUzaM, suDA, lehmaM; ‘to eat food,’ AhAraM kf. Food is divided by the Hindūs into five kinds, BakzyaM, BojyaM, lehyaM, cozyaM, peyaM.

FOOD , s. aByavahAraH, aByavahAryyaM, jemanaM; ‘heavy f.,’ jaqAnnaM; ‘savory f.,’ mizwAnnaM; ‘wholesome f.,’ sattvAnnaM; ‘loathing of f.,’ annadvezaH; ‘non-observant of the distinction of f.,’ sarvvaBakzaH, sarvvAnnaBojI &c.

Fool, s. mUrKaH, mUQaH, nirbudDiH, ajYaH, jaqaH, maMdaH, abuDaH, aprAjYaH, prajYAhInaH, sTUla-jaqa-DIH, alpa-DIH-matiH, maMda-DIH-matiH, anAtmajYa, varvaraH; ‘make a f(ool) of’ upahAsAspadaM kf 8 U, viqaMb 10, (evaM prArTayitA viqaM-byate S. 2). v. t. muh c., vi-pra-luB c., vac 10; See Cheat; ‘f(ool)-hardy’ atisAhAsika, vyAmUQa, avimfSyakArin, avimfSya, pragalBa, pramattavIra, pramatta. [Fool]ery, s. prahasanaM viqaMbanA. 2 bAliSyaM, mUrKakriyA, bAli-SatA, mUrKatA, vyAmohaH. [Fool]ish, a. mUrKa, mUQa, bAliSa, anAtmajYa, durmati, durmeDas, vEDeya, bAliSamati, nirbudDi, jaqa, sTUlaDI, prajYA-budDi-hIna; See (s.). 2 nirarTaka, avi-mfSyakfta-datta. [Fool]ishly, adv. mUQatayA, ajYAnena, mUrKavat, mUQavat, mOrKyeRa. [Fool]ishness, Folly, s. mOrKyaM, jAqyaM, mohaH, maMdamatitA, mUrKatA, mUQatA, bAliSyaM, bAliSatA, durbudDitA, ajYAnaM, nirbudDitvaM, jYAnABAvaH, anAtmajYatvaM.

FOOL (subs.): (1) mUrKaH, there is no medicine for a f.: mUrKasya nAstyOzaDam, J.;(2) nirbudDiH or abudDiH, what has been done by me a f.: kiM mayA kftamabudDinA, Mah.;(3) avidvAn, f. s bow down to fate: dEvama- vidvAMsaH pramARayanti, Mu. Ph.: to make a f. of: avahAsAspadaM karoti; to play the f.: mUrKavad vyavaharati (hf, c. 1.); f.'s errand: mUrKacezwitam.
FOOL (v.t.): mohayati, vi-, vyA-, (c. of muh): v. To delude, deceive.

FOOL , s. mUrKaH, mUQaH, ajYaH, nirbudDiH m., nivIDaH, abudDiH m. -dDimAn m. (t), abuDaH, aprAjYaH, avijYaH, avidvAn m. (s), pramUQaH, prajYAhInaH, ajYAnI m. (n), jaqaH, jaqamatiH m., alpaDIH m., mandabudDiH m., mandaH, barvvaraH, kuRWakaH, lawaH. — (Buffoon, jester) vidUzakaH, narmmasacivaH, BaRqaH.
To FOOL , v. n. KelA (nom. KelAyati), kuq (c. 6. kuqati -qituM), parihAsaM kf, law (c. 1. lawati -wituM).
To FOOL , v. a. muh (c. 10. mohayati -yituM), sammuh, vaYc (c. 10. vaYcayate -yituM), pralaB (c. 1. -laBate -labDuM), Cal (c. 10. Calayati -yituM).
FOOL-HARDINESS: (1) atisAhasikatvam;(2) vyAmohaH (= madness).
FOOL-HARDINESS , s. asamIkzya sAhasaM, avicAreRa pragalBatA, atisAhasikatvaM, jAlmatvaM, avimfSyakAritvaM, atyAhitaM, darpaH, pramattatA.
FOOL-HARDY: atisAhasin (f. nI); (2) pramattaH (ttA, ttaM) (= mad).
FOOL-HARDY , a. asamIkzya sAhasI -sinI -si (n), avimfSya pragalBaH -lBA -lBaM, jAlmaH -lmA -lmaM, pramattavIraH -rA -raM, pramattaSUraH -rA -raM.
FOOLERY: mUrKatA (of the behaviour and of acts of folly), K.
FOOLERY , s. mUrKakarmma n. (n), mUrKakriyA, mUrKatA, bAlakarmma n., bAliSya.

FOOLISH: I Silly: mUQaH (QA, QaM), f. (men) are troubled with passion: mUQo madanenAyAsyate, K.: v. Also unwise.II Of acts, etc.:(1) vAliSaH (SA, SaM) (=children), attachment to f. acts: vAliSacaritezvAsaktiH, K.;(2) nirarTakaH (kA, kaM) (= useless: q.v.).III Ridiculous: q.v.

FOOLISHLY: (1) mUQatayA or mOQyAt (rare), V.p. v. 30. 4.;(2) durbudDikrameRa;(3) aJAnataH (= not knowing);(4) nirarTakam (=uselessly).
FOOLISHLY , adv. mUrKavat, mUQavat, ajYavat, ajYAnAt, mOrKyAt, alyavudvyA.
FOOLISHNESS: (1) mUQatA;(2) vAliSatA;(3) durbudDitA: v. Foolly.
FOOLISHNISS , s. mUrKatA, mOrKyaM, mUQatA, mOQyaM, ajYatA, anaBijYatA, nirbu- dDitvaM, mohaH, budDihInatA, aboDatA, ajYAnaM, jYAnABAvaH, bAliSatA, bAliSyaM.
FOOLSCAP: *puraskam, puraskapatram.
FOOLSGAP , s. mUrKaSirovezwanasaMjYakaH kArpAsaviSepaH or patraviSepaH.

Foot, s. pAdaH, padaM, caraRaH-RaM, aMGriH. 2 talaM, aDoBAgaH, mUlaM; upasTaH. 3 (In metre) caraRaH, padaM. 4 patti-padAti-samUhaH-gaRaH. v. t. pAdena prahf 1 P or taq 10 or Ahan 2 U; ‘f(oot) of a mountain’ upatyakA, pAdaH; ‘set oneʼs f(oot) in’ padaM kf 8 U (lit. and fig.); ASrame padaM karizyasi (S. 4), kutUhalena praSnASayA hfdi padaM kftaM (Ka. 133); ‘walk on f(oot)’ padByAM car-vraj 1 P, pAdacArI BU; ‘walking on f(oot)’ pAdagaH, pAdacAraH; padAtiH; ‘water for the feet’ pAdyaM; pAdodakaM; ‘set on f(oot)’ pravft c., upakram 1 A; prAraB 1 A; ‘f(oot)-board’ caraRaPalakaH, ‘f(oot)-boy’ cewaH, BftyaH, bAlasevakaH, yuvaprezyaH; ‘f(oot)-bridge’ saMkramaH, saMkramasetuH; ‘f(oot)-fall’ caraRa-pAtaH, pAdanyAsaH, sKalanaM; ‘f(oot)-fight’ padAti-pAdaga-yudDaM; ‘f(oot)-licker’ pIWamardaH, caraRasevaka, ‘f(oot)-man’ cewaH, sevakaH, prezyaH, paricaraH, kiMkaraH, ‘f(oot)-mark-print’ pAda-pada-cihnaM, padapaMkti f., padavI, padDati f.; pAdamudrA; ‘f(oot)-pace’ pAdanyAsaH, caraRakramaH-pAtaH; ‘f(oot)-path’ saMsaraRaM, caraRavITi f., paTikamArgaH, padyA, ‘f(oot)-soldier’ padAtiH, pattiH, pAdAtiH-tikaH, pa(pA)dAtaH, pAdacAraH, pa(pA)dagaH, padAjiH, padgaH, padikaH; ‘f(oot)-step’ pAdanyAsaH, pada-caraRa-nikzepaH-pAtaH, padaM, pada-paMkti f. (‘f(oot)-print’); padDatiH, mArgaH, vartman n., padavi-vI f., lakzaRaM; ‘f(oot)-stool’ pAda-pIWaM, caraRapIWaM, pAdAsanaM. [Foot]ing, s. padaM, sTAnaM, BUmi f., sTalaM, AspadaM, padavi-vI, saraRi f. 2 vAstu m., n., mUla, upazwaMBaH. 3 ASrayaH, avalaMbanaM, ADAraH. 4 sTiti f., vftti f., avasTA, BAvaH, daSA; ‘f(ooting) of equality’ samatA, tulyaBAvaH. [Foot]less, a. pAdahIna, acaraRa.

FOOT (subs.): I Lit.:(1) pAdaH, without hand and f.: apARipAdaH (dA, daM). S.; to go on f.: padByAM (or pAdacAreRa A.r.) gacCatiH Mr.; water for cleaning the feet: pAdyam; water in which feet have been washed: pAdodakam;(2) caraRa (mn.); (3) padam;(4) aMGniH.II Fig.: pAdaH, from its f. rises the lake named Hill-water: tasya pAdAt [Page289] praBavati SElodaM nAma tatsaraH, Mat.: v. Bottom.III Of a stool etc.: pAdaH or padam.IV Metrical f.:(1) caraRa (mn.), a Gāyatri f. consists of six syllables: zaqakzaro gAyatrIcaraRaH, Li.;(2) pAdaH; (3) padam. V. A measure: expr. by hastaH (= cubit), three f. in length: trihastadIrGaH (rGA, rGaM).VI Infantry:(1) pattiH;(2) padAtiH.
FOOT, SET ON: pravartayati (c. of vft).

FOOT , s. (Part of the body) pAdaH, padaM, caraRaM -RaH, aMhriH m., aNGriH m., aDamANgaM, laYjaH; ‘both feet,’ pAdO du., caraRe du., caraRayugaM; ‘point of the foot,’ pAdAgraM, padikaM; ‘foot and knee,’ padazWIvaM. — (Bottom, base) talaM, aDoBAgaH, aDaHsTAnaM, mUlaM, upasTaH; ‘foot of a trectree,’ tarutala vfkzatalaM, vfkzANGriH m., pAdaH; ‘foot of a mountain,’ upatyakA, SElopaSalyaM, parvvatatalaM, giripAdaH, parvvatADoBAgaH. — (Measure) manupyapAdaparimARaM, sArdDacaturaNguliparimARaM; ‘ornament for the feet,’ nUpuraH, pAdANgadaM, caraRABaraRaM, pAdakawakaH, tulAkowiH f., maYjIraM; ‘water for ablution of the feet,’ pAdyaM, pAdodakaM; ‘to go on foot,’ padvyAM or pAdAByAM vraj (c. 1. vrajati -jituM) or car (c. 1. carati -rituM); ‘going on foot,’ pAdacAraH; ‘foot by foot,’ pAdaSaS, pade pade, pacCaSa; ‘at the foot,’ pAdatasa; ‘to set on foot,’ pravft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM); ‘set on foot,’ pravarttitaH -tA -taM, upakrAntaH -ntA -ntaM.
To FOOT , v. n. (Kick) pAdena prahf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM) or Ahan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM), pAdAGAtaM kf. — (Tread) kram (c. 1. krAmati, kramituM), caraRapAtaM kf.
To FOOT , H, v. n. nft (c. 4. nftyati, narttituM), pAdAdi saYcal in caus. (-cAlayati -yituM).

FOOT , s. (Hollow of) talahfdayaM; ‘fallen at the feet of,’ caraRagataH -tA -taM, caraRapatitaH &c., pAdalagnaH -gnA -gnaM; ‘water presented to wash the feet,’ pAdArGyaM. — (Of a verse) padaM, caraRaM, pAdaH.
FOOT-BALL pAdAhatakaRqukakrIqA; pAdakaRqukam.
FOOT-BALL , s. vAtADmAto govastir yaH saNkrIqamAnajanapAdAGAtena itastato [Page282-b+ 51] vikzipyate, pAdAhatakandukakrIqA.
FOOT-BATH: I The act: pAdamajjanam.II The vessel: pAdadroRI (?).
FOOT-BOARD: pAdaPalakam (?).
FOOT-BOARD , s. pAdaPalakaM, caraRaPalakaM, pAdakAzWaM.
FOOT-BOY: cewaH: v. Menial.

FOOT-BRIDGE: saNkramaH, all the f.s were broken: saNkramA BeditAH sarve, Mah.
FOOT-BRIDGE , s. saNkramaH, saNkrAmaH, saNkramasetuH m., durgasaYcaraH -saYcAraH.
FOOT-FALL: I Foot-step: q.v.II A trip: sKalanam, pAda-.
FOOT-FALL , s. padapAtaH, pAdapAtaH, caraRapAtaH, padanyAsaH, padavizwamBaH. — (Trip) sKalanaM.
FOOT-FIGHT: (1) pAdacArayudDam (after U.);(2) niyudDam (gen. f.).
FOOT-FIGHT , s. pAdAtiyudDaM, padAtiyudDaM, padikayudDaM, padagayudDaM.
FOOT-GUARD , s. pAdAtikasEnyaH, padAtikasEnikaH, padagarakzakaH.
FOOT-GUARDS: rakzADikftAH padAtayaH.
FOOT-LICKER: (1) caraRasevin (f. nI);(2) pAdalih (mfn.).
FOOT-LICKER , s. pAdasevakaH, caraRasevakaH, padAnurAgaH, pIzWamarddaH.

FOOT-MAN , s. (Foot-soldier) padAtiH m. -tikaH, pAdAtiH m. -tikaH, pAdAtaH, padAtaH, pAdAt, pattiH m., padagaH, padgaH, padikaH, pAdacAraH -rI m. (n), pAdAvikaH, padAjiH m. — (Running footman) jANGikaH. — (Servant) sevakaH, prezyaH, kulasevakaH, paricaraH, kiNkaraH.
FOOT-MARK , s. pAdacihnaM, padacihnaM, padANkaH, padapaMktiH f., pAdamudrA, caraRapadavI, padavI, padaM; ‘of a horse,’ KurapadavI.
FOOT-PACE , s. padapAtaH, pAdagatiH f., padakramaH, caraRakramaH.
FOOT-PAD , s. sAraRikaGnaH, pAdavikaGnaH, paripanTI m. (n), hoqA m. (qf).
FOOT-PAN , s. pAdyapAtraM, pAdyaBAjanaM, pAdyADAraH, pAdodakapAtraM.

FOOT-STALK , s. prasavabanDanaM, vfntaM, maYjarI.

(n). — (Token) cihnaM, lakzaRaM.
FOOT-STOOL , s. pAdapIWaM, caraRapIWaM, pAdAsanaM, pAdapaH, padAsanaM.

FOOTED , p. p. pAdAhataH -tA -taM. — (Having feet) pAdI -dinI -di (n), padI &c.

(n), padavI -viH f., ayanaM, saraRiH f., varttanaM; ‘firm footing,’ pratizWAnaM; ‘place with no firm footing,’ asTAnaM. — (Basis, foundation) mUlaM, upazwamBaH, talaM. — (Support) upastamBaH, upaGnaH, ASrayaH, avalambanaM. (Condition, position) avasTA, sTitiH f., BAvaH, saMsTAnaM, vfttiH f.
FOOTLESS: (1) nizpAdaH (dA, daM);(2) caraRahInaH (nA, naM); and sim. comp.s.

FOOTPATH: (1) saMsaraRam, Vri.;(2) govAwaH (= cattle-path).

(Powerful) prabalaH -lA -laM, balavAn -vatI -vat (t), SaktimAn -matI -mat (t), samarTaH -rTA -rTaM, tejovAn -vatI -vat (t), — (Efficacious) sapraBAvaH -vA -vaM, praBavizRuH -zRuH -zRu, amoGaH -GA -GaM, avyarTaH -rTA -rTaM. — (Impressive) nirbanDena or dArQyena or gOraveRa or sagOravam uktaH -ktA -ktaM, tIkzRaH -kzRA -kzRaM. — (Violent, done by force) sAhasikaH -kI -kaM, balena kftaH -tA -taM; ‘forcible entry,’ balapraveSaH or balAtpraveSaH; ‘forcible removal,’ balApakarzaH.
FORCIBLENESS , s. balavattvaM, SaktimattvaM, prAbalyaM, sAmarTyaM, tEkzRyaM, gOravaM.
FORCIBLY: (1) balAt;(2) prasamam, Ki. ii. 28.; (3) prasahya, R. ii. 27.;(4) haWAt, M. n.
FORCIBLY , adv. balAt, balena, balAtkAreRa, balavat, prasaBaM, prasahya, aBizahya, pramaTya, balApakarzaM, avagfhya. — (Impressively) nirbanDena, dArQyena, gOraveRa, sagOravaM.
FORCING , s. GawanaM -nA -naM, nirmmARaM, kalpanaM, racanA, kfwakaraRaM.

To FORCIVE , v. a. kzam (c. 1. kzamate -ti, kzantuM), saMkzam, muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM), vimuca, avamfj (c. 6. -mfjati -srazwuM), tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tpaktuM), mfza (c. 4. mfzyati, marzituM, mrazwuM, c. 10. marzayati -yituM), mfj (c. 2. mArzwi -rzwuM), anujYA (c. 9. -jAnAti -jYAtuM), samanujYA, saha (c. 1. sahate, soQuM), niryat (c. 10. -yAtayati -yituM); ‘forgive injuries,’ aparADAn kzam; ‘forgive sins,’ pApAni mfj or avamfj; ‘forgive a debt,’ fRaM tyaj.

Ford, s. tIrTaM, taraRasTAnaM-sTalaM, GawwaH. v. t. padByAM tF 1 P or pAraM gam 1 P. [Ford]able, a. alpajala, sutara, supratara; ‘the rivers having become f(ordable)’ suKottAratAmApannA-svApagAsu (Ka. 326).
FORD (subs.): I Lit.: supratarasTalam.II A current: srotas (n.).
FORD (v.t.): padByAM tarati (tF, c. 1.), to f. on horseback: hayena tarati.
FORD , s. nadItarasTAnaM, nadItarasTalaM, taraRasTAnaM, uttaraRasTAnaM, Izajjalo nadIBAgaH, GawwaH.
To FORD , v. a. padmAM or pAdAByAM or aSvagajAdivAhanena nadIm Izajjala- -sTAne tF (c. 1. tarati -rituM -rItuM) or nadIpAraM tF.
FORDABLE: (1) sutaraH (rA, raM);(2) suprataraH (rA, raM), R. iv. 31.
FORDABLE , a. padmAM or pAdAByAM or aSvagajAdivAhanena tAryyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, sutaraH -rA -raM, pAdaspfSyatalaH -lA -laM, alpajalaH -lA -laM.
FORDING , s. padmAM or pAdAByAM or aSvAdivAhanena nadItaraRaM or uttaraRaM.

Fore, a. agra, pUrva, agragAmin; gen. ex. by agra, pUrva in comp.; ‘f(ore)-fathers’ pUrvajAH, pitaraH, pUrve-pUrvAH, vfdDAH; ‘f(ore)-finger’ prade-SinI, tarjanI; ‘f(ore)-foot’ agrapAdaH; ‘f(ore)-head’ lalAwaM, BAlaM, lalAwa-BAla-pawwaM, ali-(lI)kaM, goDiH; ‘f(ore)-land’ aMtarIpaH-paM, udagraBUH-BUmiH; ‘fore leg’, s. pUrva-agra-pAdaH; ‘f(ore)-lock’ lalAwakeSaH-ruhaH; ‘f(ore)-man’ aDyakzaH, aDizWAtf m., aDISaH; ‘f(ore)-mentioned, -named, -said, -spoken’ prAgukta, pUrvokta, pUrvakaTita; ‘f(ore)-mast’ agrakUpakaH; ‘f(ore)-most’ praDAna, utkfzwa, parama; ‘f(ore)-noon’ pUrvAhRaH-kAlaH; ‘f(ore)-part’ agraBAgaH, pUrva-Adi-praTama-BAgaH; ‘f(ore)-rank’ agra-praDAna-padaM; ‘f(ore)-tooth’ agradaMtaH, rAjadaMtaH ‘f(ore)-ward’ senAmuKaM, raRaSiras n.; ‘foreward’, s. See Preface.
FORE (adj.): (1) agraH (grA, graM), f. part: agraBAgaH; (2) pUrvaH (rvA, rvaM) (= upper).
FORE (adv.): agrataH, f. and aft.: agrapaScAt.
FORE , a. pUrvvaH -rvvA -rvvaM, agraH -grA -graM, pUrvvavarttI -rttinI -rtti (n), agragAmI -minI -mi (n), pUrvvagataH -tA -taM; ‘fore-part,’ agraBAgaH, agrAMSaH; ‘fore part of the thigh,’ agrajaNGA.
FORE , adv. pUrvvaM, pUrvve, agre, agratas, pUrvvatas, prAk; ‘fore and aft,’ nAvo' graBAgAtpraBfti paScimaBAgaparyyantaM.
To FORE-ADMONISH , v. a. agre prabuD (c. 10. -boDayati -yituM) or upadiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM).
FORE-ARM (subs.): (1) prakozWaH;(2) agrabAhuH.
FORE-ARM (v.): (1) pUrvameva or prAgeva sannahyati (nah, c. 4.): v. To arm;(2) sajjImavati (=to prepare).
To FORE-ARM , v. a. agre or pUrvve sannah (c. 4. -nahyati -nadDuM) or yudDArTaM sajjIkf.

To FORE-BODE , v. a. anizwaGawanAM pUrvve sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM) or agre jYA (c. 9. jAnAti, jYAtuM) or pradfS (c. 1. -paSyati -drazwuM), pUrvvalakzaRaM dA, pUrvvacihnaM dA, pUrvvalakzaRena anizwam anumA (c. 2. -mAti -tuM) or avagam (c. 1. -gacCati -gantuM).
FORE-DECK: *agracCadaH.
To FORE-DETERMINE , v. a. agre niSci (c. 5. cinoti -cetuM) or nirRI (c. 1. -Rayati -RetuM).
FORE-DETERMINED , p. p. pUrvvaniScitaH -tA -taM, pUrvvanirRItaH -tA -taM, agravicAritaH -tA -taM.
FORE-END: (1) pUrvAntaH (?);(2) agropAntaH (?).
FORE-FATHERS: (1) pUrvajAH (m. pl.);(2) pUrva- puruzAH;(3) pUrvA, Vi.
FORE-FINGER: (1) tarjanI;(2) pradeSinI. N.B. With or without aNgulI.
FORE-FOOT: (1) agrapAdaH;(2) pUrvacaraRam, M. n.
To FORE-IMAGINE , v. a. agre man (c. 4. manyate, mantuM) or cint (c. 10. cintayati -yituM).
To FORE-JUDGE , v. a. agre or pUrvve vicar (c. 10. -cArayati -yituM) or nirRI (c. 1. -Rayati -RetuM).
FORE-KNOW: prageva jAnAtiH v. To know, beforehand.

To FORE-KNOW , v. a. agre or pUrvvaM jYA (c. 9. jAnAti, jYAtuM) or vid (c. 2. vetti, vedituM) or nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM) or buD (c. 4. buDyate, bodDuM), Bavizyad jYA, pravekz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), pradfS (c. 1. -paSyati -drazwuM), pUrvvaM lakzyIkf.
FORE-KNOWLEDGE: agraJAnam (?); BavizyadviJAnam; anAgataJAnam.
FORE-MENTIONED , a. pUrvvoktaH -ktA -ktaM, pUrvvoditaH -tA -taM, prAguktaH -ktA -ktaM.
FORE-NOON (subs.): (1) pUrvAhlaH;(2) prAhRaH.
FORE-NOON (adj.): (1) pUrvAhRetanaH (nI, naM);(2) prAhRetanaH (nI, naM).
FORE-ORDAIN: pUrvaM nirdiSati (diS, c. 6.): v. To ordain, beforehand.

To FORE-ORDAIN , v. a. agre or pUrvvaM nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM) or prakxp (c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM) or nirdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM) or niyuj (c. 7. -yunakti -yoktuM) or viDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM).
FORE-ORDAINED , p. p. agranirUpitaH -tA -taM, pUrvvanirdizwaH -zwA -zwaM, pUrvvapra- -kalpitaH -tA -taM.
FORE-QUARTER of an animal: agrapAdaH (?).
To FORE-RUN , v. a. agre or agrataH or puraH or prAk sf (c. 1. sarati, sarttuM) or gam (c. 1. gacCati, gantuM) or yA (c. 2. yAti -tuM) or vft (c. 1. varttate -rttituM).
FORE-RUNNER: (1) pUrogaH, -gAmin (m.);(2) puraHsaraH;(3) agresaraH.
FORE-RUNNER , s. agresaraH, agrasaraH, agragaH -gAmI m. (n), purogaH -gAmI m., prAggAmI m., agravarttI m. (n), agragataH, pUrvvapuruzaH.
FORE-SEEING (adj.): BavizyaddarSin (f. nI); Bavizyat- prekzin (f. RI).
FORE-SHIP , s. nAvaH pUrvvaBAgaH or agraBAgaH, nOkAgraBAgaH.
FORE-SKIN , s. SePAgracarmma n. (n), liNgAgracarmma n., agracarmma.
FORE-TOOTH , s. agradantaH, rAjadantaH, sammuKadantaH, muKyadantaH.
FORE-WARD , s. senAmuKaM, DvajinImuKaM, senAgraM, raRamUrdDA m. (n), SiraH n. (s).
To FORE-WARN , v. a. agre or pUrvve buD (c. 10. boDayati -yituM) or prabuD or pratyAdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM) or upadiS or sandiS or jYA in caus. (jYApayati -yituM), pUrvvalakzaRaM dA.
FORE-WARNED , p. p. pUrvvaboDitaH -tA -taM, agravijYApitaH -tA -taM, pUrvvopadizWaH. -zwA -zwaM.
FORE-WARNING , s. agrapratyAdeSaH, pUrvvaboDanaM, pUrvvozadeSaH, pUrvvavijYaptiH f.
Forearm, s. prakozWaH, agraBujaH-hastaH-bAhuH. v. t. pUrvaM sannah 4 P or c. or sajjIkf 8 U.
FOREARM , s. prakozWaH, pravezwaH, kalAcikA, agrabAhuH m., agraBujaH.

Forebode, v. t. A-, sUc 10, prAk A-vid c., pUrvaM kaT 10; (anizwaM) pUrvaM jYA 9 U or avagam 1 P, anu-mA 3 A; See Bode; ‘the tawny lightning f(orebode)s a hurricane’ vAtAya kapilA vidyut (S. K.). [Forebod]er, s. anizwAvedakaH, anizwasUcakaH. [Forebod]ing, s. anizwasUcanaM-jYAnaM-darSanaM.

FOREBODE: (1) sUcayati, vi-, A-, (sUc, c. 10.) (= to indicate), this omen is good-f. ing: kalyARa- sUcakamidaM nimittam, Sa. i.;(2) kaTayati (= to tell), f. s terrible death: kaTayati mahAGoraM mftyum, Mr. ix.: v. To bespeak.
FOREBODER , s. anizwasUcakaH, anizwapradarSakaH, pUrvvalakzaRajYaH, pUrvvaliNgajYaH, agrasUcakaH.
FOREBODING , s. anizwasUcanaM -nA, anizwapradarSanaM, pUrvvalakzaRAd anizwAnumAnaM.
Forecast, v. t. pUrvaM-agre ciMt 10 or nirUp 10 or nirdiS 6 P or anusaM-DA 3 U. s. pUrvakalpanA-vivekaH, agranirUpaRaM, pUrvaciMtanaM, dIrGadfzwi f.
FORECAST (v.): I To project: kalpayati (kxp, c. 10.).II To foresee: q.v.
FORECAST (subs.): I Contrivance: kalpanA. II Prevision: samIkzA.
To FORECAST , v. a. and n. agre or pUrvve cint (c. 10. cintayati -yituM) or pracint or nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM) or upAyam anusanDA, (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), agravivecanAM kf, agrakalpanAM kf.
FORECAST , s. agracintanaM, agranirUpaRaM, pUrvvavivecanaM, pUrvvakalpanA, dIrGadfzwiH f.
FORECASTLE: *agrakozWaH.
FORECASTLE , s. nAvaH pUrvvaBAgaH or agraBAgaH, agrakUpakapurato nOBAgaH.
Foreclose, v. t. pratibaMD 9 P, prati-ni-ziD 1 P. [Foreclos]ure, s. pratibaMDaH, pratizeDaH.
To FORECLOSE , v. prativanD (c. 9. -baGnAti -banDuM), pratipiD (c. 1. -paDati -pedDuM). — (Foreclose a mortgage) nyAsakAriRa fRamokzaRa- -kzamatAm apanI (c. 1. -nayati -netuM).
FORECLOSURE: banDa (-ka) mokzapratizeDaH.
FORECLOSURE , s. pratibanDanaM, pratipeDaH, avaroDanaM, fRamokzaRakzamatAharaRaM.
FOREDECK , s. nOkApazWasya pUrvvaBAgaH or agraBAgaH, pUrvvapfzWaM, agrapfzWaM.
Fore-determine, v. t. agre-pUrvaM-nirRI 1 P or niSci 5 U.
Foredoom, v. t. pUrvaM nirdiS 6 P or vi-car c.
To FOREDOOM , v. a. agre or pUrvvenirdiS (c. 6. -diSati -dezwuM) or prakxp (c. 10. -kalpayati -yituM) or vicar in caus. (-cArayati -yituM).
FOREFATHERS , s. pl. pUrvvAH m. pl., pUrvvapuruzAH m. pl., pUrvvajAH m. pl., pitflokaH, pitaraH m. pl., pitfpitAmahAdi n., vfdDAH m. pl.; ‘practice of forefathers,’ vfdDAcAraH.
FOREFEND: nivArayati (vf, c. 10.): v. To forbid.
To FOREFEND , v. a. nivf (c. 10. -vArayati -yituM), pratihan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM), pratikf.
FOREFINGER , s. pradeSinI, pradeSanI, deSinI, deSI m. (n), tarjjanI, taritA.
FOREFOOT , s. aSvAdicatuzpadajantUnAM pUrvvapAdaH or sammuKInapAdaH.
Forego, v. t. tyaj 1 P, hA 3 P, ut-vi-sfj 6 P; ‘I shall f(orego) my name’ svanAmatyAgaM karomi (P. 1); ‘a foregone conclusion’ pUrvanirRitaH-prAgevasidDaH-sidDAMtaH.
FOREGO: jahAti (hA, c. 3.): v. To relin- -quish, renounce.
To FOREGO , v. a. avasfj (c. 6. -sfjati -srazwuM), utsfj, tyaj (c. 1. tyajati, tyaktuM), parityaj, hA (c. 3. jahAti, hAtuM), ujJ (c. 6. ujJati -jJituM), projJ.
FOREGOING: i.e. preceding: atikrAntaH (ntA, ntaM), S.
FOREGONE: Ph.: f. conclusion: pUrvakalpitanigamaH.
FOREGONE , s. tyaktaH -ktA -ktaM, parityaktaH -ktA -ktaM, avasfzwaH -zwA -zwaM.
FOREGROUND: agraBUmiH, Ki.
FOREGROUND , s. citragataBUmer agraBAgaH or pUrvvaBAgaH.
FOREHEAD: (1) lalAwam, whatever is written by God on one's f.: yasyeSvareRa yadaleKi lalAwapawwe, N.; (2) BAlam (rare). Ku.

FOREHEAD , s. lalAwaM, alikaM, alIkaM, BAlaM, goDiH m., muRqaH -RqaM, lalAwatawaM, lalAwapawwaM, lakaM, niwalaM, gaRqaSElaH, mahASaNKaH; ‘having a high forehead.’ uccalalAwaH -wA -waM; ‘the open forehead,’ lalAwaPalakaM.

Foreign, a. videSIya, vEdeSika-pAradeSika (kI f.), videSaja, videSin, anya-Binna-deSaja-deSIya-deSodBava, pAradeSya, videSAdA-gata, bahirdeSodBava; ‘a f(oreign) country’ videSaH, paradeSaH, deSAMtaraM. 2 bAhya, bahirBava, aprastuta, aprakfta; ‘this is f(oreign) to our present inquiry’ aprakftametadasmin vizaye. [Foreign]er, s. vEdeSikaH, pAradeSikaH, anyadeSIyaH-deSajaH; See (a.). [Foreign]ness, s. bAhyatA, BinnatA; aprakftatA, asaMbaMDaH.

FOREIGN: I Of another country:(1) by comp., f. commodities: paradeSapaRyAH, V. s.;(2) videSIyaH (yA, yaM);(3) vEdeSikaH (kI, kaM), f. merchant: vEdeSikavaRik, D. i.;(4) deSAntarIyaH (yA, yaM), K. b.;(5) videSajaH (jA, jaM), etc. (= produced in a f. country);(6) paradeSyaH (f. SyA) (rare), Y. Ph.: f. country:(1) videSaH; (2) deSAntaram;(3) paradeSaH.II Extraneous, irrelevant: bAhya (f. hyA), f. matters: bAhya- vastUni (?); it is f. to my purpose...... madaBi- pretabAhya (f. hyA) (?).

FOREIGN , a. videSIyaH -yA -yaM, vEdeSikaH -kI -kaM, videSI -SinI -Si (n), pAradeSikaH -kI -kaM, paradeSI -SinI -Si (n), videSajaH -jA -jaM, anyadeSIyaH -yA -yaM, anyadeSajaH -jA -jaM, anyadeSoqBavaH -vA -vaM, BinnadeSIyaH -yA -yaM; ‘a foreign country,’ videSaH, vahirdeSaH, deSAntaraM, anyadeSaH. — (Extraneous) vahirBavaH -vA -vaM, vahirBUtaH -tA -taM, vahiHsTaH -sTA -sTaM, vAhyaH -hyA -hyaM. — (Not pertaining) asambanDI -nDinI -nDi (n), ananvitaH -tA -taM, asamparkIyaH -yA -yaM.
FOREIGNER: (1) vEdeSikaH (kI, kaM), as I am a f.: vEdeSiko'smIti, U. i.;(2) videSin (f. nI); (3) pAradeSikaH (kI, kaM) (rare): v. Stranger, new comer.
FOREIGNER , s. videSI m. (n), videSIyaH, vEdeSikaH, paradeSI m. (n), pAradeSikaH, pAradeSyaH, BinnadeSIyaH, vahirdeSajaH, videSAdAgataH, deSAnta- -rAdAgataH, vahirdeSodBavaH, vEdeSyaH.
FOREIGNNESS , s. vAhyatvaM, vahirBUtatvaM, dUratvaM, asambanDaH, asamparkaH.
Fore-imagine, v. t. pUrvaM-agre-ciMt 10 or man 4 A.
Fore-judge, v. t. pUrvaM avekz 1 A, vicar c. or nirRI 1 P.
Fore-know, v. t. pUrvaM jYA 9 U or buD 1 P, or vid 2 P; know, q. v.; pradfS 1 P, agre nirUp 10. [Fore-know]ledge, s. agra-pUrva-jYAnaM, BavizyajjYAnaM, agranirUpaRaM, agra-pUrva-dfzwi f.
FOREKNOWLEDGE , s. agrajYAnaM, pUrvvajYAnaM, agranirUpaRaM, BavizyajjYAnaM, BAvi- jYAnaM, pravekzaRaM, pradarSanaM, pUrvvalakzyaM, agradfzwiH f., pUrvvadfzwiH f.
FOREKNOWN , p. p. pUrvvajYAtaH -tA -taM, agrajYAtaH -tA -taM, agranirUpitaH -tA -taM.
FORELAND: *pralambam: v. Promontory.
FORELAND , s. antarIpaH -paM, samudramaDye mahAdvIpavahiHsTo BUmiBAgaH, udagra- -BUmiH f., udagraBUH f., udagrasTalaM, mahAdvIpanAsikA, samudranAsikA.
FORELOCK: (1) agrakeSAH (m. pl.);(2) agraSiKA. Ph.: to take time or occasion by the f.: *vinAti- pAtaM kAlaM or avasaraM gfhRAti.
FORELOCK , s. lalAwaruhaH -haM, lalAwajaH -jaM, keSapASI, lalAwakeSaH mastakAgrakeSaH, mastakAgraruhaH keSapASaH or keSapakzaH.
FOREMAN: (1) praDAnaH, f. of a fury: saByapraDAnaH. v. Chief;(2) nAyakaH (= leader).

FOREMAN , s. (Of a jury) dvAdaSapramARapuruzaprazWaH, dvAdaSamaDyasTapuruzamuKaM, praDAnamaDyasTaH, muKyapramARapuruzaH. — (Superintendant) kAryyADizWAtA m. (tf), aDikarmmikaH, kAryyADISaH, kAryyADyakzaH, kAryyADikftaH SrezWI m. (n), karmma kurvvatAm aDizWAtA m.
FOREMAST: (1) agrakUpakaH;(2) agrasTo guRavfkzaH.
FOREMAST , s. nOkAgrasTaH kUpakaH, nOkAgraBAge guRavfkzakaH, agrakUpakaH.
FOREMOST: I Chief: q.v.:(1) muKya (f. KyA); (2) praDAnatamaH (mA, maM).II First: q.v.

FOREMOST , a. agraH -grA -graM, muKyaH, -KyA -KyaM, pramuKaH -KA -KaM, agryaH -gryA -gryaM, agrIyaH -yA -yaM, prAgryaH -gryA -gryaM, praDAnaH -nA -naM, praTamaH -mA -maM, uttamaH -mA -maM, utkfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, SrezWaH -zWA -zWaM, sarvvaSrezWaH -zWA -zWaM, sarvvAgrasTaH -sTA -sTaM; ‘first in rank,’ praTamapadasTaH -sTA -sTaM.
FORENAMED , a. pUrvvoktaH -ktA -ktaM, pUrvvABihitaH -tA -taM, pUrvvodAhftaH -tA -taM.
FORENOON , s. pUrvvAhnaH, prAhlaH, pUrvvAhnakAlaH; ‘in the forenoon,’ prAhle, pUrvvAhne, prAhletamAM; ‘relating to it,’ prAhletanaH -nI -naM, pUrvvAhnetanaH -nI -naM.
Forensic, a. vyAvahArika (kI f.), vyavahArAnubadDa.
FORENSIC , a. vyAvahArikaH -kI -kaM or vyavahArikaH, vyavahArI -riRI -ri (n), vicArasaBAsu vyavahAritaH -tA -taM, vicArasTAnasambanDIyaH -yA -yaM.
FORENSICAL: expr. by comp., f. medicine: vyavahAracikitsA.
Fore ordain, v. t. agre-pUrvaM-nirdiS 6 P or niyuj 7 A, 10 or vi-DA 3 U.
FOREPART: (1) agraBAgaH;(2) agrimaBAgaH;(3) pUrvaBAgaH.
FOREPART , s. agraBAgaH, pUrvvaBAgaH, AdiBAgaH, praTamaBAgaH, sammuKaBAgaH.
FORERANK , s. agrapadaM, praTamapadaM, praDAnapadaM, muKyapadaM, SrezWapadaviH f.
Forerun, v. i. pUrvaM-puraH-agre-sf or DAv or gam 1 P or vft 1 A or yA-i 2 P. [Forerun]ner, s. agresaraH, puro-gaH-gAmin m., agra-gaH-gAmin m., agravartin m., agragataH, pUrvapuruzaH.
FORESAID , p. p. pUrvvoktaH -ktA -ktaM, pUrvvoditaH -tA -taM, prAguktaH -ktA -ktaM.
FORESAIL , s. nOkAgrasTakUpakAlambitaM vAyuvasanaM or vAtavasanaM.
Fore-say, [Fore]-speak, prAk-pUrvaM-vad 1 P, or kaT 10.
To FORESAY , v. a. agre or pUrvvaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM) or pravad, Bavizpad vad.

Foresee, v. t. pUrvaM-dfS 1 P or jYA 9 U, BAvi-anAgataM-dfS or avekz 1 A, agre ni-rUp 10; gen. ex. by BAvin, ‘I f(oresee) my ruin’ jAnAmi BAvinaM nASaM. Foresight, s. dUradarSitvaM-tA, dUra-dIrGa-dfzwi f., agra-nirUpaRaM, dUradarSanaM.

FORESEE: (1) paSyati, pra-, (dfS, c. 1.) (when the sense is clear), old man's intellect f.s the future: vfdDabudDiranAgataM paSyati, Vi. vi.: v. To see; (2) expr. with words meaning future, I f. death: mama BAvi maraRaM paSyAmi.

To FORESEE , v. a. pradfS (c. 1. -paSyati -drazwuM), uddfS, pravekz for prAvekz (c. 1. -Ikzate -kzituM), agre or pUrvve dfS, anAgataM or pariRAmaM or Bavipyad dfS or samIkz, agre jYA (c. 9. jAnAti, jYAtuM) or nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM).

FORESEEING , part. prapaSyan -SyantI -Syat (t), agradarSI -rSinI -rSi (n), anAgatadarjYI &c., pUrvvadarSI &c., BavizpaddarSI &c., dUradarSI &c., antarajYaH -jYA -jYaM, pravekzyan &c. for prAvekzyan &c.
FORESEEN , p. p. pravekzitaH -tA -taM, pradfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, sandfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, sandfSya- mAnaH -nA -naM, agranirUpitaH -tA -taM.
FORESHADOW: pUrvam or prAk or agre rUpayati (rUp, c. 10.).
To FORESHADOW , v. a. pUrvvavarRanaM kf, pUrvvamUrttiM kf, agre rUp (c. 10. rUpa- -yati -yituM).
To FORESHAME , v. a. lajj in caus. (lajjayati -yituM), kalaNka (nom. kalaNkayati -yituM).
FORESHORTEN: I Lit.: agraM saMharati (hf, c. 1.) (??).II Fig.: saMharati (hf, c. 1.). v. To shorten.
To FORESHORTEN , v. a. mUrttiM citrasamarpaRAt sammuKaBAge hras (c. 10. hrAsayati -yituM) or saMhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM) or saMkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM).
FORESHORTENING (subs.): agrasaMhAraH, vakracitritam.
FORESHOW: (1) sUcayati (sUc, c. 10.) (= to indicate);(2) kaTayati (kaT, c. 10.): v. To bespeak;(3) pradarSayati (c. of dfS): v. To show.
To FORESHOW , v. a. pradfS in caus. (-darSayati -yituM), agre or pUrvve dfSa or sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), Bavizpat sUc or vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM).
FORESHOWN , p. p. pradarSitaH -tA -taM, agrasUcitaH -tA -taM, pUrvvasUcitaH -tA -taM.
FORESIGHT: I Lit.: BavizyaddarSanam (?).II In gen.;(1) dUradarSitA, (?), dIrGadarSitA, Ka. viii. 10.
FORESIGHT , s. pUrvvadfzwiH f., agradfzwiH f., pravekzaRaM, pradarSanaM, pariRAmadfzwiH f., agranirUpaRaM, BavizpaddarSanaM, dUradfzwiH f., dUradarSanaM, dIrGadfzwiH f., parivedanA.
FORESKIN: (puruzANgasya) uparigatacarman (n.).
FORESKIRT , s. agrasTo vastrAYcalaH, pariDAnasya agrAYcalaH, agrato vasanAntaM.
To FORESPEAK , v. a. agre vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM), pravad, pravyAhf (c. 1. -harati -harttuM).
FORESPENT , a. kzIRabalaH -lA -laM, SrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, KinnaH -nnA -nnaM.
FORESPOKEN , a. pUrvvoktaH -ktA -ktaM, pUrvvoditaH -tA -taM, prAguktaH -ktA -ktaM.

Forest, s. vanaM, araRyaM, kAnanaM, vipinaM, awa-vi-vI f., gahanaM, kAMtAraH-raM; ‘a large f(orest)’ araRyAnI; ‘growing in f(orest)’ vanya, AraRya-ka, vanodBava, araRyaja-jAta, vana or araRya in comp. [Forest]er, s. vanecaraH, vanavAsin m., A-raRyakaH, AwavikaH, vanasTaH, vanacArin m., vanacaraH-vartin m., vanOkas m., araRyasad m. 2 araRyarakzakaH, vanapAlakaH.

FOREST: I Subs.:(1) vanam (also=a park);(2) araRyam;(3) vipinam;(4) kAnanam;(5) awavI;(6) [Page292] gahanam (= thicket).II Adj.:(1) expr. by tat. comp.: a f. tree: vanapAdapaH;(2) vanyaH (nyA, nyaM);(3) AraRyaka (f. kA).

FOREST , s. araRyaM -RyI -RyAnI, vanaM, -nI, awaviH -vI f., gahanaM, gahaH, kAnanaM, vipinaM, jaNgalaH -laM, dAvaH, davaH, kAntAraH -raM, kuvraM, riktaM, talkaM; ‘forest on fire,’ dAvaH, dAvAgniH m., muKAgniH, maNkilaH.

FOREST , a. vanyaH -nyA -nyaM, AraRyaH -RyI -RyaM -RyakaH -kA -kaM, jaNgalaH -lA -laM, jANgalaH -lI -laM; ‘produced in a forest,’ vanoqBavaH -vA -vaM, araRyajaH -jA -jaM -jAtaH -tA -taM, araRyaBavaH -vA -vaM, araRyotyannaH -nnA -nnaM, araRyasamBavaH -vA -vaM, araRya or vana in comp.; as, ‘a forest tree,’ vanapAdapaH, araRyavfkzaH, vanarAjiH m., vanaspatiH m., vanyataruH m.
Forestall, v. t. pUrvaM grah 9 P or AdA 3 A, pUrvagrahaRena moGIkf 8 U; See Anticipate. 2 pUrvaM krI 9 U.
FORESTALL: I To anticipate: q.v.II To obstruct: q.v.III To f. a market: mUlya- varDanAya dravyARi pUrvaM krIRAti (krI, c. 9.).

To FORESTALL , v. a. (Take beforehand) agre or pUrvvaM or pUrvvato grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM) or AdA (c. 3. -datte -dAtuM), agre gfhItvA nivf (c. 10. -vArayati -yituM) or niziD (c. 1. -zeDati -zedDuM). — (Buy before- hand) pUrvve krI (c. 9. krIRAti, kretuM), pUrvvakrayaM kf, praKyA (c. 2. -KyAti -tuM).
FORESTALLED , p. p. pUrvvagfhItaH -tA -taM, pUrvvakrItaH -tA -taM, praKyAtaH -tA -taM.
FORESTALLER: mUlyavarDanAya pUrvakretf (m.); *paRyaroDakaH.
FORESTALLER , s. pUrvvakretA m. (tf), agrakrayI m. (n), sarvvapaRyAni vikraya- sTAnAnayanAt pUrvvaM krItvA mUlyavarDakaH.
FORESTER: I Inhabitant of a forest:(1) vanecaraH;(2) vanesad- (m.);(3) vanavAsin (m.); (4) AraRyakaH;(5) AwavikaH, H.; and sim. comp.s.II Keeper of a forest: banapAlaH, N.

FORESTER , s. (Inhabitant of a forest) vanavAsI m. (n), araRyavAsI m., vanasTAyI m. (n), vanasTaH, vanecaraH, vanacaraH, vanacArI m. (n), vanavarttI m. (n), vanOkAH m. (s), araRyOkAH m. (s), vanASrayaH, vanavyavaharI m. (n), AraRyakaH, araRyasad m. — (Overseer of the forests) araRyADyakzaH, araRyarakzakaH.
Foretaste, v. t. pUrvaM anuBU 1 P or AsvAd 1 A or Buj 7 A. s. pUrvAnuBavaH, pUrva-agra-jYAnaM, pUrvAsvAdaH, pUrva-agra-Bukti f.
FORETASTE: I Subs.: pUrvasvAdaH: v. Taste.II Verb: pUrvam or prAk svAdayati (c. of svad).
FORETASTE , s. pUrvvaBuktiH f., agraBuktiH f., pUrvvaBojanaM, pUrvvAsvAdanaM, agropa- -BogaH, pUrvvopaBogaH, pUrvvAnuBavaH, pUrvvajYAnaM, agrajYAnaM.
To FORETASTE , v. a. agre or pUrvve or agrato Buj (c. 7. BuMkte, BoktuM) or upaBuj or anuBU or AsvAd (c. 1. -svAdati -dituM), pUrvvaBuktiM kf, pUrvvasvAdanaM kf.
FORETASTED p. p. pUrvvaBuktaH -ktA -ktaM, pUrvvAsvAditaH -tA -taM, pUrvvAnuBUtaH -tA -taM.
Foretell, v. t. pUrvaM kaT 10, BAvi-Bavizyad vad 1 P or vac 2 P; pradfS c., anAgataM ni-vid c.; See Predict. [Foretell]er, s. Bavizya-dvAdin m., BAvidarSakaH, anAgatanivedakaH, dEvajYaH.
FORETELL: anAgataM vadati (vad, c. 1.): v. To predict.

To FORETELL , v. a. agre or agrataH or pUrvvaM vad (c. 1. vadati -dituM) or pravad, Bavizyad vad or vac (c. 2. vakti -ktuM), pradfS in caus. (-darSa- -yati -yituM) agre dfS, anAgataM jYA in caus. (jYApayati -yituM).
FORETELLER: Bavizyadvaktf (m.): v. Prophet.
FORETELLER , s. agravAdI m. (n), BavizpadvaktA m. (ktf), BavizyadvAdI m., BAvivaktA m., anAgatajYApakaH, pradarSakaH, BAvidarSakaH, dEvajYaH.
Forethink, v. t. pUrvaM ciMt 10 or vimfS 6 P. Forethought, s. agra-pUrva-ciMtA, pUrvavimarSaH-vivekaH, prasamIkzA-kzaRaM, dUra-dIrGa-dfzwi f., pUrvavicAraRaM-RA.
To FORETHINK , v. a. pUrvve or agre cint (c. 10. cintayati -yituM) or pracint or vimfS (c. 6. -mfSati -mrazwuM) or nirUp (c. 10. -rUpayati -yituM), pUrvvavivecanaM kf.
FORETHOUGHT: I Lit.: expr. by verb, having f. of his own end: BAvinamantamAtmano jAnannapi, Si. II Prudence: samIkzA, pra-.

FORETHOUGHT , s. pUrvvacintA, agracintA, pUrvvavivecanaM -nA, agravivecanaM, pUrvvavicAraRaM -RA, agranirUpaRaM, pUrvvavimarSaH, prasamIkzA, pravekzaRaM, pUrvvadfzwiH f., dIrGadfzwiH f., pariRAmadfzwiH, parivedanA.
Foretoken, v. t. pUrvaM sUc 10. s. pUrvalakzaRaM-cihnaM-liMgaM, BAvilakzaRaM.
FORETOKEN: sUcayati (sUc, c. 10.): v. To forebode.
To FORETOKEN , v. a. agre or pUrvve dfS (c. 10. darSayati -yituM) or sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM), pradfS, pUrvvalakzaRaM or pUrvvacihnaM dA, pUrvvalakzaRena Bavizpat sUc.
FORETOKEN , s. pUrvvalakzaRaM, pUrvvacihnaM, pUrvvaliNgaM, BAvilakzaRaM, BAvicihnaM, BavizyallakzaRaM, BavizyalliNgaM.
FORETOLD , p. p. pUrvvakaTitaH -tA -taM, pradarSitaH -tA -taM, prAksamBavAduktaH -ktA -ktaM.
FORETOP , s. mastakAgrakeSaH. — (Of a ship) kUpakAgre maYcakaH.
FORETOP-MAST: *agramaYcakUpaH.

Forewarn, v. t. pUrvaM sUc 10 or prabuD c., agre upadiS 6 P or jYA c. (jYApayati); ‘to be f(orewarn)ed is to be fore-armed’ pUrvaprabo-DanaM pUrvasannAhatulyaM. [Forewarn]ing, s. pUrvapraboDaH-DanaM, pUrvopadeSaH.
FOREWOMAN: (1) praDAnA;(2) nAyikA: v. Fore- -man.

Forfeit, v. t. daMq pass., BraMS 1 A, 4 P, cyu 1 A, pari-hA pass., (with abl.); ‘f(orfeit)s his kingdom’ rAjyAtpariBraMSate; ‘f(orfeit)s his right’ svatvaM tasmAnnivartate; oft. ex. by hIna-hfta in comp.; ‘you will f(orfeit) all your wealth’ hftasarvasvo BaveH, sarvasvaM daM-qyeTAH. s. daMqaH, Dana-arTa-daMqaH. [Forfeit]ed, a. daMqita, Brazwa, cyuta, hIna; ‘who has f(orfeit)ed his right’ svatvaBrazwaH, cyutADikAraH; hfta-sarvasvaH, &c. [Forfeit]ure, s. hAni f., cyuti f., BraMSaH, apahAraH, apavartanaM, nASaH, daMqadAnaM.
FORFEIT (subs.): daRqaH: v. Penalty, fine.
FORFEIT (v.): (1) daRqam aDigacCati (gam, c. 1.) v. Punishment;(2) hArayati (c. of hf) v. To lose.

To FORFEIT , v. a. daRq in pass. (daRqyate), daRqaM dA; ‘he forfeits the eighth part of his property,’ svavittasya azwamAMSaM daRqyate. — (Lose one's right) svADikArAt or svasvatvAd BraMS (c. 4. BraSyati, BraMSituM) or pariBraMS or praBraMS or cyu (c. 1. cyavate, cyotuM) or pracyu, hA in pass. (hIyate) with instr. or abl. c., prahA; ‘he forfeits his right,’ tasmAt svatvam apavarttate; ‘his kingdom,’ rAjyAt praBraSyati.
FORFEIT , s. daRqaH, DanadaRqaH, arTadaRqaH, hAritaM, vihApitaM, nikzepaH, nyAsaH.
FORFEITABLE , a. daRqyaH -RqyA -RqyaM, daRqanIyaH -yA -yaM, heyaH -yA -yaM.
FORFEITED (adj.): no exact equiv.: daRqitaH (tA, taM) (= punished, fined): v. Also to escheat.

FORFEITED , p. p. daRqitaH -tA -taM, BfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, hInaH -nA -naM, cyutaH -tA -taM; ‘one who has forfeited his right,’ hftADikAraH -rA -raM, cyutADikAraH -rA -raM, aDikArAdBrazwaH -zwA -zwaM; ‘all his property,’ sarvvasvadaRqaH -RqA -RqaM, hftasarvvasvaH -svA -svaM; ‘his kingdom,’ rAjyA- -tpraBrazwaH -zwA -zwaM.
FORFEITURE: I The act: expr. by daRqaH or hAniH (= loss).II Anything forfeited: pramAdAddeyo daRqaH (?).

FORFEITURE , s. hAniH f., BraMSaH, apahAraH, cyutiH f., nASaH, apavarttanaM, vfdDiH f., daRqadAnaM; ‘of right,’ svatvahAniH f., aDikArahAniH, aDi- -kAraBraMSaH; ‘of property,’ vittahAniH f., dAyApavarttanaM.

Forge, v. t. Gaw c. (Gawayati), rac 10, nirmA 3 A, vi-DA 3 U, kxp c. 2 miTyA-kUwena-kf 8 U, kapawakUwa in comp.; ‘f(orge)s a letter’ kUwa-kapawa-leKaM prayuMkte; See Counterfeit. s. nirmARasTAnaM; agnikuMqaM, uDmAnaM. [Forg]er, s. kUwa-kAraH-kft m., kapawa-leKakArin m. [Forge]ry, s. kUwa-kapawa-leKa-karaRaM, kUwa-kapawa-karaRaM, kUwaracanA. [Forg]ing, s. GawanA, GawanaM, racanA-naM; kUwanirmARa, &c.
FORGE (subs.): (1) kuwilikA, Wilson;(2) udDmAnam (gen. term).

FORGE (v.t.): I To form, effect: q.v.: Gawayati (c. of Gaw).II To fabricate, expr. with kapawa or kUwa, to f. a grant: kUwaSAsanaM karoti; to use a f.d letter: kapawaleKaM prayuMkte: v. Counterfeit, false.
FORGE , s. kuwilikA, uDmAnaM, agnikuRqaM, taptalohaGawanasTAnaM, nirmmARasTAnaM.

To FORGE , v. a. (Metals) taptalohAdi muharAdinA tAqayitvA nAnArUpeRa Gaw (c. 10. Gawayati -yituM) or kuwilikAyAM vilApya Gaw or nirmA (c. 2. -mAti -tuM). — (Make) Gaw, nirmA, kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM), viDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), virac (c. 10. -racayati -yituM). — (Counterfeit) Calena or kapawena kxp or nirmmA, kUwaM kf, kapawaM kf; ‘forge a writ- -ing,’ kapawaleKyaM kf, kfwaleKaM kf.

FORGED , p. p. (Fabricated) GawitaH -tA -taM, kalpitaH -tA -taM, racitaH -tA -taM, nirmmitaH -tA -taM. — (Counterfeit) kAlpanikaH -kI -kaM, kftrimaH -mAM -maM, kapawI -winI -wi (n), kUwa or kapawa in comp.; as, ‘a forged document,’ kapawaleKyaM, kfwaleKaH; ‘a forged decree,’ kUwaSAsanaM; ‘forged coin,’ kUwasvarRaM.
FORGER: kUwakAraH, -kaH; kUwakft (m.); kapawaleKAdikAraH.
FORGER , s. kUwakaH, kUwakft m. -kAraH, kapawaleKyakArI m. (n), kUwale- -KyakArakaH, kapawikaH, kapawakArI m., kftrimaleKakft.
FORGERY: I The crime: kUwakaraRam (?), f. of a document: kapawaleKakaraRam.II Anything forged: expr. by kOwaH (wI, waM) or kOwikaH (kI, kaM).

Forget, v. t. vismf 1 P, na smf; smfteH-smara-RAdBraMS 1 A, 4 P or apa-i 2 P, (of what is forgotten). [Forget]ful, a. vismaraRa-SIla, lupta-nazwa-smfti; anavahita, pramatta, [Forget]fulness, s. vismfti f., vismaraRaM, smfti-lopaH, smftinASaH-BraMSaH-hAni f., vismaraRa-SIlatA, anavaDAnaM.
FORGET: (1) vismarati (smf, c. 1.), who f. s wrongs: yo'pakftaM vismarati, Mr. ii.;(2) na smarati, who f.s his mother land: kena janmaBUmirna smaryate, V.p.

To FORGET , v. a. vimmf (c. 1. -smarati -te -smarttuM), na smf, apasmf, smfter BraMS (c. 4. BraSyati, BraMSituM) with nom. of thing forgotten smftpapetaH -tA -taM Bf, vismaraRAt parityaj (c. 1. -tyajati -tyaktuM), avamarzaRaM kf.
FORGETFUL: (1) vismaraRaSIlaH (lA, laM);(2) svalpasmfti (mfn.), Mr.
FORGETFUL , a. vismaraRaSIlaH -lA -laM, vismArakaH -kA -kaM, nazwasaMsmftiH -tiH -ti, nazwasmftiH -tiH -ti, apasmftiH -tiH -ti, anavahitaH -tA -taM, pramattaH -ttA -ttaM.
FORGETFULNESS: (1) vismftiH;(2) vismaraRam;(3) asmaraRam;(4) smftilopaH, Sa. and sim. comp.s.

Forgive, v. t. kzam 1 A, (with acc. of person also), mfz 4 P, 10, sah 1 A, tij desid. (titikzate). (with acc. of fault). 2 muc 6 P, avasfj 6 P, tyaj 1 P, (as a debt). [Forgive]ness, s. kzamA, ti-tikzA, kzAMti f., sahizRutA, marzaRaM; ‘f(orgiveness) of sin’ pApa-doza-mukti f. -mArjanaM. [Forgiv]ing, a. kzamin, sahizRu, kzamAvat, kzamASIla, titikzu, kzamAyukta, kzaMtf, kzamitf.

FORGIVE: (1) kzamate or kzAmyati (kzam, c. l. and 4.), Śātānanda will not so easily f.: na tvevaM SatanandaH kzamizyate, Vi. iii.;(2) titikzate (titikz, c. 1.), please f. my misbehaviour: titikzatuM duScaritaM tvamarhasi, Ki. xviii. 42.;(3) marzayati or mfzyati (mfz, c. 10. and 4.), you should f. this fault: ayamaparADo BavatA marzayitavyaH, Sa. iv.;(4) sahate (sah, c. 1.), I will then f. this fault: aparADimamaM tataH sahizye, Sa. iii. N.B. Only kzam can take an acc. of the person.
FORGIVEN , p. p. kzAntaH -ntA -ntaM, dozamuktaH -ktA -ktaM, pApamuktaH -ktA -ktaM, vimocitaH -tA -taM, avamfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pApamArjjitaH -tA -taM.
FORGIVENESS: (1) kzamA;(2) titikzA;(3) sahizRutA.
FORGIVENESS , s. kzamA, kzAntiH f., pApamocanaM, pApamuktiH f., dozamuktiH f., aparADa- [Page286-b+ 51] sahizRutA, pApamArjanaM, vimocanaM, kfpA, dayA, marzaRaM; ‘of a debt,’ fRatyAgaH.
FORGIVING (adj.): (1) kzamin (f. RI);(2) kzamAvat (f. tI);(3) titikzu (mfn.);(4) sahizRu (mfn.) (= bearing up);(5) kfpAlu (mfn.) (=merci- -ful).
FORGIVING , a. kzamI -miRI -mi (n), kzamAvAn -vatI -vat (t), kzamAnvitaH -tA -taM, kzamAyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, aparADasahizRuH -zRuH -zRu, dayAluH -luH -lu, kfpAluH -luH -lu.
FORGOTTEN , p. p. vismftaH -tA -taM, asmftaH -tA -taM, smftiBrazwaH -zwA -zwaM, smftpapetaH -tA -taM, antargataH -tA -taM.
Fork, s. kaMwakaH, SUlaM. v. i. viBid pass., dviSiKIBU 1 P, dviDA Bid pass. [Fork]ed, [Fork]y, a. dviSiKa, dvyagra; ‘having a f(orked) tongue’ dvijihva; ‘f(orked) lightning’ vidyullatA.
FORK (subs): *kaRwakaH, three pronged f.: *trimuKa- kaRwakaH; caturdantakaRwakaH.
FORK , s. KAdyamAMsAdyuttolanArTaM SUlaviSezaH, kaRwakaH; ‘two-pronged,’ dviSiKaSUlaH, dvyagraSUlaH; ‘three-pronged,’ triSiKaSUlaH, tryagraSUlaH.
To FORK , v. n. (Divide in two) dviSiKaH -KA -KaM BU, dviSiKArUpeRa BinnIBU or viBid in pass. (-Bidyate), dviSiKIBU.
To FORK , v. a. pUrvvoktaSUlena uttul (c. 10. -tolayati -yituM) or utkzip (c. 6. -kzipati -kzeptuM).
FORKED (adj.): dvimuKaH (KA, KaM) (?).

FORTIETH , a. catvAriMSaH -SI -SaM, catvAriMSattamaH -mA -maM.

FORTIFICATION: I The works:(1) guptiH (= defences), the f.s are most inaccessible: alaNGyatamA guptiH, D.;(2) durgam (= fort), f. s naturally strong: prakftyA vizamaM durgam, Mah.;(3) prAkArapariKAdi (n.).II The operation: guptiH; durgakarman (n.), Mah. s. 86. 3.

FORTIFICATION , s. (The act) durgakaraRaM, pariKAprAcIrAdinirmmARaM, pAri kriyA. — (The works themselves) durgaM, prAcIraM, pariKA, nagarapari pariKAprAcIrAdi, parikUwaM, guptiH f., kuwaH, kUwaH, kowaH.
FORTIFICATION , s. (Science) durgaprAkArAdiracanavidyA.
FORTIFIED , p. p. pariKAprAcIrAdivezwitaH -tA -taM, prAcIrAvftaH -tA. guptaH -ptA -ptaM, sajjaH -jjA -jjaM, dfQIkftaH -tA -taM; ‘a fortified cit. durgapuraM, durganagaraM, prAcIrAdyAvftaM nagaraM.
FORTIFIER: expr. by verb, f. of a town: nagara- guptikAraH.
FORTIFIER , s. durgakArI m. (n), prAcIrakarttA m. (rttf), saMstamBakaH.

sanskrit.slp1: samantAdvihitA sapatAkA satoraRA . sacakrA sahuqA cEva
sanskrit.word: समन्ताद्विहिता सपताका सतोरणा . सचक्रा सहुडा चैव
sanskrit.iast: samantādvihitā sapatākā satoraṇā . sacakrā sahuḍā caiva

details.body: Fortify, v. t. dfQIkf, sTirIkf 8 U, draQayati (D.), saM-staMB 9 P or c. 2 sugupta-surakzita a. kf, pariKayA A-pari-vf 5 U or parivezw c. [Fortif]ication, s. gupti f., pariKA, prAcIraM, durgaM, kUwaH, kowaH, prAkArapariKAdi.

FORTIFY (v.): I In gen.: v. To strengthen, confirm.II To render defensible:(1) sugupta (f. ptAM) or surakzitaM (f. tAM) karoti, to f. strongly: paramAM guptiM karoti, Ka.;(2) by circumlo.: “purI samantAdvihitA sapatAkA satoraRA . sacakrA sahuqA cEva sayantraKanakA taTA .........saMkramA BeditAH sarve nAvaSca pratizeDitAH . pariKAScApi kOKya kIlEH sunicitAH kftAH .. udapAnAH kuruSrezWa taTEvApyambarIzakAH . samantAt koSamAtraYca kAritA vizamA ca BUH ..”, Mah. iii. 156.

To FORTIFY , v. a. (Surround with a wall, ditch, &c.) pariKA- prAcIrAdinA parivezw (c. 10. -vezwayati -yituM) or parivf (c. 5. -vfRoti -varituM -rItuM), durgaM kf. — (Confirm, strengthen) dfQIkf, sTirIkf, saMstamB (c. 5. -staBnoti -stamBituM).
FORTIORI A . (Argument) daRqApUpanyAyena vitarkaH.
Fortitude, s. DEryaM, sattvaM, DIratA, manaHsTEryaM. 2 vIryaM, SOryaM, vikramaH, sAhasaM, pOruzaM.
FORTITUDE: (1) DEryam;(2) DftiH (rare), R. viii. 66.
FORTITUDE , s. sTEryyaM, DEryyaM, DIratvaM, DftiH f., sTiratA, manaHsTEryyaM, cittasya sTEryyaM, vIryyaM, vIratA, SOryyaM, SUratA, sAhasaM, pOruzaM, nirBayatA.
Fortnight, s. pakzaH, mAsArDaM, arDamAsaH.
FORTNIGHT: (1) pakzaH, in three f.s: pakzatraye, L.s.; the dark f.: kfzRapakzaH; the light f.: SuklapakzaH;(2) mAsArdDam (= half a month).
FORTNIGHT , s. pakzaH, dvisaptAhaH, mAsArdDaM, ardDamAsaH.
FORTRESS: I A fort: q.v.: durgam.II A town: suguptaM nagaram and sim. expr.
FORTRESS , s. durgaM, kowiH f., kowaH, kUwaH, kuwaH, SiKarI m. (n), gulmaH, manTaraH; ‘governor of a fortress,’ durgADikArI m. (n), durgADyakzaH, kowipAlaH.
FORTUITOUS: (1) AkasimakaH (kI, kaM);(2) samApatti- in comp.: v. Accidental.

FORTUITOUS , a. AkasmikaH -kI -kaM, dEvikaH -kI -kaM, dEvADInaH -nA -naM, dEvAyattaH -ttA -ttaM, ApatikaH -kI -kaM, adfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, acintitaH -tA -taM, akasmAqGawitaH -tA -taM, akasmAdutpannaH -nnA -nnaM.
FORTUITOUSLY: dEvayogenaH v. Accidentally.
FORTUITOUSLY , adv. akasmAt, dEvAt, dEvayogAt, dEvavaSAt, adfzwavaSAt.
Fortuity, s. dEvayogaH-GawanA, dEvaM, samApatti f. [Fortuit]ous, a. dEvAyatta, dEvADIna, aciMtita, atarkitopanata, Akasmika (kI f.). [Fortuit]ously, adv. Accidentally, q. v.
FORTUITY , s. dEvayogaH, dEvaM, dEvADInatA, adfzwaM, AkasmikatvaM.

FORTUNATE: (1) BAgyavat (f. tI), considered him- self more f. than even Indra: maGavato'pi BAgyavanta- mAtmAnamajIgaRat, D. iv.;(2) suBAgya (f. gyA), ah! I am very f.: aho'tIva suBAgyA'ham, Mah.;(3) suBagaH (gA, gaM), vain of being. f. thinks himself beauti- ful: suBagamAnI sundarammanyaH, D. ii.;(4) DanyaH (nyA, nyaM) (= happy), f. are you: Danyo'si, Si;(5) maNgalya (f. lyA) (= auspicious: q.v.: of time etc.).

FORTUNATE , a. sOBAgyavAn -vatI -vat (t) or BAgyavAn, DanyaH -nyA -nyaM, pusvavAn -vatI -vat (t), SarmmavAn &c., SrImAn -matI -mat (t), naNgalaH -lA -laM, kalyARaH -RA -RaM -RI -RinI -Ri (n), SuBaH -BA -BaM, kuSalaH -lA -laM, kuSalaSAlI -linI -li (n), suKaBAgI -ginI -gi (n), mahABAgaH -gA -gaM, suBagaH -gA -gaM, sukftI -tinI -ti (n), lakzmIvAn &c., SrIyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, BadraH -drA -draM, SivaH -vA -vaM.
FORTUNATELY: (1) BAgyAt or BAgyena, sO-;(2) dizwyA, U.i.
FORTUNATELY , adv. sOBAgyena -gyAt, kalyARAt, kOSalyAt, mANgalyena, dizwyA, SriyA, suBagaM.
FORTUNATENESS , s. sOBAgyavattvaM, puRyavattvaM, DanyatA, kalyARatA, mANgalyaM.

Fortune, s. dEvaM, BAgyaM, BAgaDeyaM, viDiH, adfzwaM, BavitavyatA; See Fate. 2 fdDi f., SrIH, lakzmIH, ESvaryaM, saMpad f., saMpatti f., DanaM. 3 SuBaM, kalyARaM, BadraM, SivaM, sOBAgyaM, maMgalaM, puRyodayaH; ‘bad f(ortune)’ durdEvaM, dur-maMda-BAgyaM, dEvadurvipAkaH; ‘tell f(ortune)’ SuBASuBaM kaT 10 or ciMt 10 or nirUp 10 or Aloc 10; ‘f(ortune)-teller’ dEvajYaH; gaRakaH, kArtAMtikaH, dEva-ciMtakaH; ‘a female f(ortune)-teller’ vi-praSnikA, IkzaRikA, dEvajYA; ‘f(ortune)-telling’ Su-BASuBadarSanaM. [Fortun]ate, a. BAgyavat, mahABAga, suBAgya, suBaga, sOBAgyavat, dEvaSAlin, Danya, puRyavat, kftin, SrImat, puRyaBAj. 3 SuBa, kalyARa, Siva, maMgala, Badra. [Fortun]ately, adv. dEvAt, dEvaBogAt, dizwyA, sOBAgyena, BAgya-dEva-vaSAt.

FORTUNE: I The goddess:(1) SrIH;(2) lakzmIH, at home she is f.: iyaM gehe lakzmIH, U.II Chance, luck:(1) BAgyam, to conceal your good f.: AtmanaH sOBAgyaM niguhitum, V. ii.; (every thing) else depends on f.: BAgyADInamataHparam, Sa. iv.;(2) dEvam: v. Fate.III Wealth; possessions: (1) fdDiH;(2) samfdDiH;(3) ESvaryam. Ph.: to tell f. s: SuBASuBaM vadati, kaTayati, etc.: v. To tell.

FORTUNE , s. (Goddess) lakzmIH, SrIH. — (Chance, destiny) dEvaM, BAgyaM, BAgaDeyaM, BavitavyatA, dEvayogaH, dEvadaSA, adfzwaM, kftAntaH, niyatiH f., viDiH m., gatiH f., dEvikaM, dizwaM, rizwaM, kAlaniyogaH. — (Good for- tune) sOBAgyaM, kalyARaM, BadraM, SuBaM, SivaM, maNgalaM, mANgalyaM, kuSalaM -latA, kOSalyaM, SrIH, lakzmIH, sampattiH f., sampad f., Sarmma n. (n), ayaH, puRyodayaH; ‘bad fortune,’ durBAgyaM, dudErvaM.
To FORTUNE , v. n. dEvAd Gaw (c. 1. Gawate -wituM) or sampad (c. 4. -padyate -pattuM),

sanskrit.slp1: vivAhArTaM DanavatIM strIm anvipyati yo janaH
sanskrit.word: विवाहार्थं धनवतीं स्त्रीम् अन्विप्यति यो जनः
sanskrit.iast: vivāhārthaṃ dhanavatīṃ strīm anvipyati yo janaḥ

details.body: FORTUNE-HUNTER: ESvaryalipsu (mfn.) and sim comp.s.
FORTUNE-HUNTER , s. vivAhArTaM DanavatIM strIm anvipyati yo janaH.
FORTUNE-TELLER: (1) dEvaJa (f. JA);(2) vipraSnikA (= female f.);(3) kArtAntikaH (rare), D.: v. Also soothsayer.
FORTUNE-TELLER , s. dEvajYaH -jYA, vipraSnikA, gaRakaH -kI, maNgalAdeSavfttaH, maNgalAmaNgalAdeSI m. (n), AdeSI m., SuBASuBadarSanAjIvaH, kArttAntikaH.
FORTUNE-TELLING: SuBASuBakaTanam and sim. comp.s.
FORTUNE-TELLING , s. dEvapraSnaH, SuBASuBadarSanaM, maNgalAdeSaH, jAtakaM.
Forty, a. catvAriMSat f. Fortieth, a. catvAriMSa (SI f.), -Sattama (mI f.).
FORTY: catvAriMSat (f.), f. times: catvAriMSadvArAn.
FORTY , s. catvAriMSat f. sing.; ‘forty-one,’ ekacatvAriMSat; ‘forty- -two,’ dvAcatvAriMSat; ‘forty-three,’ trayaScatvAriMSat; ‘forty-four,’ catuScatvAriMSat.
FORUM: aDikaraRam, -maRqapaH (?).

Forward, a. agrima, Adima, agrasTa, puro-gAmin. 2 apUrRakAla, AkAlika (kI f.). 3 Dfzwa, pragalBa, nirlajja, pratiBAnavat, sapratiBa, avinIta. 4 udyata, vyagra, udyukta, pratyutpanna, avilaMbita. v. t. saM-pra-vfD c., upakf 8 U, puraskf, pra-vft c., samudyuj 10, sAhAyyaM kf, unnatiM nI 1 P, anugrah 9 P. 2 prer c., pra-cud 10, pra-hi 5 P. 3 Accelerate, q. v. adv. (‘f(orward)s’) agrataH, purataH; puraH, agre, pura-stAt, saM-aBi-muKaM; ‘this day f(orward)’ adya pra-Bfti; ‘to go backward and f(orward)’ gatAgataM kf; See Forth. [Forward]ness, s. utsAhaH, avilaMbaH, udyogaH. 2 prAgalByaM, nirlajjatA, DArzwyaM, ati-prasaMgaH, avinayaH, pratiBAnaM.

FORWARD (adj.): I In place:(1) agrimaH (mA, maM);(2) agrasTaH (sTA, sTaM).II Early: (1) SIGrapakva (f. kvA) (= precocious);(2) AkAlikaH (kI, kaM) (= untimely), a f. spring: AkAlikI maDupravfttiH, Ku. iii. 34.III Bold, confident: q.v.: pragalBa (f. lBA).
FORWARD (v.): I To send on: q.v.: prerayati (Ir, c. 10.).II To hasten: q.v.: tvarayati (c. of tvar).III To promote: varDayati (c. of vfD).
FORWARD, FORWARDS (adv.): (1) agrataH;(2) purataH. To go f.: puraH sarati; to go backwards and f.: parikrAmati; from this day f.: adyAraBya, adyapraBfti; f.: puro Baba, Ku.

FORWARD , a. (At the fore-part) agrasTaH -sTA -sTaM, sammuKasTaH -sTA -sTaM, sammuKInaH -nA -naM, prazWaH -zWA -zWaM. — (Prompt, eager) udyuktaH -ktA -ktaM, udyataH -tA -taM, pratyutpannaH -nnA -nnaM, avilambaH -mbA -mbaM, prastutaH -tA -taM, vyagraH -grA -graM, pragalBaH -lBA -lBaM, pracaRqaH -RqA -RqaM. — (Bold) nirlajjaH -jjA -jjaM, pragalBaH -lBA -lBaM, sapratiBaH -BA -BaM, pratiBAnavAn -vatI -vat (t). — (Before its time) apUrRakAlaH -lA -laM, AkAlikaH -kI -kaM, AkAlaBavaH -vA -vaM, prAkpUrRakAlAt pakvaH -kvA -kvaM. — (Advanced in learning) kftAgamaH -mA -maM, kftavidyAgamaH -mA -maM. — (Anterior) agraH -grA -graM.

FORWARD , adv. (In front) agraM, agratas, puras, puratas, purastAt, aBitas, aBimuKaM, pratimuKaM, sammuKaM, or expressed by pra or A; ‘going forward,’ pragamanaM, prasTAnaM, agragamanaM; ‘to go forward and backward,’ pratigatAgataM kf, gatAgataM kf, gamanAgamane kf, yAtAyAtaM kf; ‘from this day forward,’ adyAraBya, adyapraBfti, aDunAraBya, adyAvaDi.

To FORWARD , v. a. (Advance, promote) puraskf, upakf, sAhAyyaM kf, sahAyatvaM kf, prayuj (c. 10. -yojayati -yituM), udyuj, pravfD (c. 10. -varDa- -yati -yituM), pravft (c. 10. -varttayati -yituM), udyogaM kf. — (Accelerate) tvara in caus. (tvarayati -yituM), santvar. — (Send forward) prer (c. 10. [Page288-b+ 51] -Irayati -yituM), puraskf.
FORWARDED , p. p. puraskftaH -tA -taM, preritaH -tA -taM, saYcAritaH -tA -taM.
FORWARDNESS: I Promptness, eagerness: q.v.: utsAhaH.II Boldness, impudence: q.v.: pragalBatA.III Precociousness: SIGrapAkaH.

FORWARDNESS , s. (Promptness) pratyutpannatA, udyogaH, udyamaH, utsAhaH, udyuktatA, sayatnatA, pravfttiH f., avilambaH. — (Eagerness) pracaRqatA, vyagratA, tIkzRatA. — (Boldness) pragalBatA, prAgalByaM, nirlajjatvaM, pratiBA -BAnaM. — (Advance before the usual time) prAkpUrRakAlAt pakvatA. — (In learning, &c.) vidyAgamaH, AgamaH.
Fosse, s. KAtaM, pariKA.
FOSSE: KAtam: v. Dich, moat.
FOSSE , s. pariKA, KAtaM -takaM, KAtaBUH f., KeyaM, aKAtaM, avawaH.
Fossick, v. t. lABAya, anviz 4 P.
Fossil, a. SilAjAta. s. DAtuH; SilABavaM, DAtudravyaM; utKAtadravyaM. [Fossil]ist, s. DAtuvidyAjYaH.
FOSSIL: I Dug out: utKAtaH (tA, taM).II Petrified: SilIBUtaH (tA, taM).
FOSSIL , s. DAtuH m., DAtudravyaM, upaDAtuH m., SilAjaM, SilABavaM, SilotpannaM, SilodBavaM, utKAtadravyaM, prastaraH.
FOSSIL , a. SilAjaH -jA -jaM, SiloqBavaH -vA -vaM, utKAtaH -tA -taM.
FOSSILIST , s. SilAjadravyaguRaDarmmAditattvajYaH, GAtuvidyAjYaH.

Foster, v. t. puz 1, 9 P; pA c. (pAlayati), pra-saM-vfD c., Bf 3 U, lal 10. 2 (Love, hatred, &c.) Df 10, vah 1 P, baMD 9 P; ‘f(oster)-brother’ DAtreyaH, DAtrIputraH; ‘f((oster))-child’ pozyaputraH (trI f.), parAcitaH; pariskaM(zkaM)-daH, pariska(zka)nnaH; parajAtaH, parEDitaH; ‘f(oster) father’ pAlakapitf m., pratipAlakaH, DarmatAtaH; ‘f((oster))-mother’ DAtrI, upamAtf f., pratipAlikA; aMkapAlikA, mAtfkA, DAtreyI.
FOSTER: puzRAti or pozayati (puz, c. 9. and 10.): v. To nourish.

To FOSTER , v. a. pup (c. 1. popati, c. 9. puzRAti, pozituM, c. 10. poza- -yati -yituM), paripuz, pAl (c. 10. pAlayati -yituM), pratipAl, vfD in caus. (varDayati -yituM), saMvfD, pravfD, Bf (c. 1. Barati -te, BarttuM), anugrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM), lal (c. 10. lAlayati -yituM), tejo vfD, upakf.
FOSTER-BROTHER: (1) DAtreyaH;(2) DAtrIputraH and sim. comp.s.
FOSTER-BROTHER , s. DAtrIputraH, ekastanapAyI BrAtA m. (tf).
FOSTER-CHILD: (1) pozyaputraH (f. trI);(2) parizka(ska)nda(nna) (f. ndA or nnA) (rare).
FOSTER-CHILD , s. pozyaputraH -trI, pariskannaH -skandaH, parizkandaH -zkannaH, paraBftaH -tA.
FOSTER-DAM , s. DAtrI, DAtreyikA, pratipAlikA, aNkapAlI.
FOSTER-EARTH , s. DAtrI mfttikA, pozaRaBUmiH f., pratipAlakaBUmiH f.
FOSTER-FATHER: pAlakapitf (m.); DAtf (m.) (rare).
FOSTER-FATHER , s. DAtA m. (tf), pAlakapitA m. (tf), pratipAlakaH, annadAtA m. (tf).
FOSTER-MOTHER: (1) mAtfkA;(2) upamAtf: v. Nurse.
FOSTER-MOTHER , s. DAtrI, DAtreyikA, papuH f., aNkapAlI, mAtfkA.
FOSTER-MOTHER , s. upamAtA f. (tf), pAlakamAtA.
FOSTER-SISTER: DAtreyI, by Mālatī's f. Lavangikā: mAlatIDAtreyyA lavaNgikayA, Ma. i.
FOSTER-SISTER , s. DAtreyikA, DAtreyI, ekastanapAyinI svasA f. (sf).
FOSTER-SON: (1) pozyaputraH;(2) pAlitasutaH and sim. comp.s.
FOSTER-SON , s. pozyaputraH, pozyasutaH, pozyasantAnaH, pariskannaH.

FOSTERED , p. p. pozitaH -tA -taM, puzwaH -zwA -zwaM, pAlitaH -tA -taM, pratipA- litaH -tA -taM, varDitaH -tA -taM, saMvarDitaH -tA -taM, BartrimaH -mA -maM — (By another) paraBftaH -tA -taM, parapuzwaH -zwA -zwaM, anyavarDitaH -tA -taM.
FOSTERER: (1) pozakaH, pari-;(2) pAlayitf (m); (3) DAtf (m.) (rare).
FOSTERER , s. pAlakaH, pratipAlakaH, pAlayitA m. (tf), pozakaH, pozwA m. (zwf).
FOSTERING (adj.): (1) pozakaH (f. zikA) (?); pA(lA)lakaH (f. likA) (?).

Foul, a. malina, samala, aSuci, kaluza, mala-dUzita, malImasa, Avila, aSudDa, apavitra, ameDya, paMkila. 2 kutsita, kaSmala, garhya, niMdya, duzwa. 3 avAcya, aSizwa, aSlIla (language). 4 kUwa, kapawa, pApa, in comp.; ‘f(oul) means’ kapawaprabaMDaH; ‘even by f(oul) means’ duritErapi (R. viii. 2); ‘f(oul) play’ duritaM, pApaM; ‘f(oul) weather’ durdinaM; ‘f(oul) quality’ rajoguRaH; ‘f(oul) smell’ pUti-gaMDaH, durgaMDaH; ‘fall f(oul) of’ upari pat 1 P, parasparaM A-han 2 U or saMGawwa 1 A; ‘f(oul)-mouthed’ durmuKa, vAgduzwa, kawuvAca, muKara, parivAdin. v. t. malinayati-kaluzayati-A-vilayati (D.); duz c. (dUzayati). [Foul]ly, adv. atiduzwaM, GoraM, malinaM. [Foul]ness, s. mAlinyaM, garhyatA, &c.
FOUL (v.t.): kaluzayati (nomi.): v. To befoul.

FOUL (adj.): I Dirty: q.v.:(1) malapUrRa (f. rRA) (= full of dirt);(2) aSuci (mfn.), ameDya (f. DyA), etc. (= impure), in a ditch full of f. (matter): aSucisaMpUrRe KAtake, K.s. xiii. 148.II Obscene, abusive: q.v.: aSlIlaH (lA, laM). III Abominable, detestable: q.v.: malinaH (nA, naM), K.IV Unfair, fraudulent: q.v.: kUwa- in comp., f. play: kUwavyavahAraH.V Unfavour- -able: q.v. Ph.: f. weather: durdinam; fall f. of: upari patati.

FOUL , a. (Filthy, impure) malinaH -nA -naM, samalaH -lA -laM, malavAn -vatI -vat (t), malImasaH -sA -saM, malIyAn -yasI -yaH (s), maladUzitaH -tA -taM, kaluzaH -zA -zaM -zI -ziRI -zi (n), ameDyaH -DyA -DyaM, kutsitaH -tA -taM, kaSmalaH -lA -laM, AvilaH -lA -laM, apavitraH -trA -traM, aSudDaH -dDA -dDaM. — (Muddy) malapaNkI -NkinI -Nki (n), paNkilaH -lA -laM, kArddamaH -mI -maM. — (Detestable) garhitaH -tA -taM, garhyaH -rhyA -rhyaM. — (Wicked) duzwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (Obscene) avAcyaH -cyA -cyaM. — (Unfair) kUwakaH -kA -kaM, vizamaH -mA -maM, kUwa in comp.; ‘foul play,’ kUwatA. — (Unfavourable) ananukUlaH -lA -laM. — (Foul weather) durddinaM. — (Foul air) pUtivAtaH; ‘foul smell,’ pUtiganDaH; ‘to fall foul of each other,’ pratimuKam Agatya parasparaM SarIrasamAGAtaM kf.
To FOUL , v. a. malina (nom. malinayati -yituM), duz in caus. (dUzayati -yituM), kaluza (nom. kaluzayati -yituM), Avila (nom. Avilayati -yituM), samalIkf.
FOUL-FEEDING , a. malaBuk m. f. n., malaBojI -jinI -ji (n), kutsitAhAraBuk.
FOUL-MOUTHED: (1) vAgaduzwa (f. zwA);(2) aSlIla- vAdin (f. nI), etc.
FOUL-MOUTHED , a. durmuKaH -KI -KaM, vAgduzwaH -zwA -zwaM, muKaraH -rA -raM, abadDamuKaH -KA -KaM, muKaSaPaH -PA -PaM, muKazWIlaH -lA -laM, kawuBAzI -ziRI -zi (n).
FOULLY: (1) malinama (= dirtily);(2) aSlIlam (= obscenely);(3) garhitam. (=abominably); better by adj.
FOULLY , adv. malinaM, samalaM, ameDyaM, kutsitaM, garhitaM, atiduzwaM.
FOULNESS: (1) malinatA;(2) aSlIlatA (= obs- -cenity);(3) ameDyatA (= impurity, dis- -honesty): v. Also foul.
FOULNESS , s. mAlinyaM, samalatA, malavattvaM, kaluzatvaM, kAluzyaM, ameDyatA -tvaM, aSudDatA, apavitratvaM, aSucitvaM, kutsitatvaM, garhyatA, pUtitvaM.

Found, v. t. sTA c. (sTApayati), prati-saM-ava-ruh c. (ropayati), nirmA 3 A or c. (mApayati), baMD 9 P, pravft c., AraB 1 A; mUla, nibaMDana, nizWA, in comp.; ‘attachment f(ound)ed on love’ premamUlA-BAvanibaMDanA-ratiH; ‘f(ound)ed on ignorance’ ajYAnaja, ajYAna-mUla-laka, avidyAkalpita. [Found]ation, s. pratizWApanaM, saMsTApanaM; nirmARaM. 2 vAstu m., n., powaH, grahapratizWA, gfhamUlaM, BittimUlaM, veSmaBUH. 3 (Fig.) mUlaM, ADAraH, upazwaMBaH. [Found]er, s. saMsTApakaH, pravartakaH, AraMBakaH, Adikartf m., pratizWApakaH, kartf m. prayojakaH. v. i. jalamajjanena naS 4 P, jale masj 6 P. [Found]ling, s. apavidDabAlakaH, utsfzwApatyaM.

FOUND (v.t.): I In gen.:(1) sTApayati, prati-, (c. of sTA) (= to establish: q.v.);(2) nirmimIte (mA, c. 3.) (= to build: q.v.);(3) mUla (= root) in comp., f. ed on love: premamUlaH (lA, laM).II To cast: saM-daDAti (DA, c. 3.) (?).
FOUND , p. p. AsAditaH -tA -taM, samAsAditaH -tA -taM, aDigataH -tA -taM prAptaH -ptA -ptaM, prapannaH -nnA -nnaM, nirUpitaH -tA -taM; ‘having found,’ AsAdya

To FOUND , v. a. (Lay the foundation) mUlaM nyas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM) or DA (c. 3. daDAti, DAtu) or ruh in caus. (ropayati -yituM). — (Build) nirmA (c. 2. -mAti -tuM or in caus. mApayati -yituM), kf in caus. (kArayati -yituM). — (Establish) sTA in caus. (sTApayati -yituM), pratizWA, avasTA, saMsTA, ruh in caus., pratiniDA.

FOUNDATION: I Groundwork:(1) BittimUlam (lit. and fig.), lay the f. stone of a college: *vidyAlayasya mittimUlaprastaraM nyasyati;(2) BUmiH (= ground).II Endowment: vfttiH, f. scholarship: *mUlavfttiH.III Establishment: sTApanam, prati-.

FOUNDATION , s. (Of a house) BittimUlaM, BittiH f., gfhaBUmiH f., veSmaBUH f., vAstuH m. -stu n., gfhapotakaH, potaH, powaH, kuwwimaM, sutalaH, talimaM, gfhapratizWA. — (Basis of any thing) mUlaM, vastu n., upazwamBaH, aDoBAgaH. — (Endowment) pratizWA; ‘to lay the foundation of a house,’ izwakAnyAsaM kf, BittinyAsaM kf.
FOUNDED , p. p. pratizWApitaH -tA -taM, ropitaH -tA -taM, nyastamUlaH -lA -laM, sTApitaH -tA -taM, nirmmitaH -tA -taM, mUlaH -lA -laM; as, ‘founded on knowledge,’ jYAnamUlaH -lA -laM.
FOUNDER (subs.): I In gen.;(1) sTApakaH, prati- (= establisher):(2) nirmAtf (m.) (=buil- -der);(3) kAraH (= author);(4) mUlam; (=root). II Caster: saMDAtf (m.) (?).
FOUNDER (v.): I Lit.: jalAvizwaH (zwA, zwaM) naSyati (naS, c. 4.): v. Also to sink.II To fail, miscarry: naSyati.
FOUNDER , s. sTApakaH, praTamasTApakaH, pratizWApakaH, nirmmAtA m. (tf), prayojakaH, pravarttakaH, AramBakaH, AdikarttA m. (rttf); ‘of a religion,’ pravarttakAcAryyaH. — (Caster of metals) vyokAraH.
To FOUNDER , v. n. samudramaDye jalAvizwatvAd majj (c. 6. majjati -jjituM).
FOUNDERED , p. p. samrudramaDye jalAvizwatvAt pramagnaH -gnA -gnaM or magnaH.
Foundery, s. saMDAnI, kupyaSAlA.
FOUNDERY, FOUNDRY: (1) sanDAnI;(2) kupyaSAlA.
FOUNDERY , FOUNDRY, s. sanDAnI, kuzyaSAlA, lohAdivilayanaSAlA.
FOUNDLING: apavidDabAlaH (f. lA), f. hospital: *anATa- bAlASramaH.
FOUNDLING , s. tyaktabAlakaH, ujJitabAlakaH, mAtfpitfvirahito bAlaH, utsfzwabAlaH, anuddizwapitfko bAlakaH.
FOUNDRESS: (1) sTApayitrI, prati-;(2) sTApikA, prati-.
FOUNDRESS , s. sTApakI, praTamasTApakA, nirmmAtrI, pravarttakA, AramBakarttrI.
Fount, Fountain, s. nirJaraH, utsaH, pra-sravaRaM, vAripravAhaH. 2 mUlaM, yoni f., praBavaH, hetuH, AdihetuH. 3 DArAyaMtraM (‘artificial f(ountain)’).
FOUNT, FOUNTAIN: I Lit.:(1) prasravaRam;(2) nirBkaraH;(3) utsaHII Source:(1) mUlam;(2) yoniH;(3) prasUH or prasUtiH (= mother), Ki. III Of types: v. Font.

FOUNT , FOUNTAIN, s. praSravaRaM, nirJaraH, JaraH -rA -rI, sravaH, jalAkaraH, utsaH, prapA, kUpaH; ‘artificial,’ SfNgaM. — (Source, original) mUlaM, yoniH m. f., AdiH m., hetuH m. — (Of types). See FONT.

Four, a. catur, catuzwaya; ‘f(our) times’ catuH; ‘in f(our) ways’ caturDA; ‘f(our)-cornered’ caturasra-Sra; ‘f(our)-fold’ caturguRa; ‘f(our)-footed’ catuzpAd, catuzpAda; ‘f(our) score’ aSIti f. Fourth, a. caturTa (rTI f.), turya, turIya. s. caturTaBAgaH, pAdaH, caturTAMSaH; turIyaH, turyaH, turyAMSaH; ‘a rupee and one f(ourth)’ sapAdarUpakaH. [Fourth]ly, adv. caturTasTAne. Fourteen, a. caturdaSan. [Fourteen]th, a. caturdaSa (SI f.).

FOUR: catur (mfn.), f. times: catuH; of f. kinds: caturviDaH (DA, DaM), aggregate of f.: catuzwayam; in f. ways: caturDA; f. hundred: catuHSatam; the f. objects of human pursuit (virtue, wealth, love, and sal- vation): caturvargaH; an army complete in its four parts-horse, foot, car and elephants: caturaNgabalam.

FOUR , a. catvAraH m. pl. catasraH f. pl. catvAri n. pl. (catur), catuzwayaH -yI -yaM. The neut. of this last word expresses ‘the aggregate of four,’ and sometimes ‘four’ itself; as, ‘four hours,’ daRqacatuzwayaM; ‘in four ways,’ caturviDaH -DA -DaM, caturDA; ‘four times,’ catuH ind., catuHkftvas ind.
FOUR-CORNERED: (1) caturasra (f. srA);(2) catuzkoRa (f. RA).
FOUR-CORNERED , a. caturasraH -srA -sraM, catuzkoRaH -RA -RaM.
FOUR-FACED , a. (Brahmā) caturmuKaH, caturAnanaH, caturvadanaH, caturvaktaH.
FOUR-FOLD , a. caturguRaH -RA -RaM, caturviDaH -DA -DaM, catuHprakAraH -rA -raM, catuzwayaH -yI -yaM, caturaNgI -NginI -Ngi (n), caturDA.
FOUR-FOOTED: (1) catuzpadaH (dI, daM);(2) catuzpAd (mfn.).
FOUR-FOOTED , a. catuzpAdaH -dA -daM, catuzpadaH -dA -daM, catuzpAd m. f. n.
FOUR-WHEELED: catuScakraH (krA, kraM).
FOUR-WHEELED , a. catuScakraH -krA -kraM, catuScakrayuktaH -ktA -ktaM.
FOURFOLD: (1) caturguRaH (RA, RaM);(2) by adv.: caturvArAn;(3) caturDA (in f. ways).
FOURSCORE: aSItiH: v. Eighty.
FOURSCORE , a. aSItiH f. sing., aSItisaMKyakaH -kA -kaM, viMSakacatuzwayaM; ‘fourscore years of age,’ aSItikaH -kA -kaM.
FOURSQUARE: samacaturasra (f. srA): v. Square.
FOURSQUARE , a. caturasraH -srA -sraM, catuzkoRaH -RA -RaM.
FOURTEEN: caturdaSan (mfn.) F. th: caturdaSaH (SI, SaM).
FOURTEEN , a. caturdaSa m. f. n. (n), caturdaSasaMKyakaH -kA -kaM, saptadvayaM.
FOURTEENTH , a. caturdaSaH -SI -SaM.
FOURTH (adj.): (1) caturTaH (rTA, rTaM);(2) turIyaH (yA, yaM);(3) turyaH (ryA, ryaM). In the f. place: caturTataH; for the f. time: caturTavAram.
FOURTH (subs.): I Lit.:(1) caturBAgaH;(2) pAdaH, three f. s: pAdatrayam, Li.: v. Quarter.II The f. note in music: zaqjaH.
FOURTH , a. caturTaH -rTA -rTI -rTaM, turIyaH -yA -yaM -yakaH -kA -kaM, turyyaH -ryyA -ryyaM, pAdikaH -kI -kaM; ‘a fourth part,’ caturBAgaH, caturTAMSaH, pAdaH, pAdinaH.
FOURTHLY: (1) caturTataH;(2) turIyataH (rare).
FOURTHLY , adv. caturTatas, turIyatas, caturTasTAne, caturTapade.

Fowl, s. KagaH, pakzin m., SakunaH; See Bird. 2 kukkuwaH, tAmracUqaH, caraRAyuDaH. v. i. pakziRo grah or baMD 9 P or Df 1 P. [Fowl]er, s. SAkunikaH, vyADaH. SakunilubDaH, jAlikaH, lubDakaH, pakzigrAhakaH, jIvAMtakaH. [Fowl]ing, s. pakzigrahaRaM-vaDaH-GAtaH.
FOWL (v.i.): pakziRo hanti (han, c. 2.), etc.; always f. ing in the forest: dvijAn hatvA vane sadA, Mah.

FOWL , s. (A winged animal) pakzI m. -kziRI f. (n), KagaH, vihagaH, vihaNgamaH, patagaH, patatrI m. (n), SakunaH, SakuniH m. — (Gallina- -ceous or domestic fowl) kukkuwaH -wI, caraRAyuDaH, kfkavAkuH m., tAmracUqaH; ‘wild-fowl,’ rajjudAlakaH.

To FOWL , v. n. pakziRo grah (c. 9. gfhlAti, grahItuM) or Df (c. 1. Darati, DarttuM) or banD (c. 9. baDnAti, banDuM), Sakuna (nom. Sakunayati -yituM), [Page289-b+ 51] pakzibaDena upajIv (c. 1. -jIvati -vituM).
FOWLER: (1) SAkunikaH;(2) SakunilubDakaH, P. iii. 7.;(3) vihaNgahan (m.), Mah.
FOWLER , s. vyADaH, SAkunikaH, lubDakaH, jAlikaH, vAgurikaH, pakzigrAhakaH, pakzibanDI m. (n), pakzibaDajIvI m. (n).
FOWLING: pakziGAtaH. F. -piece: *pakziGAtayantram.
FOWLING , s. pakziDaraRaM, pakzigrahaRaM, pakziGataH, pakzibaDaH, pakzimAraRaM.
FOWLING-PIECE , s. pakzimAraRe prayuktA laDvI AgneyanAqI.
Fox, s. SfgAlaH, ki(Ki)KiH, KiMkiraH, BUrimAyaH, gomAyuH; See Jackal; ‘f(ox)-hunt’ SfgAlAnusaraRaM; ‘f(ox)-like’ vidagDa, DUrta, bahumAya.
FOX: I Lit.:(1) KiKiH or kiKiH;(2) KiNgiraH. II Fig.: a sly rogue: DUrtaH.
FOX , s. lomaSA -SI, lomAlikA, ulkAmuKI, SfgAlaH -lI -likA, kiKiH f., KiKiH f., KiNKiraH -rA -krozwA m. (zwu), BUrimAyaH; ‘flying- fox,’ vAtuliH f., valgulaH.
FOX-GLOVE: OzaDiBedaH; *KiKipAdaH.
FOX-GLOVE , s. raktapuzpo dvivarzIRa ozaDiBedaH.
FOX-HOUND , s. SfgAlAKewikaH, lomaSAKewakaH, SfgAlAdyanusaraRe Sikzito mfgavyakukkuraH, SfgAlAriH m.
FOX-HUNT , s. SfgAlAnusaraRaM, SfgAlAKewaH, lomaSAdyanuDAvanaM.
FOX-HUNTER , s. SfgAlAKewakaH, SfgAlAnusArI m. (n), lomaSAnuDAvakaH.
FOX-LIKE , a. bahumAyaH -yA -yaM, SfgAlaDarmmA -rmmA -rmma (n), vidagDaH -gDA -gDaM.
Fracas, s. kalahaH.
Fraction, s. BinnaM, BAgaH, apUrRAMkaH, rASi-BAgaH. [Fraction]al, a. apUrRa, BAgika (kI f.), BAgin.
FRACTION: I In arith: Binnam, -rASiH, multipli- cation of f.s: BinnaguRanam, Li.II A portion, fragment: q.v.

FRACTION , s. (In arithmetic) BinnaM, BAgaH, aMSaH, rASiH m. f., rASi- -BAgaH, apUrRaH; ‘multiplication of fractions,’ BinnaguRanaM; ‘addi- -tion,’ BinnasaNkalitaM; ‘subtraction,’ BinnavyavakalitaM; ‘division,’ BinnaBAgaharaH; ‘square of a fraction,’ BinnavargaH; ‘cube,’ BinnaGanaM; ‘assimilation of fractions,’ BAgajAtiH f.
FRACTION , s. apUrRANkaH; ‘vulgar f.,’ SudDApUrRANkaH; ‘common mea- sure of a f.,’ apavarttaH -rttakaH; ‘reduction of a fraction to a common denominator,’ savarRanaM, aMSasavarRanaM.
FRACTIONAL , a. BAgikaH -kI -kaM, BAgI -ginI -gi (n), apUrRaH -rRA -rRaM.
Fractious, a. kalahakArin, SIGrakopa; vAmaSIla.
FRACTIOUS , a. kalahakArI -riRI -ri (n), sulaBakopaH -pA -paM, pratIpaH -pA -paM.
FRACTIOUSLY , adv. kalahakArivat, kalahakaraRArTaM, pratIpavat.
Fracture, s. BaMgaH, BedaH, vidAraRaM, trowanaM, viBaMgaH, viBedaH. v. t. BaMj 7 P, Bid 7 P, vidF 10; See Break.
FRACTURE (subs.): (1) BaNgaH, f. of the bones: asTnAM BaNgaH, Sr.;(2) Bagnam, a f. heals with diffi- culty: BagnaM kfcCre Ra siDyati, Sr.
FRACTURE (v.t.): Banakti (BaYj, c. 7.): v. To break.
FRACTURE , s. BaNgaH, BedaH, viBaNgaH, BaYjanaM, BedanaM, viBedaH, BaktiH f., praBaNgaH, KaRqanaM, vidAraRaM. — (Of a bone) asTiBaNgaH, asTiBedaH, asTitrowanaM.

To FRACTURE , v. a. BaYj (c. 7. Banakti, BaMktuM), praBaYj, viBaYj, Bid (c. 7. Binatti, BettuM), viBid, KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM), vidF (c. 10. -dAra- -yati -yituM), SakalIkf. — (A bone) asTi BaYj or Bid or truw (c. 10. trowayate -yituM).
FRACTURED , p. p. BagnaH -gnA -gnaM, BinnaH -nnA -nnaM, KaRqitaH -tA -taM, viBinnaH -nnA -nnaM, rugnaH -gnA -gnaM, vidIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, SakalIkftaH -tA -taM, truwitaH -tA -taM.
Fragile, a. BaMgura, BaMgaSIla, Bidura, Bidelima, suKaBedya, suBaMga; vinaSvara, kzayin. [Fragil]ity, s. BaMguratA, kzayitA, BiduratA.
FRAGILE: (1) BaNguraH (rA, raM);(2) suBaNga (f. NgA) (3) BaNgaSIlaH (lA, laM).
FRAGILE , a. BaNguraH -rA -raM, BiduraH -rA -raM, suBaNgaH -NgA -NgaM, suBedyaH -dyA -dyaM, suKaBedyaH -dyA -dyaM, suKaRqanIyaH -yA -yaM, vinaSvaraH -rA -raM.
FRAGILITY: (1) BaNguratA;(2) BaNgaSIlatA;(3) suBaNgatA.
FRAGILITY , s. BaNguratvaM -tA, BiduratA, suBaNgatvaM, suBedyatA, suKaRqanIyatA, vinaSvaratvaM, komalatA, kzayitA, kzIRatA.
Fragment, s. KaMqaH-qaM, SakalaH-laM, BAgaH, aMSaH, dalaM, BinnaM; ‘in a thousand f(ragment)s’ sahasraDA. [Fragment]ary, a. apUrRa, BAgin, KaMqayukta.
FRAGMENT: I Lit.:(1) KaRqa (mn.), in f.s: KaRqaSaH;(2) Savala (mn.) (rare).II Of a work: perh. KaRqa (mn.).

FRAGMENT , s. KaRqaH -RqaM -RqakaH, BinnaM, BittaM, BittiH f., dalaM, vidalaM, BAgaH, aMSaH, SakalaH -laM, apUrRaH, viqaM, viq f., vikiraH, CaH, AdizwaM; ‘in fragments,’ KaRqaSas, KaRqaM KaRqaM, BAgaSas; ‘in a thousand fragments,’ sahasraKaRqaSaH, sahasraDA.

sanskrit.iast: locanagranthāvatra khaṇḍitāveva sta iti na tau sampūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭau”

details.body: FRAGMENTARY: KaRqitaH (tA, taM), “vyaktiviveka- locanagranTAvatra KaRqitAveva sta iti na tO sampUrRaM dfzwO”, Mahesh.
FRAGMENTARY , a. KaRqI -RqinI -Rqi (n), BAgI -ginI -gi (n), KaRqamayaH -yI -yaM.
FRAGRANCE, FRAGRANCY: (1) sOraBam or sOramyam; (2) parimalaH;(3) AmodaH;(4) suganDiH, suganDaH or sOganDyam.
FRAGRANCE , FRAGRANCY, s. suganDaH, suganDiH m. -nDitA, sOganDyaM, ganDaH, upaganDaH, AmodaH, modaH, suraBiH m., sOraByaM, suvAsaH, vAsaH, parimalaH, tiktaH, nirhAraH.

Fragrant, a. suraBi, sugaMDi, suvAsa, Amoda-parimala-vat, suvAsika, sAmoda, parimalo-dgArin, gaMDayukta, gaMDavat; tikta, kazAya. [Fragrant]ly, adv. savAsaM, sAmodaM, sagaMDaM. Fragrance, s. AmodaH, parimalaH, sOraBaM, sOraByaM; gaMDaH, vAsaH, suvAsaH, sugaMDaH.
FRAGRANT: (1) suganDaH (nDA, nDaM);(2) suganDi (mfn.);(3) suraBi (mfn.);(4) Amodin (f. nI);(5) parimalavat (f. tI);(6) sAmodaH (dA, daM) (rare), Ki. viii. 28.

FRAGRANT , s. suganDaH -nDA -nDaM -nDiH -nDiH -nDi, sOganDikaH -kI -kaM, ganDI -nDinI -nDi (n), saganDaH -nDA -nDaM, ganDavahaH -hA -haM, ganDavAn -vatI -vat (t), suraBiH -BiH -Bi, muvAsikaH -kA -kaM, savAsaH -sA -saM, AmodI -dinI -di (n), sAmod -dA -daM, tiktaH -ktA -ktaM, kazAyaH -yA -yaM.
FRAGRANTLY: (1) sOraBena;(2) suganDam;(3) sAmodam.
FRAGRANTLY , adv. saganDaM, suganDena sAmodaM, savAsaM, suraBi, tiktaM.
Frail, a. BaMgura, naSvara, DvaMsin, anitya, asTAyin, kzayin, sadyaHpAtin, kzaRa-BaMgura-viDvaMsin. [Frail]ness, [Frail]ty, s. BaMguratA, naSvaratvaM, kzayitA, &c. 2 dozaH, sKalitaM, pramAdaH.
FRAIL (subs.): pewikA: v. Basket.
FRAIL (adj.): I Fragile: q.v.II Weak, infirm: durbbalaH (lA, laM).III Easily des- -troyed:(1) kzaRaBaNguraH (rA, raM);(2) vinaSvaraH (rI, raM).IV Of infirm virtue: indriyaparavaSaH (SA, SaM).

FRAIL , a. BaNguraH -rA -raM, kzaRaBaNkaraH -rA -raM, kzayI -yiRI -yi (n), naSvaraH -rA -raM, vinaSvaraH -rA -raM, drutApAyaH -yA -yaM, kzaRaviDvaMsI -minI -si [Page290-a+ 51] (n), sadyaHpAtI -tinI -ti (n), anityaH -tyA -tyaM, asTAyI -yinI -yi (n)
FRAIL , s. (Basket made of rushes) dUrbbAmayaH or nalamayaH pewakaH.
FRAILNESS, FRAILTY: I Fragility: BaNguratA.II Weakness; durbalatA.III Fickleness: anityatA. IV Fault, foible: q.v.
FRAILTY , s. BaNguratA -tvaM, asTEryyaM, aDEryyaM, DftihInatA, dOrbalyaM, alyaSaktitvaM, kzayitA, naSvaratvaM, anityatA, asTAyitA.

Frame, v. t. vi-, rac 10, vi-DA 3 U, kxp c., kf 8 U, Gaw c. (Gawayati), saMvi-DA, samA-DA, nirmA 2 P, 3 A. 2 nibaMD 9 P. 3 sadfSIkf; ‘f(rame) in the mind’ manasA ciMt 10 or kxp c., citte kf. s. nirmARaM, raca-naM-nA, GawanaM-nA. 2 ADAraH, upazwaMBaH; Ava-raRaM, koSaH, AvezwanaM. 3 SarIraM, dehaH, gAtraM, vapus n., kAyaH, aMgaM; ‘f(rame) of body’ deha-baMDaH; ‘of a hardy f(rame)’ vajradehin, siMha-saMhanana. 4 BAvaH, vftti f., sTiti f., daSA, avasTA; ‘joyous f(rame) of mind’ AnaMdavfttiH. 5 AkAraH, rUpaM, Akfti f., rIti f., saMsTAnaM.

FRAME (subs.): I A fabric: nirmARam.II A case: ADAraH, door -f.: dvArasyADAradAru, M.n.III Body: q.v.: vapuH, surely (her) f. was made of golden lotuses: DruvaM vapuH kAYcanapadmanirmitam, Ku. IV Humour: BAvaH; oftenn ot expr., in a happy f. of mind: nirvftamanas (mfn.).V System: prakAraH.

FRAME (v.t.): I To form, make: q.v.: nirmimIte (mA, c. 3.), with which the earth has been f.d: vasuDA yena nirmitA, Ram.II To plan: q.v.: kalpayati (kxp, c. 10.).III To provide with a f.: sADAraM (f. rAM) karoti.IV To draw up: nibaDnAti (banD, c. 9.).

To FRAME , v. a. (Fabricate, form) kf, saNkf, nirmA (c. 2. -mAti -tuM, c. 3. -mimIte, c. 4. -mAyate), kxp (c. 10. kalpayati -yituM), Gaw (c. 10. Gawayati -yituM), viDA (c. 3. -daDAti -DAtuM), rac (c. 10. racayati -yituM). — (Adjust, shape) virac, saMviDA, samADA, vinyas (c. 4. -asyati -asituM). — (Compose) rac, virac, nibanD (c. 9. -baDnAti -banDuM), saNgrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM). — (Conform) sAdfSyaM kf, AnurUpyaM kf, sadfSIkf; ‘frame a plan in the mind,’ upAyaM manasA kxp.

FRAME , s. (Fabric) nirmmARaM, kalpanaM -nA, GawanaM. — (Form) AkAraH, AkftiH f., rUpaM. — (Body) SarIraM, dehaH, gAtraM, gAtrakaM, kAyaH, mUrttiH f., aNgaM, vapuH n. (s); ‘of a hardy frame,’ vajradehI -hinI -hi (n), vajraSarIrI -riRI -ri (n). — (Stand, support) maYcaH -YcakaH, vfkzaH -kzakaH, talaH, upastamBaH. — (Of a picture) citrakoSaH, citrAvaraRaM, citrAvezwanaM, citraparigataM kAzWAdi. — (Of a window) vAtAyanaparigataM kAzWAdi. — (State) sTitiH f., BAvaH, avasTA, vfttiH f., daSAH; ‘frame of mind,’ manoBAvaH, manaHsTitiH f., cittavfttiH f.; ‘frame of body,’ SarIrasTitiH f. — (Structure, system) saMsTAnaM, saMsTitiH f., sTitiH f., rItiH f., pravfttiH f., vyUhaH -hanaM.
FRAMED , p. p. racitaH -tA -taM, viracitaH -tA -taM, kalpitaH -tA -taM, GawitaH -tA -taM, nirmmitaH -tA -taM, kftaH -tA -taM, vihitaH -tA -taM.
FRAMER: racayitf (f. trI), f. of the world: viSva- racayitA; f. of a law: viDiracayitA (?); f. of the Vedas: vedasya kartAraH, D.s.: v. Maker.
FRAMER , s. racakaH, viracakaH, karttA m. (rttf), kArakaH, nibanDA m. (nDf).
FRAMEWORK: ADAraH: v. Frame (II).
Franchise, s. pOrajanADikAraH. 2 mukti f., mocanaM, svADInatA. v. t. muc 6 P.

FRANCHISE (subs.): I Freedom: mokzaH.II In gen.: aDikAraH, f. of a citizen: pOrADikAraH; “crowning f.” praDAnatamADikAraH; monasteries in Spain are f.s for criminals”: *hispAnIyavihArA duzwAnAmaDikArAH.
FRANCHISE (v.): mokzayati (mokz, c. 10.); mokzaM dadAti (dA, c. 3.).
FRANCHISE , s. pOrajanAGikAraH. — (Freedom from burden) muktiH f., vimuktiH f., mocanaM, vimocanaM, mokzaH, akaratvaM, nizkaratvaM, svADInatA.
To FRANCHISE , v. a. muc (c. 6. muYcati, moktuM, c. 10. mocayati -yituM), vimuc. See ENFRANCHISE.
FRANGIBILITY , s. BaNguratvaM -tA, BiduratA, suBaNgatvaM, suBedyatA, KaRqanIyatA.
FRANGIBLE , a. BaNguraH -rA -raM, KaRqanIyaH -yA -yaM, BedyaH -dyA -dyaM.
