details.body: Frank, a. nizkapawa, sarala, fjumati-budDi, udAra, nirvyAja, spazwa-sPuwa-vAdin, asaMvfta, avakra, amAya, nirvyalIka, dakziRa, agUQaBAva; akapawa, avyAja, amAyin; ‘f(rank)-hearted’ vimalAtman, udAraDI; SudDAMtaHkaraRa. [Frank]ly, adv. nirvyAjaM, nizkapawaM, amAyayA, saralaM. [Frank]ness, s. amAyA, fjutA, nizkApawyaM, OdAryaM, dAkziRyaM, sAralyaM, akApawyaM, &c.

FRANK (adj.): (1) saralaH (lA, laM) (= straight- -forward);(2) nizkapawaH (wA, waM), amAyaH (yA, yaM) etc. (= sincere);(3) sPuwamAzin (f. RI), sPuwa- vAdin (f. nI), etc. (= open: of men only); (4) asaMvftaH (tA, taM) (= unreserved).
FRANK (v.): of letters: rAjakAryato vinA mUlyena vAhArTaM patropari prerakasya nAma liKati.

FRANK , a. (Ingenuous, candid) akapawaH -wA -waM, nizkapawaH -wA -waM, amAyaH -yA -yaM, amAyikaH -kI -kaM, mAyAhInaH -nA -naM, vimalAtmA -tmA -tma (n), vimalArTakaH -kA -kaM, avakraH -krA -kraM, agUQaBAvaH -vA -vaM, saralaH -lA -laM, dakziRaH -RA -RaM, nirvyalIkaH -kA -kaM. — (Gene- -rous) udAraH -rA -raM.
FRANK , s. (Coin) rUppamudrAviSezaH. — (Letter carried without post- age) mUlyaM vinA vAhanIyaM patraM. — (The mark which makes it free) idaM patraM mUlyaM vinA vAhyam iti patropari sUcakaM cihnaM.
To FRANK , v. a. idaM patraM mUlyaM vinA vAhanIyam iti patrasyopariliKi- -tacihnena sUc (c. 10. sUcayati -yituM).
FRANK-HEARTED , a. udAracetAH -tAH -taH (s), udAraDIH -DIH -Di, vima- -lAtmA -tmA -tma (n).
Frank-incense, s. kuMduraH-ruH, kuMduH-daH, mukuMdaH, pAlaMkI.
FRANKINCENSE: (1) kunduruH;(2) kunduH;(3) rasAlam (?).
FRANKINCENSE , s. kunduruH m. f. -rukaH, kunduH f., rasAlaM, kxptaDUpaH, KowIrasaH.
FRANKLY: (1) sPuwam (= openly), makes enmity when talked to f.: karoti bEraM sPuwamucyamAnaH, B. xii. 83.;(2) nizkapawam: v. Sincerely;(3) asaMvftam (= unreservedly).
FRANKLY , adv. nizkapawaM, kapawaM vinA, avakraM, amAyayA, vyaktaM, nirvyAjaM, nirvyalIkaM, saralaM, dAkziRyena, udAravat.
FRANKNESS: (1) saralatA or sAralyam;(2) nizkapawatA; (3) amAyatA;(4) asaMvftiH;(5) sPuwaBAzitvam; (6) sPuwavAditA; for dif.: v. Frank.
FRANKNESS , s. udAratvaM, OdAryyaM, saralatA, sAralyaM, avakratA, kapawahInatA, nizkapawatvaM, mAyAhInatA, dAkziRyaM, BAvAgUQatA, amAyA, nirvyalIkatA, vimalAtmatA, akApawyaM.

Frantic, a. unmatta, madavikzipta, vyastacitta, saMrabDa; ‘f(rantic) with rage’ kroDonmatta, kopo-nmAdin. [Frantic]ally, adv. unmattavat, sonmAdaM, sasaMraMBaM. [Frantic]ness, s. unmAdaH, vyAmohaH, cittaviplavaH, unmattatA, vAtulatA, citta-viBramaH.
FRANTIC: UnmattaH (ttA, ttaM), f. with rage: kroDonmattaH (ttA, ttaM): v. Mad, maddened.
FRANTIC , a. unmattaH -ttA -ttaM, unmAdaH -dA -daM, unmAdasaMrabDaH -bDA -bDaM, madotkawaH -wA -waM, madavikziptaH -ptA -ptaM, vyastacittaH -ttA -ttaM, pramadaH -dA -daM.
FRANTICLY: unmattavat: v. Madly.
FRANTICLY , adv. unmattavat, unmAdavat, unmAdavikziptavat, vAtulavat.
FRANTICNESS , s. unmattatA, unmAdaH, unmAdasaMrabDatA, cittavikziptatA, cittavyastatA, cittaviplavaH, vimohaH, sonmAdatvaM, vAtulatA.
Frater, s. parivrAj m. yati m. 2 baMDu m., bAMDavaH.
Fraternal, a. BrAtrIya, BrAtfsaMniBa, BrAtranu-rUpa. [Fraternal]ly, adv. BrAtfvat, sodaravat.
FRATERNAL: BrAtrIyaH (yA, yaM): v. Brotherly (adj.).
FRATERNAL , a. BrAtrIyaH -yA -yaM, BrAtfkaH -kA -kaM, BrAtfsanniBaH -BA -BaM.
FRATERNALLY: (1) BrAtfvat;(2) BrAtfsanniBam;(3) sodaravat.
FRATERNALLY , adv. BrAtfvat, BrAtfrUpeRa, sodaravat, BrAtrIyaprakAreRa.
Fraternity, s. BrAtftvaM, sOBrAtraM. 2 samAjaH, saMsargaH, sAhityaM, baMDutA. Fraternize, v. i. BrAtfvat saMmil 6 P or saMyuj pass. or ekIBU or sannipat 1 P.
FRATERNITY: I Brother-hood: BrAtftvam, good f.: sOmrAtram, R.II Association: q.v.: samAjaH.
FRATERNITY , s. (Brotherhood) BrAtftvaM, sOBrAtraM. — (Association) saMsargaH, saMsargitvaM, sAhityaM, banDutA. — (Body of men associated) sahakArijanasamUhaH.
FRATERNIZE: mrAtfvat militaH or saMhataH (tA, taM) mavati (BU, c. 1.).
To FRATERNIZE , v. a. BAtfvat sahitaH -tA -taM, BU or saha mil (c. 6. milati -te, melituM) or saMyuktaH -ktA -ktaM BU or saNGAtavAn -vatI -vad BU.
FRATRICIDAL: expr. by comp., f. crime: mrAtf- vaDapAtakaH.
Fratricide, s. BrAtfGAtakaH, BrAtfGAtin m. 2 BrAtfvaDaH-hatyA-GAtaH.
FRATRICIDE: I The murderer: BrAtfDAtin (f. nI), Mah.; BrAtfhan (mfn.) BrAtfGAtakaH (m.); and sim. comp.s.II The crime: BrAtfhatyA; BrAtfvaDaH and sim. comp.s.
FRATRICIDE , s. BrAtfhatyA, BrAtfbaDaH, BrAtfGAtaH. — (One who murders a brother) BrAtfGAtakaH, BrAtfhA m. (n), BrAtfGAtI m. (n).

Fraud, s. kapawaH-waM, CalaM, kEtavaM, mAyA, vyAjaH, kUwaM, vaMcanaM-nA, upaDiH, pratAraRaM-RA, vipralaMBaH, Cadman n., daMBaH, kusfti f., nikfti f. Fraudulent, a. kapawin, savyAja, SaWa, DUrta, mAyin, vaMcaka, pratAraka, vipralaMBaka, kApawika-CAdmika (kI f.), kapawa in comp.; ‘a f(radulent) plan’ kapawaprabaMDaH. [Fraudulent]ly, adv. Calena, sakapawaM, savyAjaM, mAyayA, DUrtavat, samAyaM, sakEtavaM.
FRAUD: cCalam, without force or f.: balacCale vihAya, Viv.: v. Deceit.

FRAUD , s. kapawaH -waM, vyAjaH, CalaM -lanA, kEtavaM, kUwaH -waM, kOwaM, mAyA, damBaH, upaDiH m., vaYcanaM -nA, pravaYcanA, pralamBaH, vipralamBaH, atisanDAnaM, aBisanDiH m. -nDAnaM, prapaYcaH, pratAraRaM -RA, kuhakaH, vyAkUtiH, saMScat, nimIlikA, daRqAjinaM, sKalitaM.
FRAUDFUL , a. kapawI -winI -wi (n), mAyI -yinI -yi (n). See FRAUDULENT.
FRAUDULENCE , s. kapawatA, kApawyaM, kUwatA, savyAjatA, DUrttatA, SaWatA.
FRAUDULENT: expr. by Calena, to make a f. sale: Calena vikrayaM karoti; f. (man): CalapriyaH (yA, yaM), CalanAparaH (rA, raM): v. Deceitful.

FRAUDULENT , a. kapawI -winI -wi (n), kApawikaH -kI -kaM, CalI -linI -li (n), mAyI -yinI -yi (n), vaYcakaH -kA -kaM, pravaYcakaH -kA -kaM, kUwakaH -kA -kaM, kOwaH -wI -waM -wikaH -kI -kaM, CAdmikaH -kI -kaM, dAmBikaH -kI -kaM, DUrttaH -rttA -rttaM, pratArakaH -kA -kaM, savyAjaH -jA -jaM, upaDikaH -kA -kaM, pralamBakaH -kA -kaM, SaWaH -WA -WaM, dARqAjinikaH -kI -kaM, takilaH -lA -laM, sTagaH -gA -gaM, kUwa in comp.
FRAUDULENTLY: CalenaH v. Deceitfully, dis- -honestly.
FRAUDULENTLY , adv. sakapawaM, savyAjaM, sakUwaM, Calena, sakEtavaM, DUrttavat, vaYcanArTaM, kitavavat, SaWavat, damBAt, mAyayA, samAyaM.
Fraught, a. Durya, DurIRa, BArAkrAMta. 2 A-saM-paripUrRa, AkIrRa, A-saM-kula, garBa-Avaha- in comp.; ‘f(raught) with danger’ anarTAvaha.

FRAUGHT , a. (Laden) DurIRaH -RA -RaM, DurIyaH -yA -yaM, BAravAn -vatI -vat (t). — (Filled) pUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, aBipUrRaH -rRA -rRaM, pariparRaH -rRA -rRaM, pUryyamARaH -RA -RaM, AkIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, saNkIrRaH -rRA -rRaM, saNkulaH -lA -laM, garBaH -rBA -rBaM in comp.; ‘fraught with happiness,’ suKAvahaH -hA -haM.
Fray, s. kalahaH, kaliH, yudDaM, dvaMdvaM.
FRAY: I Subs.: kaliH: v. Affray.II Verb. f. ed: BItaH (tA, taM): v. To frighten.
FRAY , s. kalahaH, kaliH m., yudDaM, tumulaM, dvandvaM, saNgrAmaH, samaraH, sayugaH, qimbaH, qamaraH, qAmaraH, viroDaH, vyavakroSanaM.
To FRAY , v. a. (Rub) vastrAYcalavad GarzaRena jarjarIBU or rUkzIBU.
FRAYED , p. p. vastrAYcalavad GarzaRena jarjarIkaH -kA -kaM or jarjarIBUtaH -tA -taM.

Freak, s. kAmacAraH, cApalyaM-laM, manolOlyaM, CaMdaH-das n., laharI; taraMgaH, vilAsaH; viBramaH, lIlA, svEritA. v. t. citrIkf 8 U, citr 10 [Freak]ish, a. capala, lola, calacitta, lolamati, svErin, kAmacArin.
FREAK (subs.): kAmAcAraH: v. Caprice. Ph.: in a f., by a mere f.: asamIkzya.
FREAK (v.): citrayati (citr, c. 10.): v. To variegate.
FREAK , s. cApalaM, lOlyaM, manolOlyaM, budDicApalyaM, CandaH, n. (s), lIlA, KelA, keliH m. f., vilAsaH, vihAraH, laharI, taraNgaH, aKawwiH m.
To FREAK , v. a. citr (c. 10. citrayati -yituM), citrIkf, citravicitrIkf.
FREAKISH: capalaH (lA, laM): v. Capricious.
FREAKISH , a. capalaH -lA -laM, lolaH -lA -laM, kelikaH -kA -kaM, lIlA- -KelaH -lA -laM.
FREAKISHLY: (1) cApalyAt (inconstantly);(2) asamIkzya (inconsiderately);(3) kAmacAreRa.
FREAKISHLY , adv. capalaM, cApalyAt, lOlyAt, manolOlyAt, salIlaM.
FREAKISHNESS: (1) kAmacAritA;(2) cApalyam; (3) manolOlyam.
FREAKISHNESS , s. cApalyaM, capalatA, lOlyaM, lIlAvattvaM, vilAsitA.
Freckle, s. jaqulaH, kAlakaH, pipluH.
FRECKLE: (1) tilaH, -kaH;(2) kAlakaH;(3) jawulaH (rare).
FRECKLE , s. jawulaH, kAlakaH, vipluH m., tilakaH, tilaH, tilakAlakaH, cihnaM.
FRECKLED, FRECKLY: (1) tilakin (f. nI);(2) kAlakin (f. nI).
FRECKLED , a. jawulacihnitaH -tA -taM, tilakI -kinI -ki (n), tilakaH -kA -kaM.

Free, a. amaryAda, maryAdAtikrAMta, vinaya-hIna-SUnya, pragalBa, Dfzwa, avinIta. 2 Atma-sva-taMtra, svADIna, anaDIna, anAyatta, aparADIna, svecCAcArin, svacCaMda, svErin, niravagraha, apAvfta, a-vi-vaSa. 3 mukta, vimukta, nirmukta, vimocita. 4 niryaMtraRa, abadDa, anirudDa, vi-ut-SfMKala, anargala, nirargala. 5 nirviGna, nizpratyUha, apratihata, niravaroDa, asaMbADa. 6 niSciMta, vItaciMta, viSada, svasTa. 7 muktahasta, tyAgaSIla, vyayapara. 8 ayatavAc, asaMvfta, aniyaMtritakaTa. 9 mUlyaM vinA. 10 sarvasADAraRa-sAmAnya; ‘f(ree) from’ ex. by nir-a in comp. or by gata, vIta, hIna, rahita, varjita, SUnya, mukta, mostly in comp.; ‘f(ree) from pride’ niravalapa; anfRa, vItaspfha, ciMtAhIna, &c., ‘f(ree) choice’ svecCA, svaruci f.; ‘f(ree) course’ prasaraH. v. t. muc 6 P or c., vi-nir°, vi-sfj 6 P or c., mokz 10; gen. ex. by nir or a pr. to nouns; ‘f(ree) from obstacle’ viGnAn apanI or hf 1 P, nirviGnIkf 8 U; ‘f(ree) from debt’ anfRa a. kf, fRaM apAkf or nistF c.; ‘I f(re)ed him from doubt’ taM nirmuktasaMdehamakaravaM, tasya saMdehamapAnayam, ‘f(ree)-agency’, ‘f(ree) will’ svecCA, yadfcCA, svAtaMtryaM, svAcCaMdyaM, svEratA, svakAmaH; ‘f(ree)-booter’ dasyuH, sAhasikaH, prasahyacOraH; ‘f(ree)-booting’ prasaBaM apahAraH, sAhasaM; ‘f(ree)-born’ jAta-janma-svataMtra, jAtyA svAyatta, janmanEva aparAyatta, kulIna-jAti, adAsaja; ‘f(ree)-hearted, -minded’ See Frank; ‘f(ree)-hold’ nizkaraBUmi f., svADInA BUH; ‘f(ree)-holder’ svADInakzetrasvA-min m.; ‘f(ree) liver’ kukziMBariH, OdarikaH; ‘f(ree)-man’ svataMtraH, aparAyattaH, svADInaH, adAsaH; ‘f(ree)-spoken’ sPuwavAdin, spazwa-vAc, agUQaBAva; ‘f(ree)-thinker’ nAstikaH, anISvaravAdin m.; ‘f(ree)-woman’ svADInA, svEriRI, svEracAriRI. [Free]dom, s. svataMtratA, avaSatA, svAtaMtryaM. 2 mokzaH-kzaRaM, vi-, mukti f., mocanaM. 3 niryaMtraRaM-RatA, nirviGnatA. 4 avinayaH, maryAdAtikramaH, prAgalByaM. 5 virahaH, aBAvaH, rAhityaM, hAni f., mukti f.; ‘f(reedom) of will or thought’ svecCA, svarucyanuvartanaM, kAmacAraH, svAcCaMdyaM. [Free]ly, adv. svecCayA, svEraM, svacCaMdataH; kAmataH ayAcitaM. 2 bahuSaH, bAhulyena, muktahastaM, BUyasA. 3 yaTecCaM, ni-pra-kAmaM, paryAptaM, yaTepsitaM, A-tfpti. 4 nirviGnaM, niryaMtraRaM, anivAritaM. 5 mUlyaM vinA. [Free]ness, s. nirviGnatA, nizkA-pawyaM, vAgyatatvaM, tyAgaSIlatA, &c.

FREE (adj.): I At liberty:(1) svADInaH (nA, naM), he is f.: svADIno'yam, K., “f. town”: *svADIna- nagaram;(2) svatantra (f. ntrA), who being f. sells himself: vikrIRIte svatantraH sannAtmAnaM yaH, N.s.; “f. country”. svatantrarAjyam. Ph.: according to one's f. will: svecCayA; she should be made f.: sAdAsI kartavyA, Kat.: v. Slave; f. agency, svacCandatA.II Liberated: muktaH (ktA, ktaM), vi-, nir-; mokzitaH (tA, taM), vi-.III Unrestrained: niryantraRa (f. RA); ayantritaH (tA, taM).IV muktahastaH (stA, staM).V Not obstructed, open: muktaH (ktA, ktaM). VI Gratuitous: expr. by vinA mulyena.VII Unreserved: asaMvftaH (tA, taM).

FREE (v.t.): I To set free:(1) mokzayati, vi-, (mokz, c. 10.), how to f. a slave: kaTaM dAsasya mokzaH, Viv.; f. s from danger of life: mokzayet prARasaMSayAt, M. p.;(2) muYcati or mocayati, vi-, pari-, nir-, (muc, c. 6. and 10.), a debtor is f. d from slavery..... fRI dAsyAdvimucyate, Viv.; f. d him thus bewailing: itTamamaM vilapantamamuYcat, N.II To clear: q.v.: mocayati, vi-, nir-, one who f. s others from all doubts: sarbasaMSayanirmoktA, Mah. ii. 39. 8.III To f. a lock: unmocayati or unmuYcati (?).

FREE , a. (Set at liberty) muktaH -ktA -ktaM, vimuktaH -ktA -ktaM, mocitaH -tA -taM, vimocitaH -tA -taM, mokzitaH -tA -taM, vimokzitaH -tA -taM, nirmuktaH -ktA -kta, visfzwaH -zwA -zwaM. — (Not subject to the will of others) svADInaH -nA -naM, anaDInaH -nA -naM, aparADInaH -nA -naM, anAyattaH -ttA -ttaM, svatantraH -ntrA -ntraM, AtmatantraH -ntrA -ntraM, vivaSaH -SA -SaM, svEracArI -riRI -ri (n), svecCAcArI &c., svacCandaH -ndA -ndaM, anupASrayaH -yA -yaM, aBujizyaH -zyA -zyaM. — (Unshackled) abadDaH -dDA -dDaM, niryantraRaH -RA -RaM, viSfNKalaH -lA -laM, ucCfNKalaH -lA -laM. FRET (subs.): kzomaH: v. Agitation, vexation.
FRET (v.t.): I To rub: q.v.: Garzati (Gfz, c. 1.).II To impair: q.v.: dApayati (c. of do).III To variegate: q.v.IV To vex: q.v.: kliSnAti (kliS, c. 9.). v. To agitate: q.v.
FRET (v.i.): I To be agitated: q.v.: kzuByati (kzuB, c. 4.).II To be vexed: kzuByati; santapyate (pass. of tap).
FRET , s. (Of the sea) samudrakzoBaH, itastato vIcipraloWanaM or Urmmipra- loWanaM. — (Vexation of mind) AtmadrohaH, AtmakleSaH, AtmapIqA, svamanastApaH, svacittakzoBaH, aSAntiH f., udvegaH.

To FRET , v. a. (Vex) vyaT (c. 10. vyaTayati -yituM), tap (c. 10. tApa- yati -yituM), paritap, santap, bAD (c. 1. bADate -DituM), kliS (c. 9. kliSnAti, kleSituM), kzuB (c. 10. kzoBayati -yituM). — (Chafe) Gfz (c. 1. Garzati -rzituM), AGfz, GarzaRena tap or kzatIkf or vraRIkf.

To FRET , v. n. (Be vexed) vyaT (c. 1. vyaTate -TituM), tap in pass. (tapyate), paritap, santap, Atap, kliS (c. 4. kliSyate, kleSituM), udvij (c. 6. -vijate -jituM), Suc (c. 1. Socati -cituM), jvar (c. 1. jvarati -rituM), saMjvar, darmanas (nom. durmanAyate), AtmAnaM tap (c. 10. tApayati -yituM), kzuB (c. 4. kzuByati, kzoBituM). — (Wear away by friction) GarzaRena kzi in pass. (kzIyate) or parikzatIBU.
FRETFUL: (1) caRqa (f. RqA) (= irritable);(2) pratIpaH (pA, paM) (= cross);(3) SIDrakzubDa (f. bDA), ASusantapta (f. ptA), etc. (?).
FRETFUL , a. AtmadrohI -hiRI -hi (n), SIGrakopI -pinI -pi (n), AtmatApI -pinI -pi (n), vakraBAvaH -vA -vaM, duzprakftiH -tiH -ti, durmanAH -nAH -naH (s).
FRETFULLY: (1) sakroDam (= angrily);(2) kzoBeRa; (3) by adj.
FRETFULLY , adv. vakraBAvena, vakraprakftitvAt, duzprakftitvAt, samanastApaM.
FRETFULNESS: (1) SIGrakzubDatA;(2) ASusantApitA; (3) pratIpatA (?).
FRETFULNESS , s. atmadrohaH, AtmakleSaH, AtmapIqA, svamanastApaH, svacitta- -kzoBaH, BAvavakratA, prakftivakratA, pratIpatA, sadApratIpatvaM, udvegaH, aSAntiH f.
FRETTED , p. p. vyaTitaH -tA -taM, klizwaH -zwA -zwaM, santApitaH -tA -taM, pIqitaH -tA -taM, bADitaH -tA -taM. — (Rubbed) GarzitaH -tA -taM.
Fretty, a. vyatyastareKArUpeRa tazwa.
FRETTY , a. vyatyastareKAlaNkftaH -tA -taM, vyatyastareKArUpeRa tazwaH -zwA -zwaM.
FRETWORK: karRareKAkarman (n.).
FRETWORK or FRET, s. vyatyastaresvArUpaM takzaRakarmma n. (n).
FRIABILITY: (1) BaNguratA: v. Fragility;(2) by circumlo.: v. Friable.
FRIABILITY , s. cUrRayogyatA, sucUrRanIyatA, BaNguratvaM, BiduratA.
FRIABLE: maNguraH (rA, raM): v. Fragile. yaH (yA, yat) suKena cUrRImavati.
FRIABLE , a. sucUrRanIyaH -yA -yaM, cUrRayogyaH -gyA -gyaM, BiduraH -rA -raM, BaNguraH -rA -raM, suBedyaH -dyA -dyaM, suKaRqanIyaH -yA -yaM.
Friar, s. yogin m., muniH, yatiH, saMnyAsin n. tapasvin m. [Friar]y, s. maWaH, ASramaH, vihAraH.
FRIAR: brahmacArin (m.) (?): v. Monk.
FRIAR , s. sannyAsI m. (n), tapaKI m. (n), yogI m. (n), muniH m., vErAgI m. (n).
FRIARY , s. maWaH, sannyAsinAM maWaH, ASramaH, tapovanaM, vihAraH.
FRICASSE (subs.): talitamAMsam (?), Bha.
FRICASSEE , s. pakziSaSakAdimAMsanizkvaTitaM sarasaBojanaM or savyaYjanaBojanaM, rasakaH, mAMsavyaYjanaM.
To FRICASSEE , v. a. pakziSaSakAdimAMsaM rasAdinA saha or vyaYjanAdinA saha nizkvaT (c. 1. -kvaTati -TituM).
Friction, s. GarzaRaM, saMGarzaH, A-aBi-GarzaH-rzaRaM, A-vi-GawwanaM, parasparaGarzaRaM-mardanaM.
FRICTION: (1) GarzaRam;(2) GarzaH, ni-, saM-, ut-, fire rising from the f. of the roots of branches: SAKAnta- niGarzajo'nalaH, Ki.

FRICTION , s. GarzaRaM, AGarzaH -rzaRaM, saNGarzaH, udGarzaRaM, aBiGarzaRaM, nirGarzaRaM, upaGarzaRaM, parasparaGarzaRaM, marddanaM, aBimarddaH, parimarddanaM, parimarSaH, AGawwanaM, viGawwanaM, udGawwanaM, mArjjanaM, parimArjjanaM.
FRICTION , s. vyAGawwanaM, saNGawwanaM, saMharzaH.
Friday, s. Sukra-Bfgu-vAraH-vAsaraH.
FRIDAY: (1) SukravAraH;(2) SukravAsaraH;(3) Bfgu- vAraH.
FRIDAY , s. SukravAraH, kulavAraH, BfguvAraH, saptAhasya zazWavAraH.

FRIED , p. p. BfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, BarjjitaH -tA -taM, BrazwaH -zwA -zwaM, kandupakvaH -kvA -kvaM; ‘fried meat,’ custaM, BaruwakaM; ‘fried grain,’ lAjAH m. pl., akzataM -tAH m. pl., DAnAH f. pl., BfzwayavaH.

Friend, s. mitraM, saKi m., suhfd m., snigDaH, praRayin m., hitaH, sahAyaH, sajus m., saMgin m. vayasyaH, baMDuH; (term of address) BadraH-drA; ‘an old f(riend)’ ciramitraM; ‘a true f(riend)’ sanmitraM. v. t. upakf 8 U, anugrah 9 P. [Friend]less, a. mitra-baMDu-hIna, asahAya, anATa, aSa-raRa; See Forlorn. [Friend]ship, s. saKyaM, mitratvaM; mEtrI, mEtryaM, baMDutA, sOhfdaM, sOhArdaM, snehaH, praRayaH, prIti f., preman m., n., anurAgaH. 2 sAhAyyaM. Friendly, a. snigDa, sadaya, hita-kAma, hitEzin, snehaSIla, sAnurAga, suhfdaya, sapraRaya. 2 hita, anukUla, anugrAhin, upakA-raka, hitakara; suKAvaha, kalyARakara (rI f.); ‘on f(riendly) terms’ snehavfttyA, mitraBAvena; ‘f(riendly) disposed’ hitabudDi; ‘f(riendly) dispute’ praRaya-kalahaH, prItikalahaH. adv. mitravat, hitavat, snigDaM, priyaM. [Friendly]ness, s. hitecCA, hitakAmatA, hitabudDi f., anukUlatA, mitratvaM, praRayaH, snehaSIlatA.

FRIEND: I In gen.:(1) saKi (m.) (f. KI), bosom f.: hfdayaNgamaH saKA, Ku.(2) mitram, greatest f.: paraM mitram, K.; old f.: ciramitram, H.;(3) suhfd (m.), dear old f.: cirantanapriyasuhfd, U. vi.; first shewing leniency as a f.: suhfdiva praTamamanukUlatAM prakawayya, Ma. iv. 7.;(7) banDuH, who else is f. to me like you: ko'paraH tvatsamo me banDuH, K.;(5) vayasya (f. syA = of the same age).II An advocate:(1) mitram;(2) banDuH.

FRIEND , s. mitraM, suhft m. (d), saKA m. (Ki), banDuH m., vayasyaH, snigDaH, snehI m. (n), bAnDavaH, sahAyaH, anurAgI m. (n), praRayI m. (n), suhfttamaH, hitaH, hitakArI m. (n), priyakft m., sajUH m. (s), anukUlaH, viBAvaH, kelikaraH, saNgI m. (n), AryyaH; ‘friend of the same age,’ savayAH m. (s), vayasyaH; ‘female friend,’ saKI f.; ‘an old friend,’ ciramitraM; ‘a true friend,’ sanmitraM; ‘my friend,’ saKe voc. c. m., saKi voc. c. f.
To FRIEND , v. a. mitra (nom. mitrIyate -yituM), saKivfttiM kf or AsTA (c. 1. -tizWati -sTAtuM), upakf, anugrah (c. 9. -gfhlAti -grahItuM).
FRIEND , s. ekaduHKasuKaH; ‘acquired f.,’ kftrimamitraM; ‘false f.,’ kapa- wamitraM, asanmitraM, durmitraM; ‘friends and relations,’ suhftsambanDinaH m. pl.
FRIENDLESS: (1) banDuhInaH (nA, naM), I live in this wood f. as dead: atrAraRye banDuhIno mftavannivasAmi, H.; (2) mitrahInaH (nA, naM);(3) asahAyaH (yA, yaM) (= without a helper).

FRIENDLESS , a. mitrahInaH -nA -naM, banDuhInaH -nA -naM, abanDuH -nDuH -nDu, abAnDavaH -vI -vaM, asahAyaH -yA -yaM, niHsahAyaH -yA -yaM, anATaH -TA -TaM, alabGanATaH -TA -TaM, nirASrayaH -yA -yaM, aSaraRaH -RA -RaM, niravalambaH -mbA -mbaM, bAnDavojJitaH -tA -taM.
FRIENDLESSNESS , s. mitrahInatA, banDuhInatA, asahAyatA, nirASrayatvaM.
FRIENDLINESS: (1) snehaH: v. Affection, love; (2) anukUlatA (favourableness);(3) dayA (= kindness):(4) mitravadvyavahAraH.
FRIENDLINESS , s. mitratvaM, sOhfdyaM, banDutA, prItiH f., saKitvaM, praRayaH, prema n. (n), priyatA, anurAgaH, anukUlatA, upakAraSIlatA, hitatA, hitecCA, hitakAmyA.

FRIENDLY (adj.): (1) snigDa (f. gDA) (affec- -tionate);(2) anukUlaH (lA, laM) (= favour- -able);(3) sadayaH (yA, yaM) (= kind). Ph.: should have f. feeling towards those who have enjoyments: samBogApanne zu mEtrIM BAvayet, P. d.; the one next to an enemy is a f. power: areranantaraM mitram, M. vii. 158.
FRIENDLY (adv.): (1) mitravat;(2) suhfdiva;(3) banDuvat, etc.

FRIENDLY , a. hitaH -tA -taM, hitEzI -ziRI -zi (n), hitavAn -vatI -vat (t), hitakAmaH -mA -maM, hitaprepsuH -psuH -psu, suhitaH -tA -taM, mEtraH -trI -traM, mitraH -trA -traM, sAKeyaH -yI -yaM, suhfttamaH -mA -maM, kftamEtraH -trA -traM, anurAgI -giRI -gi (n), praRayI -yinI -yi (n), sapraRayaH -yA -yaM, snehI -hinI -hi (n), snigDaH -gDA -gDaM, snehaSIlaH -lA -laM, prItimAn -matI -mat (t), sAnurAgaH -gA -gaM, priyaNkaraH -rA -raM, priyakft m. f. n., hitakaraH -rI -raM, anukUlaH -lA -laM, anugrAhI -hiRI -hi (n), upakAraSIlaH -lA -laM, suhfdayaH -yA -yaM, priyatamaH -mA -maM; ‘friendly- -minded,’ hitabudDiH -dDiH -dDi; ‘friendly to all creatures,’ kftaBUtamEtraH; ‘friendly dispute,’ prItikalahaH, prItivAdaH.
FRIENDLY , adv. mitravat, banDuvat, hitavat, snigDavat, mitratvAt, priyaM.

FRIENDSHIP: (1) saKyam, among the good, f. (is produced) in seven words: satAM sAptapadaM saKyam, Mah.; (2) mitratA or mEtrI, to make f.: mEtrIM karoti, Ki.; it is not proper (to form) f. with a stranger: AgantunA saha mEtrI na yuktA, H.;(3) sOhArdam or sOhfdam out of f. or from compassion towards me: sOhArdAdvA mayyanukroSabudDyA vA, Me.;(4) banDutA.

FRIENDSHIP , s. mitratvaM, -tA mEtryaM, mEtrI, sOhfdyaM, sOhArddaM, muhfttA, saKyaM, sAKyaM, saKitvaM, banDutA, snehaH, praRayaH, prItiH f., prema n. (n), priyatA, sAhAyyaM, sahAyatA, anurAgaH, sAptapadInaM; ‘to form friendship with another,’ anyasmin prItiM kf.

sanskrit.iast: sa ca uccaprakāreṇa takṣitair nānājantupratimānair alaṅkriyate

details.body: Frieze, s. sTUlapawwaM-SAwakaH, varASiH.
FRIEZE: I Coarse cloth: sTUlapawwam.II In architecture: *avacUqA.

FRIEZE , s. (Coarse cloth) sTUlapawwaM, sTUlaSAwakaH, varASiH m. — (In architecture) mahABavanasya yo dIrGacaturasro BAgaH stamBAgram avalambate sa ca uccaprakAreRa takzitEr nAnAjantupratimAnEr alaNkriyate.
Frigate, s. mahAyudDanOkA.
FRIGATE: madguH (?). D. vi.: v. Ship.
FRIGATE , s. yudDanOkA, mahAyudDanOkA, vfhadyudDanOH f.

Fright, s. BayaM, trAsaH, saMtrAsaH, SaMkA, sADvasaM, BIti f., udvegaH, daraM; ‘take f(right)’ saM-ut-tras 1, 4 P, uttrasta-cakita a. BU. [Fright]en, v. t. BI c. (BApayate-BIzayate), saM-ut-tras c., udvij c. [Frighten]ed, a. BIta, trasta, BayArta; BayAkula, cakita, sasADvasa, jAtaSaMka, SaMkita, BayAvizwa. [Fright]ful, a. BIma, vikawa, karAla, dAruRa, BIzaRa, Gora, BErava (vI f.), rOdra (drI f.), BayAnaka, BayAvaha, ugra, BayaMkara; ‘f(rightful) in appearance’ karAlavadana, BIma-rOdra-darSana, ugradarSana. [Fright]fully, adv. dAruRaM, GoraM, ugraM.
FRIGHT (subs.): trAsaH: v. Fear, terror. To take f.: trasyati (tras, c. 4.) (with abl.).
FRIGHT , s. trAsaH, santrAsaH, BayaM, sADvasaM, SaNkA, BItiH f., parikampaH. [Page293-a+ 51] udvegaH, AtaNkaH, BIzaRaM, daraH.

To FRIGHT , FRIGHTEN, v. a. BI in caus. (BAyayati -yituM or BIzayati -yituM), tras in caus. (trAsayati -yituM), santras, vitras, uttras, udvij in caus. (-vejayati -yituM), kamp in caus. (kampayati -yituM), vikamp.

FRIGHTEN (v.): (1) BIzayati, vi-, (c. of BI), I can never be f. ed with mere words: nAhaM BIzayituM Sakyo vANmAtreRa kaTaYcana, Mah.(2) trAsayati, vi-, (c. of tras), on the pretence of f. ing pigeons: pArAvatatrAsanApadeSAt, D. To be f. ed: biBeti, BI, c. 2.), do not get f. ed: mA BEzIH, I therefore stand f. ed before you: ata eva BItastizWAmi te'grataH, Mah.

FRIGHTENED , p. p. BItaH -tA -taM, trAsitaH -tA -taM, trastaH -stA -staM, santrastaH -stA -staM, vitrastaH -stA -staM, BIzitaH -tA -taM, BayArttaH -rttA -rttaM, BayAturaH -rA -raM, BayAkrAntaH -ntA -ntaM, SaNkitaH -tA -taM, aBiSaNkitaH -tA -taM, daritaH -tA -taM, sasADvasaH -sA -saM, cakitaH -tA -taM, tarjitaH -tA -taM.
FRIGHTFUL: (1) BEravaH (vI, vaM);(2) BIzaRa (f. RA);(3) BImaH (mA, maM);(4) karAlaH (lA, laM); (5) vikawaH (wA, waM): v. Also dreadful, fear- -ful.

FRIGHTFUL , a. dAruRaH -RA -RaM, BayAnakaH -kI -kaM, BayaNkaraH -rA -raM, BayAvahaH -hA -haM, GoraH -rA -raM, BImaH -mA -maM, BEravaH -vI -vaM, suBEravaH -vI -vaM, BIrumayaH -yI -yaM, rOdraH -drI -draM, trAsakaraH -rA -raM, vikawaH -wA -waM, ugraH -grA -graM, karAlaH -lA -laM, SaNkAjanakaH -kA -kaM, udveja- -nIyaH -yA -yaM; ‘in appearance,’ BImadarSanaH -nA -naM, rOdradarSanaH -nA -naM, karAlavadanaH -nA -naM.
FRIGHTFULLY: (1) BEravam;(2) BIzaRam;(3) BImam; (4) karAlam;(5) vikawam, Vi.: v. Also dread- -fully.
FRIGHTFULLY , adv. dAruRaM, GoraM, BayAnakaM, ugraM, BEravaM, suBEravaM, rOdraM.
FRIGHTFULNESS: (1) BEravatA;(2) BIzaRatA;(3) dAruRatA.
FRIGHTFULNESS , s. dAruRatA -tvaM, GoratA -tvaM, dAruRyaM, ugratA -tvaM, rOdratA.
Frigid, a. SIta, SiSira, hima, jaqa. 2 nirutsAha, niHsneha; See Cold. [Frigid]ity, s. himaM, SEtyaM, jaqatA. 2 virAgaH, snehABAvaH. [Frigid]ly, adv. SItalaM, SiSiraM, niHsnehaM.
FRIGID: I Cold: q.v.: SItaH (tA, taM).II Un- -feeling: q.v.: nIrasaH (sA, saM).

FRIGID , a. (Cold) SItalaH -lA -laM, SItaH -tA -taM, SiSiraH -rA -raM, himaH -mA -maM, anuzRaH -zRA -zRaM, jaqaH -qA -qaM, suzImaH -mA -maM, — (Wanting in affection) niHsnehaH -hA -haM, snehaSUnyaH -nyA -nyaM.
FRIGIDITY: I Coldness: q.v.: SItatA.II Fig.: nIrasatA.
FRIGIDITY , s. (Coldness) SItatA, SItalatA, SItaM, SEtyaM, himaM, jaqatA, jAqyaM, suzImaH. — (Of affection) niHsnehatA, nEHsnehyaM.
FRIGIDLY: I Lit.: SItalam.II Fig.: nIrasam
FRIGIDLY , adv. SItalaM, SiSiraM, SEtyena, jAqyena, jaqaM, snehaM vinA.
FRILL: *PullitadaSA (after Assamese).
FRILL , s. viralAMSukamaya Urmmivad unnatAnato vastrAlaNkAraH, vastrAYcalaM, aYcalaH, vastrakowiH f., UrmyAkArAMSukamayo vastrAlaNkAraH, UrmmimadaMSukamayo vastrAnubanDaH.

Fringe, s. aMcalaH-laM, daSAH (f. pl.), bastayaH (m. f.); ‘like a f(ringe) rent from the robe of heaven’ CinnA ivAMbarapawasya daSAH (Mr. 5). v. t. prAMtayati (D.); ‘f(ring)ed with gold’ suvarRamaMqitaprAMtaM (vastraM).
FRINGE: (1) daSA;(2) aYcalaH;(3) tarI or tariH (rare).
FRINGE , s. aYcalaH, vastrAYcalaH -laM, tarI, tariH f., vastiH m., daSA, SiTi- -latantumayo vastrAdyalaNkAraH or vastrAdyanubanDaH.
To FRINGE , v. a. pUrvvoktAYcalena alaNkf, SiTilatantuBir vastrAdikowim alaNkf.
FRINGED: (1) daSAyuktaH (ktA, ktaM);(2) aYcalAnvitaH (tA, taM); etc.
FRIPPERER , s. jIrRavastrakrayavikrayikaH, cIravastravyApArI m. (n).
Frippery, s. cIrARi (pl.), jIrRa-cIra-vastraM, vastraKaMqAH, karpawAH. 2 nizprayojanadravyaM, ucCizwaM.
FRIPPERY: I Lit.:(1) jIrRavastram;(2) ucCizwa- vastram.II Fig.: secondhand finery: dfzwi- SoBanaH (nA, naM) (?).
FRIPPERY , s. (Old clothes) jIrRavastraM, cIravastraM, cIrARi n. pl., vastraKaRqAH m. pl., ucCizwavastraM. — (Useless matter) nirarTakaM, mfzArTakaM, ucCizwaM.
Frisk, v. i. krIq 1 U, itastataH ram 1 A or nft 4 P or plu 1 A, Kel 1 P, vi-hf 1 P. [Frisk]y, a. hfzwa, prahfzwa, praPulla, sAnaMda.
FRISK (v.) Kelati (Kel, c. 1.), U.: v. To play, leap.

To FRISK , v. n. cittapraharzAt krIq (c. 1. krIqati -te -qituM) or prakrIq or vikrIq, or itastataH plu (c. 1. plavate, plotuM) or nft (c. 4. nftyati, narttituM) or ram (c. 1. ramate, rantuM) or KelA (nom. KelAyati) or hastapAdAdi saYcal in caus. (-cAlayati -yituM).
FRISKER , s. cittaprasannatvAd itastataH plavakaH or narttakaH or KelAkArI m. (n).
FRISKY , a. hfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, cittapraharzAd itastataH krIqamAnaH -nA -naM or plavana- -SIlaH -lA -laM, prahfzwaH -zwA -zwaM, praPullaH -llA -llaM, AnandI -ndinI -ndi (n), KelAkArI -riRI -ri (n).
Frith, s. saMkawaM, saMBedaH.
FRITH: muKam (= mouth); saNgamaH (= confluence).
FRITH , s. samudrasya saNkawapaTaH, saNkawaM, samBedaH, saNgamaH.

Fritter, v. t. KaMqaSaH kft 6 P; KaMq 10, SakalIkf 8 U; ‘f(ritter) away’ KaMqaSaH-alpaSaH-nyUnIkf or kzIRIkf or kzE c. (kzapayati); ‘f(ritter) away time’ alpaSaH (muDA) velAM kzE c. s. KaMqaH-qaM, SakalaH-laM.
FRITTER (subs.): KaRqaH (mn.): v. Fragment.
FRITTER (v.): I To cut: KaRqaSaH kfntati (kft, [Page300] c. 6.).II To break into pieces: Sakalayati (nomi.) F. away: kzapayati (c. of kzE). v. To waste.
FRITTER , s. BfzwapizwakaviSezaH, BfzwApUpaH. — (Fragment) KaRqaH -RqakaH, SakalaH -laM, vidalaM.
To FRITTER , v. a. KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM), KaRqaSaH kf, SakalIkf; ‘fritter away,’ alpam alpaM or KaRqaM KaRqaM kziptvA nyUnIkf or kzIRIkf or kzi in caus. (kzapayati -yituM).

God: trahmaRaH prajAH prajAyante, S. k.V Denoting cause, occasion, etc.: (a) by abl. not f. exhaustion: na KedAt, Mu. i.; and f. non- perception of others: itarezAYcAnupalabDeH, S.; (b) by ins. in the case of feminine nouns, f. a diesiredesire to see: didfkzayA, Ki.: f. fragrance: suraBitayA, K.VI Of material: v. Of.VII Of persons: expr. by sakASAt and gen., f. Raghu: roGoH sakASAt, R. v. 24. Miscell: f. day to day. dine dine, Ku. i. 25.: f. country: to country: deSAt deSam or deSAntaram, D. vi.; wandered f. house to house: gfhAdgfhaM praviSyABramat, D.; f. the beginning: AmUlAt or AditaH, Mu. ii.; f. a boy: bAla eva or bAlyAt praBftiH, Vi.; f. behind: pfzWenAgatya or paScA- detya,V iii.; f. humanity to corporeal beings ending in God: manuzyatvAdAraBya brahmAntezu dehavatsu, S.; f. God to columns: AbrahmastamBaparyantam, S. p. b.; speaking of the difference of happiness f. humanity upwards, speaks of it among the lower (beings): manuzyatvAdUrDvagatezu suKasya tAratamyamuktavA'Dogatezu, tadAha, S. com.; told (her) all f. the conquest: vijayAdAraBya sarvamAcacakze, K.; f. me (=for me): madvacanAt, Sa.; the sixth king f. Nimi: nimeH zazWo mahIpatiH, Ram. i. 68. 8.

FROM , prep. In phrases where it denotes procession, deriva- -tion, deliverance, extraction, separation, distance, emis- -sion, removal, the reason or motive of any act, and the ground or cause of any thing, it is usually expressed by the abl. case. It is also expressed in some phrases by such words as sakASAt, maDyAt, praBfti, AraBya, or even by the prep. A with the abl. c. The following are examples; ‘coming out from his house,’ niHmftya gfhAt; ‘from avarice anger arises,’ loBAt kroDaH praBavati; ‘even from poison nectar may be taken,’ vizAd apy amftaM grAhyaM; ‘he delivers me from danger,’ trAyate mAM BayAt; ‘Krishna is a hundred kos from Somanāth,’ kfzRaH SataM kroSAH somanATAt; ‘he separates the good from the bad,’ sADUn duzweByaH pfTakkaroti; ‘having discharged an arrow from the bow,’ vARaM DanuzaH prakzipya; ‘he rises from his seat,’ AsanAd uttizWati; ‘from fear of punishment,’ daRqaBayAt; ‘from unsteadiness of mind,’ anavasTitacittatvAt; ‘from being founded on observation,’ pratyakzamUlatvAt. The abl. c. is also used to express ‘from,’ in the sense of since; as, ‘from childhood,’ bAlyAt or bAlyataH; ‘from the earliest period of the world,’ jagadAramBa- -kAlAt, but in these cases praBfti or AraBya or avaDi are often added, or A may sometimes, but very rarely, be prefixed; as, ‘from childhood,’ bAlyAt praBfti, AbAlyAt, AbAlyakAlAt; ‘from birth,’ janmataH praBfti, janmata AraBya, AjanmataH, janmAvaDi; ‘from the very first glance,’ praTamadarSanakzaRAt praBfti. The word sakASAt is used in such phrases as, ‘from the presence of the king,’ rAjasakASAt; ‘an order from the council,’ saBAsakASAd AjYA. The word maDyAt in such phrases as, ‘from among the soldiers,’ sEnyamaDyAt. Other [Page294-a+ 51] examples of the modes of expressing ‘from’ are, ‘from the top to the bottom,’ UrdDvAd aDaHparyyantaM; ‘from the hole of the weasel to the hole of the serpent,’ nakulavivarAd AraBya sarpavivaraM yAvat; ‘from birth to death,’ janmAvaDi mftyuparyyantaM; ‘from that time forth,’ tadApraBfti, tatkAlAt praBftiH; ‘from this day,’ adyAraBya, adyapraBfti, adyAvaDi; ‘from city to city,’ purAt puraM; ‘from the beginning to the end,’ praTamAtpraBfti or ApraTamAd antaM, yAvat, anupUrvvaSas; ‘Let them be told from me,’ ucyantAM mama vacanAt; ‘from any one soever,’ yataHkutaScit; ‘from above,’ UrdDvAt, uparizwAt; ‘from below,’ aDastAt, aDaH- -sTAnAt; ‘from behind,’ paScimaBAgAt; ‘from far,’ dUrAt, dUratas; ‘from hence,’ itas, atas; ‘from without,’ vahirdeSAt; ‘from within,’ aByan

FROWN (v.): BrUBaNgaM karoti; BrukuwiM baGnAti (banD, c. 9). etc., you are f. ing at me: mayyeva BrUkuwiDaraH saMvfttaH, Vi. ii.
To FROWN , v. n. BUBaNgaM kf, BUkuwiM kf, kawAkzeRa or BrUBaNgena dfS (c. 1. paSyati, drazwuM), BruvO saNkuc (c. 1. -kocati -cituM), BrUkzepaM kf, BrUsaNkocaM kf.
FROWN , s. BrUBaNgaH, BrUkuwiH f. -wI, BrukuwiH f. -wI, BfkuwI, BrUkzepaH, kAkzaM, BrUsaNkocaH -canaM, kawAkzaH.
FROWNED UPON , p. p. kawAkzitaH -tA -taM, BrUBaNgena nirIkzitaH -tA -taM.
FROWNING , a. nataBrUH -BrUH -Bru, saMhataBrUH -BrUH -Bru, saBrUBaNgaH -NgA -NgaM, saBrUkzepaH -pA -paM, saBfkuwImuKaH -KI -KaM, sakawAkzaH -kzA -kzaM, kAkzaH -kzA -kzaM.
FROWNINGLY: (1) BrUBaNgaM bad DvA;(2) BrUkuwiM kftvA; (3) BrUmaNgamADAya.
FROWNINGLY , adv. saBrUBaNgaM, BrUBaNgena, saBrUkzepaM, BrUkzepeRa, kawAkzeRa, sakawAkzaM.
FROZEN: I Lit.:(1) SilIBUtaH (tA, taM);(2) GanaH (nA, naM) (= thick), f. dew: GananIhAraH, Ki.: v. To freeze.II Chilly;(1) nitAntaSItaH (tA, taM);(2) himapraDAnaH (nA, naM).

FROZEN , a. or p. p. atiSItatvAd GanIBUtaH -tA -taM or saMhatIBUtaH -tA -taM or SyAnIBUtaH -tA -taM, himasaMhataH -tA -taM, avaSyAnaH -nA -naM, avaSItaH -tA -taM, avaSInaH -nA -naM, SItaH -tA -taM, SInaH -nA -naM, jaqIBUtaH -tA -taM, jaqIkftaH -tA -taM.
FROZEN , p. p. himastabDaH -bDA -bDaM, himastamBitaH &c., himagrastaH &c.
FRUCTIFEROUS , a. PaladaH -dA -daM, PaladAyI -yinI -yi (n), PalI -linI -li (n).
FRUCTIFICATION: I Lit.: PaladIkaraRam; better by verb.II The reproductive parts of a plant: prasUnam; Palapuzpam.III The process: prasUnakxptiH (?).
FRUCTIFICATION , s. saPalIkaraRaM, PaladIkaraRaM, abanDyIkaraRaM, ADAnaM.
Fructify, v. t. bahuPaladIkf 8 U, saPalIkf, sPItIkf, saPalayati (D.). Fructuous, Fructiferous, a. (bahu) Palada, Palin, PaladAyin.
FRUCTIFY: Palavantam (tIM, -t) karoti; PaladIkaroti (rare).
To FRUCTIFY , v. a. saPala (nom. saPalayati -yituM), saPalIkf, bahuPaladIkf, PalitaM -tAM -taM, kf, sPItIkf, abanDyIkf.
FRUCTUOUS , a. PalI -linI -li (n), PalavAn -vatI -vat (t), PaladaH -dA -daM.

Frugal, a. mita-alpa-vyaya-vyayin, svalpa-parimita-vyaya, amuktahasta, kfpaRa, vyayavimuKa. [Frugal]ity, s. mitavyayitA, mita-svalpa-vyayaH, amuktahastatvaM, kfpaRatvaM. [Frugal]ly, adv. amuktahastaM; mita-svalpa-vyayena, alpavyayapUrvaM, kfpaRaM.
FRUGAL: (1) mitavyayin (f. nI);(2) parimita- vyayaH (yA, yaM).

FRUGAL , a. parimitavyayaH -yA -yaM, mitavyayI -yinI -yi (n), svalpavyayaH -yA -yaM, avyayaH -yA -yaM, vyayaparANmuKaH -KI -KaM, abahupradaH -dA -daM, abahudah -dA -daM, amuktahastaH -stA -staM, parimitah -tA -taM, kfpaRaH -RA -RaM.
FRUGALITY: (1) mitavyayitA;(2) parimitavyayaH.
FRUGALITY , s. parimitavyayaH, mitavyayaH, svalpavyayaH, amuktahastatvaM, vyayaparA- -NmuKatA, parimitatvaM, kfpaRatvaM.
FRUGALLY: I With frugality: mitavyayena, pari-,II Moderately, sparingly: mitam, pari-.
FRUGALLY , adv. parimitavyayena, mitavyayena, svalpavyayena, amuktahastena, alpavyayapUrvvaM, parimitaM, kfpaRaM, sakArpaRyaM.

Fruit, s. PalaM (lit. and fig.); Sa(sa)syaM, prasa-vaH, utpannaM. 2 pariRAmaH, uttaraPalaM, karmaPalaM. 3 (Progeny) apatyaM, saMtAnaH-naM, saMtati f., prajA, prasUti f.; PalaM. 4 arTaH, lABaH, Pa-lAgamaH, PalaprApti f., ‘dry f(ruit)’ vAnaM; ‘unripe f(ruit)’ SalAwu; ‘bear f(ruit)’ Pal 1 P, PalaM baMD 9 P or dA 3 U, saPalIBU, pac pass., (sadya eva sukftAM hi pacyate kAMkzitaM R. xi. 50); ‘f(ruit)-bearer’ PaladAtf m., PaladaH; ‘f(ruit)-bearing’ Palada, Palegrahi, PalaBft, PaladA-yin, Palin, PalaSAlin; ‘f(ruit)-garden’ Pala-vAwaH-wikA; ‘f(ruit)-season or -time’ Pala-kAlaH-samayaH, PalAvacayakAlaH; ‘f(ruit)-stalk or -stem’ SasyamaMjarI, prasavabaMDanaM, vfMtaM; ‘f(ruit) tree’ PaladaH vfkzaH or vanaspatiH, PalagrAhin m. [Fruit]age, s. PaloccayaH, PalaBAraH-gucCaH, Pa-lAgamaH. [Fruit]erer, s. Palavikrayin m. [Fruit]ery, s. PalAni (pl.). 2 PalasTAnaM. [Fruit]ful, a. Palavat, Palada, Palin, saPala, Palita, avaMDya, amoGa, bahuPalada, Palina, Palegrahi. 2 bahupraja, prajanizRu, bahvapatya, bahuprajopeta. 3 utpAdaka, janaka; Avaha-praBavaH-mUlaM-kAraRaM in comp. [Fruit]less, a. nizPala, vi-a-Pala, nirarTaka, vyarTa, moGa, vaMDya, anarTaka, nizprayojana, nirguRa, anupayukta, PalahIna, avakeSin. [Fruit]lessly, adv. vyarTaM, nirarTakaM, muDA, vfTA, moGaM, ni-zPalaM. [Fruit]lessness, s. vEyarTyaM, anupayogaH, vyarTatA, vEPalyaM. Fruition, s. upa-, BogaH, Bukti f., anuBavaH, AsvAdaH; suKopaBogaH, PalAsvAdaH, suKAnuBavaH, suKAsvAdaH.

FRUIT: (1) (lit. and fig.), raw, ripe, dry, juicy, insect-contaminated f.: AmaM, pakvaM, SuzkaM, sarasaM, kIwadgazitaM Palam, Bha.; and to enjoy the sweet f. s of the life-tree: BoktuM, svAdu PalaYca jIvitataroH, B. i.; you will get (its) f. also: Palamapi prApsyasi, Mr. ii.; considering very important production of f. s: garIyasIM PalanizpattiM vigaRayya, Ki. ii. 35.; (2) prasavaH (of trees, of animals), about f. s: prasavaM prati, M. ix. 55.

FRUIT, TO BEAR: Palati (Pal, c. 1.), b. s f. among the good: Palati sADuzu, Ma. n.; your wishes have borne f.: tava kAmAH PalitAH, R.; about to b. f.: PalonmuKaH (KA, KaM), Vi.; b. f. in time: kAle PalaM baDnanti, R. xii. 69.

FRUIT , s. (Produce of a tree or plant) PalaM, vfkzAdiPalaM, prasavaH vfkzotpannaM. — (Offspring) apatyaM, santAnaH, santatiH f., prajA, prasUtiH f., utpattiH f. — (Effect, consequence) utpannaM, utpattiH f., uqBUtaM, kAryyaM, vfttaM, PalaM, karmmaPalaM. — (Profit) PalaM, lABaH, arTaH; ‘moist fruit,’ SalAwuH m. f. n.; ‘dry fruit,’ vAnaH -nA -naM; ‘collection of fruit,’ PaloccayaH; ‘fruit season,’ PalakAlaH, PalasamayaH; ‘fruit-stalk,’ SasyamaYjarI, prasavabanDanaM; ‘to bear fruit,’ Pal (c. 1. Palati -lituM), PalaM dA; ‘bearing fruit,’ PalanizpattiH f.
FRUIT-BEARER , s. PaladAtA m. (tf), PalagrAhI m. (n), PalegrAhI m., PaladaH.
FRUIT-BEARING: (1) Palin (f. nI);(2) PalaBft (mfn.): v. Fruitful.
FRUIT-BEARING , a. PaladaH -dA -daM -dAyI -yinI -yi (n), PalagrahiH -hiH [Page295-a+ 51] -hi, PalegrahiH -hiH -hi, PalI -linI -li (n), PalavAn -vatI -vat (t), PalaSAlI -linI -li (n).
FRUIT-GARDEN: (1) PalavAwikA;(2) PalodyAnam, Raj.
FRUIT-TIME , s. PalakAlaH, PalasamayaH, PalAvacayakAlaH, PalasaNgrahakAlaH.
FRUIT-TREE: (1) PalavAn vfkzaH, etc.;(2) vanaspatiH (large f.), B. ii. 33.
FRUIT-TREE , s. PaladaH, PalagrAhI m. (n), saPalavfkzaH.
FRUITEFULLY: (1) Palavat;(2) saPalam;(3) pracuram (= copiously).
FRUITERER: (1) Palavikrotf (f. trI);(2) Palavikrayin (f. nI);(3) PalajIvin (f. nI).
FRUITERER , s. PalavikretA m. (tf), PalakrayavikrayikaH, PalAdivikrayI m. (n).
FRUITERY: I Fruits: PalAni (n. pl.).II A fruit-loft: PalAgAram.
FRUITERY , s. (Fruit collectively) PalatvaM, PalAni n. pl., PaloccayaH. — (Fruit-loft) PalasTAnaM, PalAgAraM.

FRUITFUL: (1) Palavat (f. tI);(2) Palin (f. nI); (3) PalaSAlin (f. nI), f. action: PalaSAlinI kriyA, Ki. ii. 36.;(4) PaladaH (dA, daM), PaladAyin (f. nI), etc. (= fruit-producing), as a germ would become f. in time: yaTANkuraH kAle Palaprado mavet, Bha.

FRUITFUL , a. PalI -linI -li (n), PalavAn -vatI -vat (t), bahuPalaH -lA -lI -laM, PalitaH -tA -taM, saPalaH -lA -laM, pracuraPalaH -lA -laM, PaladaH -dA -daM -dAyI -yinI -yi (n), bahuPaladaH -dA -daM, PalotyAdakaH -kA -kaM, PalegrahiH -hiH -hi, kftaPalaH -lA -laM, PalopetaH -tA -taM, abanDyaH -nDyA -nDyaM. — (Prolific) bahuprajaH -jA -jaM, bahuprajAvAn -vatI -vat (t), bahvapatyaH -tyA -tyaM, prajanizRuH -zRuH -zRu. — (Productive of) utpAdakaH -kA -kaM, janakaH -kA -kaM, sAvakaH -vikA -kaM.
FRUITFULLY , adv. saPalaM, sabahuPalaM, PalabAhulpena, bahuSas, pracuraM.
FRUITFULNESS: (1) PalavattA;(2) PalaSAlitA; (3) Palapradatvam.

FRUITFULNESS , s. sAPalyaM, saPalatA, PalavattvaM, PalitA, PalabAhulyaM, Pala- -prAcuryyaM, PalotpAdakatvaM. — (Fecundity) prajanizRutA, bahuprajAvattvaM, bahvapatyatvaM, sPItiH f., prasavitvaM, sAvakatvaM. — (Productiveness) utpAda- -katA, janakatA.
FRUITION: samBogaH: v. Enjoyment.
FRUITION , s. BogaH, BuktiH f., upaBogaH, pariBogaH, PalaBogaH, anuBavaH, AsvAdaH -danaM, suKaBogaH, suKAsvAdaH.
FRUITIVE , a. PalaBogI -ginI -gi (n), upaBogI &c., pariBoktA -ktrI -ktf (ktf).
FRUITLESS (1) nizPalaH (lA, laM), by all means (your) wisdom is f.: sarvaTA nizPalA prajYA, K.; (2) viPalaH (lA, laM);(3) aPalaH (lA, laM); (4) PalahInaH (nA, naM);(5) PalaSUnyaH (nyA, nyaM); etc.

FRUITLESS , a. nizPalaH -lA -laM, viPalaH -lA -laM, aPalaH -lA -laM, PalahInaH -nA -naM, PalApetaH -tA -taM, moGaH -GA -GaM, anarTaH -rTA -rTaM -rTakaH -kA -kaM, vyarTaH -rTA -rTaM, nirarTakaH -kA -kaM, apArTaH -rTA -rTaM, anupayuktaH -ktA -ktaM, nizprayojanaH -nA -naM, banDyaH -nDyA -nDyaM.
FRUITLESSLY: (1) nizPalam;(2) viPalam;(3) vyarTam (= in vain: q.v.).
FRUITLESSLY , adv. nizPalaM, viPalaM, moGaM, vyarTaM, vfTA, muDA.
FRUITLESSNESS , s. nizPalatA, viPalatA, vEPalyaM, aPalatvaM, PalahInatA, vyarTatA, vEyarTyaM, anarTakatvaM, moGatA, anupayogaH, banDyatvaM.
FRUITY , a. PalasarasaH -sA -saM, PalarasopetaH -tA -taM, PalopamaH -mA -maM.
Frumentaceous, a. goDUmamaya (yI f.).
FRUMENTACEOUS , a. goDUmamayaH -yI -yaM, DAnyamayaH -yI -yaM, SasyamayaH -yI -yaM.
Frump, s. karkaSA, kEkeyI.

Frustrate, v. t. viPalI-nizPalI-moGI-kf 8 U, prati-vyA-han 2 P, BaMj 7 P, KaMq 10, vfTA-muDA-kf; See Baffle. a. Fruitless, q. v. [Frustrat]ed, a. prati-vyA-hata, moGIkfta, vfTABUta; ‘f(rustrated) in attempts or hopes’ Bagnodyama, vyarTaprayatna, BagnasaMkalpa; BagnASa, akftArTa, mo-GASa, KaMqitASa, pratihata, pratibadDa. [Frustrat]ion, s. BaMgaH, vyAGAtaH, viPalIkaraRaM, KaMqanaM. [Frustrat]ive, [Frustrat]ory, a. vyAGAtin, BaMjaka, vfTAkArin.

FRUSTRATE: (1) viPalIkaroti, whose efforts were f. d: viPalIkftayatna (f. tnA) Ki. xv. 46.;(2) vyarTI- karoti, finding her undertaking f. d: asyA vyavasAyaM vyarTIkftamavasAya, N. iii. 6.;(3) moGIkaroti; (4) nizPalIkaroti;(5) viPalaM (f. lAM), moGaM (f. GAM), etc. karoti, vitanoti (tan, c. 8.) or vidaDAti (DA, c. 3.). To be f. d: viPalIBavati, etc., K.

To FRUSTRATE , v. a. KaRq (c. 10. KaRqayati -yituM), pratihan (c. 2. -hanti -ntuM), vyAhan, viPalIkf, nizPalIkf, moGIkf, vyarTIkf, saNkalpaM han or BaYj (c. 7. Banakti, BaMktuM), vfTA kf, muDA kf, yatnaM or ASAM KaRq, BagnASaM -SAM -SaM kf, viPalaM -lAM -laM, kf, tiroBU in caus. (-BAvayati -yituM); ‘to be frustrated,’ vfTA BU, muDA BU, tiroBU.
FRUSTRATE , a. nizPalaH -lA -laM, viPalaH -lA -laM, moGaH -GA -GaM, vyarTaH -rTA -rTaM, nizprayojanaH -nA -naM, anizpannaH -nnA -nnaM.

FRUSTRATED , p. p. KaRqitaH -tA -taM, pratihataH -tA -taM, vyAhataH -tA -taM, viPalIkftaH -tA -taM, moGIkftaH -tA -taM, vfTABUtaH -tA -taM, vyarTIkftaH -tA -taM, manohataH -tA -taM; ‘in one's efforts,’ BagnodyamaH -mA -maM, KaRqitayatnaH -tnA -tnaM, vyarTayatnaH -tnA -tnaM, BagnasaNkalpaH -lpA -lpaM; ‘in one's expectations,’ BagnASaH -SA -SaM, hatASaH -SA -SaM, KaRqitASaMsaH -sA -saM, ASAviBinnaH -nnA -nnaM, moGavAYCitaH -tA -taM, anaDigatamanoraTaH -TA -TaM, akftArTaH -rTA -rTaM, BrazwasaNkalpaH -lpA -lpaM.
FRUSTRATION: (1) by verb;(2) BaNgaH;(3) ziGAtaH or vyAGAtaH.

FRUSTRATION , s. KaRqanaM, BaNgaH, viPalIkaraRaM, nizPalIkaraRaM, moGIkaraRaM, vyarTIkaraRaM, vfTAkaraRaM, vyAGAtaH. — (Of expectation) ASAKaRqanaM, ASABaNgaH. — (Of effort) yatnaKaRqanaM, yatnavyAGAtaH, karmmaDvaMsaH.
FRUSTRATIVE , FRUSTRATORY, a. vyarTakArI -riRI -ri (n), viPalakArI &c., moGakArI &c., vfTAkArI &c., KaRqanakArI &c., GAtI -tinI [Page295-b+ 51] -ti (n), BaYjakaH -kA -kaM, vyAGAtajanakaH -kA -kaM.
Frutescent, a. gulmAvfta.
FRUTESCENT , a. gulmI -lminI -lmi (n), stambakAraH -rI -raM.
FRUTICANT , a. aNkuritaH -tA -taM, pallavitaH -tA -taM, pallavI -vinI -vi (n).

Fry, s. kzudramatsyasaMGaH, matsyasaMGAtaH, potADAnaM. 2 mInAMqaM. v. t. Brasj 6 P or c. (Barjayati), pac 1 P, Bfjj 1 A. [Fry]ing, s. BarjanaM, pacanaM; ‘f(rying)-pan’ piWaraH-raM, BfjjanaM, BrAzwraH, BarjanapAtraM, aMbarIzaM; fjIzaM, pizwapacanaM; (for liquor) svedanI, kaMdu-dU m. f. [Fri]ed, a. Brazwa, Barjita, kaMdupakva; ‘f(ried) grain’ DAnAH (f. pl.), BrazwayavAH, lAjAH (m. pl.).
FRY (subs.): I Of fishes:(1) kzudramatsyasaMGAtaH; (2) potADAnam (= small f.), A.II Of men: “even the smaller f.”: kzudrA api.
FRY (v. t.): Barjayati, saM-, ni-, (c. of Bfj), to f. with oil: tEle Barjayati, Bha. F. ed meat: mfzwaM mAMsam, Bha.
FRY , s. (Swarm of fish) matsyasaNGAtaH, matsyasaNGaH, kzudramatsyasamUhaH, kzudrARqamatsyasaNGAtaH, potADAnaM. — (Spawn) jalARqakaH, mInARqaM. — (Any thing fried) BfzwAnnaM.
To FRY , v. a. Brajj (c. 6. Bfjjati -te, BrazwuM, BarzwuM), Bfj (c. 1. Barjate -rjituM), ambarIze pac (c. 1. pacati, paktuM).
To FRY , v. n. Bfj in pass. (Bfjyate), BfzwaH -zwA -zwaM BU, pac in pass. (pacyate).
FRYING , s. BarjjanaM, Bfjjane or ambarIze pacanaM or pAkaH.
FRYING-PAN: (1) BrAzwam;(2) Brajjanam;(3) ambarIzam.
FRYING-PAN , s. ambarIzaM, BrAzwraH, fjIzaM, BfjjanaM, BarjjanayantraM, kawahaH, kanduH -ndUH m. f. n., svedanI, KallikA.
FUCATED , a. citritaH -tA -taM, miTyArAgAnvitaH -tA -taM, kapawarAgAnvitaH &c.
Fuddle, v. t. mad c., madena muh c. v. i. mad 4 P. [Fuddl]er, s. pAnAsaktaH, pAnarataH.
To FUDDLE , v. a. mad in caus. (madayati, mAdayati -yituM) or unmad madyadAnena muh in caus. (mohayati -yituM) or mUQIkf.
To FUDDLE , v. n. mad (c. 4. mAdyati, madituM), mattIBU, madyapAnena mUQIBU.
FUDDLED: madena or maDunA hftacetanaH (nA, naM), K. s.
FUDDLED , p. p. mattaH -ttA -ttaM, madyapAnena unmattaH -ttA -ttaM or mUQaH -QA -QaM, madonmattaH -ttA -ttaM, mUQabudDiH -dDiH -dDi.
FUDDLER , s. pAnarataH, pAnaprasaktaH, madyapAnAsaktaH, pAnaSORqaH.
Fudge, s. anarTakaM, asaMbadDaM. v. i. asaMbadDaM jalp 1 P.
FUDGE: an exclamation: (1) halam;(2) kam; (3) Pas (?).
FUDGE , s. anarTakaM, AnarTakyaM, asambadDaM, mfzArTakaM.
Fuel, s. iMDanaM, eDas n., eDaH, iDmaM, samiD f., samiMDanaM; ‘add f(uel) to the flames’ kzate kzAraM prakzip 6 P.
FUEL: (1) inDanam;(2) samiD (f.);(3) eDas (n.); (4) iDmam. Ph.: to add. f. to the flames: kzAraM kzate prakzipati, Mr.
FUEL , s. inDanaM, iDmaM, samit f. (D), saminDanaM, eDaH n. (s), dAhyakAzWaM, araRiH m. f., dAhyaM, jvalanArTam aNgArakAzWAdi.
To FUEL , v. a. inDanaM, dA, kAzWAdIni dAhyavastUni upasTA in caus. (-sTApa- -yati -yituM) or agnO kzip (c. 6. kzipati, kzeptuM).
Fugacious, a. palAyanaSIla, palAyanapara; a-sTira, capala, lola.
FUGACIOUS , a. palAyI -yinI -yi (n), prapalAyI &c., vipalAyI &c., palAyanaSIlaH -lA -laM, palAyamAnaH -nA -naM, asTAyI -yinI -yi (n).
FUGACIOUSNESS , FUGACITY, s. palAyanaSIlatA, asTAyitvaM, caYcalatvaM.
Fugitive, s. kftapalAyanaH, palAyin m., kAM-diSIkaH. a. palAyin, palAyanapara-SIla. 2 capala, tarala, caMcala, asTira.
FUGITIVE (adj.); I Fleeting: q.v.:(1) caYcalaH (lA, laM);(2) acirasTAyin (f. nI).II Running away: palAyitaH (tA, taM); kftapalAyanaH (nA, naM).
FUGITIVE (subs.): kftapalAyaRaH (nA, naM); palAyana- kArin (f. RI).

FUGITIVE , a. (Apt to flee away) prapalAyI -yinI -yi (n), palAyana- -parAyaRaH -RA -RaM. — (Unstable, fleeting) asTiraH -rA -raM, acirasTAyI -yinI -yi (n), caYcalaH -lA -laM, capalaH -lA -laM, aSASvataH -tI -taM, kzaRikaH -kI -kaM, aniyataH -tA -taM, asurakzaH -kzA -kzaM, vAzpaDarmmakaH -kA -kaM, taralaH -lA -laM.
FUGITIVE , s. palAyI m. (n), vipalAyI m., yudDatyAgI m. (n), senAtyAgI m. -tyaktA m. (ktf), yudDaparANmuKaH.
FUGITIVENESS , s. cAYcalyaM, caYcalatA, asTEryyaM, asTiratA, cApalyaM, taralatA, acirasTAyitvaM.
Fulcrum, s. ADAraH, upastaM(zwaM)BaH, AlaMbaH, ASrayaH.
